entries.title: Weekly JOI Bulletin Vol.27 | Weekly Otaku Roundup: Splatoon Direct, Pokémon 30th Anniversary UT, Hatsune Miku Night Sky Program & More Hot Topics [JOI Weekly 6/22-28]
entries.title_ja: 週間JOI通信 Vol.27｜今週のヲタ界隈総まとめ！スプラ新作Direct・ポケモン30周年UT・初音ミク夜空プログラムほか注目情報が目白押し【週間JOI通信 6/22-28】
entries.description:
This week (6/22-28) in the otaku world was packed with exciting news! From the reveal of the first Splatoon spinoff title info, Uniqlo's Pokémon 30th Anniversary UT and Disney Princess UT 2nd wave, to detailed announcements for the Hatsune Miku Night Sky Program in Niigata—anime, games, merchandise, and events were all buzzing. The VTuber scene saw the debut of quiz-focused unit 'Q-girls,' while the figure world welcomed creative releases like UNDERTALE's knitted-style figure and Dragon Quest encounter capsule toys. The cosplay community also brought vibrant energy throughout the week!

## 🎮 ゲーム界のホットトピック

### スプラトゥーン初スピンオフ『スプラトゥーン レイダース』Direct配信決定！
任天堂から嬉しいニュースが飛び込んできました。6月30日23時より『スプラトゥーン レイダース Direct 2026.6.30』が配信決定！シリーズ初のスピンオフ作品となる本作の新情報を約15分にわたってお届けするとのこと。イカたちの新たな冒険に期待が高まります。

### ポケモン30周年記念UT第2弾がユニクロから登場
ポケモンファン必見！ユニクロから『ポケモン』30周年記念UT第2弾が発売予定。ピカチュウや歴代主人公たちをシリーズの原点であるモノクロのゲームドット絵で表現した、ノスタルジックかつスタイリッシュなデザインが魅力です。初代プレイヤーなら胸アツ間違いなし。

### Steam注目セール情報
今週はSteamでもアツい動きが。名作ADV『デトロイト：ビカム ヒューマン』が4,500円→450円の90%オフで登場（1,500万本突破の傑作がワンコイン以下！）、人気ハクスラARPG『Grim Dawn』も2,800円→280円、動物園シム『プラネット ズー』は驚異の95%オフで4,750円→237円に。続編発売を控えた今がチャンスです。

---

## 🎭 VTuber＆アニメの最新動向

### クイズ動画VTuberユニット『Qがーる』始動
なんかたのしい株式会社から、クイズ動画に特化した新VTuberユニット『Qがーる』がデビュー。クイズ×VTuberという新ジャンルの開拓に注目が集まっています。『この動画がすごい！』では今週のおすすめVTuber動画（～6月26日）も紹介されており、チェック必須です。

### 『ホロライブ』デフォルメコレクション第4弾
大空スバル、さくらみこ、白上フブキ、星街すいせいの4人が象徴的なアイテムと共にデフォルメフィギュア化。可愛らしいミニサイズながら各メンバーの個性をしっかり表現した、ファン垂涎のアイテムです。

---

## 🗿 フィギュア＆グッズの注目リリース

### 『UNDERTALE』フラウィが"あみぐるみ風"フィギュアに
日本あみぐるみ協会監修の新感覚フィギュアが登場！編み物のような質感を立体で再現した、これまでにないタイプのフィギュアです。フラウィのあの不気味な笑顔が、どこか温かみのある仕上がりに。

### 『ドラクエ』エンカウント再現ガシャポン
フィールド上でモンスターに遭遇する瞬間を立体化したガシャポンが素敵すぎる！草原や海辺などのフィールドパーツも付属し、ケースはそのままテラリウムとして飾れる仕様。ドラクエファンの心をくすぐるアイテムです。

### 『ワンピース』エルバフ編ガシャポン第27弾
ギア5ルフィ、エルバフ編から初登場のロキなど全6人を収録した『ワンピの実』最新弾がオンライン販売開始。原作の盛り上がりをリアルタイムで楽しめるラインナップです。

### その他注目グッズ
- **『ドラゴンボール』一番くじ**：かめはめ波構える悟空、ベジータ、悟飯らが大技と共に立体化
- **『ドラえもん』UDF新作**：手のひらサイズのドラえもん＆のび太、ジャイアン＆ムクがキュート
- **ガンダムシリーズ ラバーコースター第2弾**：シャアやララァ専用モビルアーマーなど全8種

---

## 🎪 イベント＆コラボ情報

### 初音ミク 夜空プログラム 2026（新潟）第二弾情報解禁
新潟開催の『初音ミク 夜空プログラム 2026』がメインビジュアル公開、DJイベント開催など最新情報を続々発表。ミクファンは現地参戦の準備を！

### コラボグッズ＆ショップ展開
- **しまむら×サンリオキャラクターズ**：7月1日から歯ブラシセットや手帳ポーチなど新作グッズ発売
- **ローソン×森永製菓**：チョコボール、ラムネ、おっとっとのキャラが立体シールに
- **ユニクロ×ディズニープリンセス新作UT**：ラプンツェル、エルサら個性光る全4種
- **ユニクロ×スヌーピー新作UT**：7月6日発売、遊び心溢れるユーモアがテーマ

### コスプレシーンの盛り上がり
今週も『崩スタ』キュレネ、『原神』マーヴィカ、『涼宮ハルヒ』長門有希など、人気作品の美麗コスプレが多数話題に。8月のコスプレイベント情報もまとめられており、夏コミ準備も本格化してきました。

---

## 📅 来週の注目ポイント

1. **6月30日23時『スプラトゥーン レイダース Direct』配信** – スピンオフ作品の全貌が明らかに！
2. **7月1日しまむら×サンリオ新作グッズ発売開始** – 店頭チェックをお忘れなく
3. **7月上旬の各種UT・一番くじ情報** – ポケモン、スヌーピー、ディズニープリンセスなど続々展開予定

今週はゲームリリース情報からグッズ展開、イベント詳細まで幅広く動きがありました。来週も新情報が目白押しの予感……引き続きJapan OTAKU Insiderで最新ニュースをチェックしていきましょう！

entries.article_markdown_en:
## 🎮 Hot Gaming Topics

### First Splatoon Spinoff 'Splatoon Raiders' Direct Announced!
Exciting news from Nintendo: The 'Splatoon Raiders Direct 2026.6.30' will stream on June 30 at 23:00 JST! This ~15-minute presentation will unveil new details about the series' first-ever spinoff title. Squid fans, get ready for a fresh adventure!

### Pokémon 30th Anniversary UT Wave 2 from Uniqlo
Pokémon fans, rejoice! Uniqlo is releasing the second wave of Pokémon 30th Anniversary UTs, featuring Pikachu and protagonists rendered in nostalgic monochrome game-dot style—a tribute to the series' origins. Original trainers will feel the nostalgia!

### Steam Sales Spotlight
Steam had some scorching deals this week: the acclaimed ADV 'Detroit: Become Human' (15M+ copies sold) dropped from ¥4,500 to ¥450 (90% off—under a coin!), popular hack-and-slash ARPG 'Grim Dawn' fell to ¥280 from ¥2,800, and zoo sim 'Planet Zoo' hit a staggering 95% off at ¥237 (down from ¥4,750). Perfect timing before the sequel launches!

---

## 🎭 VTuber & Anime Updates

### Quiz-Focused VTuber Unit 'Q-girls' Debuts
Nankatanoshii Inc. launched 'Q-girls,' a quiz-video-specialized VTuber unit. This quiz × VTuber crossover is carving out a new genre niche. Don't miss 'This Video is Amazing! Recommended VTuber Videos of the Week (~June 26)' for more must-watch content.

### Hololive Deformed Collection Vol. 4
Oozora Subaru, Sakura Miko, Shirakami Fubuki, and Hoshimachi Suisei are immortalized as adorable deformed figures alongside their iconic items. Compact yet brimming with personality—fan favorites for sure!

---

## 🗿 Figure & Merchandise Highlights

### UNDERTALE Flowey Gets 'Amigurumi-Style' Figure
Supervised by the Japan Amigurumi Association, this innovative figure recreates knitted texture in 3D form. Flowey's unsettling grin takes on an unexpectedly cozy vibe—truly one-of-a-kind!

### Dragon Quest Encounter Capsule Toy
This gashapon captures the magic moment of field encounters with monsters! Complete with grassland and seaside terrain parts, the case doubles as a displayable terrarium. A heartwarming throwback for DQ fans.

### One Piece Elbaf Arc Gashapon Vol. 27
Featuring Gear 5 Luffy, newly introduced Loki from the Elbaf arc, and four others—all six characters are now available online. Perfect for riding the manga's current hype wave!

### Other Notable Goods
- **Dragon Ball Ichiban Kuji**: Goku charging Kamehameha, Vegeta, Gohan, and more in dynamic attack poses
- **Doraemon UDF Series**: Palm-sized Doraemon & Nobita, Gian & Muku in adorable form
- **Gundam Rubber Coaster Vol. 2**: Char, Lalah's Mobile Armor, and 6 other designs

---

## 🎪 Events & Collaborations

### Hatsune Miku Night Sky Program 2026 (Niigata) Wave 2 Info Released
The Niigata event unveiled its main visual and DJ event lineup. Miku fans, start planning your pilgrimage!

### Collab Goods & Shop Launches
- **Shimamura × Sanrio Characters**: New goods (toothbrush sets, notebook pouches, etc.) drop July 1
- **Lawson × Morinaga Confectionery**: Chocoball, Ramune, and Ottotto mascots as 3D stickers
- **Uniqlo × Disney Princess UT**: Rapunzel, Elsa, and more in 4 unique designs
- **Uniqlo × Snoopy UT**: Launching July 6 with playful, humor-infused themes

### Cosplay Scene Buzzing
This week saw stunning cosplays of *Zenless Zone Zero*'s Koleda, *Genshin Impact*'s Mavuika, and *The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya*'s Yuki Nagato trending. August cosplay event schedules are also out—Comiket prep is heating up!

---

## 📅 Next Week's Watch List

1. **June 30, 23:00 JST: Splatoon Raiders Direct streams** – Full spinoff reveal incoming!
2. **July 1: Shimamura × Sanrio goods launch** – Hit stores early for the best picks
3. **Early July UT & Ichiban Kuji releases** – Pokémon, Snoopy, Disney Princess waves rolling out

This week brought a whirlwind of game announcements, merchandise drops, and event details. Next week promises even more—stay tuned to Japan OTAKU Insider for the latest!

entries.description: “Fast and Furious” 25th Anniversary Edo Kiriko Glass is now available from Imperial Enterprises! Dominic Toretto's favorite car and the arc of his drift are expressed in hand-cut fish pattern! Limited to 250 pieces with edition number #Fast & Furious

entries.title: We announced the launch of "Power Animal Series Extra" for "Hyakujuu Sentai Gaoranger" at the Candy Toy Plastic Kit SMP 10th Anniversary Online Distribution Event! Introducing the first three items that show off the new combination of beasts!
entries.title_ja: 食玩プラキットSMP10周年オンライン配信イベントにて『百獣戦隊ガオレンジャー』の「パワーアニマルシリーズ エクストラ」始動を発表！新たな百獣合体を見せる第1陣3アイテムを一挙紹介!!
entries.description: “Power Animal Series Extra” is now available at SMP! Pre-orders for the first batch of items “Gao Peacock & Gao Cobra”, “Gao Turtle & Gao Toppy”, and “Gao Wallaby” are now available at Premium Bandai! There is also a bonus for purchasing 3 items! #SMP #Gaoranger

entries.title: A three-dimensional figure of her cute and cute casual clothes. Figure “Miko Sakura Date Style Casual Clothes Ver.” will be released in September 2027
entries.title_ja: みこちらしいキュートな私服姿を立体化。フィギュア「さくらみこ Date Style 私服衣装 Ver.」が2027年9月に発売
entries.description: Max Factory will release the figure "Sakura Miko Date Style Casual Clothes Ver." in September 2027. The price is 24,800 yen.

entries.title: A yuri romance game from an “angel’s perspective” “Are we fake marriages?” ” to be released on August 25th. A work that attracts a lot of attention from yuri fans who guide the character as a third party and "don't get caught between the couple"
entries.title_ja: “天使視点”の百合恋愛ゲーム『私たちフェイクマリッジ？』8月25日発売へ。第三者としてキャラを導く、「カップルの間に挟まらない」百合ファンから大注目の作品
entries.description: On June 25th, Sekai Project released an article titled “Are we fake marriages? ” was announced to be released on August 25th.

entries.title: A new work for Famicom/NES created by a former KONAMI staff member, ``I'll never forget the flow and the roar of the waves.'' The story of the speedy and difficult ACT and the hearts of the girls unfolds.
entries.title_ja: 元KONAMIスタッフが制作するファミコン/NES用新作「フローと感じたあの潮騒を決して忘れない」。スピーディーな高難度ACTと少女たちの心の物語が展開
entries.description: The Steam store page for the new work for Famicom/NES, ``I'll Never Forget Flow and the Sound of the Sea'' created by a former KONAMI staff member, has been released. A platform action game in which the beautiful girl ``Lyra'' explores a mysterious island, featuring speedy, highly difficult action and a story of her heart that changes depending on the choices she makes regarding her character.

entries.title: “Counter specialized” martial arts Soul-like “Monkey Ken” is a severe specification with “no evasion”. We asked how to balance this intense action game that combines offense and defense.
entries.title_ja: “カウンター特化”武術ソウルライク『猿公剣』は、あえて「回避なし」のシビア仕様。攻防一体の骨太アクション、バランスの取り方を訊いた
entries.description: We bring you the contents of an interview we conducted with the producer of "SWORD SAGE: AWAKENING".

entries.title: Martial Arts Girl Soul-like ``Sarukoken'' has a highly difficult and intense ``close-out counter action''. I tried out a remarkable work that has undergone super evolution.
entries.title_ja: 武術少女ソウルライク『猿公剣』は「見切りカウンターアクション」が高難度で濃厚。超進化を遂げた注目作を試遊してきた
entries.description: The latest demo of ``SWORD SAGE: AWAKENING'' has undergone a dramatic evolution.

entries.title: Major semiconductor companies have expressed their view that "memory shortages will continue into 2027." Global memory shortage that caused “game console price hike rush”; supply improvement likely to occur “after 2028”
entries.title_ja: 半導体大手各社、「メモリ不足は2027年も続く」との見方示す。“ゲーム機値上げラッシュ”も引き起こした世界的メモリ不足、供給改善は「2028年以降」か
entries.description: Micron held a financial results briefing for the third quarter of 2026 on June 24, local time. Sanjay Mehrotra, the company's chief business officer, said he expects supply to improve only after 2028.

entries.title: Giant monster "excavation" FPS "KAIJECT" announced. Internal destruction exploration action that “freely digs inside the monster’s body” and searches for weak points.
entries.title_ja: 巨大怪獣「掘削」FPS『KAIJECT』発表。怪獣の体内を“自由に掘り進めて”弱点を探す、体内破壊探索アクション
entries.description: Gryphon's Nest announced the monster-killing FPS "KAIJECT" on June 25th. This is a first-person action game where you aim to invade the body of a giant monster and destroy it from within.

entries.title: "Neko Neko Soft"'s new visual novel "Koi Shiboshi ~Letter from the Lost House~" will be released on July 10th. A heart-wrenching tale about a girl and a “lost house” presented by Tomo Kataoka of “Narcissus”
entries.title_ja: 「ねこねこソフト」新作ビジュアルノベル『恋しかるべき ～迷い家からの手紙～』7月10日配信へ。『ナルキッソス』片岡とも氏が贈る、「迷い家」と少女にまつわる切ない奇譚
entries.description: OVERLAP GAMES announced on June 26th that ``Koi Shikiboshi ~Letter from the Lost House~'' will be released on July 10th.

entries.title: “Beginner support function” has been implemented in the new update of Square Enix deception multiplayer “KILLER INN”. Now 75% off, easy to get started, cheaper than gyudon
entries.title_ja: スクエニ騙し合いマルチ『KILLER INN（キラーイン）』新アプデで“初心者応援機能”実装。今なら75%オフで始めやすい、牛丼より安い
entries.description: Square Enix released patch ver.0.9.4 for ``KILLER INN'' on June 26th. Now it's 300 yen.

entries.title: Game production and youth group drama ADV "FORTUNE x WORLD ~The reason why we make games~" will be released on October 30th. A new work from the developer of “From Einstein with Love” that lets you relive the “light and darkness” of creating a beautiful girl game.
entries.title_ja: ゲーム制作・青春群像劇ADV『FORTUNE×WORLD～僕らがゲームを作る理由～』10月30日発売へ。美少女ゲーム制作の“光と闇”を追体験する、『アインシュタインより愛を込めて』開発元新作
entries.description: GLOVETY announced on June 26th that ``FORTUNE x WORLD ~The reason we make games~'' will be released on October 30th. This work is a beautiful girl ADV that allows you to relive the light and darkness of game creativity.

entries.title: Steam cooperative roguelike "Barony" achieved "1 million sales" in 11 years. A super late-blooming game that's not selling slowly but is "now in its prime"
entries.title_ja: Steam協力ローグライク『Barony』11年目にして「売上100万本」達成。じわ売れどころか“今が全盛期”、超遅咲きゲーム
entries.description: Turning Wheel reported on June 26 that sales of the roguelike game ``Barony'' exceeded 1 million copies.

entries.title: Rhythm adventure "UNBEATABLE" will be available in Japanese on July 27th. Distribution of Ver2.0 with various updates has also started
entries.title_ja: リズムアドベンチャー「UNBEATABLE」，7月27日に日本語対応が決定。さまざまなアップデートを行うVer2.0の配信もスタート
entries.description: Playstack announced today (June 26, 2026) that it will distribute version 2.0 of "UNBEATABLE" developed by D-CELLGAMES, and will release the first major DLC "Jamie Page Content Companion" on July 27th. The game will also be localized into Japanese on the same day.

entries.title: Various soundtracks for the "Star Ocean" series are now available on Steam. We are also holding a summer sale where you can buy soundtracks from Square Enix works at a great price.
entries.title_ja: 「スターオーシャン」シリーズの各種サウンドトラックがSteamで発売。スクエニ作品のサントラをお得に買えるサマーセールも開催中
entries.description: Square Enix today (June 26, 2026) released music works (all 10 works) for the company's RPG "Star Ocean" series on Steam. A summer sale is also being held until around 2:00 on July 10th for music products from Square Enix works currently available on Steam.

entries.title: Multi-compatible Dragon Continent survival craft ``Runescape: Dragon Wilds'' is rapidly gaining popularity again. A large update finally supports Japanese, and the adventure life where battles and material collection are all done with magic
entries.title_ja: マルチ対応ドラゴン大陸サバイバルクラフト『ルーンスケープ：ドラゴンワイルズ』一気に人気再燃中。大型アプデでついに日本語対応、戦闘も素材集めも“全部魔法でヨシ”冒険ぐらし
entries.description: A major update has been released for ``Runescape: Dragon Wilds,'' and the game is proving popular, with the number of concurrently connected players exceeding 10,000.

entries.title: The hugely popular drawing hide-and-seek game “Meccha Chameleon” has sold over 10 million copies. Just 16 days after release, a huge record was achieved at an extremely fast pace.
entries.title_ja: 大ブームのお絵描きかくれんぼゲーム『めっちゃカメレオン』売上1000万本突破。リリースからわずか16日、超爆速で大記録達成
entries.description: On June 26th, Mr. LEMORION and Mr. HAGANEIRO announced that sales of ``Meccha Chameleon'' exceeded 10 million copies.

entries.title: While collecting supplies in the labyrinth, you will explore a different world with 50 floors spread out beneath the old school building. Dungeon crawl RPG “S.O.L School Of Labyrinth”, Steam store page released
entries.title_ja: 迷宮で物資を集めながら，旧校舎の地下に広がる全50階層の異界に挑む。ダンジョンクロールRPG「S.O.L School Of Labyrinth」，Steamストアページ公開
entries.description: Indie development team SUSHILab has released the Steam store page for their new title "S.O.LSchoolOfLabyrinth". This work is a dungeon crawl RPG that aims to return to everyday life by exploring a total of 50 floors of another world beneath the old school building, bringing back supplies and restoring the base.

entries.title: ``Kanji de GOGO!'', a quiz game that challenges you to dictate kanji, is now available on Steam. In addition to the easy-to-play mode, there is also a “serious” mode to challenge difficult words.
entries.title_ja: 漢字の書き取りに挑むクイズゲーム「漢字でGOGO!」，Steamで配信開始。遊びやすいモードだけでなく，難語に挑む“ガチ”モードも用意
entries.description: Today (June 26, 2026), individual developer Mr. Mise released his new title ``Kanji de GOGO!'' on Steam. You can enjoy the ``Entertainment'' mode for streamers and first-time players, the highly difficult ``Serious'' mode that includes phrases that are not commonly seen, and the ``Rush'' mode that allows you to concentrate on practicing specific difficulty levels.

entries.title: Cat-covered train abandonment game ``Cat Conductor'' will be released on July 13th. Customize the train to entertain cat passengers, with a live streaming link function that allows viewers to ride the train.
entries.title_ja: 猫まみれ電車放置系ゲーム『ネコの車掌さん』7月13日配信へ。列車をカスタマイズしてネコの乗客をおもてなし、“視聴者が乗車できる”実況配信連携機能あり
entries.description: Fly High Works announced on June 26th that ``The Cat Conductor'' will be released on July 13th. This is an idle game where you run a train carrying cat passengers.

entries.title: A former staff member says that the masterpiece FPS "Quake" was "worth making, but the company went bankrupt." Mr. Carmack and Mr. Romero also have bitter regrets about the overly ambitious 3D conversion.
entries.title_ja: 傑作FPS『Quake』は“作る価値があった、でも会社は壊れた”と元スタッフが吐露。野心的すぎた3D化に、カーマック氏やロメロ氏も苦い反省
entries.description: John Carmack, known as the co-founder of id Software, and fellow founder John Romero also looked back at the time, citing the post.

entries.title: ``Cozy Mining'', a soothing idle game that resides on your desktop, has been released on Steam. The character moves automatically and digs underground.
entries.title_ja: デスクトップ常駐型の癒し系放置ゲーム「Cozy Mining」，Steamでリリース。キャラクターが自動で移動し，地下を掘り進めていく
entries.description: Tatsumaki Games today released the PC game ``CozyMining''. This work is a soothing idle game that resides on the desktop. When you click on the destination, the character moves automatically and digs underground while collecting ore and treasure chests. There are 20 types of ore, ranging from copper to orichalcum, and you can forge a pickaxe with the materials you collect.

entries.title: ``The Demon Butler and the Black Cat'', the 19th butler ``Crowther Knox'' (CV: Kosuke Toriumi) has been added. A butler in charge of the second floor of the villa and a mafia boss.
entries.title_ja: 「悪魔執事と黒い猫」，19人目の執事「クロウザー・ノックス」（CV：鳥海浩輔）を追加。別邸2階を担当する執事であり，マフィアのボス
entries.description: Studio Wasabi today added a new butler, ``Crowther Knox'' (CV: Kosuke Toriumi), to the smartphone app ``Devil Butler and the Black Cat''. This work is a concierge game app in which unique butlers support you in your daily life.

entries.title: “The rock bottom of life” underground dungeon ADV “UNDERGROUNDED” will be released on July 3rd. A grand adventure of a young man with little luck in the underground world who was dumped and fell into the world.
entries.title_ja: “人生のどん底”地下ダンジョンADV『UNDERGROUNDED』7月3日配信へ。フラれて落ちた地下世界、幸薄青年の「アメリカぜんぶ盛り」壮大冒険
entries.description: room6 announced on June 26th that "UNDERGROUNDED" will be released on July 3rd.

entries.title: How was "Ryusei no Rockman" transformed into a game that can be played in a modern environment? We asked the Capcom development team about the behind-the-scenes aspects of the port, the history and merits of adopting "RE ENGINE," and even the forbidden question.
entries.title_ja: 『流星のロックマン』はいかにして現代の環境で遊べる姿に変身できたのか―移植実現の裏側と「RE ENGINE」採用の経緯とメリット、そして禁断の“あの”質問までカプコン開発チームに訊いた
entries.description: We asked him how ``Ryusei no Rockman'' Remaster was able to recreate a game created for a special platform in a modern environment.

entries.title: The daily life of a high school literature club begins to go haywire due to a certain notebook. Horror ADV "I entered" drawn with 256-color VGA-style graphics is released
entries.title_ja: 高校の文芸部での日常が，あるノートをきっかけに狂い始める。256色VGA風のグラフィックスで描かれるホラーADV「入ってしまった」が公開に
entries.description: Installingsomething has released a new title, ``I entered.'' This work is a horror adventure game set in a high school's literature club and depicts the daily life that starts to go awry after a certain notebook. The story branches depending on the player's choices, and different horrors await in each route.

entries.title: ``Security 51'' is a horror sim that monitors people going in and out of a facility to find non-humans, released on July 27th. Demo version currently available
entries.title_ja: 施設の出入りを監視して，人ならざるものを見つけ出すホラーシム「Security 51」，7月27日にリリース。現在デモ版を配信中
entries.description: Alawar announced today (June 26, 2026) that it will release a new title under development, "Security51", on July 27th. This is a horror simulation game where you play as a security guard at a mysterious facility in the basement of Area 51, managing access to the elevator area, which is considered the most dangerous area.

entries.title: Time that had stopped for two former lovers, a breakup man and a businessman, begins to move.
entries.title_ja: 別れさせ屋と実業家、元恋人の男性2人の止まっていた時間が動き出す
entries.description: The first and second volumes of Akane Abe's ``Goodbye is here'' were released simultaneously today, June 25th.

entries.title: Kenshi Yonezu's ``Crow'' short animation released, video produced by MAPPA
entries.title_ja: 米津玄師「烏」ショートアニメ公開、映像はMAPPAが手がける
entries.description: A short animation of Kenshi Yonezu's ``Crow'' created by MAPPA has been released on YouTube.

entries.title: "Don't touch Eizouken!" The 10th anniversary exhibition opens tomorrow! Sale of Onkyoku Bath bath tubs, etc.
entries.title_ja: 「映像研には手を出すな！」連載10周年展が明日開幕！音曲浴場の風呂桶など販売
entries.description: An exhibition event commemorating the 10th anniversary of the series ``Don't Mess with Eizouken!'' by Sumitomo Odo, ``Don't Mess with Eizouken!'' 10th Anniversary of the Serialization, will be held at Kitasenju Marui in Tokyo from June 26th to July 12th. The goods information was released today.

entries.title: What was supposed to be a “marriage licking the wounds” turns into doting love, a reversal love fantasy that begins with the engagement being broken.
entries.title_ja: “傷の舐め合い結婚”のはずが溺愛してきます、婚約破棄から始まる逆転ラブファンタジー
entries.description: Mayumu Manata's new series based on the original work by Chiko Mizuki, ``It's supposed to be a marriage to lick each other's wounds, but a cold-hearted knight loves me'' started today, June 25th, on COMIC Polaris.

entries.title: Maaya Uchida, Tomokazu Sugita, and Daisuke Ono will be featured in “Is it a landmine? Jibara-san” as well as the Jibara Mai music project.
entries.title_ja: 「地雷なんですか？地原さん」に内田真礼、杉田智和、小野大輔　地原舞音楽プロジェクトも
entries.description: The TV anime "What's the landmine? Jibara-san" based on the original work by Ryon will start broadcasting in the "Super Animeism TURBO" slot on 28 MBS/TBS stations from January 2027. Additional cast and staff have been announced.

entries.title: "Nano EXGV" Episode 1 in which a girl living on a remote island gets caught up in the fate surrounding a "demon"
entries.title_ja: 「なのはEXGV」離島で暮らす少女が“魔人”を巡る運命に巻きこまれる第1話
entries.description: The synopsis and advance cut of the first episode of the TV anime ``Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance'' have been released.

entries.title: "Another Stories", a collection of 12 extra stories of "Honey Lemon Soda" released
entries.title_ja: 「ハニーレモンソーダ」12の番外編をまとめた「Another Stories」発売
entries.description: Mayu Murata's ``Honey Lemon Soda Another Stories'' book was released today, June 25th.

entries.title: The new afternoon series “Hyakudai Weapon Book” is a war story of twin brother and sister about the most powerful “100 Weapons”
entries.title_ja: 最強の“兵器百本”を巡る双子の兄妹戦記、アフタヌーン新連載「百大兵器譜」
entries.description: Ryu Suenobu's new series ``Hyakudai Weapons Fu'' started in the August issue of Monthly Afternoon (Kodansha), released today, June 25th.

entries.title: ``The demon sword I bought online was really cool'' A college student who cut through space and went to another world becomes a samurai
entries.title_ja: 「通販で買った妖刀がガチだった」空間を切り裂き異世界に行った大学生、侍になる
entries.description: Shinme Futatsu's volume 1, ``The demon sword I bought online was really bad. When I tried cutting it, the space split open and I was sent to another world, and then I was mistaken for a legendary hero, so I'm in trouble.'' Volume 1 was released today, June 25th, by Hifumi Shobo. This is a comic adaptation based on the novel by Sora Hinokage.

entries.title: Hypnosis x Death Game: If you do no good, you will be forced to commit suicide, but I don't know what that is.
entries.title_ja: 催眠術×デスゲーム　NG行動をしたら強制自殺、けどそれが何かはわからない
entries.description: Furuike Penki's new series ``Suggestion of Death: Forced Hypnosis Death Game'' will be released today, June 25th, on Takeshobo's web manga site Takekomi! It started with This is a comic adaptation of Kenji Kuroda's novel.

entries.title: Scene cut from episode 1 of the anime “The Cat and the Dragon” released: A mother cat who just gave birth picks up a small dragon
entries.title_ja: アニメ「猫と竜」第1話場面カット公開　出産したばかりの母猫が小さな竜を拾う
entries.description: The scene cut and synopsis of the first episode of the TV anime "Neko and Ryu" have been released.

entries.title: "Yowamushi Pedal" Sakamichi Onoda appears on the cover of Tarzan, Wataru Watanabe also talks about stretching
entries.title_ja: 「弱虫ペダル」小野田坂道がTarzanの表紙に、渡辺航もストレッチについて語る
entries.description: Onoda Sakamichi from Wataru Watanabe's ``Yowamushi Pedal'' is featured on the cover of Tarzan issue 928 (Magazine House), released today, June 25th.

entries.title: Toshiyuki Toyonaga, Daisuke Ono, Koichi Yamadera and others participate in Gospellers' new song "A Cappella Ondo"
entries.title_ja: 豊永利行、小野大輔、山寺宏一らがゴスペラーズの新曲「アカペラ音頭」に参加
entries.description: The voice actors from the anime ``Acapella Samurai ~Hamori-tai Saves Edo!~'' participated in the music video for Gospellers' new song ``Acapella Ondo'' by providing character voices.

entries.title: MAGKAN's new series "Manifestation Kitan" is the story of an art college student who discovered a manju-shaped "manifestation"
entries.title_ja: おまんじゅう形の“顕現様”を発見した芸大生の物語　MAGKAN新連載「顕現奇譚」
entries.description: Makimi Miwa's new series ``Kengen Kitan'' started on MAGKAN today, June 25th. It is an ``academic spiritual story'' that unfolds when a ``manifestation'' shaped like a steamed bun appears to a male art university student.

entries.title: "I should have killed my husband" scene cut released, Rio Uchida sticking out a knife
entries.title_ja: 「夫を殺したはずなのに」場面カット公開、内田理央が包丁を突き出す
entries.description: The teaser video, scene photos, opening theme, and ending theme for the drama ``I Should Have Killed My Husband,'' based on the original work by Mana Akaishi and Digital Artisan, have been released. Additionally, a special program depicting a prequel to the main story will also be broadcast.

entries.title: Cover Co., Ltd., a distribution system that runs still image illustrations as VTubers, introduces it on a trial basis to mekPark and holoAN.
entries.title_ja: 静止画のイラストをVTuberとして動かす配信システム カバー株式会社がmekParkとholoANに試験導入
entries.description:
On June 22nd, Cover Co., Ltd. announced the development of a new distribution system. From June 24th, we began trial implementation in the VTuber groups mekPark and holoAN, which the company is involved with. mekPark's VTuber candidate unit UNI […]
The post Cover Co., Ltd., a distribution system that runs still image illustrations as VTubers, has introduced a trial version to mekPark and holoAN. Appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: 10 managers announced for Nijisanji Koshien 2026, the main match will be held for 3 days in August
entries.title_ja: にじさんじ甲子園2026の監督10名が発表、本戦は8月に3日間開催
entries.description:
This project is a game project using the Powerful Professional Baseball series. Nijisanji's VTuber will be the manager and train the team, which will compete against each other in the main tournament. This year, both the draft meeting and the main game will be held in 3D. Hosted by Keisuke Maimoto and Tsukasa Tenkai […]
The post 10 managers announced for Nijisanji Koshien 2026, the main match will be held for 3 days in August appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: Novel game “Wantama☆Life” starring male VTuber “Tamaki Inuyama” released! “Kagura Mea” and “Tsukudani Norio” also appear as themselves
entries.title_ja: 男の娘VTuber「犬山たまき」主演ノベルゲーム『わんたま☆らいふ』発売！「神楽めあ」「佃煮のりお」も本人役で登場
entries.description: Cyber ​​Step will be releasing a novel game starring VTuber “Tamaki Inuyama” from June 25th!

entries.title: “Uma Musume” “Satono Diamond” in the training center school uniform is now in a sitting position! The winking expression is super cute
entries.title_ja: 『ウマ娘』トレセン学園制服の「サトノダイヤモンド」がおすわり姿で立体化！ウインクする表情が超キュート

entries.title: ``Fallout: New Vegas'' director complains, ``Designing an armor system is too difficult.'' However, I am impressed that both the simple ``Tsushima'' and the well-crafted ``Kingdom Come'' are well-made.

entries.description: The difficulty of designing the armor system in 3DRPGs is discussed using specific titles as examples.

entries.title: Impressions of playing the live-action interactive drama game "Rise of the World: The Road to Empress I & II". "Play the taiga drama by yourself" "Experience turbulent fate from countless branches" simulator

entries.description: In ``Rising World: The Road to the Empress I'' and ``Rising World: The Road to the Empress II'', it was fun to play and relive the history of China from about 1,400 years ago like a taiga drama.

entries.title: Official release of ``Burger Bots Inc.'', an intergalactic hamburger shop sim with multiplayer support for up to 8 people. A busy work experience where you make and serve burgers, clean up, and fire a shotgun at unwanted customers.

entries.description: Normogames officially released Burger Bots Inc. on June 18th. This work has received high praise since early access.

entries.title: The development philosophy of ``Two Point'', a highly rated sim in the series, ``allows failure even though it is a full-fledged sim''. We also asked about the behind-the-scenes details of the new work ``Two Point Museum'', which has a lot of freedom, including collaboration with ``Vansaba''.
entries.title_ja: シリーズぜんぶ高評価シム『ツーポイント』の、「本格シムなのに失敗を許す」開発哲学。『ヴァンサバ』コラボなど自由すぎる新作『ツーポイントミュージアム』の裏側も訊いた
entries.description: Interview with studio director Gary Carr and technical director Ben Hymers. We had the opportunity to ask him a variety of interesting questions, from his memories of the studio to his future plans.

entries.title: Mythical hack-and-slash RPG "Titan Quest II" is thriving once again with new locations being implemented one after another in the "largest update ever." Walk through a vast and harsh wasteland ruled by a centaur king.

entries.title: How do foreign publishers view Japanese board games? Game Market 2026 Spring Board Game Roundtable Report

entries.description: We report on a board game roundtable discussion held by overseas publishers and distributors at Japan's largest analog game event, "Game Market 2026 Spring." I wonder how the game market event and Japanese board games are viewed from overseas.

The main theme of the keynote speech is "Unreal Engine 6," which is the next version of Unreal Engine. Let's summarize the keynote speech to see what UE6 will be like.

entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, the psychological horror ``MOLE'', in which players control a gigantic machine that digs through the post-war earth, and the 2.5D FPS ``Final Recovery SQUAD'', in which players control a 12m tall humanoid weapon and fight against swarms of alien weapons, were released.

entries.title: [Play report] "Pictonico!" is a game where you can play the photos on your smartphone. Get addicted to the many simple and surreal mini-games!

entries.description: Will the picture of you on your smartphone become the protagonist of a surreal mini-game? Have you played Nintendo's smartphone app "Pictonico!" yet? This game allows you to easily play surreal mini-games that pop up one after another in a short amount of time, but what about the privacy aspect? Let's introduce it, including things like this.

entries.title: [Interview] Congratulations on the 10th anniversary of Two Point Studios. The developers of the strange management sim "Two Point" series talk about the past, future, and relationship with the community.

entries.title: Two and a half years after its launch, why did Hololive's derivative game brand "holo Indie" shift to a seasonal system? The total number of downloads has exceeded 3 million, and we heard about Cover's unique "indie game" policy so far [Interview]

entries.description: Mr. Sansara plans to release ``Echowood'' on June 22nd. He recently lost his beloved dog, who was his companion for many years, and has implemented a "hidden quest" in the game to commemorate his beloved dog.

entries.title: ``Pickupbal'', a mysterious game that costs about 300 yen on Steam, has a ``99% positive rating'' and is a sign of a boom. A game where you can play with physics balls.

entries.description: Game developer Nikulas released ``Pickupbal'' on June 15th. It has continued to receive positive reviews since its release, with a 99% positive rating at the time of writing this article.

entries.title: ``Dave the Diver'' has exploded in popularity since its official release with over 47,000 users on Steam. Dave’s fever is reignited with the arrival of “Jungle” large-scale DLC

entries.title: Large-volume royal road SRPG “Euresia Heroic Chronicles” will be released for free on Steam on July 3rd. A strategic story with a less “luck-like” feel, filled with over 250,000 characters of text.

entries.title: Research on "controllers operated by the brain" is progressing. Will an input method that the brain remembers be a clue to practical use?

entries.title: "Dave the Diver" is not an indie game. However, things were difficult. We asked the developer about everything from success to hot topics to jungle DLC.

entries.description: We asked him about his behind-the-scenes stories from the release of the main game up to the present, and his thoughts on the definition of indie.

entries.title: Report on the "Father's Day Special Event" commemorating the huge hit of "Pragmata". Contains a lot of content such as development secrets and voice recording episodes.

entries.description: On June 18, 2026, Capcom held the "Pragmata Big Hit Commemoration! Father's Day Special Event" at esportsStyleUENO in Ueno, Tokyo. This event was planned as a token of gratitude for the worldwide sales of the company's sci-fi action adventure ``Pragmata,'' which exceeded 2 million copies in 16 days after its release.

entries.title: "Touken Ranbu ONLINE" and J.League collaboration project "Go! J.League Support Honmaru" has opened a special website. Pre-sale of goods begins

A special website has recently opened and pre-sale of goods has begun.

entries.description: The time may not be far off when AI agents will work in place of humans and take charge of economic activities. I would like to introduce a lecture on the theme of ``Games will be the first testing ground in an AI agent society.''

entries.description: IceLemonTeaStudio today (June 19, 2026) released the new title ``Thank you for your application'' on Steam. This is an interview simulation game set in a dystopian city in 2066, where you play as an interviewer at the city's largest company and review applicants' resumes based on strict hiring conditions.

entries.title: ``Spellsided'', a ``dice building strategy RPG'' where magic dice explore the world, has been decided to be available in Japanese. Trial version can also be played in Japanese

entries.description: Funselektor and Strelka Games released a trial version of "over the hill" on June 12th. This work is about exploring an open world wilderness while riding an off-road vehicle. A trial version is currently available and has quickly become popular.

entries.title: The new florist sim ``Puni the Florist'' is slowly starting to receive high praise with a ``98% popularity rate'' for its relaxing and free bouquet designs. Experience arranging things with “a little ingenuity” while responding to customer requests.
entries.title_ja: 新人お花屋さんシム『Puni the Florist』、まったり自由花束デザインで“好評率98％”のじわじわ高評価スタート。客のリクエストに応えつつ、「ちょっとした工夫」でアレンジ体験
entries.description: Developer Earthquack Games released the flower shop sim ``Puni the Florist'' on June 8th. This work is slowly gaining positive reviews while maintaining a high rating.

entries.title: Microsoft is reportedly planning to "accelerate" the development of games such as Fallout and The Elder Scrolls. Is there a plan to increase development funds?
entries.title_ja: マイクロソフト、『フォールアウト』『The Elder Scrolls』などの開発の“加速”を計画中と報じられる。開発資金の「増額計画」も視野か
entries.description: It has been reported that Microsoft plans to accelerate the development of series such as the ``Fallout'' series.

entries.title: Fantasy Senran SLG “Brigandine Abyss” advance play impressions. It's not just a "battlefield drama", it's also "everyday" and "tactical", with a unique flavor.
entries.title_ja: ファンタジー戦乱SLG『ブリガンダイン アビス』先行プレイ感想。「戦場ドラマ」だけじゃない、「日常」も「タクティカル」もある、ならでは味付けに
entries.description: It is both easy to play and challenging, and I would recommend it not only to people who like war simulations, but also to people who are interested but have no experience with it.

entries.title: Official version of Lost Castle 2, a roguelite action game with multiplayer support for up to 4 people, released. The number of concurrently connected players is ``over 20,000,'' the highest ever, and monsters can be defeated with a variety of builds.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人マルチ対応・ローグライトアクション『Lost Castle 2』正式版リリース。同時接続プレイヤーは「2万人超え」で過去最高、多様ビルドで挑むモンスター討伐
entries.description: Hunter Studio officially released "Lost Castle 2", which had been in early access, on June 11th. This work is a belt-scrolling action game with roguelite elements.

entries.title: Smash hit weird chimera evolution roguelite ``Everything is Crab'' sold over 500,000 copies. The momentum of biological evolution action continues, and the developer is extremely grateful to the developer
entries.title_ja: スマッシュヒット中へんてこキメラ進化ローグライト『Everything is Crab』売上50万本突破。生物進化アクションの勢い止まらず、開発元は“タカアシガニ級”の大感謝
entries.description: Secret Mode and Odd Dreams Digital announced on June 12 that sales of Everything is Crab: The Biological Evolution Roguelite have reached 500,000 copies. This record was made approximately one month after its release.

entries.title: Free "lane switching" music game "CoLane" Steam store page unveiled, official version to be released by the end of the year. The lane changes with the spotlight, and you can conquer notes with “my fingerings”
entries.title_ja: 無料“レーン切り換え”音楽ゲーム『CoLane』Steamストアページお披露目、正式版年内リリースへ。スポットライトでレーンが変化、“マイ運指”でノーツを攻略
entries.description: Hayabusa announced on June 13th that the official version of ``CoLane'' will be released for free on Steam in 2026.

entries.title: What kind of publisher is "Harrison World", an up-and-coming Steam company that is currently growing in power? “Kushiyaki Master” is popular in Japan, and he has been involved from the early stages of development and is particular about making interesting games
entries.title_ja: いま勢力を伸ばすSteam新進気鋭「ハリソンワールド」ってどんなパブリッシャー？日本では『串焼きマスター』が人気、開発初期から関わり面白いゲームにこだわる
entries.description: We asked the person in charge what kind of publisher ``Harrison World'' is, which is gaining momentum on Steam.

entries.title: The developer of the popular open world airship "Everwind" has announced in a big way that it has become a foster parent to a real-life capybara. I couldn't resist just putting it in the game.
entries.title_ja: 人気飛行船オープンワールド『Everwind』開発元、「現実のカピバラの里親になった」とやたら大々的に発表。ゲームに出すだけじゃ我慢できなかった
entries.description: The developers of the popular sandbox RPG "Everwind" announced on June 12th that they have become foster parents to capybaras at Prague Zoo. This is because he loves capybaras too much.

entries.title: ``ZeroSpace'', a ``next generation RTS'' developed by former ``StarCraft'' professionals, will be released on July 20th. A trial version is available on the Steam store page.
entries.title_ja: 「スタークラフト」の元プロが開発に参加する“次世代RTS”こと「ZeroSpace」が7月20日発売へ。Steamストアページでは体験版が公開中
entries.description: Starlance Studios and Ironward today (June 12, 2026) will release the new PC software "ZeroSpace" jointly developed by the two companies on July 20th. This work is a work that claims to be a "next-generation RTS" created by Marvin Gouw, who was involved in the development of games such as "Far Cry," CatZ, who is known as a former professional gamer of "StarCraft," and Scarlett.

entries.title: ``Mina the Hollower,'' a new work by the ``Shovel Knight'' development team, is extremely sturdy despite its retro appearance. Find out the reason for the high rating from the feel of exploration and combat
entries.title_ja: 「ショベルナイト」開発チームの新作「Mina the Hollower」は，レトロな見た目に反して超骨太。高評価の理由を，探索と戦闘の手触りから探る
entries.description: The new game "Minathe Hollower" released by Yacht Club Games on May 29, 2026 is a top-down action adventure with visuals reminiscent of works from the Game Boy Color era. Reviews are quickly gathering on Steam, with the game receiving "very positive reviews." Let me explain why through my experience of actually playing the game.

entries.title: Cat cafe “Cat Café MOFF Granbury Park store” review
entries.title_ja: 猫カフェ「Cat Café MOFF グランベリーパーク店」レビュー
entries.description: We bring you a review of the cat cafe "Cat Café MOFF Granbury Park branch". A cat cafe is a facility where you can interact with cats. Currently, we are collaborating with Sega's new work ``Little Kitty Big City ~ Baby Kitten Town Walk~''.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 157: Monster breeding action “Voidling Bound” and roguelite RTS “Tabletop Tavern” to be released
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第157号：モンスター育成アクション「Voidling Bound」や，ローグライトRTS「Tabletop Tavern」が発売に
entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, the TPS ``VoidlingBound'', which combines monster breeding and action, and the roguelike real-time strategy ``Tabletop Tavern'', in which you build an army from scratch and fight through a harsh campaign, were released.

entries.title: The soccer world is in full swing with the upcoming World Cup. On this occasion, we will introduce "Fantasista Asusho", which is similar to the Famicom software masterpiece "Captain Tsubasa"
entries.title_ja: 「ワールドカップ」の開催で盛り上がるサッカー界。この機に，ファミコンソフトの名作「キャプテン翼」ライクな「ファンタジスタ明日翔」を紹介
entries.description: ``Fantasista Asusho'', released by qureate on February 12, 2026, is a soccer game whose main character is ``Aozora Daitsubasa'', a former popular professional soccer player who retired due to injury. The game system is similar to the Famicom software ``Captain Tsubasa.'' It's been a while since its release, but since it's the time of year when the world cup is so exciting, I thought I'd introduce it.

entries.title: YouTubers and VTubers who love "Street Fighter 6" compete in a 3on3 match aiming for victory and "leaving a mark." “Seize your chance! Capcom Creators JP Cup Round 2” starts today
entries.title_ja: 「ストリートファイター6」好きYouTuber＆VTuberが勝利と「爪痕を残すこと」を目指して3on3で対決。「チャンスを掴め！Capcom Creators JP杯 Round 2」本日開幕
entries.description: Round 2 of the event ``Seize the Chance! Capcom Creators JP Cup'' using Capcom's fighting game ``Street Fighter 6'' will begin today (June 13, 2026) at 18:00. The event will be streamed on YouTube's Capcom Channel.

entries.title: The new protagonist eats everything, including ingredients, concoctions, and bombs. Announcing the latest information on "Atelier Kalia ~The Kingdom of Night and the Signpost of Reminiscence~". The latest PV has also been released
entries.title_ja: 新主人公はなんでも食べる，素材も調合品も爆弾も。「カリアのアトリエ 〜夜の王国と追憶の道標〜」，最新情報を発表。最新PVも公開に
entries.description: Koei Tecmo Games today (June 12, 2026) released information about the characters and systems that appear in the latest work in the company's "Atelier" series, "Atelier Kalia: The Kingdom of Night and the Signpost of Reminiscence." This work depicts a new atelier experience based on the concept of "alchemy expands everything."

entries.title: Of course, the confrontation with the monster is “less than 3 minutes”!　Ultra member competition race ``Ultraman game: The biggest invasion in history'' Showa and Heisei retro board game encyclopedia No. 16
entries.title_ja: 怪獣との対決は当然“3分以内”！　ウルトラ隊員対抗レース「ウルトラマンゲーム 史上最大の侵略戦」　昭和・平成レトロボードゲーム大百科 第16回
entries.description: This year marks 60 years since the broadcast of "Ultraman" began, so in this "Showa/Heisei Retro Board Game Encyclopedia", we will introduce "The Largest Invasion in the History of Ultraman Games". It seems like a classic game where you play as an Ultra member and sometimes transform into an Ultra brother to fight monsters...!?

entries.title: Celebrating the 2nd anniversary of "Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ LIVE EMOTION" service. Anniversary projects such as new album release, commemorative gacha, and new live MV implementation released
entries.title_ja: 「うたの☆プリンスさまっ♪ LIVE EMOTION」サービス開始2周年を迎える。新譜リリースや記念ガチャ，新規ライブMV実装など周年企画を公開
entries.description: Broccoli announced on June 12, 2026 that the smartphone rhythm game ``Uta no Prince-sama LIVEEMOTION'' operated by the company has celebrated its 2nd anniversary since its launch. Information such as upcoming anniversary projects is being made public.

entries.title: Paradox Interactive, a major strategy game company known for the "Europa Universalis" series, is listed on the NASDAQ Stockholm book market
entries.title_ja: 「Europa Universalis」シリーズなどで知られるストラテジーゲーム大手Paradox Interactiveが，ナスダック・ストックホルムの本市場に上場
entries.description: Sweden's ParadoxInteractive, known for its ``CrusaderKings'' series and ``Europa Universalis'' series, has been listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm book market. This is a shift from the market for emerging companies, where transactions have been made up until now, to the larger book market.

entries.title: Yui's Hoe Hoe Game Speech: 267th "Let's take a serious look back on the 10 and a half years of serialization"
entries.title_ja: 結のほえほえゲーム演説：第267回「10年半の連載を本気で振り返ってみる」
entries.description: For about 10 and a half years since the serialization began in December 2015, ``Yui no Hoe Hoe Game Speech'' has continued to ``talk about the games you love from the perspective of a gamer.'' This time, I would like to introduce the episodes selected by Yui herself that she would like to read again. And finally, there is an important announcement regarding this series.

entries.title: [Play report] Instant assassination with one mistake! An ancient Chinese live-action full-motion video game that depicts the intrigues of the inner palace, “Rise of the World: The Road to Empress II”
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］一度の過ちで即暗殺！ 後宮の陰謀を描く古代中国実写フルモーションビデオゲーム「盛世天下：女帝への道II」
entries.description: Released on Steam on June 9, 2026, ``Rise of the World: The Road to the Empress II'' is a live-action, full-motion video game set in the Inner Palace of ancient China. The player takes on the role of Mototeru Take, a lowly woman who survives an imperial court full of intrigue and makes love and power her own.

entries.title: “Tales of Eternia Remastered” will be released on October 15, 2026

entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment has announced that the RPG "Tales of Eternia Remastered" will be released on October 15, 2026. This is a remastered version with higher resolution graphics and added comfort features.

entries.title_ja: 『プロセカ』×「たまごっち」カード付きグミ発売決定！“初音ミク&まめっち”などコラボイラストが可愛い
entries.description: "Project Sekai Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku x Tamagotchi Card Gummy" is scheduled to be released from June 22nd!

entries.description: I would like to introduce some beautiful cosplayers I found in Taiwan.

entries.description: There are multiple prizes available, including figurines, cushions, and tapestries. The price is 3,300 yen (tax included).

entries.title: Naniwa Danshi's Joichiro Fujiwara and the comedy duo "Untouchable" talk about their "love for Power Pro Baseball" - "At that time, we held a tournament to compete for the championship in a pennant race with Teppei Arita and others" ["Powerful Professional Baseball 2026-2027" event report]

entries.description: On June 11th, an event was held to commemorate the release of "Powerful Professional Baseball 2026-2027". Naniwa Danshi's Joichiro Fujiwara, Untouchable's Hiroya Yamazaki, and Hidetsugu Shibata took to the stage and talked about their memories of PowerPro.

entries.title: "Ichiban Kuji 'Persona' Series 30th ANNIVERSARY" will be commercialized! Goods information such as Lawson campaigns will be released one after another.
entries.title_ja: 「一番くじ 『ペルソナ』シリーズ  30th ANNIVERSARY」商品化決定！ローソンキャンペーンなどグッズ情報が続々公開
entries.description: "Ichiban Kuji 'Persona' Series 30th ANNIVERSARY" announced! The follow-up report will be released on June 30th.

entries.title: “Initial D” goods are now on sale at Shimamura! T-shirts and tote bags for various car models, as well as key cases and key rings for everyday use.
entries.title_ja: しまむらで「頭文字D」グッズが発売！様々な車種のTシャツやトートバッグ、日常使いできるキーケースにキーリングも
entries.description: “Initial D” goods will be released at Shimamura on June 13th! It will also be available at the online store from 3pm on the same day.

entries.title: A romantic comedy in which a shy young lady casts a spell on a cool marquis to make him fall in love with me.
entries.title_ja: クールな侯爵に内気な令嬢が「私のことを好きになって」とおまじないをかけるラブコメ
entries.description: Volume 1 of Shishika Hatori's ``The Result of Praying to the Partner of a Political Marriage, ``Please Fall in Love with Me,'' was released today, June 12th, by Kill Time Communication's Breeze Comics. This is a comic adaptation of Shirohi's novel.

entries.title: The young lady wants to make the stupid prince who disrespected her regret it. ``The banishment of the marquis' daughter Aria Rain'' Volume 1
entries.title_ja: ご令嬢は、自分を侮ったバカ王子を後悔させたい「侯爵令嬢アリアレインの追放」1巻
entries.description: Volume 1 of Nimaru Kisaragi's ``The Banishment of Lady Arialaine'' was released by Earth Star Entertainment today, June 12th. This is a comic adaptation based on Shiro Ruri's novel.

entries.title: A new series of "Beautiful Reincarnation" in which a boring old man who likes beautiful men is reincarnated as a handsome man in another world.
entries.title_ja: 美男子好きの冴えないおじさん、異世界で美男子に転生する「美麗転生」新連載
entries.description: Gamu-chan's new series ``Beautiful Reincarnation ~Saekano Ojisan Reincarnates as a Beautiful Boy~'' started today, June 12th, at Core Mix's WEB Zenon Editorial Department.

entries.title: A dissolute senior who sneaks up on a serious young man. ``Can you overcome the temptation of an immoral older sister?'' New series
entries.title_ja: マジメな青年に忍び寄る、自堕落な先輩「背徳お姉さんの誘惑に君は勝てるか？」新連載
entries.description: Nagokatsu's new series ``Can you overcome the temptation of an immoral older sister?'' is now available as a comipo comics work. Distribution began today, June 12th, at various e-book stores.

entries.title_ja: 「ボボステ」新作が開幕！ボーボボたちがワイヤーアクションで縦横無尽に駆け巡る
entries.description: The play ``Cho Hajike Stage ☆ Bobobobo Bobobo ~Fate! Nose Hair! Decisive Battle!~'' based on the original work by Hiroo Sawai opens today, June 12th at Theater G Rosso in Tokyo. Stage photos have been released.

entries.title: A new series of Japan travel essays by the original author who looks like a “beautiful girl” regardless of gender and an author who likes “giant women”
entries.title_ja: 男女問わず全員“美少女”に見える原作者と“巨女”好き作家の日本旅行エッセイ新連載

entries.title: Focus on Osamu Tezuka's work in academic magazines such as "Missing Pieces" series and "Ants and Giants"

entries.description: Osamu Tezuka's collection of works ``Osamu Tezuka Missing Pieces Juvenile Works Ants and Giants'' was released by Rittosha today, June 12th.

entries.title: Hajime Ueda's solo exhibition "USO" will be held in Shibuya from tomorrow June 13th, and the exhibition will be changed in the first and second half.
entries.title_ja: ウエダハジメの個展「USO」明日6月13日から渋谷で開催、前後期での展示替えも

The first half will run from June 13th to 28th, and the second half will run from July 3rd to 20th, and there will be changes in exhibits and additions to the exhibits during the exhibition period.

entries.title: Anime “Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha” Season 1 and 2 will be released for free for a limited time on YouTube
entries.title_ja: アニメ「魔法少女リリカルなのは」1期・2期が期間限定で無料公開、YouTubeで
entries.description: The TV anime ``Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha'' and ``Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's'' will be released for free on the official YouTube channel starting today, June 12th.

entries.title_ja: エヴァンゲリオン×CASETiFY、数量限定のヘッドフォンやグリップスタンドなど

entries.title: New series of ``Maware Nekotama Cafe'', a story of a mysterious coffee shop where people with feelings for cats arrive.

entries.title_ja: 任天堂・株ポケの『パルワールド』訴訟、対象が「旧バージョンに限定された」との報道。『パルワールド』で実施された“訴訟の影響予防アプデ”もあってか
entries.description: The lawsuit filed by Nintendo and the Pokémon Company over Palworld has reportedly been narrowed down to older versions of the game.

entries.title: Monster city defense sim "Godzilla Defense Force: X" announced. New “Godzilla” game for smartphones from the developer of “Dave the Diver”
entries.title_ja: 怪獣都市防衛シム『ゴジラ ディフェンス フォース：X』発表。『デイヴ・ザ・ダイバー』開発元が手がける、スマホ向け新作「ゴジラ」ゲーム
entries.description: MINTROCKET announced the mobile game ``Godzilla Defense Force:X'' on June 12th. Scheduled for official release in 2027.

entries.title: The developer of ``RPG Maker'' is looking for ways to ``archive'' the old forum site that was announced to be closed. Many people expressed regret for decades of "treasure trove of Tsukuru knowledge", so they decided to preserve it.
entries.title_ja: 「RPGツクール」開発元、閉鎖告知した旧フォーラムサイトの「アーカイブ化」を模索中。数十年分の“ツクール知識の宝庫”を惜しむ声相次ぎ、保存に乗り出す
entries.description: Gotcha Gotcha Games announced on June 12th that it is considering archiving the "Tsukuru Web Forum," which had been announced to be closed.

entries.title: ``CAUTION WET PAINT'', a game where you just watch a ``freshly painted wall'' for several hours, will be released on July 15th. If you touch it before it dries, try again.
entries.title_ja: 「ペンキ塗りたての壁」を数時間見守るだけのゲーム『CAUTION WET PAINT』7月15日配信へ。乾く前に触ったらやり直し
entries.description: Seedborne announced on June 11th that ``CAUTION WET PAINT'' will begin distribution on July 15th.

entries.title: Highly rated dog sled roguelite ADV "The Red Lantern" is being distributed free of charge for a limited time on Steam. A game with a list price of 2570 yen
entries.title_ja: 高評価犬ぞりローグライトADV『The Red Lantern』Steamにて期間限定で無料配布中。定価2570円のゲーム
entries.description: Kepler Interactive began distributing The Red Lantern for free on June 12th.

entries.title: Steam multiplayer “Drawing mimicry” hide-and-seek game “Meccha Chameleon” has already sold over 500,000 copies. Unstoppable global popularity achieved in just 2 days after release
entries.title_ja: Steamマルチ“お絵描き擬態”かくれんぼ『めっちゃカメレオン』早くも売上50万本突破。止まらぬグローバル人気、発売からわずか2日で達成
entries.description: On June 12th, game developer LEMORION reported that sales of ``Meccha Chameleon'' exceeded 500,000 copies.

entries.title: French Revolutionary SRPG "Banner of the Maid" by "Napoleon's Sister" has Japanese voices implemented in the latest update. Complete Japaneseization, which “once disappeared into an illusion,” has finally been realized.
entries.title_ja: “ナポレオンの妹”によるフランス革命SRPG『聖女戦旗 Banner of the Maid』、最新アプデで日本語ボイス実装。“一度は幻に消えた”完全日本語化がついに実現
entries.description: 2P Games has implemented a Japanese voice implementation update for "Banner of the Maid". This work already supported Japanese display, but the implementation of Japanese voices was temporarily abandoned due to various reasons. This time, it has finally come true.

entries.title: Space exploration MMO "SpaceCraft" has started to become popular on Steam, although there are pros and cons to the MMO elements. A leisurely mining and craft journey through the vast universe
entries.title_ja: 宇宙探索MMO『SpaceCraft』Steamで人気白熱スタート、MMO要素には賛否ありつつ。広大宇宙、のんびり採掘＆クラフトの旅
entries.description: Although it has quickly become a success, attracting many players, user reviews seem to be divided, mainly due to the fact that it is an MMO.

entries.title: Trial version of pigeon courtship flight game "Pigeon: A Love Story" available for up to 8 players. It also supports "pigeon imitation" using a microphone, where you search for your soulmate among hundreds of thousands of pigeons by chirping.
entries.title_ja: 鳩の求愛飛行ゲーム『Pigeon: A Love Story』最大8人マルチ対応の体験版配信。ひたすら鳴いて数十万羽の鳩の中から運命の相手を探す、マイクを使った“鳩マネ”にも対応
entries.description: Wristwork released a new trial version of the pigeon simulation game ``Pigeon: A Love Story'' on June 11th.

entries.title: My Play Watch, an offline smart watch that allows you to play retro games, will be released on October 29th. You can play ``Tetris'', ``Space Invaders'', etc. anywhere.
entries.title_ja: レトロゲームが遊べるオフライン専用スマートウォッチ「My Play Watch」10月29日発売へ。『テトリス』『スペースインベーダー』などがどこでも遊べる
entries.description: Mizuki announced on June 12th that it would release ``My Play Watch'' in Japan on October 29th. The device is a smartwatch that allows you to play retro games such as ``Space Invaders'' and ``Tetris.''

entries.title: The free trial version of the “infinite space” exploration game “Platonica Space” is now available for a limited time. Memory search to fight drowsiness by the developer of ``Natsuno Kanata''
entries.title_ja: “無限空間”探索ゲーム『プラトニカ・スペース』無料体験版、期間限定で配信開始。『ナツノカナタ』開発者が手がける、「眠気」に抗う記憶探し
entries.description: KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO began distributing the trial version of ``Platonica Space'' for a limited time on June 12th.

entries.title: Ghost luxury cruise ship horror mystery romance sim “Phantom Rapport -Intermezzo-” announced. A romance spent on a ship with women and a mystery that approaches the mystery of a ship where monsters roam.
entries.title_ja: 幽霊豪華客船ホラーミステリー恋愛シム『ファントム・ラポール -インテルメッツォ-』発表。女性たちと過ごす船上浪漫と、化け物の徘徊する船の謎へ迫るミステリー
entries.description: NTT Solmare Corporation released information on the novel game ``Fantôme Rapport -Intermezzo-'' on June 12th.

entries.title: New Soulslike "Valor Mortis" is postponed just 4 days after its release date was announced. After all, I had decided to postpone it even before the announcement was made.
entries.title_ja: 新作ソウルライク『Valor Mortis』、発売日発表後わずか4日で延期告知。なんなら“発表前”から延期は心に決めていた
entries.description: One More Level has announced that the soul-like RPG "Valor Mortis" will be released on October 13th of this year. It was originally scheduled to be released in September to coincide with the Xbox Games Showcase, but due to various circumstances, it was postponed shortly after the announcement. The head of the developer talks about the circumstances that led to the postponement.

entries.title: "Neon Dog" rhythm action "Rhythm Dog" announced. A new type of dog game where you can conquer the stage by following the beat and “create music” according to your movements.
entries.title_ja: 「ネオン犬」リズムアクション『リズム・イッヌ』発表。ビートにノってステージ攻略、動きにあわせて“音楽が出来上がる”新感覚ワンコゲーム
entries.description: 505 Games' indie game label 505 Pulse announced the rhythm exploration action game ``Rhythm Dog'' on June 12th.

entries.title: New belt-scrolling action game “Metro Siege” for NEOGEO/Amiga/PC is currently crowdfunding
entries.title_ja: NEOGEO/Amiga/PC用の新作ベルトスクロールアクション「Metro Siege」がクラウドファンディング中
entries.description: BitBeamCannon is currently conducting crowdfunding for the belt-scrolling action game ``MetroSiege'' for NEOGEO/Amiga/PC. Each of the three main characters has a different version of the fight style, and features systems such as guarding, parrying, and follow-up attacks.

entries.title: “Dragon Quest Weapons Collection Vol.1”, which is a three-dimensional version of “Dragon Quest” weapons, will be released on September 4th.
entries.title_ja: 「ドラゴンクエスト」の武器を立体化した「ドラゴンクエスト ウェポンズコレクション Vol.1」が9月4日に発売
entries.description: Square Enix today announced that new goods "Dragon Quest Weapons Collection Vol. 1" will be released on September 4, 2026. This is a collection figure that is a 1/12 scale three-dimensional version of the weapons and shields that appear in the "Dragon Quest" series. A total of 6 types are available, including Loto's sword and Dragon Killer.

entries.title: Use a variety of heavy machinery to dig for gold and become rich. “Gold Mining Simulator 2” demo version released
entries.title_ja: さまざまな重機を活用し，金を掘って大金持ちになろう。「Gold Mining Simulator 2」，デモ版を配信開始
entries.description: CodeHorizon and PlayWay today (June 11, 2026) began distributing the demo version of the new title "GoldMiningSimulator2" under development. This is a gold mining simulation game where you dig for gold in the harsh wilderness of Alaska, and use the money you earn to acquire better equipment and dig for even more gold.

entries.title: Almost all episodes of the manga ``Berserk'' will be free for 48 hours only. You can read the contents up to the latest issue all at once.
entries.title_ja: 漫画「ベルセルク」が48時間限定でほぼ全話無料に。最新刊直前までの内容を一気に読める
entries.description: Hakusensha today (June 12, 2026) started a campaign for free all episodes except the latest issue, in conjunction with the update of the latest episode of the manga ``Berserk'' currently being serialized in the company's Young Animal magazine. It will be held in conjunction with the latest episode, which will be updated continuously on June 26th and July 10th, and will be held for a limited time from 0:00 on June 12th to 23:59 on the 13th.

entries.title: Barbie wearing an "ATARI" T-shirt will present 16 retro games to you. “Barbie Rewind” where you can enjoy decorating the Barbie Dream House, now accepting reservations
entries.title_ja: 「ATARI」Tシャツを着たバービーが，レトロゲーム16本をあなたにプレゼント。バービー ドリーム ハウスの飾りつけも楽しめる「Barbie Rewind」，予約受付中
entries.description: ATARI has started accepting pre-orders for the physical version of ``BarbieRewind,'' which includes 16 games for the dress-up doll ``Barbie.'' The game's release date and physical version shipping date is scheduled for November 12, 2026. The Deluxe Edition bonus is a Barbie wearing an "ATARI" T-shirt.

entries.title: “Overwatch” releases gameplay trailer for new hero “Shion”. Scheduled to appear in season 3 starting June 17th
entries.title_ja: 「オーバーウォッチ」，新ヒーロー“シオン”のゲームプレイトレイラーを公開。6月17日からのシーズン3で登場予定
entries.description: Blizzard Entertainment today (June 12, 2026) released a gameplay trailer for the new hero ``Shion'' who will appear in Season 3 ``Into the Tiger's Lair'', which will begin on June 17th in the team competitive shooter ``Overwatch.''

entries.title: Preparations are in full swing for a new MMORPG based on the IP of "Night Crows" with the aim of launching service within 2026. Compatible platforms are PC & smartphone
entries.title_ja: 「Night Crows」のIPを基盤とした新作MMORPG，2026年内のサービス開始を目指し準備を本格化。対応プラットフォームはPC＆スマホ
entries.description: WEMADE announced today (June 12, 2026) that it has signed a publishing agreement with MADNGINE for a new title based on the "NightCrows" IP. The new game announced this time is an MMORPG for PCs and smartphones that is based on the gameplay of the original, with further enhanced graphics and content.

entries.title: The smartphone version of ``Kizakura'', where you can enjoy shogi with attractive characters, has been released today. PC version will also be available soon
entries.title_ja: 魅力的なキャラクターと共に将棋を楽しめる「棋桜」，スマートフォン版を本日リリース。PC版も近日中に登場予定
entries.description: Nekonome today (June 12, 2026) released the smartphone version of the free-to-play online shogi game ``Kizakura''. The iOS version can be downloaded from the AppStore, but the Android version requires downloading and extracting the APK version from the announcement page on the official website. The PC version will be released on Steam soon.

entries.title: Steam store page for ``PICK A BOO'', a roguelike escape action game that allows up to 6 people to cooperate, is now available. Trial version distributed on June 16th
entries.title_ja: 最大6人で協力できるローグライク脱出アクション「PICK A BOO」，Steamストアページを公開。6月16日に体験版を配信
entries.description: Game&Co. today announced the PC game "PICKABOO" and released the Steam store page. This work is a roguelike escape action game that allows up to 6 people to cooperate. While dodging the pursuit of the enemy, the goal is to collect furniture and luggage using magnetic force, load them onto a truck, and escape.

entries.title: Win your way through a tabletop-style battlefield. Roguelike RTS "Tabletop Tavern" released on Steam. You can form unique corps such as giants and trolls.
entries.title_ja: テーブルトップ風の戦場を勝ち抜け。ローグライクRTS「Tabletop Tavern」，Steamでリリース。巨人やトロルなど，特色ある軍団を編成可能
entries.description: Frostbloom and GamirrorGames today released ``Tabletop Tavern,'' a roguelike RTS for PC developed by TJ, on Steam. It's a work where you assemble your army, take on real-time battles, and conquer a different campaign each time. A trial version is also available.

entries.title: Confront ghosts with a tambourine! First-person survival horror “TAMBOURINE” Steam store page now available
entries.title_ja: タンバリンで幽霊に立ち向かえ！ 一人称視点のサバイバルホラー「TAMBOURINE」Steamストアページを公開中
entries.description: ParryMechanics has released a Steam store page for the PC game ``TAMBOURINE''. This work is a first-person survival horror game in which players explore ruins and exorcise the ghosts that haunt them. Players take on an investigation with a type of tambourine designed for ritual purposes.

entries.title: ``TANUKI: Pon's Summer'', a raccoon dog riding a BMX that carries luggage and earns money hard, latest demo released on Steam
entries.title_ja: BMXに乗ったタヌキが荷物を運んで一生懸命お金を稼ぐ「TANUKI: Pon's Summer」，最新デモをSteamで公開
entries.description: CRITICALREFLEX released the latest demo of "TANUKI:Pon's Summer" on Steam ahead of SteamNextFest. The demo version includes the first 3 days (in-game time) and allows you to play for 2-3 hours, including your first shift at the post office and building a shrine.

entries.title: Moominvalley's character "Nyoronyoro" is now available as a wooden jigsaw puzzle that can be used as interior decoration!
entries.title_ja: ムーミン谷のキャラクター「ニョロニョロ」が、インテリアとして飾れる木製ジグソーパズルで登場！
entries.description:
“Nyoronyoro” from “Moomin” is now available in the “WOODY PUZZLE LigMe” series of wooden jigsaw puzzles. Scheduled to be released in late June 2026. Below is an excerpt from the press release. Product Overview Product Name: […]

entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ』 坂柳有栖 1/7 完成品フィギュア[ベルファイン]
entries.description:
From the TV anime ``Welcome to the classroom of meritocracy'', Arisu Sakayanagi is now a three-dimensional character! Recreate the elegant and mysterious atmosphere with your gaze and gestures. From ``Slayers'', a non-scale figure of ``Lina Inverse'' has appeared based on the illustration drawn for the ``35th Anniversary Slayers Exhibition ~Gozuon~''. Scheduled to be released in February 2027. Below is an excerpt from the press release. […]
The post The main character "Lina Inverse" from "Slayers" has been made into a figure based on a newly drawn illustration! first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title_ja: Switch2／Switch版「デジモンストーリー タイムストレンジャー」体験版が配信開始

entries.title_ja: VTuberプロダクション「ゲームHIGH人になりまして。」一期生オーディション開催へ―ジャンル問わず“ゲーム好き”な候補生を広く募集
entries.description: Auditions for the first generation of VTuber production specializing in game distribution “Game HIGH Become a Person” will begin on June 12th.

The New Life Award went to Saito Mado for ``Dissecting a Monster,'' the short story award went to Kazujiro Kawajiro's ``A New Friend: Kawajiro's Short Story Collection,'' and the special award went to Kazuyoshi Takeda for ``Peleliu: Guernica in Paradise.''
