entries.description: The "Tsuyoshi Nagano Original Drawings and Prints Exhibition" will be held in Osaka and Tokyo from July 2026, displaying approximately 50 works by Tsuyoshi Nagano, a master of history and war art who is known for his illustrations for the "Nobunaga's Ambition" and "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" series. Posters and clear files will also be distributed as special benefits to visitors! #Sengoku Busho #Romance of the Three Kingdoms

entries.title: "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" 1/12 movable figures of Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael, and Michelangelo are back in the lineup! Also includes ninja gear such as shuriken and kunai! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 『ティーンエイジ・ミュータント・ニンジャ・タートルズ』レオナルド、ドナテロ、ラファエロ、ミケランジェロの1/12可動フィギュアが再ラインナップ！手裏剣、クナイなどの忍者ギアも収録！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: From "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles", 1/12 scale movable figures "One 12 Collective" of Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael, and Michelangelo are back in the lineup from Mezco Toys! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books! #TMNT

entries.title: “Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity” Emorgia’s Namco exclusive prize is now available! There's also Emorgia designed by Space Sheriff Gavan type-G that appears in "Space Sheriff Gavan THE MOVIE"!
entries.title_ja: 『超宇宙刑事ギャバン インフィニティ』エモルギアのナムコ限定プライズが登場！『宇宙刑事ギャバン THE MOVIE』に登場する宇宙刑事ギャバンtype-Gがデザインされたエモルギアも！
entries.description: A Namco limited prize of Emorgia, a key item that appears in “Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity”, is now available! Deployment starts from June 19th (Friday)! #Project RED #Super Gavan

entries.title: A set of "Dragner 1" and the aircraft carrier deformed movable figure "BRICKROID" is now available! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 『機甲戦記ドラグナー』ドラグナー1と空母のデフォルメ可動フィギュア「BRICKROID」のセットが登場！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: From "Dragner" comes a set of Dragoner 1 (Opening ver.) and the deformed movable aircraft carrier figure "BRICKROID"! The aircraft carrier's catapult can slide back and forth with the Dragonar installed! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books! #Kekoru Senki Dragonar

entries.title: “Blue Archive Game Development Department Daibouken! '' Volume 6, ``Uncle and the Cat'' Volume 17, and more Kindle comics released on June 11th!
entries.title_ja: 『ブルーアーカイブ ゲーム開発部だいぼうけん！』6巻、『おじさまと猫』17巻など6月11日配信のKindle本コミックをピックアップ！
entries.description: Pick up Square Enix's Kindle book comic that will be distributed on June 11th at Amazon Kindle Store! “Blue Archive Game Development Department Daibouken! Introducing Volume 6 of ``The Uncle and the Cat'' Volume 17 and more! #Kindle

entries.title: Pick up Kindle comics released on June 11th, including “Tsukirisuru Town People” Volume 5 and “After School Return Home” Volume 6!
entries.title_ja: 『月出づる街の人々』5巻、『放課後帰宅びより』6巻など6月11日配信のKindle本コミックをピックアップ！
entries.description: Pick up Futabasha's Kindle book comic that will be distributed on June 11th at Amazon Kindle Store! Introducing ``Tsukirisuru Town People'' Volume 5, ``After School Return Home'' Volume 6, and more! #Kindle

entries.title: "Ultraman MINI ULTRA ART Mejirushi Accessory" containing Ultraman, Zero, Seven, Tiga, Tiga Dark, Bouska, Alien Baltan is on sale again!
entries.title_ja: ウルトラマン、ゼロ、セブン、ティガ、ティガダーク、ブースカ、バルタン星人を収録した「ウルトラマン MINI ULTRA ART めじるしアクセサリー」が再販！
entries.description: “Ultraman MINI ULTRA ART Mejirushi Accessory” released in March 2026 is on sale again! Sales start on Friday, June 12th at Gashapon Online! #Ultraman

entries.title: "It's not Nintendo Direct's fault that E3 ended," an industry journalist asserts. The “death” of E3 started before the coronavirus
entries.title_ja: 「E3が終了したのはNintendo Directのせいじゃない」と業界ジャーナリストが断言。コロナ前から始まっていた、E3の“死”
entries.description: The gaming event E3 (Electronic Entertainment Expo) ended in 2023. Jason Schreier, a game journalist who attended the event and witnessed the history first-hand, gave his thoughts on why E3 ended.

entries.title: "Fate/Grand Order (FGO)" has finally updated its game engine to "Unity 6". First update in 2 years
entries.title_ja: 『Fate/Grand Order（FGO）』、ついにゲームエンジンを「Unity 6」に刷新へ。2年ぶりのバージョンアップ
entries.description: FGO PROJECT announced on June 11th that the game engine for ``Fate/Grand Order (FGO)'' will be upgraded to ``Unity 6'' in mid-June.

entries.title: "Eternal Fantasy 2nd Album Revival" announced, scheduled for release in spring 2027. “Second remake” revived by the original staff, friendship development simulation once again
entries.title_ja: 『悠久幻想曲 2nd Album リバイバル』発表、2027年春発売へ。オリジナル版スタッフの手で蘇る“リメイク第2弾”、友情育成シミュレーションふたたび
entries.description: Taito announced ``Eternal Fantasy 2nd Album Revival'' on June 11th.

entries.title: Debt repayment black factory roguelite “Lazy Witches Factory” trial version now available. Forced labor, counterfeiting money, and a “30 minute time limit” debt payment game with no rules
entries.title_ja: 借金返済ブラック工場ローグライト『レイジーウィッチーズファクトリー』体験版配信開始。強制労働にお金偽造、ルール無用な“制限時間30分”借金完済ゲーム
entries.description: On June 11th, Phoenixx released a trial version of the roguelite factory builder game ``Lazy Witch's Factory''.

entries.title: The communication delay issue that was reported in some games such as the Steam version of ``Street Fighter 6'' has been fixed with a ``Steam client'' update. Steam “NAT traversal failure” bug
entries.title_ja: Steam版『ストリートファイター6』などで一部報告されていた通信遅延問題、「Steamクライアント」のアプデで修正か。Steamの“NAT越え失敗”バグ
entries.description: It appears that a network issue that was reported to occur in some regions in certain games such as ``Street Fighter 6'' has been fixed.

entries.title: ``Xenoblade Chronicles DE Nintendo Switch 2 Edition'' is in the spotlight for being transformed into a ``Xenoblade Cart'' with the implementation of ``Aether Jet.'' New elements with extreme speed and noisiness
entries.title_ja: 『ゼノブレイドDE Nintendo Switch 2 Edition』、「エーテルジェット」実装で“ゼノブレイドカート”化したと脚光浴びる。スピードもやかましさもぶっちぎりの新要素
entries.description: A new element in ``Xenoblade Chronicles Definitive Edition Nintendo Switch 2 Edition'', ``Aether Jet'', has been in the spotlight right away, and coupled with its ``liveliness'', it seems to be gaining attention.

entries.title: Approximately 550 books have been added to the sale for Nintendo Switch. “Over 80% off” and many highly rated games such as Cyberpunk Delivery Game and Zombie World Parenting Survival are available at low prices.
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch向けセールに約550本がっつり追加。“80％以上オフ”もいろいろ、サイバーパンク配達ゲームやゾンビ世界子育てサバイバルなど高評価ゲームいっぱいお安い
entries.description: On June 11th, a new sale for Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch titles began on the Nintendo eShop. Approximately 550 titles are eligible.

entries.title: Steam food factory automation sim "Snacktorio" is gaining popularity. Automating all processes from ingredient harvest to cooking, endless mass production of dishes for "hungry beasts"
entries.title_ja: Steam食品工場自動化シム『Snacktorio』に好評集まる。食材収穫から調理まで工程ぜんぶ自動化、“腹ぺこビースト”の料理をエンドレス大量生産
entries.description: TNgineers and Rekoup released "Snacktorio" on June 4th.

entries.title: Nintendo reinstates the purchase condition of ``50 hours or more of play time'' only for the Nintendo Switch 2 (multilingual support), in response to an increase in orders suspected of ``hoarding''. Is it a countermeasure for overseas resale?
entries.title_ja: 任天堂、Nintendo Switch 2（多言語対応）のみ「プレイ時間50時間以上」の購入条件を復活、“買い占め疑惑”のある注文増加を受けて。国外転売対策か
entries.description: Nintendo announced on June 11 that sales of the Nintendo Switch 2 (multilingual support) on the Nintendo Store had been temporarily suspended. From now on, it will be sold with conditions.

entries.title: Mythical hack and slash RPG "Titan Quest II" The largest ever "Chapter 4" has been announced and will be released soon. The unexplored land "Wildland" is implemented, where King Centaur and a huge temple of the nemesis Nemesis await
entries.title_ja: 神話ハクスラRPG『Titan Quest II』過去最大規模の「チャプター4」発表、近日配信へ。未踏の地「ワイルドランド」実装、キング・ケンタウロスや宿敵ネメシスの巨大神殿が待ち受ける
entries.description: THQ Nordic announced on June 11th that Chapter 4 will be added to Titan Quest II in a major update.

entries.title: "Thief Gnomes", a dwarf thief game with up to 6 players, has quickly become very popular with 10,000 people playing the same game. Sneaking into people's houses, stealing everything, and doing mischief all over the house.
entries.title_ja: 最大6人協力・こびと泥棒ゲーム『どろぼうノーム』、さっそく“同接1万人”の大人気スタート。人間の住宅に忍び込みなんでも略奪、家中イタズラしまくる
entries.description: Fobri released the thief game Burglin' ​​Gnomes on June 10th.

entries.title: The remake version of the masterpiece free game ``Type Help'', ``The Garry House Incident'', will be released on July 14th. A bold mystery “reborn” in 3D
entries.title_ja: 傑作フリーゲーム『Type Help』のリメイク版『ギャリー邸事件』、7月14日発売へ。3Dに“新生”する骨太ミステリー
entries.description: Evil Trout has announced that they will be releasing The Garry Mansion, co-written with William Rous, on July 14th. This work is a remake of the highly rated puzzle mystery "Type Help" released in 2025.

entries.title: “Scarlet Deer Inn,” a 2D action game with “moving embroidery,” will be released on July 22nd. A medieval fantasy that respects "Studio Ghibli" where all characters are drawn with "sewing machines"
entries.title_ja: 「刺繍が動く」2Dアクション『Scarlet Deer Inn』7月22日配信へ。全キャラを“ミシン”で描く、「スタジオジブリ」リスペクトの中世ファンタジー
entries.description: Attu Games announced on June 10th that ``Scarlet Deer Inn'' will be distributed domestically on Steam on July 22nd. This is a 2D action game inspired by Slavic folklore and Ghibli movies. The feature is that the characters are drawn with actual embroidery.

entries.title: "Funnel Runners," a disaster-stricken city escape game with up to 8 players, will be released on July 17th. Escape from the approaching “F5 class tornado”, extreme disaster survival with “inevitable disappearance”
entries.title_ja: 最大8人協力・被災都市脱出ゲーム『Funnel Runners』7月17日配信へ。迫りくる「F5級竜巻」から逃げ延びる、“行方不明必至”極限ディザスターサバイバル
entries.description: Supernova Studios announced on June 11th that "Funnel Runners" will be released on July 17th Japan time.

entries.title: A save disappearing bug has been reported in "Forza Horizon 6" and the official is investigating. The community is calling attention to “upgrades for specific car models” etc.
entries.title_ja: 『Forza Horizon 6』にてセーブ消失バグの報告上がり、公式が調査中。“特定車種のアプグレ”などにコミュニティ間で注意喚起も
entries.description: Microsoft announced on June 11 that it is investigating an issue in Forza Horizon 6 that causes save progress to disappear. Regarding the bug, there have been reports that it occurs with Xbox's quick resume function and certain car customizations.

entries.title: Washagana TV's latest video introduces the food delivery service "Rocket Now"
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，フードデリバリーサービス「ロケットナウ」を紹介する様子をお届け
entries.description: Today (June 11, 2026), the latest video of the web program "Washagana TV" by Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita was released. This time, we will introduce the food delivery service "Rocket Now". Taking advantage of this opportunity, I actually ordered a bunch of the dishes I wanted to eat from the recording studio.

entries.title: Double-speed viewing, fast movies, spoilers welcome: A must-have book for surviving the present: “People who can no longer read books” (Book Guide for Gamers: No. 64)
entries.title_ja: 倍速視聴，ファスト映画，ネタバレ歓迎――“いま”をサバイヴするための必携書「本を読めなくなった人たち」（ゲーマーのためのブックガイド：第64回）
entries.description: Double-speed viewing, fast movies, spoilers welcome - there are probably many readers who feel uncomfortable with these keywords. However, these are just adaptations to the environment. This time, we will be introducing Toyofumi Inada's non-fiction book ``People Who Can No Longer Read Books,'' which focuses on Generation Z.

entries.title: Thief Gnome, a cooperative action game where you become a dwarf and steal things from humans, now available on Steam
entries.title_ja: 小人になって人間から物を盗みまくる協力アクションゲーム「どろぼうノーム」，Steamで配信開始
entries.description: On June 10, 2026, Fobri released a new title "Thief Gnome" on Steam. This is an online cooperative action game where you play as a small ``gnome'' with up to five friends and sneak into people's homes to steal things and cause havoc.

entries.title: Dive into the chaos of “STRANGER THAN HEAVEN”. Feeling the weight of the history and violence of the “Japan that might have existed” through unique combat using left and right limbs
entries.title_ja: 「STRANGER THAN HEAVEN」の修羅場に飛び込む。左右の手足を操る独自コンバットで感じた，“あったかもしれない日本”の地べたの歴史と暴力の重み
entries.description: At SummerGameFest:PlayDays, I experienced the battle of RGG Studio's completely new work "STRANGERTHANHEAVEN". Combat, in which the left and right hands and feet are controlled individually, not only has unique controls, but also retains at hand the violence depicted in this work and the weight of Japan's history as it might have been.

entries.title: Collect data on powerful tornadoes, repair your vehicle, and escape. 8-person cooperative survival ACT “Funnel Runners” to be released on July 16th
entries.title_ja: 強大な竜巻のデータを集め，車両を修理して脱出せよ。8人協力サバイバルACT「Funnel Runners」，7月16日にリリース決定
entries.description: SupernovaStudios announced today (June 11, 2026) that it will release a new title under development, ``FunnelRunners'', on July 16th. This work is a survival action game that supports multiplayer for up to 8 players, where players go to the scene where a gigantic F5-class tornado approaches and collect data.

entries.title: Crimson Moon, a dark gothic action ADV that also allows cooperative play, will be released in September. Latest trailer also released
entries.title_ja: 協力プレイも可能なダークゴシックアクションADV「Crimson Moon」，9月にリリース決定。最新トレイラーも公開
entries.description: ProbablyMonsters today (June 11, 2026) announced that the release date for the new title "CrimsonMoon" under development has been decided in September 2026, and released the latest trailer. A dark gothic action adventure where you can enjoy fierce battles with Souls-like action.

entries.title: Play Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis the fastest. Create a sense of excitement with modern gameplay and graphics
entries.title_ja: 「トゥームレイダー：レガシー・オブ・アトランティス」を最速プレイ。現代的なゲームプレイとグラフィックス表現でワクワク感を演出
entries.description: At SummerGameFest:PlayDays2026, I experienced a playable demo of "Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis". The excitement of this work, which ``reimagined'' the monumental action-adventure genre with a modern system and the latest graphics, far exceeded my expectations.

entries.title: “THYSIASTERY” undergoes a major update that adds three difficulty adjustment options, new monsters, skills, and monsters
entries.title_ja: 「THYSIASTERY」，3つの難度調整オプションや新モンスター，スキル，モンスターを追加する大型アップデートを実施
entries.description: DIRGA today (June 11, 2026) released a major update 1.1 for the roguelike 3D dungeon RPG "THYSIASTERY" currently being distributed on Steam. This update implements three difficulty adjustment options, new monsters, skills, and items.

entries.title: Switch 2 (multilingual support), multiple orders suspected of panic buying have been confirmed at the Nintendo Store. From now on, it will be sold to people who meet the conditions.
entries.title_ja: Switch 2（多言語対応），買い占めなどの疑いがある注文をNintendo Storeで複数確認。今後は条件を満たした人へ販売
entries.description: Nintendo today (June 11, 2026) reported that sales of the Nintendo Switch 2 (multilingual support) at the Nintendo Store had been temporarily suspended due to confirmation of multiple orders suspected to be panic buying. From now on, it will be sold to people who meet the conditions.

entries.title: “Space Invaders 90” is only 100 yen! “’Space Invaders Day’ Sale 2026” with great deals on eligible titles has started
entries.title_ja: 「スペースインベーダー90」がなんと100円！ 対象タイトルがお得な“『スペースインベーダーの日』セール2026”がスタート
entries.description: Taito today (June 11, 2026) launched the ``Space Invaders Day'' Sale 2026, which targets ``Space Invaders'' related works currently on sale on Nintendo Switch and Steam. To commemorate ``Space Invaders Day,'' the official X account is running a campaign where you can win various goods.

entries.title: Nijisanji “Rainy Day Laundry” goods will be released at 7pm on June 12th. Five popular male riders appear on the theme of rainy days and laundromats.
entries.title_ja: にじさんじ「Rainy Day Laundry」グッズが6月12日19時発売。雨の日とコインランドリーがテーマで人気男性ライバー5人が登場
entries.description: On June 11, 2026, ANYCOLOR announced that all 11 types of goods "RainyDayLaundry" with the theme of rainy days and coin laundry will be released at Nijisanji Official Store and NIJISANJIENO Official Store on June 12th at 7pm. The five livers appearing are Ibrahim, Kei Nagao, Ayato Hitotsubashi, Minato Fuwa, and Luca Kaneshiro.

entries.title: "Arcanadia - Gleam Gatherers -" will be released in 2026. A new action game for smartphones based on Kotobukiya's beautiful girl plastic model series.
entries.title_ja: 「アルカナディア - Gleam Gatherers -」が2026年内リリースへ。コトブキヤの美少女プラモシリーズを原作とするスマホ向け新作アクション
entries.description: The Arcanadia Gleam Gatherers Production Committee announced today (June 11, 2026) that it will release the smartphone game "Arcanadia -Gleam Gatherers-" within 2026, and has started accepting pre-registrations.

entries.title: "Soulframe" releases update "Prelude 15: Gods and Ghosts" for closed alpha test. Revamped loot and crafting system
entries.title_ja: 「Soulframe」，クローズドαテスト向けアップデート「プレリュード15：神々と亡霊」をリリース。戦利品とクラフトシステムを刷新
entries.description: Digital Extremes today released "Prelude 15: Gods and Ghosts", an update for the closed alpha test of the PC version of "Soulframe". The loot and crafting system has been revamped, trade and in-game mail functions have been implemented, new weapons and enemies have been added, and various QoL improvements have been made based on community feedback.

entries.title: "Minecraft Dungeons II" releases new trailer introducing new elements and systems evolved from the previous game
entries.title_ja: 「Minecraft Dungeons II」，新たな要素や前作から進化したシステムを紹介する最新トレイラーを公開
entries.description: MojangStudios today (June 11, 2026) released the trailer ``ANEWTHREATAPPROACHING....'' that introduces new elements of the new title ``Minecraft Dungeons II'' scheduled to be released on September 29th. In the video, you can see the worldview of this work, as well as new elements and improvements from the previous work.

entries.title: Personification of “Keirin x Hell Tour”! ? New IP project “Jigokufurin” has started. Characters and 7 cast members including Chiharu Sawashiro revealed
entries.title_ja: 「競輪×地獄めぐり」を擬人化！？ 新規IPプロジェクト「地獄降輪」が始動。登場キャラクターと沢城千春さんら7名のキャストを公開
entries.description: Today (June 11, 2026), Pictoria, in collaboration with the Beppu City Public Works Bureau, launched a new IP project, ``Hell Furin''. This project is a fusion of Beppu Keirin in Beppu City, Oita Prefecture, and the tourist attraction ``Hell Tour.'' Hiroko Utsumi, known for her work on the anime ``Free!'', is participating in the character design.

entries.title: TV Anime “Magical Girl ni Amorete” Leopard Serious Mode 1/6 Complete Figure [Bell Fine]
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『魔法少女にあこがれて』 レオパルト 本気モード 1/6 完成品フィギュア[ベルファイン]
entries.description:
From the TV anime ``Magical Girl ni Amorete'', Leopard, a member of the evil organization ``Enormita'', is now in his serious mode! The pose with its arms and legs spread wide, with a provocative and relaxed expression, fully expresses Leopard's energetic side. Proposal […]
The post TV anime ``Magical Girl ni Amorete'' Leopard Serious Mode 1/6 Complete Figure [Bell Fine] first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title: Heroines in swimsuits and bunny costumes appear one after another! Announcing the “May 2026 AmiAmi Figure Monthly Ranking”!
entries.title_ja: 水着やバニー衣装のヒロインたちが続々登場！「2026年5月あみあみフィギュア月間ランキング」を発表！
entries.description:
Hobby shop "AmiAmi" has announced its "May 2026 Figure Reservation Ranking". Many beautiful girl characters have been ranked. In the pickup corner, "General Raiden Isshin Pure Land Ver." from "Genshin" is introduced. From […]
The post Heroines in swimsuits and bunny costumes are appearing one after another! Announcing the “May 2026 AmiAmi Figure Monthly Ranking”! first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title: Lotte Holdings exhibits BELLYGOM and Lotte characters at "19th Licensing Japan"
entries.title_ja: ロッテホールディングス、「第19回ライセンシングジャパン」に出展　BELLYGOMやロッテキャラクターを展示
entries.description: Lotte Holdings Co., Ltd. announced that it will exhibit at the 19th Licensing Japan, a character and brand licensing business trade fair. At the venue, there will be exhibitions of Lotte-related characters such as BELLYGOM, and a business negotiation booth.
entries.location: 東京ビッグサイト 西展示棟（東京都江東区）

_url_verified.page_title: 「第19回ライセンシングジャパン」に出展　～BELLYGOMやロッテ「イタガム」、千葉ロッテマリーンズなどグループのコンテンツが集結～

entries.title: "Lords of the Fallen II", Switch 2 version to be released in 2026. Latest gameplay video released
entries.title_ja: 「Lords of the Fallen II」，Switch2版を2026年内に発売決定。最新ゲームプレイ映像を公開
entries.description: CI Games has announced that the 2nd version of the soul-like action RPG "Lords of the Fallen II" will be released on Nintendo Switch within 2026. In addition, the latest footage of the gameplay of the Switch 2 version has also been released.

entries.title_ja: 「Star Fox」体験版が配信開始。発売日までにチュートリアル体験
entries.description: Nintendo has started distributing the trial version of the latest game in the series, Star Fox. The product version is scheduled to be released on June 25, 2026, and the trial version allows you to play tutorials such as Erwin's operating instructions.

entries.title: From Software's new game "The Duskbloods" will undergo closed network testing in summer 2026

entries.description: During SGFPlayDays, GPTRACK50 participated in a closed session of "StupidNeverDies" which is currently under development. With explanations from producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi and other staff members, and a playthrough of the actual machine, we got a feel for the action RPG in which a zombie falls in love with a dead person, eats them, transforms, and becomes stronger.

entries.description: Solo developer Ichiji has announced a new title currently under development, ``Travel in the Rain.'' This work is a story-oriented 2D adventure game set on an isolated island covered in rain, where players search for their way home while visiting various eras and places. Through exploration, puzzles, branching conversations, and more, you will get closer to the truth about the island.

entries.title: Announcement of Sengoku Japan/branched history RPG “Expeditions: Samurai”. Tactical battles that take advantage of the terrain, a story with plenty of choices, and surviving the Sengoku era as the end approaches.
entries.title_ja: 戦国日本・分岐たくさん歴史RPG『Expeditions: Samurai』発表。地形を活かした戦術バトルと豊富選択肢のストーリー、“終わり”が近づく戦国の世を生き抜く
entries.description: THQ Nordic announced the historical RPG "Expeditions: Samurai" on June 7th. Early access distribution is scheduled to start within 2026.

entries.title: Highly difficult grotesque action game "Brass Famous 2", a free large-scale update with the addition of "Dodeka new area" will be released suddenly. New weapons and bosses also appear
entries.title_ja: 高難度グロテスクアクション『ブラスフェマス 2』、“ドデカ新規エリア”追加の無料大型アプデいきなり配信。新たな武器やボスも登場
entries.description: On June 7th, Team17 released a major update for "Blasphemous 2" created by The Game Kitchen. The update adds a vast area that is 1/4 of the previous map.

entries.title: Enjoy playing Ingrid in Street Fighter 6. “Slay the Spire 2” Did everyone have a problem with how much it costs? I was very excited at the collaboration cafe of “Mugen Meiro”. This week's gaming
entries.title_ja: 『ストリートファイター6』でイングリッドを楽しむ。『Slay the Spire 2』みんなはアセいくらでつまづいた？『無期迷途』のコラボカフェで大興奮。今週のゲーミング
entries.description: Every Sunday, Now Gaming is a corner where each writer loosely writes about the games they played that week. This is the 547th time.

entries.title: DLC "STAR WARS Pack" for high pressure washing sim "PowerWash Simulator 2" will be released on July 16th. Step into the world of the original Star Wars trilogy and clean up the dirt
entries.title_ja: 高圧洗浄シム『PowerWash Simulator 2』向けDLC「STAR WARS Pack」7月16日配信へ。「スター・ウォーズ」旧三部作の世界に入り込み汚れを落とす
entries.description: FuturLab announced on June 7th that the DLC "STAR WARS Pack" for "PowerWash Simulator 2" will be distributed on July 16th. A new stage set in the world of the old Star Wars movie trilogy will appear.

entries.title: “The world inside the manuscript” exploration metroidvania “Chronoscript” will be released this fall. A gorgeous team of creators involved in the Bayonetta and Xenoblade series will also be unveiled.
entries.title_ja: “原稿の中の世界”探索メトロイドヴァニア『Chronoscript（クロノスクリプト）』今秋リリースへ。『ベヨネッタ』『ゼノブレイド』シリーズなどに携わる豪華クリエイター陣もお披露目
entries.description: Shueisha Games announced on June 7th that Chronoscript: The Endless End will be released in the fall of 2026. This work is a 2D exploration action-adventure game in which you explore the inside of a manuscript.

entries.title: 2D anime/detective mystery puzzle "The Mermaid Mask" to be released on July 17th. The latest mystery adventure work that is extremely popular and approaches the mystery of "closed room murder in a submarine"
entries.title_ja: 2Dアニメ・探偵推理パズル『The Mermaid Mask』7月17日発売へ。「潜水艦での密室殺人」の謎に迫る、熱狂的人気誇る推理アドベンチャー最新作
entries.description: SFB Games announced on June 7th that The Mermaid Mask will be released on July 16th. This game is the latest in the Detective Grimoire mystery adventure game series, and is said to approach the truth behind a murder on a submarine.

entries.title: A narrative adventure depicting the interaction between a barber and the customers who visit the barber has been announced.
entries.title_ja: 理容師と店を訪れる客たちの交流を描くナラティブアドベンチャー「けものたちの髪切り屋」が発表に
entries.description: SIGONO today (June 7, 2026) announced a new title for PC, ``Kemonotachi no Haircut Shop''. This work is a narrative adventure set in a barber shop in a modern city where a wide variety of beastmen coexist, and depicts the interactions between the barber and the customers who visit the shop.

entries.title: Genesis, giant gods, maps, and the first cervical vertebra: Explore the meaning behind the name "gen ATLAS." We asked Fumihito Ueda about genDESIGN's new work.
entries.title_ja: 創世，巨神，地図，第1頸椎――「gen ATLAS」という名に込められた意味を探る。genDESIGN新作について上田文人氏に聞いた
entries.description: What is the meaning behind the title of genDESIGN's new work "genATLAS", which was officially announced at SummerGameFest2026, and what kind of experience will it create? We spoke directly to Fumihito Ueda.

entries.title: The latest DLC "Last Variable" for the sci-fi survival "The Alters" will be released on July 13th. Contains approximately 20 hours of content, featuring the protagonist "Scientist Yang" who remained on the planet.
entries.title_ja: SFサバイバル「The Alters」の最新DLC「Last Variable」が7月13日に配信へ。惑星に居残った"サイエンティストのヤン"を主人公に，約20時間分のコンテンツを収録
entries.description: 11bitstudios announced at Future Games Show 2026 held today that it will release a large DLC for SF survival called ``The Alters: Last Variable'' on July 13th.

entries.title: I cleared the game without speaking to anyone - Playing "SONIC PICO PARK" at the SGF venue
entries.title_ja: 声を掛け合わずにクリアしてしまった――「SONIC PICO PARK」をSGF会場でプレイ
entries.description: I had a chance to play ``SONICPICOPARK'', which Sega announced on June 6, 2026, at SummerGameFest:PlayDays2026. Let's take a look at how Sega's most representative IP is fused with a cooperative puzzle masterpiece.

entries.title: A new development for "Vampire Survivors" has been revealed. Announcement of the launch of "Survivaton" and the establishment of Poncle Japan, whose representative is Sawaki Takeyasu, who has worked on El Shaddai etc.
entries.title_ja: 「Vampire Survivors」の新展開が明らかに。「Survivaton」始動と，エルシャダイなどを手がけた竹安佐和記氏が代表を務めるPoncle Japan設立を発表
entries.description: Poncle has announced that as a new development for "VampireSurvivors", it will launch "Survivaton", which will compile new works related to the same work, and will retitle the main volume to "VampireSurvivors-FirstSurvivaton". The new expansion pack ``Legacy of the Bloodmoon'' and the establishment of a Japanese corporation, Poncle Japan, have also been announced.

entries.title: Exploration-type action ADV "Chronoscript: The Endless End" to be released in fall 2026. Mari Shimazaki and Yasunori Mitsuda also announced their participation.
entries.title_ja: 探索型アクションADV「Chronoscript: The Endless End」，2026年秋に発売決定。島崎麻里氏と光田康典氏の参加も明らかに
entries.description: Shueisha Games announced on ``Future Games Show'' broadcast today that the release date for the exploration-type action adventure ``Chronoscript: The Endless End'' has been decided in the fall of 2026. At the same time, a new prologue trailer has been released, and the participation of creators such as Mari Shimazaki and Yasunori Mitsuda has also been revealed.

entries.title: “Sky: Children of the Stars”, a game experience that allows you to travel through Van Gogh’s life and works, will be available from July 17th
entries.title_ja: 「Sky 星を紡ぐ子どもたち」，ゴッホの人生と作品の中を旅することができるゲーム体験を7月17日から配信
entries.description: thatgamecompany announced today (June 7, 2026) that it will distribute the game experience ``Dear Van Gogh'' in ``Sky Children'' from July 17th to October 2nd, where you can travel through the life and works of painter Vincent van Gogh.

entries.title: A point and click adventure starring Moomintroll and Little My. "Moomin: Moominvalley Summer Festival" announced
entries.title_ja: ムーミントロールとリトルミイが活躍するポイント＆クリックアドベンチャー。「ムーミン：ムーミン谷の夏まつり」発表
entries.description: Shochiku Games announced the new ADV ``Moomin: Moomin Valley Summer Festival'' at the event ``WholesomeDirect2026'' distributed today. The work is based on Tove Jansson's novel ``Summer Festival in Moominvalley'' and is scheduled to be released in 2026. A Japanese trailer narrated by Akio Otsuka has also been released.

entries.title: We are now recruiting participants for the closed beta test of "Animo," a monster collecting RPG with beautiful anime-style graphics and a system that allows you to transform into creatures.
entries.title_ja: 美しいアニメ調グラフィックスや，クリーチャーになり切れるシステムが魅力のモンスター収集RPG「アニモ」のクローズドβテスト参加者募集を開始
entries.description: The latest information on the open world monster collecting RPG "Animo" developed by Pawprint Studio has been released in conjunction with SummerGameFest. In addition, recruitment of participants for the closed beta test has begun in preparation for the official release in the second half of 2026. Set in a fantasy world, the game unfolds an adventure while capturing and training Animos with special abilities.

entries.title: “Washisu Mahjong Showdown” was held in collaboration with “Akagi” at “Maddam”. Team up with a professional mahjong player and aim for the top using special rules where transparent tiles fly around.
entries.title_ja: 「雀魂」で「アカギ」とコラボした「鷲巣麻雀決斗戦」を開催。透明牌が飛び交う特殊ルールでプロ雀士とタッグを組んで頂点を目指せ
entries.description: Yostar's mahjong game ``Jantama'' will be holding a collaboration tournament ``Washisu Mahjong Showdown'' with the manga ``Akagi.'' The two winners of the online preliminary round will team up with a professional mahjong player in the offline final, playing under special rules that make many of the tiles transparent. Qualifying starts on June 12, 2026.

entries.title: Visual novel "Valkyrie Tune: Mechanical Eye" will be released on Steam on July 23rd. Product version PV also released
entries.title_ja: ビジュアルノベル「ヴァルキリーチューン：機械仕掛けのアイ」，7月23日にSteamでリリース決定。製品版PVも公開
entries.description: Good Smile Company announced on June 6, 2026 that the visual novel ``Valkyrie Tune: Mechanical Eye'' will be released on Steam on July 23. At the same time, the product version PV was released. In the video, you can see the world of the work and the characters appearing in it, as well as listen to the theme song ``song of birth'' sung by Asami Imai.

entries.title: "Out of Words" created by a Danish stop-motion artist and poet, a co-op exclusive ADV that depicts a heartbreaking love story between a man and a woman who are childhood friends.
entries.title_ja: デンマークのストップモーション作家と詩人が生み出す「Out of Words」，幼なじみの仲良し男女の切ない恋の物語を描くCo-op専用ADV
entries.description: A demo of the co-op ADV ``OutofWords'' was on display at the EpicGames booth at SummerGameFest, so I played it while listening to developer Johan Oettinger. This work, co-produced with Danish poet Morten Sundargaard, depicts a heartbreaking love story between a man and a woman who are childhood friends.

entries.title: “Zenless Zone Zero” Ver. 3.0 “Confessions of a Dreamer” will be distributed on June 17th. The main character "Pyrois" in battle form can be obtained for free. Steam version will also be released
entries.title_ja: 「ゼンレスゾーンゼロ」Ver.3.0「ある夢に遊ぶ者の告白」を6月17日に配信。戦闘形態の主人公「ピュロイス」は無料でもらえる。Steam版もリリースへ
entries.description: HoYoverse announced on June 6, 2026 that it will distribute Ver. 3.0 of "Zenless Zone Zero" "Confessions of a Dreamer" on June 17th.

entries.title: The special input boom has arrived! ? Picking up games that use a variety of inputs, from player facial expressions to balance balls [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 特殊入力のブームが到来！？ プレイヤーの表情からバランスボールまで，さまざまな入力を使ったゲームをピックアップ［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the indie game event ``BitSummitPUNCH,'' there were a large number of exhibits of games that used special input devices, and there was something of a boom. Normally, these games are exhibited at ``make.ctrl.Japan,'' which is held at the same venue, but this year, special input games were also seen at regular booths.

entries.title: "Aniimo" will hold its first closed beta test in Japan in early July. Recruitment of participants has started on each platform
entries.title_ja: 「Aniimo」，日本国内向け初となるクローズドβテストを7月上旬に開催。各プラットフォームで参加者募集がスタート
entries.description: Pawprint Interactive Entertainment today (June 7, 2026) announced that it will hold the first closed beta test in Japan for its new title "Aniimo" in early July. Recruitment of participants has started on each platform.

entries.title: "R-Type Dimensions III" Switch2 / PS5 / Switch version, release date changed to July 2nd
entries.title_ja: 「R-Type Dimensions III」Switch2 / PS5 / Switch版，発売日を7月2日に変更
entries.description: Tozai Games announced that the release date of the Switch 2 / PS5 / Switch version of "R-Type Dimensions III" will be changed to July 2, 2026. The schedule has been adjusted so that updates reflecting various improvements will be applied from the time of release.

entries.description: It has been revealed that an update patch that will add a new group of labyrinths to the Switch software ``Demon Kill Demon ~Yomi 1984~'' will be distributed on June 11, 2026. Additionally, a trial version that allows you to play the introduction to the story has been available since May 21st.

entries.title: Open world survival action "RuneScape: Dragonwilds" to be released on September 15th
entries.title_ja: オープンワールドサバイバルアクション「RuneScape: Dragonwilds」，9月15日に発売
entries.description: Jagex announced at Summer Game Fest 2026 that it will release the open world survival action game ``RuneScape: Dragonwilds'' on September 15, 2026. It will be developed as a new work based on the world view of the classic MMO "RuneScape".

entries.title_ja: 協力型物理アクション「An Eggstremely Hard Game」，発売日が7月24日に決定。Steamで体験版も配信中
entries.description: The release date of "An Eggtremely Hard Game," a cooperative physical action game in which two geese transport eggs, has been set for July 24, 2026. A trial version is currently being distributed on Steam prior to the retail version.

entries.description: The latest footage of the action RPG "Lords of the Fallen II" has been released, confirming that it is scheduled to be released in the fall of 2026. This work is also available in Japanese and features highly difficult action set in a dark fantasy world.

entries.title: Anime Times official VTuber "Hoshinomiya Mirko" launches, teaser PV and first public visual released
entries.title_ja: アニメタイムズ公式VTuber「星ノ宮ミルコ」始動、ティザーPVと初公開ビジュアルを解禁
entries.description:
On June 5th, Anime Times announced the launch of the service's first official VTuber, Miruko Hoshinomiya. On the same day, the first visual and teaser PV were released. Mirko Hoshinomiya is ”AT- […]
The post Anime Times official VTuber "Hoshinomiya Mirko" launches, teaser PV and first public visual released first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: Hirona Yamazaki, So Okuno, Masahiro Toda, Reia Yonekura on “Meeting with a Serial Killer Tonight”
entries.title_ja: 「今夜もシリアルキラーと待ち合わせ」に山崎紘菜、奥野壮、戸田昌宏、米倉れいあ
entries.description: Hirona Yamazaki, So Okuno, Masahiro Toda, and Reia Yonekura will appear as new cast members of the drama ``Tonight I'm Meeting with a Serial Killer'' based on the original work by Kon Iguchi and Yuji Nakamura.

entries.title: Drecom x Manga Box launches new manga label specializing in other world/fantasy works
entries.title_ja: ドリコム×マンガボックスの新マンガレーベル始動　異世界・ファンタジー作品に特化
entries.description: A new comic label, DRE Box (Dori Box), which is a collaboration between Drecom and Manga Box, started today, June 6th. Starting today, four new serialized works will be distributed sequentially on the manga app Manga Box and the browser version of Manga Box.

entries.title: Anime "Akane Banashi" exhibition will be held in Shibuya from July, allowing you to experience the charm of the work in three dimensions
entries.title_ja: アニメ「あかね噺」展が7月から渋谷で開催、作品の魅力を立体的に体感できる
entries.description: The ``TV Anime ``Akane Banashi'' Exhibition'', an exhibition of the TV anime ``Akane Banashi'' based on the original work by Hiroki Suenaga and Takamasa Umagami, will be held at HMV museum Shibuya 6 in Tokyo from July 11th to August 9th.

entries.title: [This week's featured article] Zombie comedy "Tea of ​​the Living Dead" takes first place
entries.title_ja: 【今週の注目記事】1位はゾンビコメディ「お紅茶・オブ・ザ・リビングデッド」
entries.description: From May 28, 2026 to June 3, 2026, the article that attracted the most attention in Comic Natalie was a news article introducing the release of the first volume of ``Ocha of the Living Dead'' by the original author Kentaro Okamoto and the manga artist Shoulder Shoulder Beauty.

entries.title: Anime “Failure Sage” PV in which Ethal, who cannot hide his ability, is unparalleled, OP is FLOW
entries.title_ja: アニメ「落第賢者」実力を隠しきれないエフタルが無双するPV、OPはFLOW
entries.description: The main PV and key visual of the TV anime ``Failure Sage's Gakuin Musou ~Second Reincarnation, S Rank Cheat Magician Adventure~'', originally written by Arata Shiraishi and Kentaro, have been released.

entries.title: "Theatre Anime Seminar" introductory edition will be held at midnight on June 13th, screening of "The Wings of Honneamise" 4K version etc.
entries.title_ja: 「テアトルアニメゼミ」入門編、6月13日深夜に開催　「オネアミスの翼」4K版など上映
entries.description: From June 27th, a series of lectures related to anime, ``Theatre Anime Seminar 2026: Current Location of Anime,'' will be held once a month for a total of six sessions at Theater Shinjuku, Tokyo. Prior to that, the introductory event "odessa Midnight Movies [vol.35] Late-night lecture! Anime seminar introductory edition" will be held at midnight on June 13th.

entries.title: I want to keep the person I love in the countryside...A romantic comedy about a shy girl who transforms into a character, "Ah, Akuma-chan"
entries.title_ja: 田舎に好きな人を引き止めたい…内気な少女が大変身するラブコメ「あっ、悪魔ちゃん」
entries.description: Zaou Fukatsu's new series ``Ah, Akuma-chan'' started on Shonen Jump + today, June 6th.

entries.title: "Tanya Senki II" visual of giant Tanya swinging a tact released, mini anime sequel also released
entries.title_ja: 「幼女戦記II」巨大なターニャがタクトを振るビジュアル公開、ミニアニメの続編も
entries.description: The second key visual for the second season of the TV anime "Tanya Senki II" has been released. The work will be broadcast on TOKYO MX and other channels from July 8th, and will be distributed first and fastest on terrestrial TV at ABEMA/d Anime Store.

entries.title: Season 2 of the anime "Tomica and Tom" will be broadcast every week from July, and the original song will be sung by May J.
entries.title_ja: アニメ「トミカとトム」シーズン2が7月より毎週放送、オリジナル楽曲の歌はMay J.
entries.description: Season 2 of the TV anime "Tomica and Tom" will be broadcast from July 5th on the kids' variety show "Tomipura World Norinori Times!!" which is being broadcast from 8:30 am on 6 TV Tokyo network stations.

entries.title: “Parasite Exhibition” begins! Enjoy live original drawings with vivid sound effects, and also a "radical expression" corner
entries.title_ja: 「寄生獣展」開幕！生々しい効果音とともに生原画を鑑賞、“過激な表現”コーナーも
entries.description: The original art exhibition ``Parasyte Exhibition'' by Hitoshi Iwaaki's ``Parasyte'' opens today, June 6th, at YOKOHAMA COAST in Kanagawa. A press preview was held on June 5th. This article will report on the situation at the venue.

entries.title: Atsushi Tamaru and Nobuhiko Okamoto will appear in “Mujutsu Saint” and visuals featuring all the characters have also been released
entries.title_ja: 「無自覚聖女」に田丸篤志と岡本信彦が出演、キャラ勢揃いのビジュアルも公開
entries.description: The key visual and new cast information for the TV anime ``The Unconscious Saint is unconsciously draining her power today'' have been released. The work will begin broadcasting on AT-X, TOKYO MX, BS11, and other channels from June 30th.

entries.title: All episodes of "Cherry Blossom Tea Prince" will be released for free for 2 days only, and 3 volumes of "Sorairo Kaigan" will also be free
entries.title_ja: 「桜の花の紅茶王子」が2日間限定で全話無料公開、「空色海岸」も3巻分無料に
entries.description: All episodes of Nanpei Yamada's ``Cherry Blossom Flower Tea Prince'' are available for free on Hana to Yume+ until June 8th at 11:59.

entries.title: "Sound! Euphonium" second part preview includes many new cuts, movie tickets of Kumiko and others wearing glasses
entries.title_ja: 「響け！ユーフォニアム」後編本予告に新規カット多数、メガネな久美子たちのムビチケも
entries.description: The trailer and final key visual for the second part of the theatrical anime "Final Movement Sound! Euphonium" have been released.

entries.title: 11 people including Takahiro Sakurai gather for "Osomatsu-san" 10th anniversary event "I really like this work"
entries.title_ja: 「おそ松さん」10周年イベントに櫻井孝宏ら11人集結「僕は本当にこの作品が好き」
entries.description: The TV anime "Osomatsu-san" 10th anniversary special event "10th ANNIVERSARY Osomatsu-san SPECIAL 6DAYS Opening Festival" was held today, June 6th. The event held at Marunouchi Piccadilly in Tokyo included Takahiro Sakurai, who plays Osomatsu, Yuichi Nakamura, who plays Karamatsu, Hiroshi Kamiya, who plays Choromatsu, Jun Fukuyama, who plays Ichimatsu, and Kou, who plays Jushimatsu. Daisuke No, Miyu Irino who plays Todomatsu, Aya Endo who plays Totoko, Yuki Kuniri who plays Chibita, Yoji Ueda who plays Dekapan, Nobuo Tobita who plays Dayon, and Momoko Saito who plays Hatabo took the stage.

entries.title: "Keroro Sergeant" channel has been opened on ABEMA, and all 358 episodes will be broadcast free of charge every day.
entries.title_ja: ABEMAに「ケロロ軍曹」チャンネルが開設、全358話を毎日無料放送するであります
entries.description: A special channel for the TV anime "Keroro Sergeant" based on the original work by Kannon Yoshizaki will be opened on ABEMA for a limited time from June 13th.

entries.title: From Nijisanji to Hololive to “Uma Musume”, all the charming ita bikes are gathered at “Grand Snow Okuibuki”! Pay attention to that sense [ARCChampionship 2026 Photo Report]
entries.title_ja: にじさんじにホロライブ、『ウマ娘』まで魅力たっぷりな痛バイクが「グランスノー奥伊吹」に集結！そのセンスにご注目あれ【ARCChampionship 2026フォトレポ】
entries.description: Be sure to check out these bikes that are as attractive as Itasha!

entries.title: “007 First Light,” which depicts the birth of James Bond, sold 2.7 million copies in its first week! Introductory video of Year One content
entries.title_ja: ジェームズ・ボンド誕生を描く『007 ファーストライト』初週販売本数は270万本！Year Oneコンテンツの紹介映像も

entries.description: From ``Funeral Freelen'', the familiar Freelen cane from the work appears! Carefully reproduced down to the smallest details! #Funeral freelen #freelen

On the 2nd floor of the venue, new products from manufacturers such as Good Smile Arts Shanghai, Miyuki, and Yostar were displayed. This time, we will introduce some of the most popular figures.

Long wigs are considered difficult to handle when it comes to cosplay wigs. If you know how to keep your long wig from getting tangled, you can keep it smooth even after the shoot! Concerns about long wigs Cosplayer's concerns about long wigs […]

entries.title: The developer of the intense gory horror "ILL" releases a "self-imposed trailer" because "the trailer was blocked." A meticulous mosaic from the monster's face to the woman's chest.
entries.title_ja: グロ強烈ホラー『ILL』開発元、「トレイラーがブロックされたから」として“ヤケクソ自主規制トレイラー”を公開する。怪物の顔から女性の胸元まで、几帳面モザイク
entries.description: Team Clout has released a trailer for the "censored version" of the horror game "ILL." The “fake shit” finish is attracting attention.

entries.title: Trine 6: Together in Time, a puzzle action game for up to 4 players, announced and scheduled for release on September 17th. Adventure in a beautiful world by making full use of the "time slowing" ability and unique skills
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力対応パズルアクション『Trine 6: Together in Time』発表、9月17日配信へ。「時間減速」能力と固有スキルを駆使して美麗世界を冒険する
entries.description: Frozenbyte announced the puzzle action game ``Trine 6: Together in Time'' on June 6th. It is scheduled to be distributed on September 17th.

entries.title: "Monster Hunter Wilds" Nintendo Switch 2nd version is in development. Announcement along with major DLC announcement
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ』Nintendo Switch 2版開発中。大型DLC発表にあわせてぬるっと告知
entries.description: Capcom announced on June 6th that it is proceeding with the development of the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Monster Hunter Wilds.

entries.title: The additional route in "Steins Gate Reboot" is the "γ (gamma) world line". A new scenario of despair and loneliness without D-mail
entries.title_ja: 『シュタインズ・ゲート リブート』の追加ルートは「γ（ガンマ）世界線」に。Dメールが存在しない、絶望と孤独の新シナリオ
entries.description: On June 6th, MAGES. announced details of additional routes for ``STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT.''

entries.title: The loose and bloody auto shooter ``Blood Dungeon'' has been announced and will be released this summer. A stage-filled roguelike brought to you by the Nidhogg development team.
entries.title_ja: ゆるふわ血みどろオートシューター『ブラッドダンジョン』発表、今夏発売へ。『Nidhogg』開発陣が贈る、ステージ奔走骨太ローグライク
entries.description: Messhof announced on June 6th that Blood Dungeon will be released in late summer 2026.

entries.title: “Monster Hunter Wilds” super large DLC “Ascendance” introduces a new element “Boost Bracer”. Introducing the dynamic new action of the great sword, light bowgun, and gunlance.
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ』超大型DLC「アセンダンス」では新要素“ブーストブレイサー”登場。大剣・ライトボウガン・ガンランスの躍動新アクションお披露目
entries.description: The official website for the large-scale DLC ``Ascendance'' for ``Monster Hunter Wilds'' has been released, showing off some new elements.

entries.title: PvPvE escape shooter "SAND: Raiders of Sophie" will be released on June 10th. Board a huge mobile base and explore the desert, test play that anyone can participate in starts today
entries.title_ja: PvPvE脱出シューター『SAND: Raiders of Sophie』6月10日配信へ。移動式巨大基地に乗り込み砂漠を探索、誰でも参加できるテストプレイが本日開始
entries.description: tinyBuild announced on June 6th that "SAND: Raiders of Sophie" by Hologryph/TowerHaus will be released on June 10th. This is a PvPvE-style online multiplayer game in which players explore the desert using a huge mobile base.

entries.title: The developers of ``The Witcher 3 Wild Hunt'' have now revealed the purpose of the ``Cow Money Countermeasures'' update. Just “sealing” is not fun, so humorous and brutal support
entries.title_ja: 『ウィッチャー3 ワイルドハント』開発者が今になって“牛金策対策アプデ”の狙いをポロリ。「封じる」だけでは楽しくないので、ユーモラス鬼畜対応
entries.description: The "Gyu-Kan Saku" was once used in "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt." This trick was updated with an unusual countermeasure, but the developer directly revealed the intention of the adjustment and it has become a hot topic.

entries.title: Stealth assassination action "HITMAN Classic Trilogy Remastered" announced. The original Hitman trilogy is remastered and brought back to life
entries.title_ja: ステルス暗殺アクション『HITMAN Classic Trilogy Remastered』発表。オリジナルの『ヒットマン』初期3部作が、リマスターで現代に蘇る
entries.description: Publisher Saber Interactive announced "HITMAN Classic Trilogy Remastered" on June 6th. This is a remastered version of the original trilogy in the Hitman series.

entries.title: The popular ``Taskbar Hero'' will receive a server enhancement update on June 8th. The frequency of treasure chest drops, which was being lowered, is scheduled to be returned to the "initial release level"
entries.title_ja: 人気沸騰『タスクバーヒーロー』、6月8日にサーバー強化アプデへ。引き下げ中だった宝箱ドロップ頻度は“リリース当初レベル”まで戻す予定
entries.description: A relay server will be added in the update scheduled for June 8th at 4:00 pm, and the drop interval of treasure chests will be returned to the original level.

entries.title: Fairy tale neo-noir ADV “The Wolf Among Us 2” will finally be released in 2027. A werewolf sheriff corners familiar fairy tale characters into a hard-boiled situation.
entries.title_ja: おとぎ話ネオノワールADV『The Wolf Among Us 2』ついに2027年配信へ。オオカミ男の保安官が、おなじみ童話キャラたちをハードボイルドに追い詰める
entries.description: Developer Telltale Games announced on June 6th that The Wolf Among Us 2 will be released in 2027.

entries.title: “Final Fantasy VII Revelation” “Issues and solutions of the previous work” developer interview. How did you deal with issues such as ``prolonged play times'' and ``problems with too many minigames''?
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』“前作の課題と解決”開発者インタビュー。「長時間プレイの間延び」「ミニゲーム多い問題」などにどう向き合ったか
entries.description: After developing ``Final Fantasy VII: Rebirth'', we will delve deeper into the final work in the series, including the points that were improved in ``Final Fantasy VII: Revelation'' and the themes used in its development.

entries.title: Impressions of the horde summoning roguelite ``Be My Horde''. A bewitching necromancer who looks down on humanity, the more allies he defeats, the more allies he gains, a slightly different “vansabalike”
entries.title_ja: 大群召喚ローグライト『ビー・マイ・ホード』試遊感想。人類見下し系妖艶ネクロマンサー、敵を倒すほど味方が増える快感、一味違う“ヴァンサバライク”
entries.description: We bring you a play report of ``Be My Horde'' by developer Polished Games.

entries.title: Virtua's new game, VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS, also has a very serious story mode. Created by creators such as “Ryu ga Gotoku” and “Ghost of Tsushima”
entries.title_ja: 『バーチャ』新作『VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS』は「ストーリーモード」もかなり本気。『龍が如く』『Ghost of Tsushima』などのクリエイター陣が手がける
entries.description: Details of the recently officially announced "VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS" were revealed on the information program "VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS SHOWCASE."

entries.title: “Final Fantasy VII Revelation” “Open World” developer interview. What kind of open world is this work? What is the degree of freedom? What title did you refer to? Ask Hamaguchi D.
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』“オープンワールド”開発者インタビュー。本作はどういうオープンワールド？自由度は？参考にしたタイトルは？浜口Dに訊く
entries.description: We talked about the open world of ``Final Fantasy VII Revelation,'' which we learned from the trailer, as well as the mini-games and new battle system in this work.

entries.title: MMORPG "AION2" featuring free flight and aerial combat, global release for PC version scheduled for September 2026
entries.title_ja: 自由飛行と空中戦が特徴のMMORPG「AION2」，2026年9月にPC版グローバルリリース決定
entries.description: NC announced today (June 6, 2026) that the global release of the PC MMORPG "AION2" is scheduled for September 2026. This title features free flight exploration, aerial combat, and fast-paced battles.

entries.title: New content “The Wizard Elusive Target” for “Hitman World of Assassination” is released today. Free to play until July 5th
entries.title_ja: 「ヒットマン ワールド・オブ・アサシネーション」の新コンテンツ「The Wizard Elusive Target」が本日リリース。7月5日まで無料でプレイ可能だ
entries.description: IOInteractive announced today (June 6th) at the game event "SummerGameFest2026" that it will release new content "TheWizard Elusive Target" for the spy action "Hitman World of Assassination" today. You can play for free until July 5th.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 156: “Gothic 1 Remake” and “My Little Cafe Nightmare” on sale
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第156号：「Gothic 1 Remake」や「My Little Cafe Nightmare」が発売に
entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, ``Gothic1Remake'', a full remake of ``Gothic'' released in 2001 using the latest technology, and ``MyLittleCafeNightmare'', a management sim set in a cafe where ghosts gather, were released.

entries.title: "Soulframe", gameplay trailer released. Starring Jennifer English, winner of The Game Awards and BAFTA.
entries.title_ja: 「Soulframe」，ゲームプレイトレイラーを公開。The Game AwardsおよびBAFTAで受賞歴を持つジェニファー・イングリッシュさんが出演
entries.description: Digital Extremes today released the gameplay trailer for their new title "Soulframe". This work is a fantasy action RPG created by the creators of ``Warframe.'' This trailer features TheGameAwards and BAFTA award-winning Jennifer English.

entries.title: “STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT” releases a trailer featuring the new route “γ World Line”. Depicts a harsh world in which “Hououin Kyoushin” was not born.
entries.title_ja: 「STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT」，新ルート“γ世界線”をフィーチャーしたトレイラーを公開。「鳳凰院凶真」が誕生しなかった苛烈な世界を描く
entries.description: MAGES. today (June 6, 2026) released the latest trailer for "STEINS;GATERE:BOOT", which will be released by the company on August 20th, featuring the newly added story "γ World Line". The new story depicts a world in which ``Hououin Kyoushin'' is not born and the situation is very different from the previous one.

entries.title: Announcement of "Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered", a remaster of the first three "Hitman" works. The origin of Agent 47 will come to PC/PS5/Xbox in 2027
entries.title_ja: 「ヒットマン」初期3作品をリマスターした「Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered」発表。エージェント47の原点が2027年にPC/PS5/Xboxへ
entries.description: SaberInteractive and IOInteractive have announced the production of ``Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered,'' a compilation of the first three works of the stealth action ``Hitman'' series. It is scheduled to be released in 2027, and will include features such as the ability to instantly switch to the original version and a photo mode.

entries.title: "STEINS;GATE"'s first full orchestra concert "STEINS;GATE Symphony of Causal Melody", official report released
entries.title_ja: 「STEINS;GATE」初のフルオーケストラコンサート「STEINS;GATE 因果旋律のシンフォニー」，オフィシャルレポート公開
entries.description: The Steins;Gate Orchestra Concert Executive Committee has released the official report of the ``STEINS;GATE Symphony of Causal Melody'' held on May 31, 2026 at ``Mori no Hall 21 Large Hall'' in Matsudo City, Chiba Prefecture. This performance is the first full orchestra concert in the "STEINS;GATE" series.

entries.title: "VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS" is a title that combines action adventure and fighting mode. Details revealed in special program
entries.title_ja: 「VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS」は，アクションアドベンチャーと対戦格闘モードが融合したタイトル。詳細が特別番組で明らかに
entries.description: Sega today (June 6, 2026) distributed a special program for the latest Virtua Fighter series, "VIRTUAFIGHTER CROSSROADS," which was officially announced at SummerGameFest2026. The game seems to be a combination of action-adventure and fighting mode.

entries.title: New information on 20 original indie/small-scale development titles released. Showcase event “Day of the Devs” announcement summary
entries.title_ja: 独創的なインディー / 小規模開発タイトル20本の新情報が公開に。ショーケースイベント「Day of the Devs」発表まとめ
entries.description: Let's summarize the information announced at "DayoftheDevs:SummerGameFestEdition2026". This event introduces indie games and small-scale development titles that are familiar to those looking for unique games. In the SGF2026 edition, new information on 20 titles, including 10 world premieres, was released.

entries.title: Summary of “Summer Game Fest 2026” with lots of new information such as “Monster Hunter Wilds” large DLC and “FFVII REVELATION”
entries.title_ja: 「モンハンワイルズ」大型DLCや「FFVII REVELATION」など新情報多数の「Summer Game Fest 2026」まとめ
entries.description: Today, the game information announcement event "SummerGameFest2026" was distributed. A lot of new information has been announced, including the long-awaited large-scale DLC for "Monster Hunter Wilds" and "FINAL FANTASY VIIREVELATION," which marks the end of the remake trilogy.

entries.title: "Monster Hunter Wilds", Nintendo Switch 2nd version is currently being developed. Details such as release date will be revealed later.
entries.title_ja: 「モンスターハンターワイルズ」，Nintendo Switch 2版を開発中。発売日などの詳細は追って明らかに
entries.description: Capcom has announced that it is proceeding with the development of the Nintendo Switch 2 version of ``Monster Hunter Wilds''. Details such as the release date will be announced later. This is the second big news after the large-scale DLC "Ascendance".

entries.title: "KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS x PARCO GAMES STRAND STORE" opens today at Shibuya PARCO. A large number of collaboration goods were sold for about 3 months. Check out the punchy collaboration menu
entries.title_ja: 渋谷PARCOに「KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS × PARCO GAMES STRAND STORE」本日オープン。約3か月にわたり多数のコラボグッズを販売。パンチの利いたコラボメニューも注目
entries.description: A limited-time pop-up store "KOJIMAPRODUCTIONS×PARCOGAMESSTRANDSTORE" by PARCOGAMES and KOJIMAPRODUCTIONS has opened at Shibuya PARCO. In addition to a large number of collaboration items from over 15 brands, there is also an impactful collaboration menu.

entries.title: The latest trailer for the dark action RPG "Mortal Shell II" has been released. You can also download the beta version on Steam.
entries.title_ja: ダークアクションRPG「Mortal Shell II」の最新トレイラーが公開に。Steamではβ版のダウンロードも
entries.description: The latest trailer for the dark action RPG "Mortal Shell II" (PC/PS5/XboxSeriesX|S) was unveiled at the digital event SummerGameFest2026, which was distributed today (June 6, 2026). At the same time, an open beta version has also started to be released on Steam.

entries.title: Figure festival "Good Smile Fest 2026 Tokyo" will be held. More than 1000 pictures of a variety of colorful figures
entries.title_ja: フィギュアの祭典「グッドスマイルフェス 2026 東京」開催。1000点以上，よりどりみどりなフィギュアたちを乱れ撮り
entries.description: More than 1,000 figures are on display at the figure festival ``Good Smile Fest 2026 Tokyo.'' Let us show you the situation with photos.

entries.title: The new "Crossfire" changes the common sense of cover shooters. A straight-forward game with no multiplayer, no DLC, and no story branches that you can do because you have confidence.
entries.title_ja: 新生「Crossfire」がカバーシューターの常識を変える。自信があるからできる，マルチプレイもDLCも，ストーリー分岐もなしの直球勝負
entries.description: The Los Angeles-based studio "That'sNoMoon" is leading the development of "Crossfire," which was announced at SummerGameFest2026. We asked two of the key people behind this game to talk about the studio facilities and the game's design philosophy, so we'd like to introduce them to you.
