entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has released the entire lineup for the character lottery ``Ichiban Kuji JoJo's Bizarre Adventure STEEL BALL RUN''.

entries.title: Takarajimasha/Takarajimasha Toys opens a special corner “Toy Shop” at the Ginza toy store “Hakuhinkan”! Enjoy touching giant meat buns and stretching reptile figures
entries.title_ja: 宝島社/宝島社トイズ、銀座の玩具店「博品館」に特別コーナー「おもちゃ屋さん」を展開！　巨大な肉まんや伸びる爬虫類フィギュアに触れて楽しめる
entries.description: Takarajimasha and Takarajimasha Toys will be holding a special corner called ``Toy Shop'' from June 5th to July 9th at the toy store ``Hakuhinkan TOY PARK Ginza Main Store'' in Ginza, Tokyo. This time, a preview was held prior to the opening.

entries.title: BANDAI SPIRITS, "Ultraman" becomes three-dimensional in the prize figure "Grandista" series [#Prize Fair] Ultra Seven and King Joe also appear in the Gogan series
entries.title_ja: BANDAI SPIRITS、プライズフィギュア「Grandista」シリーズで「ウルトラマン」が立体化【#プライズフェア】豪塊シリーズでウルトラセブン、キングジョーも登場
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS released a new "Ultraman" prize figure at the "84th Prize Fair" held on May 20th.

entries.title: Announcement of specification changes and postponement of release date for "Shanimas" x "Maddam" collaboration figure "Toru Asakura Oshigoto Effortless Ver." The order period has been extended to June 30th in line with the postponement of the release date.
entries.title_ja: 「シャニマス」×「雀魂」コラボフィギュア「浅倉透 おしごとエフォートレス Ver.」の仕様変更および発売月延期を発表発売延期に合わせ受注期間も6月30日まで延長
entries.description: Overseas hobby manufacturer "SSR FIGURE" has announced that the specifications of the figure "Toru Asakura: Work Effortless Ver." will be changed and the release date will be postponed.

entries.title: The figure of "Mikan Yuuki" who became a high school student from "ToLOVE-Ru Darkness" will be resold in January 2027! Three-dimensional based on the newly drawn illustrations in “Trouble Books”
entries.title_ja: 「ToLOVEる－とらぶる－ダークネス」より高校生になった「結城美柑」のフィギュアが2027年1月再販決定！「とらぶるくい～んず」内の描きおろしイラストをもとに立体化
entries.description: Union Creative will resell the figure "'ToLove-ru' Uniform Series Mikan Yuki ~High School Student Ver.~ [Resale 26]" in January 2027. The reservation period is until 23:59 on July 22nd. The price is 19,800 yen.

entries.title: VFC will release gas guns “AV105 GBBR (JPver.)” and “AV105 Tactical GBBR (JPver.)” which are upgraded versions of the carbine model “AK105” around June!
entries.title_ja: VFC、カービンモデルである「AK105」をモデルアップしたガスガン「AV105 GBBR（JPver.）」と「AV105 Tactical GBBR（JPver.）」を6月ごろ発売！
entries.description: VFC will release gas guns "VFC AV105 GBBR (JPver.)" and "VFC AV105 Tactical GBBR (JPver.)" around June. The price is 104,280 yen for "AV105 GBBR" and 136,400 yen for "AV105 Tactical GBBR".

entries.title: Wave releases a plastic model that can reproduce Max and Miria's "VF-1J" from "Macross" in fighter and battroid form
entries.title_ja: ウェーブ、「マクロス」のマックスとミリアの「VF-1J」を再現できるプラモデルをファイターとバトロイド形態で発売
entries.description: Wave will release the plastic model "VF-1J Valkyrie [Battroid] Multiplex" in late September, and the "VF-1J Valkyrie [Fighter] Multiplex" in late October. The price is 4,980 yen each.

entries.title: “Blue Archive” is now available in the trading figure “Nendoroid Saplaize”! A 6-piece set with all types of characters is now available for pre-order on Amazon!!
entries.title_ja: トレーディングフィギュア「ねんどろいどさぷらいず」に『ブルーアーカイブ』が登場！キャラクターが全種そろう6個入りセットが Amazonで予約受付中!!
entries.description: The game “Blue Archive” is now available in “Nendoroid Saplaize”! The 6-piece BOX set is now available for pre-order on Amazon! #Blue Archive #Nendoroid Saplus

entries.title: "Magiabese" wearing a naked apron from "Magical Girl ni Amorete" is now three-dimensional in the L size of "POP UP PARADE"!
entries.title_ja: 「魔法少女にあこがれて」より裸エプロン姿の「マジアベーゼ」が「POP UP PARADE」のLサイズで立体化！
entries.description: Good Smile Company will release the figure "POP UP PARADE Magiabese Naked Apron Ver. L size" in November. The order period is until July 1st. The price is 8,800 yen.

entries.title: From the anime "Cowboy Bebop" comes BE@RBRICK, the main character "Spike Spiegel"! Now accepting reservations at “A-on STORE” and other locations!
entries.title_ja: アニメ『カウボーイビバップ』より主人公「スパイク・スピーゲル」のBE@RBRICKが登場！「A-on STORE」ほかにて予約受付中！
entries.description: To commemorate the 25th anniversary of the theatrical release of the anime “Cowboy Bebop”, “Spike Spiegel” BE@RBRICK is now available! Reservations are being accepted until June 14th (Sunday) at “A-on STORE” and “Sunrise Store”! #Cowboy Bebop #Bearbrick

entries.title: AOZORAGEAR “Hot Spring Freeren Kerorin Oke” etc.: Amazon Hobby Latest Ranking “Anime/Moe Goods” Category BEST10
entries.title_ja: AOZORAGEAR「温泉のフリーレン ケロリン桶」など：Amazonホビー新着ランキング「アニメ・萌えグッズ」部門BEST10
entries.description: “Hot Spring Free Ren Kerorin Oke” and other items are popular! Amazon Hobby New Arrivals Ranking ``Anime/Moe Goods'' Category BEST10! #Freeren #Dragon Quest

entries.title: Ready for battle with a shotgun and shield! From the game ``Blue Archive'', the fighting chairman ``Kotoriyu Hoshino (battle)'' is now available as a Nendoroid! Now accepting pre-orders on Amazon!!
entries.title_ja: ショットガンやシールドを構えて臨戦態勢！ゲーム『ブルーアーカイブ』より戦う委員長「小鳥遊ホシノ（臨戦）」がねんどろいどになって登場！Amazonで予約受付中!!
entries.description: From "Blue Archive", "Hoshino (battle)" is now available as a Nendoroid! It comes with expression parts such as a ``relaxed face'', ``serious face'', and ``embarrassed face'', as well as weapons such as a ``shotgun'' and ``shield'', and is now available for pre-order on Amazon! #Blue Archive #Kotoriyu Hoshino

entries.title: Indoor survival game field "Phantom Avenue" grand opening on June 27th Complete renewal of the site of "Kowloon (Battle City District)"
entries.title_ja: インドアサバイバルゲームフィールド「ファントムアベニュー」6月27日にグランドオープン「九龍（戦闘市街区）」の跡地を全面リニューアル
entries.description: Koedo will hold the grand opening of the indoor survival game field "PHANTOM AVENUE" on June 27th (pre-opening will be on June 5th). The location is Nishihashimoto, Midori Ward, Sagamihara City, Kanagawa Prefecture. The site of the indoor field "Kowloon (Battle City District)", which was once closed and missed by many Sabah gamers, has been completely renovated.

entries.title: Prizes for anime works such as "NARUTO Shippuden" and "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure" are on display [#Prize Fair]
entries.title_ja: 『NARUTO-ナルト- 疾風伝』、『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険』などアニメ作品のプライズが展示【#プライズフェア】
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS released a new prize figure based on the anime at the "84th Prize Fair" held on May 20th.

entries.title: Capsule toy “Sebon Star My Charm” with a pendant from the toy confectionery “Sebon Star” as a charm will be released sequentially from June 8, 2026 (Monday)! A limited-time POP-UP event will also be held!
entries.title_ja: 玩具菓子「セボンスター」のペンダントをチャームにしたカプセルトイ「セボンスター マイチャーム」が2026年6月8日（月）から順次発売！期間限定のPOP-UPイベントも開催！
entries.description: Kabaya Foods' toy confectionery "Sebon Star" is now available as a capsule toy! “Sebon Star My Charm” will be released sequentially from June 8th (Monday)! A POP-UP event will also be held at “gashacoco Ikebukuro” #Capsule Toy

entries.title: Hasegawa reproduces the North American specification “Ninja” with additional molds! Check out the completed sample photo of the 1/12 scale kit of the legendary 1985 motorcycle "Kawasaki GPZ900R (A2)"!
entries.title_ja: 北米仕様の“Ninja”をハセガワが金型追加で再現！1985年式の伝説的オートバイ「カワサキ GPZ900R（A2）」の1/12スケールキットを完成見本写真で確認！
entries.description: Hasegawa has created a 1/12 scale kit of the 1985 North American specification "Ninja" of Kawasaki's masterpiece "GPZ900R (A2)"! Check out the completed sample photo to see how the handle base and rear fender have been recreated with new parts! #Hasegawa #Plastic model

entries.title: From Nadare Takamine's "Bunny Suit Planning", "Silva Barrel Line" is now available as a "figma" with various equipment!
entries.title_ja: 高峰ナダレ氏の「バニースーツ プランニング」より「シルヴァ・バレルライン」が多様な装備を携え「figma」に登場！
entries.description: Max Factory will release the action figure "figma Silva Barrel Line" in April 2027. The order period is until August 26th. The price is 13,800 yen.

entries.title: "Godzilla (2023)" is a deformed figure from the super-super-built series "D Modeling"! The limited edition comes with a shining dorsal fin effect! Now accepting reservations on Preban!
entries.title_ja: 「ゴジラ（2023）」が超激造シリーズ「D造形」よりデフォルメフィギュア化！限定版は輝く背びれエフェクト付き！プレバンで予約受付中！
entries.description: “Godzilla (2023)” is now three-dimensional from the new line “D Modeling” of the super-super-built series! A limited edition with dorsal fin effect will also be released at the same time! Now accepting reservations on Preban! #Godzilla #Godzilla

entries.title: RC Berg announces the resumption of sales of resin materials and price revisions for the summer Wonder Festival. Secure volume and emphasize our system to meet the demands of dealers
entries.title_ja: RCベルグ、夏のワンフェスに向けレジン材料の販売再開と価格改定を発表。量は確保し、ディーラーの要求に応える体制をアピール
entries.description: RC Berg announced on Official X the resumption of sales of resin materials and price revisions. Sales will resume from June 4th, and the price will increase by 200 yen per kg.

entries.title: Atlas warns of "impersonated accounts posing as employees." In response to the appearance of malicious “fake director” accounts?
entries.title_ja: アトラス、「社員を装うなりすましアカウント」について注意喚起。悪質な“偽ディレクター”アカウント出現を受けてか
entries.description: Atlas issued a warning on June 5, stating that an "impersonation account" has been confirmed that pretends to be an Atlas employee and sends out information.

entries.title: Use gravity reversal and point symmetry rules to escape from a Möbius strip-like space. Geometric puzzle action “Mobius” released
entries.title_ja: 重力反転と点対称のルールを利用し，メビウスの輪のような空間から脱出する。幾何学パズルアクション「Mobius」公開
entries.description: AnvilStudio has announced a new title "Mobius". This is a puzzle action game set in a Mobius strip-like space, where players use gravity reversal and point-symmetric movement rules to reach doors. There are various devices on the stage, and players aim to clear the stage by solving them.

entries.title: [Play Report] I want to see the determination of Daiki Shinjo, played by Hiromitsu Kitayama. Follow the beginning of the incident with the trial version of "AKIBA LOST"
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］北山宏光さん演じる新城大輝の覚悟を見届けたい。「AKIBA LOST」体験版で事件の始まりを追う
entries.description: Play the trial version of ``AKIBALOST'' where you will be drawn into the determination of Daiki Shinjo, played by Hiromitsu Kitayama. We will report on the visual effects that make you feel like you are watching a drama, how the characters' fates change depending on their choices, and the beginning of ``Spirited Akiba'' set in Akihabara.

entries.title: The newly implemented "AI self-driving" in the basic free-to-play "city" open world "NTE" is quite a naughty topic. I'm an honor student in a passenger car, but I suddenly change when I ride a sports car.
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料「街」オープンワールド『NTE』に新実装の「AI自動運転」、結構ヤンチャで話題呼ぶ。乗用車は優等生、スポーツカーに乗ると豹変
entries.description: The self-driving system in ``NTE: Neverness to Everness'' has been attracting a lot of attention, especially for its wild behavior when riding in the ``Porsche 918 Spyder.''

entries.title: ``Putrika 2nd.cut:For the Exquisite Attire'', a visual novel in which a boy is forced to choose whether to let him live again or kill him, is now available on Steam
entries.title_ja: 少年が再び生かすか，殺すかの選択を迫られるビジュアルノベル「プトリカ 2nd.cut:For the Exquisite Attire」，Steamで配信開始
entries.description: Totometori today released the PC software ``Putrika 2nd.cut:FortheExquisiteAttire''. This work is a fully voiced visual novel in which a boy who is a puppet maker is forced to choose whether to let him live or to kill him.

entries.title: "Ryu Miko" Memories Treasure Box No. 3: Kenshin Uesugi and Masamune Date appear. [The world of flames] is spun in a different world similar to the Sengoku period.
entries.title_ja: 「りゅうみこ」思い出玉手箱第3回：上杉謙信，伊達政宗が登場。戦国時代に似た異世界で紡がれる【燎炎の世界】編
entries.description: ``The Miko of the Dragon Palace in the Distant Time and Space'' is a ``love communication adventure game that transcends space and time'', set in the divine realm of the Dragon Palace, and depicts the love between the Miko of the Dragon God and Yatsuha. In the third installment of this series, we focus on ``The World of Enen,'' which features Kenshin Uesugi and Masamune Date. Introducing a story with two Yatsuha that takes place in a different world similar to the Sengoku period.

entries.title: The trial version of “Hakoniwa Denki”, a warm miniature garden electrical repair game, has been released. Circuit puzzles in a loose and chill miniature garden, lighting up the miniature world
entries.title_ja: ほっこり箱庭電気修理ゲーム『ハコニワデンキ』体験版配信開始。ゆるくてチルい箱庭で回路パズル、ミニチュア世界に灯りをともす
entries.description: On June 5th, Asedi distributed the trial version of the puzzle game ``Hakoniwadenki''.

entries.title: ``R-Type Dimensions III'', which has received unpopular reviews on Steam, has been postponed to release on July 2nd for Switch 2/Switch/PS5. Postponed for 2 weeks to wait for “improvement update”
entries.title_ja: Steamで不評集まる『R-Type Dimensions III』、Switch 2/Switch/PS5版は7月2日に発売延期。“改善アプデ”を待つため、2週間の延期
entries.description: Tozai Games announced on June 5th that the release date of the domestic Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch/PS5 version of "R-Type Dimensions III" will be changed from June 18th to July 2nd.

entries.title: Handsome Shinigami chat love sim ``A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS'' to be released in February next year. Sequel to the popular game, experience a date in the underworld with two new Shinigami
entries.title_ja: イケメン死神チャット恋愛シム『A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS』来年2月にリリースへ。大人気ゲーム続編、新たなふたりの死神と過ごす冥界デート体験
entries.description: Two and a Half Studios announced on June 5th that it will release a love simulation game with the Grim Reaper, ``A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS'', in February 2027.

entries.title: Manufacturers of inferior products have announced their withdrawal from the PS Store one after another, including individual game developers. Regulations on “trophy inflated games” will be strengthened
entries.title_ja: PS Storeから粗製乱造メーカーが続々と撤退表明、なかには個人ゲーム開発者も。“トロフィー水増しゲーム”への規制強まる
entries.description: Since the beginning of this year, there have been a number of cases in which poorly produced and overproduced games have been removed en masse.

entries.title: The roguelike card game "Shuuen Witch's Journey", which can be played by up to 4 people, is now available. Customize over 200 base cards to create powerful tactics
entries.title_ja: 最大4人で遊べるローグライクカードゲーム「終焉魔女の旅々」，配信開始。200種類以上のベースカードをカスタマイズして強力な戦術を生み出そう
entries.description: MeowAlive today (June 5, 2026) released a new title, ``The Journey of the Shuuen Majo''. This is a multiplayer roguelike card game where you can freely plan your daily schedule and create powerful custom cards.

entries.title: A collaboration between Hololive “Miko Sakura & Suisei Hoshimachi” and karaoke “JOYSOUND” has been decided. Collaboration menu and goods sales will start from June 13th
entries.title_ja: ホロライブ「さくらみこ＆星街すいせい」とカラオケの「JOYSOUND」によるコラボ決定。コラボメニューやグッズ販売を6月13日から実施
entries.description: On June 5, 2026, Chugai Mining Co., Ltd. announced that the collaboration project "miComet x Karaoke Shop JOYSOUND" will be held from June 13th to July 30th, a collaboration project between "miComet", a unit made up of Sakura Mikoko and Suisei Hoshimachi from "Hololive", and karaoke shop "JOYSOUND".

entries.title: The new update for the open world action game ``Crimson Desert'' includes various mini-games such as ``pinball'' and ``ball toss''. Explore the continent and indulge in arcades
entries.title_ja: オープンワールドアクション『紅の砂漠』新アプデで「ピンボール」や「玉入れ」などミニゲームいろいろ実装。大陸探索そっちのけでゲーセン三昧
entries.description: Pearl Abyss started distributing the latest update Ver.1.10.00 of "Crimson Desert" on June 5th.

entries.title: "Aooni VR Blueberry Mass Production Plan" announced. A VR attraction where up to 22 people can freely walk around the space.
entries.title_ja: 「青鬼VR ブルーベリー量産計画」が発表に。最大22人で空間内を自由に歩き回るVRアトラクション
entries.description: Dynamo Amusement today (June 5, 2026) announced the VR attraction "Aooni VR Blueberry Mass Production Plan" and released the first PV. This work is the first location-based VR attraction in the series that allows you to enjoy a sense of immersion and realism that makes you feel as if you are stepping into the world of ``Ao Oni''.

entries.title: “Cities: Skylines Remastered” announced, to be released this fall. Popular city construction sim revamped for PS5, PS4 version purchasers can buy it for “110 yen”
entries.title_ja: 『シティーズ：スカイライン リマスター』発表、今秋発売へ。人気都市建設シムがPS5向けに刷新、PS4版購入者は“110円”で買える
entries.description: Spike Chunsoft announced ``Cities: Skylines Remastered Japan Special Edition'' on June 5th.

entries.title: Introducing Japan's first ``ADHD treatment support app.'' A clinically tested “insurance covered” game from Shionogi & Co., Ltd.
entries.title_ja: 国内初「ADHD用治療補助アプリ」登場。塩野義製薬発、臨床試験済みの“保険適用”ゲーム
entries.description: Shionogi & Co., Ltd. released the mobile app ``ENDEAVORRIDE'' on June 5th.

entries.title: There have been a number of reports of people being ``wrongly banned'' from the hugely popular ``Taskbar Hero'' on Steam. Confusion spreads over “game ban” left on Steam profile
entries.title_ja: Steamで大ブームの『タスクバーヒーロー』にて「誤BANされた」との報告相次ぐ。Steamのプロフに残る“ゲーム禁止”巡り混乱広がる
entries.description: Confusion is spreading as there are a number of reports of people being "banned" on "Taskbar Hero," where unauthorized users are being disposed of.

entries.title: Announcement of new RPG development tool "RPG-Cobo". Bringing together the know-how of veteran developers, you can create 3D RPGs without any programming knowledge
entries.title_ja: 新たなRPG開発ツール「RPG-Cobo」発表。ベテラン開発者のノウハウ結集、プログラミングの知識不要で3D RPGを制作できる
entries.description: Super Shark Co., Ltd. announced the RPG development tool "RPG-Cobo" on June 5th.

entries.title: Announcing ``Every Wednesday'', an emo everyday coin laundry story. A warm exchange that only comes once a week in a corner of the city
entries.title_ja: エモ日常コインランドリー物語『Every Wednesday』発表。都会の片隅で“週に1度だけ”訪れる、あたたかな交流
entries.description: IndieArk announced "Every Wednesday" on June 5th, announcing that it would be released in February 2027.

entries.title: Atlas warns of spoofed accounts pretending to be employees of the company. Call for confirmation of official announcement
entries.title_ja: アトラス，同社社員を装うなりすましアカウントについて注意喚起。公式発表の確認を呼びかけ
entries.description: Atlas today issued a warning on its official X account about "impersonation accounts" that are transmitting information pretending to be company employees. The company explains that the account has no connection with Atlas.

entries.title: Games are becoming more free "modern games". Interview and booth report with Mr. Rasho, where topics such as “Chess with Beauty as a Victory Condition” and the new work “Bokosuka Gravity” came up [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: ゲームはより自由な“現代ゲーム”へ。「美を勝利条件とするチェス」や新作「ボコスカ グラヴィティ」の話題も飛び出した，ラショウ氏インタビュー＆ブースレポート［BitSummit］
entries.description: Mr. Rasho, known for his unique games such as ``Bokosuka Wars'' and ``Wild Dog Rodem,'' was exhibiting at the indie game event ``BitSummitPUNCH.'' We'd like to bring you a booth report along with an interview where we talked about the new idea of ​​"modern games," "library chess" where beauty is a winning condition, and the new work "Bokoska Gravity."

entries.title: Seaplane exploration/romantic flight RPG "Crosswinds" announced. Tour the port town on a reciprocating seaplane and search for your estranged lover
entries.title_ja: 水上飛行機探索・ロマンチックフライトRPG『Crosswinds』発表。レシプロ水上飛行機で港町を巡り、離ればなれになった恋人を探す
entries.description: Octeto Studios announced the adventure RPG "Crosswinds" on June 4th. This work is an adventure RPG set in the fictional Mediterranean Sea in the 1930s.

entries.title: ``Subnautica 2'' plans to expand exploration area centered on area inhabited by giant creature ``Collector Leviathan'' in major update
entries.title_ja: 「サブノーティカ 2」，大型アップデートで巨大生物「コレクター・リヴァイアサン」が生息するエリアを中心とした探索地域の拡張を予定
entries.description: KRAFTON JAPAN today (June 5, 2026) announced the outline of future short-term and long-term update plans that reflect player feedback for the underwater adventure ``Subnautica 2'', which is currently available in early access. In the upcoming major updates, new vehicles will be added and areas will be expanded.

entries.title: While there are few games released in November due to ``avoiding overlap with GTA 6'', official ``games released in November'' are promoting their existence one after another. Dare to remain steadfast
entries.title_ja: 「『GTA6』との被り回避」で11月発売ゲームが少ないなか、「11月発売ゲーム」公式が次々と存在アピール。あえて不動の構え
entries.description: Games scheduled to be released in November are being announced one after another on social media and are attracting attention.

entries.title: My dream is to make “Portal” into a movie. 'Backrooms' director Kane Parsons explores the possibility of making it a reality
entries.title_ja: 「Portal」の映画化が夢。「Backrooms」のケイン・パーソンズ監督が実現の可能性を探る
entries.description: Director Kane Parsons, known for the movie ``Backrooms,'' has said that it is his dream to make ``Portal'' into a movie. In an interview with The New York Times, the director said he is exploring the possibility of making it happen with "strong curiosity." This is just the director's personal idea, and the project is not in progress.

entries.title: Let's continue to feed delicious food to monsters with insatiable appetites. Automated kitchen factory sim “Snacktorio” starts distribution

entries.description: TNgineers and Rekoup released a new title "Snacktorio" developed by ellraiser on June 4, 2026. This is a factory construction simulation game in which players run a food manufacturing factory to feed monsters who want to devour the world.

entries.description: According to Yacht Club Games programmer David D'Angelo, there are no plans for free downloadable content (DLC) for Mina the Hollower.

entries.title: We asked him about the behind-the-scenes details of the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the masterpiece port of FFVII Rebirth. The idea of ​​``what to keep'' instead of ``what to remove'' with the magic modification of UE4 to optimize the highly difficult open field.

entries.title: Challenge various stages such as puzzles, tower defense, and races. “Wakana Legend”, in which a Little Red Riding Hood-like princess adventures in the fairy tale continent, will be released on June 16, 2026

entries.description: Publisher INDIECN announced that ``Wakana Densetsu'' will be released on June 16, 2026. This work is a 2D action ADV in which a Little Red Riding Hood-style princess adventures across a fairy-tale-style fantasy continent. Players will conquer stages that incorporate a variety of activities such as puzzles, tower defense, racing, and platform action.

entries.title: The popular explosive rat action game ``Mina the Hollower'' quickly surpassed 300,000 copies sold within 3 days of its release. The studio, which was said to be in financial difficulties, is safe for the time being.

entries.description: It has been reported that ``Mina the Hollower'' released by Yacht Club Games has already sold 300,000 copies. Although Yacht Club Games was reported to be suffering from financial difficulties, it appears that they will be able to continue operating for the time being.

entries.title: “PROHIBEAST,” a real-time tactical stealth game set in Chicago during the “meat ban” era, released today.
entries.title_ja: “禁肉法”時代のシカゴを舞台としたリアルタイム戦術ステルスゲーム「PROHIBEAST」，本日リリース
entries.description: SUPERAC will release the new title "PROHIBEAST" for PC today (June 3, 2026). This is a real-time tactical stealth game set in Chicago in the 1930s, in which the player commands a team called the "Untouchables" who fight against rampant corruption.

entries.title: Bottled By Bears, an idle sim where you run a honey farm with a cute bear family, to be released in 2026
entries.title_ja: かわいいクマの家族と一緒にハチミツ農場を経営する放置系シム「Bottled By Bears」，2026年内にリリース
entries.description: monoiistudio will release the PC game "BottledByBears" on Steam within 2026. This work is an idle simulation game in which you run a small honey farm together with the bears of the ``Porford family''.

entries.title: "JDM: Japanese Drift Master", multiplayer feature implemented on Steam version on June 11th. Up to 8 people can run in the open world
entries.title_ja: 「JDM: Japanese Drift Master」，マルチプレイ機能を6月11日にSteam版へ実装。最大8人でオープンワールドを走行可能
entries.description: GamingFactory today announced that the multiplayer feature of the racing game "JDM: Japanese Drift Master" will be implemented for PC (Steam) on June 11, 2026. It supports open world multiplayer where up to eight people can participate in the same session, and features such as voice chat and the ability to place pins on the map are also available.

entries.title: Roguelite "lunch box making" horror "Don't Let It Starve" released on June 12th. Pack your monster chef's lunch with the right ingredients so he doesn't starve.
entries.title_ja: ローグライト“弁当作り”ホラー「Don't Let It Starve」，6月12日にリリース。モンスターシェフを飢えさせないよう，適切な食材で弁当を詰めよう
entries.description: BlackLanternCollective announced on June 2, 2026 that it will release a new title "Don't Let It Starve" developed by Eduardo Scarpato on June 12. This is a roguelite horror game in which the player is trapped in a seedy kitchen and makes various bentos for a chef monster that crawls through the vents.

entries.title: A vampire princess who was betrayed by her mother challenges the queen's castle to reclaim the blood throne. New work ``Bathory - Heritage of Blood'' inspired by ``Castlevania'' released
entries.title_ja: 母に裏切られた吸血鬼の姫が，血の王座を奪い返すため女王の城へ挑む。「悪魔城ドラキュラ」に着想を得た新作「Bathory - Heritage of Blood」公開
entries.description: British game development team Moonana has announced a new title, ``Bathory-Heritage of Blood.'' This work is a 2D action game inspired by ``Castlevania'' in which a vampire princess fights for succession to the throne with her mother. It features a risk-managed combat system in which attacks consume life force and recover by collecting blood from the enemy.

entries.title: ``Animal Town Restaurant Story'', a four-person cooperative game where you run a restaurant in a town where animals live, is currently holding an open play test where anyone can participate

entries.description: On June 2, 2026, ArtDock began an open play test for a new title under development, ``Animal Town Diner Story''. This work is a cooperative simulation sandbox game for up to four players, in which players run a restaurant in a town where various animals live.

entries.description: I would like to share my impressions after playing the demo version of ``UNDEFEATED: Genesis.''

entries.title: A cheat company for games such as GTA5 was hacked and 60,000 pieces of customer data were leaked. Is it a cyber attack aimed at “revenge”?

entries.description: A service that sells cheats for games such as ``Grand Theft Auto V'' has been hacked, and customers' personal information has been leaked.

entries.title: "Steam Deck" will be restocked around 12pm on June 4th. First sale after significant price increase, limited to 1 unit per person

entries.title: ``UNDEFEATED: Genesis'', a hero open world created by a group of UE5 experts, was developed using ``almost only UE5'', including tools. We asked how the team was able to succeed because “the entire team uses UE5”

entries.description: We interviewed Yuma Shinohara, the game director of the UE5 hero action game ``UNDEFEATED: Genesis,'' and Daigo Hyodo, the game producer.

entries.title: Kinney and the Indescribable Oden Shop, which has appeared on Steam, is not an oden shop game at all. When I asked the developer why he named it, he said, "Oden shop = strategic concept."
entries.title_ja: Steamに出現した『キニーと名状しがたいおでん屋』は、全然おでん屋のゲームじゃない。開発者に命名理由を訊いたら「おでん屋＝戦略的コンセプト」だった

entries.title: Super giant drilling boat horror “MOLE” to be released on June 16th. One operation management of a gigantic machine that is about to break down, groping for repairs and operation, ``to the limit'' underground exploration

entries.title: Pixel art dynamic robot action "Gravity Circuit 2" announced. The long-awaited sequel to the “overwhelmingly popular” game, “the boss of the previous game” is now playable and has a hot double protagonist system

entries.title: ``Bunny Guys!'', a multi-player sky-climbing game that had been buried for three years, was given away for free on Steam and suddenly exploded in popularity. Developers are overjoyed and keep updating
entries.title_ja: Steamで“3年埋もれた”マルチ対応空登りゲーム『Bunny Guys!』無料配布され一転人気爆発。開発者は大喜びでアプデしまくる

entries.description: It has been announced that the release date of the first installment of the additional content "The Expanded World" has been postponed from June 9th to September 30th.

entries.title: Gamers have been seen continuing to play, unfazed, even after having hot tea poured on their backs during competitive FPS games. I'll scream, but I won't stop playing FPS

entries.description: A video of a man not stopping his game even after a hot drink is spilled on him at an internet cafe in China has gone viral, attracting attention both domestically and internationally.

entries.title: Rural town horror metroidvania "Silver Pines" will be released on October 8th. A tense detective story where supplies are cut off in a deserted town inhabited by terrifying monsters.

entries.description: HypeTrain Digital announced on June 2nd that Paperhead te4m's horror FPS "PAPERHEAD" will be released on September 19th.

entries.title: “Code Adventure” is a programming school where students and instructors have fun using “Minecraft” as teaching materials: Gamification in everyday places Part 7
entries.title_ja: 「Minecraft」を使った教材で，生徒と講師が楽しみながら取り組むプログラミングスクール「コードアドベンチャー」：身近なところにゲーミフィケーション 第7回
entries.description: Gamification is a system that introduces the elements and principles of games into other fields and uses them to increase people's motivation and solve problems. In the seventh installment of this series, ``Gamification in familiar places,'' we introduce ``Code Adventure,'' a programming school for elementary school students.

entries.title: The memory and ego of the exiled prince who lost everything is dismantled. Trial version of “My Demolition History”, a psychological horror ADV depicting twisted codependency, now available
entries.title_ja: すべてを失った亡国王子の記憶と自我を解体していく。歪んだ共依存を描く心理ホラーADV「俺の解体史」，体験版配信開始
entries.description: Indie development team PopElephantStudio has started distributing the trial version of their new title ``My Demolition History'' on Steam. This work is a psychological horror adventure that depicts the twisted codependence of the exiled prince Hector, who has lost everything, and his uncle and lieutenant Matvey, who supports him. By examining the everyday items in the room, Hector dismantles the memories and ego that he has rejected.

entries.title: "The Blood of Dawnwalker", information on the main characters that the main character Cohen meets on his journey is released
entries.title_ja: 「The Blood of Dawnwalker」，主人公コーエンが旅のなかで出会う主要キャラクターたちの情報を公開
entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment today released information about the main characters that the main character Cohen will meet on his journey regarding the action RPG ``The Blood of Dawnwalker.'' The book introduces people who have a great influence on Cohen's fate, such as Marat, who leads the rebel army, and Lakra, a mysterious woman.

entries.description: Medieval manuscript illustration studio simulation ``Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts'' released a major free update today. In addition to collaboration with Balatro, this update adds transparent PNG output, a work sharing function, and over 200 drawing assets.

entries.title: Operate a giant excavation boat and approach the abyss where the truth is hidden. Horror ADV “MOLE” to be released on June 15th

entries.title: ``Backrooms'', a horror movie based on an internet urban legend, will be released in Japan. A topical work created by A24 that became a huge hit overseas from its first weekend.
entries.title_ja: ネット都市伝説発のホラー映画「Backrooms」，日本公開が決定。A24が手がけ，海外では初週末から大ヒットを記録した話題作
entries.description: Happinet Phantom Studio announced today that the horror film ``Backrooms'' produced by A24 has been decided to be released in Japan. This is a feature-length film by director Kane Parsons that depicts the urban legend ``The Backrooms,'' which spread from a short video on YouTube. It was released overseas on May 29th and became a big hit from the first weekend.

entries.title: In a country on the brink of extinction, girls fight against approaching monsters. “ULTRA0” released today

entries.title: "Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion" Black Shinkalion is now available in the SGX series! We also have a lineup of sets that allow you to enjoy the link combination of E5 Hayabusa and 800 Tsubame! Now accepting pre-orders on Amazon!

The Chinese People's Liberation Army's support fighting vehicle "Type 100 Support Tank", which was first unveiled in 2025, is now available as a 1/35 scale plastic model from Border Model! entries.title: “Nomnomia,” a food chain survival STG created by a game developer who “loves strange creatures,” will be released on June 30th. Aim for the top of strange creatures, a game where the weakest survive on a harsh planet

entries.description: Individual game developer Fukuroku Momota announced on May 30th that the food chain shooting game ``Nomnomia'' will be released on June 30th.

entries.title: World of Tanks: HEAT, a free-to-play tank shooter, was a team-based TPS with little personal responsibility and easy play. Tank hero shooter without healer

entries.title: The Steam/Switch 2 version of the game ``Model Debut 4 Nicola'' supervised by the popular teen magazine ``nicola'' will be released on August 27th. A girl who aims to become the No. 1 model has a stylish life that balances work and love

entries.title: The mentally disintegrating deck-building roguelike ``Chaos Zero Nightmare'' seems to have worked hard to ``build deep and play short.'' From now on, we will focus on “quality of 1 play”

entries.description: Taking the opportunity of the "Half Anniversary" update for "Chaos Zero Nightmare", we asked Kim Hyun Suk, the producer of this game, about what adjustments will be made in the future.

entries.title: "Fate/Grand Order" developer Lasenguru will hold a recruitment event "Open Company" for 2028 graduates on June 27th. Held at the head office, you can hear the real voices of employees

entries.description: Lasenguru announced on June 1st that it will hold an "Open Company" event for students graduating in 2028 on June 27th, 2026.

entries.title: “Kaiju No. 8 THE GAME” expands on the world of “Kaiju No. 8” and is interesting. A story drawn with a unique story and a “live feeling”

entries.description: In this article, I would like to express the good points of "Kaiju No. 8 THE GAME" in words, mainly in terms of characters and story.

entries.title: "Steam Deck" price will increase significantly in Japan as well. The 1TB model will be priced at 167,980 yen with an increase of 50,000 yen or more.

entries.title: "Tekken 8" game director Kohei Ikeda retires from Bandai Namco Studio. “We will continue to take on new challenges,” he says with enthusiasm.

entries.description: Game creator Kohei Ikeda announced on June 1st that he has retired from Bandai Namco Studios, where he worked for 20 years.

entries.description: GRAVITY and DAEWON MEDIA announced "RAGNAROK PROJECT" on June 1st, announcing that it is under development with the goal of release in the first half of 2027.

entries.title: ROG Edition 20, a product series commemorating ROG's 20th anniversary, has been announced. 12 products scheduled to be sold in Japan

entries.title: "Wizardry" 45th anniversary special website has been released. The countdown has started towards the turning point of a series that will leave its name in RPG history.

On the special site, the words "COMINGSOON" and a countdown are displayed, and it seems that some information will be released around 18:00 on June 4th Japan time.

entries.title: New title of “Pixel Art x Abyss Exploration RPG” “Dot Abyss”, service starts on June 11th

This work is a 2D platform game in which you conquer stages while absorbing and ejecting scaffolding. Scaffolding is a limited resource, so players must consider where to absorb it and where to use it while constructing their own clear route.

entries.description: Today (June 1, 2026), the latest video of the web program "Washagana TV" by Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita was released. This time, we will be introducing Yuichi Nakamura's nostalgic game goods and airguns that he brought with him. There are some very old goods that he found while cleaning his house.

entries.title: AB 1921, a bill related to the consumer movement “Stop Killing Games”, passed by the California House of Representatives plenary session
entries.title_ja: 消費者運動「Stop Killing Games」関連法案AB 1921，米カリフォルニア州下院本会議で可決
entries.description: AB1921, a bill regarding the termination of gaming services, was passed in the California State House of Representatives plenary session and will be sent to the state Senate. The bill was introduced in response to the issue of games that rely on online connections and server operations becoming unplayable after the service ends. The content calls for advance notice from the business operator, measures for continued use, and refunds.

entries.title: ``Meccha Chameleon'', a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you paint and mimic yourself, will be released on June 10th

This is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you blend into the scenery and fool the devil's eyes. The game is characterized by the fact that the characters are painted in color and can be camouflaged and hidden, just like a chameleon.

entries.title: Body cam perspective horror “It Reaches” now available for PS5. Vibrations transmitted from the DualSense to your hand allow you to experience the tension of silence and the fear effect even more intensely.

entries.description: PerpGames began distributing the PS5 version of the survival horror "It Reaches" on May 26, 2026. This work features realistic subjective video production from a body cam perspective and enemy AI that detects "breathing sounds." The PS5 version is compatible with the DualSense controller, and the sense of realism transmitted to your hands further enhances the fear of the subjective images, increasing the sense of immersion.

entries.title_ja: 着せ替え・組み換えが楽しめる食玩「リンクトラベラーズ～武ノ国のサムライ編～SIDE:C」が登場！サムライの少女や師匠、ノラマリオンやウマなど全10種を収録！
entries.description: “~Bunokuni no Samurai Edition~SIDE:C” is now available in “Link Travelers”, a candy toy with the theme of dress-up and recombination! Includes a total of 10 types, including a samurai girl, samurai master, Nora Lion, costume sets, and horses! #LinkTravelers #CandyToy

entries.title: “S.H.Figuarts Kamen Rider Dawn” from “Kamen Rider Zets” will be commercialized
entries.title_ja: 「仮面ライダーゼッツ」より「S.H.Figuarts 仮面ライダードォーン」が商品化決定
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS announced the commercialization of the action figure "S.H.Figuarts Kamen Rider Dawn" on May 24th.

entries.title: Stylish Lupine is now three-dimensional at approximately 26 centimeters! From the "LUPIN THE IIIRD" series, the elusive great thief "Lupin the Third" appears as a Banpresto prize figure!
entries.title_ja: スタイリッシュなルパンを約26センチで立体化！『LUPIN THE ⅢRD』シリーズより、神出鬼没の大泥棒「ルパン三世」がバンプレストのプライズフィギュアに登場！
entries.description: From the "LUPIN THE IIIRD" series, Lupine the Third appears as a Banpresto prize figure! Recreate the slender style and cool expression! Scheduled to be released sequentially from May 27th (Wednesday)! #Lupine the Third #Prize

entries.title: The first package image of the Gunpla "HG 1/144 Messer M01 Type (Gaumann Machine)" from "Flash of Light Hathaway: The Witch of Circe" is released! Scheduled to be released on May 30th
entries.title_ja: 「閃光のハサウェイ キルケーの魔女」のガンプラ「HG 1/144 メッサーM01型（ガウマン機）」のパッケージ画像初公開！5月30日発売予定
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has released the package image of the Gundam model "HG 1/144 Messer M01 type (Gauman machine)". Release is scheduled for May 30th, and the price is 3,740 yen.

entries.title: The 5th edition of "Niformation" wafers with "NARUTO" stickers is now available! This time, characters from Sasuke Recapture Arc and Itachi Shinden Arc are included!
entries.title_ja: 『NARUTO-ナルト-』のシール付きウエハース「にふぉるめーしょん」第5弾が登場！今回はサスケ奪還編、イタチ真伝篇からキャラクターたちを収録！
entries.description: From "NARUTO", the 5th edition of "Niformation" sticker wafers using original illustrations! This time, we have included characters that appear in the Sasuke Recapture Arc and Itachi Shinden Arc! #NARUTO #candy toys

entries.title: The theme of the newly drawn illustration is Heisei Gal! TV anime “A Certain Scientific Railgun T” x Don Quijote collaboration will be held from June 6th (Saturday)!!
entries.title_ja: 描き下ろしイラストのテーマは平成ギャル！TVアニメ『とある科学の超電磁砲T』×ドン・キホーテコラボが6月6日（土）より開催決定!!
entries.description: A collaboration between “A Certain Scientific Railgun T” and Don Quijote will be held from Saturday, June 6th! Newly drawn illustrations with the theme of “Heisei Gal” have been released for the first time!! A lineup of goods using the illustrations has also been announced! #A Certain Scientific Railgun #A Certain Scientific Railgun #A Certain Scientific Railgun

entries.title: The hat with bunny ears is too cute! "Moon Witch Police Marshmallow Illustration by SAVI" [Newly taken at AmiAmi exhibition] SAVI's original character is made into a figure
entries.title_ja: うさ耳付き帽子がキュートすぎる！「月の魔女警察 マシュマロ Illustration by SAVI」【あみあみ展示撮り下ろし】SAVI氏のオリジナルキャラクターをフィギュア化
entries.description: From Hobby Sakura, 1/6 scale figure "Moon Witch Police Marshmallow Illustration by SAVI" scheduled to be released in March 2027. This is a three-dimensional version of "Marshmallow" from the original character series "Moon Witch Police" drawn by illustrator SAVI.

entries.title: Even her panicked face is cute! “Goddess of Victory: NIKKE Shifty Illustration ver. “Panic Site”” [Newly taken at AmiAmi exhibition] Figure based on official illustration
entries.title_ja: 慌てた顔まで可愛い！「勝利の女神：NIKKE シフティー イラストver. “パニックサイト”」【あみあみ展示撮り下ろし】公式のイラストをモチーフにフィギュア化
entries.description: 1/7 scale figure "Shifty Illustration ver. 'Panic Sight'" scheduled to be released by Hobby Sakura. This is a three-dimensional version of ``Shifty,'' an operator who provides remote field support from the Level Infinite game ``Goddess of Victory: NIKKE.''

entries.title: Figures of Heisei gal style My Melody and Kuromi! "Sanrio Characters" cosplay figure collection is now available at Banpresto Prize!
entries.title_ja: 平成ギャルスタイルのマイメロディとクロミをフィギュア化！「サンリオキャラクターズ」のコスプレフィギュアコレクションがバンプレストのプライズに登場！
entries.description: A cosplay figure collection from "Sanrio Characters" is now available at Banpresto's Prize! This time, the lineup includes My Melody and Kuromi who are cosplaying as Heisei gals! Scheduled to be released sequentially from May 27th (Wednesday)! #Sanrio Characters #Prize

entries.title: New prize figures scheduled to be released in late May 2026 such as ``Hell Teacher Nube'', ``Buruaka'', and ``Gakumasu'' will be on display in Akihabara!
entries.title_ja: 2026年5月下旬登場予定の新作プライズ『地獄先生ぬ～べ～』『ブルアカ』『学マス』などのフィギュアが秋葉原で展示！
entries.description: Prize figures such as Yukime from "Hell Teacher Nube", Arona and Prana from "Blue Archive", and Seika Shiun from "School Idolmaster" will be on display in Akihabara! #Nu-be- #Buruaka

entries.title: High-quality three-dimensional prize figures of Kanki and Ogiko from "Kingdom" are now available from Banpresto! The Ogiko figure comes with a dialogue plate of Ogiko and Kanki!
entries.title_ja: 『キングダム』桓騎とオギコをハイクオリティに立体化したプライズフィギュアがバンプレストから登場！オギコのフィギュアにはオギコ＆桓騎のセリフプレート付き！
entries.description: From "Kingdom", prize figures of Kanki and Ogiko are now available from Banpresto! The Ogiko figure comes with a plate designed with Ogiko and Kanki's lines! Scheduled to be released sequentially from May 27th (Wednesday)! #Kingdom #Prize

entries.title: Pokemon playing with bubbles are so cute! “Bikkura Egg Bubble Fever Pokemon ~Let’s all play with bubbles♪~” is now available!
entries.title_ja: 泡と遊んでいるポケモンたちがかわいい！「びっくらたまご バブルフィーバー ポケモン ～みんなで泡あそび♪～」が登場！
entries.description: Mascot bubble bath bathing fee "Bikkura Tamago Bubble Fever Pokemon ~ Let's all play with bubbles ♪ ~" is now available! There are 5 mascots in the lineup: Pikachu, Piplup, Yadon, Vulpix (Alola form), and Chirrut! #Pokémon

entries.title: The refreshing casual look of blouse and denim is attractive! From “Uma Musume Pretty Derby”, Hishi Miracle is now a prize figure!
entries.title_ja: ブラウス×デニムの爽やかな私服姿が魅力！『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー』より、ヒシミラクルがプライズフィギュア化！
entries.description: From “Uma Musume Pretty Derby” comes a Hishi Miracle prize figure! A refreshing standing pose in casual clothes! #Uma Musume #Hishimiracle

entries.title: ``Yoshi and Fukashigi's Illustrated Encyclopedia'' has a childhood bug-catching feel to it. “Rune Dice” has a strong puzzle feel. What do you think about the revamped "X Power" specifications in "Splatoon 3"? This week's gaming
entries.title_ja: 『ヨッシーとフカシギの図鑑』は子供の頃の虫取りっぽさあり。『ルーンダイス』はパズル色強め。『スプラトゥーン3』の「Xパワー」仕様刷新に思うところ。今週のゲーミング
entries.description: Now Gaming is a corner where every Sunday, each writer loosely writes about the games they played that week. This is the 545th time.

entries.title: The new version 1.1 of the basic free-to-play "Town" open world "NTE" will implement a new area where you can "live on an island". A big update will be released on June 3rd, including 2 new characters, new play, "Mute only Tagido's voice" function, etc.
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料「街」オープンワールド『NTE』新バージョン1.1では“島暮らし”できる新エリア実装へ。新キャラ2体に新たな遊び、「タギドの声だけミュート」機能などデカ盛りアプデ6月3日配信へ
entries.description: On May 23rd, Perfect World Games revealed the details of Ver. 1.1 of ``NTE: Neverness to Everness'' ``Dream Corridor'' and announced that it will be released on June 3rd.

entries.title: M2 announces the discontinuation of development of STG "Ubusuna", which had been in development for 2012. Due to the retirement of game creator Hiroshi Inouchi
entries.title_ja: エムツー、12年開発していたSTG『ウブスナ』の開発中止を発表。ゲームクリエイター井内ひろし氏退職に伴って
entries.description: On May 24th, M2 announced the suspension of development of ``Ubusuna.'' This work is a shooting game released 12 years ago by Hiroshi Inouchi. It was reported that development had been abandoned following his retirement.

entries.title: Furyu's new survival horror TPS "Anomaris" announced. Multiplayer open world ARPG "Outward 2" will be released in early access on July 7th. 7 must-see gaming articles this week
entries.title_ja: フリューの新作サバイバルホラーTPS『アノマリス』発表。マルチ対応オープンワールドARPG『Outward 2』は7月7日に早期アクセス配信へ。今週の見逃せないゲーム記事7選
entries.description: We have picked up 7 articles, focusing on game introduction articles that received a great response from this week's AUTOMATON. This week, in addition to ``Anomaris,'' other songs such as ``Winter Whiskers'' and ``Handwalk'' were talked about.

entries.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018 is now 100% off, meaning it's free. The popular giant coloring puzzle "Proverbs" is 75% off. "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure All Star Battle R" is also a great deal, this week's high discount PC game
entries.title_ja: 『Car Mechanic Simulator 2018』が今なら100％オフ、つまり無料。大人気巨大色塗りパズル『Proverbs』は75％オフ。『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 オールスターバトル R』もお得な、今週の高割引率PCゲーム
entries.description: In this article, we will focus on titles that have been on sale on Steam in the past week, with a focus on games with particularly high discount rates.

entries.title: In the final episode of ``Saka Tsuku 2026'', a 3-month serious play diary, he continued to be beaten down by the ``club he grew up with''. Challenging a student who is too strong with the power of “all-powerful director”
entries.title_ja: 『サカつく2026』3か月ガチプレイ日記最終回は、“自分が育てたクラブ”にボコボコにされ続けた。強すぎる教え子に「全権監督」パワーで挑む
entries.description: “Let’s create a professional soccer club! 2026'' is the 10th and final installment of the Gachiplay series. In Europe, which is crowded with powerful players, it was his ``student'' who stood in his way at the end of his journey to become the champion.

entries.title: A lonely gourmet's creepy secret. The full story of the cooking sim x cosmic horror “Cucina Stellata” whose demo was released for the first time is finally revealed [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 孤独な美食家の不気味な秘密。デモが初公開された料理シム×コズミックホラーの「Cucina Stellata」の全貌がいよいよ明らかに［BitSummit］
entries.description: At BitSummitPUNCH, a demo of the new product "Cucina Stellata" being developed by FilthyEden was on display. This work is based on a cooking sim about a gourmet who is so obsessed with the traditional cuisine of 19th century Italy that he becomes isolated in the countryside, and a story inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos and a horrifying secret lurking in a basement.

entries.title: Disassemble and repair retro gadgets filled with memories! “Re-Story: Memories Repair Shop” with its relaxing atmosphere [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 思い出が詰まったレトロガジェットを分解＆修理！ リラックスした雰囲気が魅力の「リ・ストーリー: 思い出修理屋」［BitSummit］
entries.description: At "BitSummitPUNCH" held from May 22nd to 24th, 2026, a new title "Re-Story: Memories Repair Shop", published by tinyBuild, was exhibited. I heard that it deals with topics that are compatible with 4Gamer, such as disassembling and repairing gadgets, so I immediately played around with it to see what it was all about.

entries.title: The entire 249 years of American history is turned into a dungeon! Play the mystery-solving ADV “UNDERGROUNDED” that searches for things lost from the strata of history [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: アメリカ249年の歴史が丸ごとダンジョンに！ 歴史の地層から失ったものを探し出す謎解きADV「UNDERGROUNDED」をプレイ［BitSummit］
entries.description: Indie games are created all over the world, and there are quite a few that feature the history and culture of each region. This time, we'll be introducing ``UNDERGROUNDED'', a puzzle-solving ADV that was exhibited at ``BitSummitPUNCH'' and which turns the entire 249-year history of America into a dungeon.

entries.title: Today at Washa Live from 8:00 pm, we will be playing "METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2"
entries.title_ja: 本日20：00からのわしゃ生では，「METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2」をプレイします
entries.description: A live broadcast of the web program "Washagana TV" by voice actor Yuichi Nakamura and freelance writer Mafia Kajita, "Washagana TV", will be held from 8:00 pm today. This time, we will be introducing Konami Digital Entertainment's "METALGEARSOLID: MASTERCOLLECTION Vol.2". The game I'm playing is MGS4, which is my first port.

entries.title: It's fun to play in single player as well. “Yumesen Shoujo” is an attractive rogue-lite action game with a system that makes the most of tag elements [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: シングルプレイでも楽しく遊べる。タッグ要素を最大限に生かしたシステムが魅力のローグライトアクション「夢閃少女」［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the indie game event "BitSummitPUNCH" being held from May 22nd to 24th, 2026, a playable trial version of YOHCAN's new title "Yumesen Shoujo" was on display. This work, which features cartoon-style art, is a roguelite action game where you can enjoy battles that make use of tag elements.

entries.title: ``SOMBRAS: negative frames'' [BitSummit] is a horror-like adventure where you develop the photos you take and solve the mysteries of a creepy parallel world.
entries.title_ja: 撮影した写真を現像し，不気味な異次元世界の謎を解き明かすホラータッチなアドベンチャー「SOMBRAS: negative frames」［BitSummit］
entries.description: Osaka indie developer MaboroshiArtworks' new work ``SOMBRAS:negativeframes'' was exhibited playable for the first time at the BitSummitPunch venue. The game is set in a rural Japanese town in the 2000s, and is a first-person horror adventure featuring a photography system, in which you uncover a dark, distorted, parallel world that reflects your own mind.

entries.title: Remember your customers' faces and offer them your special weapons! Report on a “weapon blacksmith shop with long lines” born from experience in the hospitality industry and appreciation for JRPGs [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: お客さんの顔を覚えて，得意な武器を提供しよう！ 接客業経験とJRPGへの感謝から生まれた「行列のできる武器鍛冶屋」をレポート［BitSummit］
entries.description: KansyaGames is exhibiting a ``weapon blacksmith with long lines'' at ``BitSummitPUNCH'' being held in Kyoto. This is an action game where you play as a blacksmith in a fantasy world and provide weapons to villagers. It is important to guess and memorize the customer's favorite weapon.

entries.title: What do major publishers look for from indies: "works" or "products"? Creator conversation between Yosuke Saito and Hiroshi Matsuyama [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 大手パブリッシャがインディーに求めるのは「作品」か「商品」か。齊藤陽介氏と松山 洋氏のクリエイター対談［BitSummit］
entries.description: On the second day of the indie game festival "BitSummitPUNCH," Yosuke Saito from Square Enix and Hiroshi Matsuyama from CyberConnect2 took to the stage. They talked about the use of AI, suggestions for the indie scene, and the boundaries between works and products.

entries.title: Surreal and crazy 3D platformer "Grindset T.V.", platform ACT where you can enjoy speed running using grind and wall run [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: シュールでイカれた3Dプラットフォーマー「Grindset T.V.」，グラインドやウォールランを駆使したスピードランを満喫できるプラットフォームACT［BitSummit］
entries.description: Indie game publisher CRITICALREFLEX was exhibiting a new title ``GrindsetT.V.'' developed by up-and-coming studio INFINITEANIMAL at BitSummitPUNCH. It's a platform action game with an emphasis on speed-running, in which a private package delivery company races around at ultra-high speed in a dystopian paradise.

entries.title: "BitSummit PUNCH" has ended. The next event will be held from May 21st to May 23rd, 2027. Award-winning works also announced
entries.title_ja: 「BitSummit PUNCH」閉幕。次回開催は2027年5月21日から23日まで。アワード受賞作品も発表
entries.description: The BitSummit Executive Committee announced that the next "BitSummit" will be held for three days from May 21st to May 23rd, 2027 at the Kyoto City Kangyokan Miyako Messe. In addition, with the conclusion of "BitSummitPUNCH", the winning works of two awards decided by audience votes were also announced.

entries.title: Prove your abilities to the Mayan gods! Try out Kaneda Games' "Zaya: Rise to the Gods" [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: マヤの神々に自分の能力を証明せよ！　Kaneda Gamesの「Zaya: Rise to the Gods」を試遊［BitSummit］
entries.description: KanedaGames' new platformer ``Zaya: RisetotheGods'' was on display at the CatalanArtsDigitalCulture booth at ``BitSummitPunch''. It's a metroidvania in which the main character, Saya, goes on a journey to discover the source of a curse that pollutes the hearts of humans and corrupts even the gods. Localization for Japan has already been underway.

entries.title: Cocodrolo Games, the creator of the cute detective mystery “Clue: Murder By Death,” is releasing a new work called “School Days,” a life sim set in a school [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: キュートな探偵ミステリー「Clue: Murder By Death」を生んだCocodrolo Gamesによる新作は，学校を舞台にしたライフシム「School Days」［BitSummit］
entries.description: At BitSummitPUNCH, I had the opportunity to speak with the representative of CocodroloGames, which released the detective ADV ``Clue:MurderByDeath'', in which you hunt down a murderer while solving puzzles in a mansion with 165 rooms. We were also introduced to a new project called ``SchoolDays,'' a life sim ADV that has the same taste as the same work, so let us share with you the details.

entries.title: The haiku adventure “OKU”, which has signed a publishing contract, has improved both the quality of its haiku and its ukiyo-e style art style [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: パブリッシング契約を結んだ俳句アドベンチャー「OKU」は，俳句の質も浮世絵風アートスタイルもパワーアップしていた［BitSummit］
entries.description: OKU, developed by Germany's IroxGames, is an adventure game in which the player travels through the beautiful seasons of Japan as a monk following in the footsteps of his master. This work was introduced at ``gamescom 2025,'' but it was announced that a new publishing contract had been signed with ByteRockers' Games, and development seems to be on track.

entries.title: Mango Protocol's cute new work "Angie Magica" released for the first time in Japan. Although it is a magical girl story, it is not suitable for children [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: Mango Protocolのキュートな新作「Angie Magica」を日本初公開。魔法少女のストーリーながら子供向けにあらず［BitSummit］
entries.description: MangoProtocol announced the development of a new title ``AngieMagica'' and held a trial exhibition for the first time in Japan at BitSummitPUNCH. . It is a top-down adventure game with a cooking system at its core, and the story is that the main character, Angie, who admires magical girls, has truly wandered into another world.

entries.title: Survive in the garden of death filled with flowers. Fixed camera survival horror "The Florist" exhibited at BitSummit PUNCH. Latest gameplay video also released [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 花々が彩る死の庭園で生き残れ。固定カメラ式サバイバルホラー「The Florist」，BitSummit PUNCHに展示。最新ゲームプレイ動画も公開［BitSummit］
entries.description: UnclearGames has released the latest gameplay video in conjunction with the exhibition of ``The Florist'', which is currently under development, at BitSummitPUNCH. This is a classically styled horror action film that uses a fixed camera system and depicts the harsh survival of the main character Jessica, set in a rural lakeside town that has suddenly been invaded by colorful flowers that are beautiful yet deadly.

entries.title: "Hyper Euphoria" Steam version will be released on May 22, 2026, Nintendo Switch version will also be released within 2026
entries.title_ja: 「ハイパー・ユーフォリア」Steam版2026年5月22日発売，Nintendo Switch版も2026年内にリリース予定
entries.description: The Steam version of ``Hyper Euphoria'', a yuri suspense horror ADV set in the psychedelic travel world of Hiroshima, will be distributed on May 22, 2026 for 1,500 yen (tax included). In addition to Japanese, it supports traditional and simplified Chinese, and a Nintendo Switch version is scheduled to be released in 2026.

entries.title: 25 people including Hajime Isayama and Nobunaga Shimazaki will be exhibiting colored paper at the "Parasite Exhibition" New goods include Hirokawa's election towel
entries.title_ja: 「寄生獣展」で諫山創、島﨑信長ら25人の色紙展示　新グッズに広川の選挙タオルも
entries.description: The third teaser visual and second set of goods for Hitoshi Iwaaki's original art exhibition "Parasyte Exhibition" have been released.

entries.title: [This week's featured article] Voices of sadness over the death of Wakana Yamazaki, who played Ran Mori in "Detective Conan"
entries.title_ja: 【今週の注目記事】「名探偵コナン」毛利蘭役の山崎和佳奈の訃報に悲しみの声
entries.description: From May 14th to May 20th, 2026, the article that attracted the most attention in Comic Natalie was a news article reporting the death of voice actress Wakana Yamazaki.

entries.title: "Hyakuem." x Village Vanguard Pop-style badges of Togashi and others wearing aprons
entries.title_ja: 「ひゃくえむ。」×ヴィレヴァン　エプロンを着用したトガシたちのポップ風バッジなど
entries.description: Collaboration goods between Village Vanguard and the theatrical anime "Hyakuemu" based on the original work by Uotoyo are now available. It is available for order at Village Vanguard's online store.

entries.title: Free distribution of Hololive secondary creation game "HoRoyal", you can also take commemorative photos with 3D model talents
entries.title_ja: ホロライブ二次創作ゲーム「HoRoyal」無料配信、3Dモデルのタレントと記念撮影もできる
entries.description:
The action game "HoRoyal ~Hololive Battle Royal~" from Hololive Production's derivative game brand "holo Indie" will be distributed for free on Steam from May 21, 2026 (Thursday) […]
The post Hololive derivative game "HoRoyal" is available for free distribution, and you can also take commemorative photos with 3D model talents. Appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: Rebuild “Getter Robo”! “Force Getter Robo”, a robot toy made with priority on “playing with deformation and combination”, is super cool
entries.title_ja: 「ゲッターロボ」を再構築！“変形合体を遊ぶ事”を優先に作られたロボット玩具、「フォースゲッターロボ」がメチャカッコ良い

entries.title_ja: 「スター・ウォーズ」シリーズの可動フィギュア「Infinity Action Xシリーズ」が2026年6月発売予定！『スター・ウォーズ／マンダロリアン・アンド・グローグー』登場キャラなど5体！
entries.description: Characters from “Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Groogoo” are also available! Five “Star Wars” characters appear in the movable figure “Infinity Action X Series”! Doyusha sells ZD toys products domestically! #Star Wars #The Mandalorian and Groogoo

entries.title: "Blue Archive" CCC's Hikari and Nozomi are now available as deformed figures "Nendoroid"! Pay attention to the adorable visuals!
entries.title_ja: 『ブルーアーカイブ』CCCのヒカリとノゾミがデフォルメフィギュア「ねんどろいど」で登場！愛らしいビジュアルに注目！
entries.description: From ``Blue Archive'', Hikari Tachibana and Nozomi Tachibana from CCC, members of Highlander Railway Academy, have been turned into deformed figures ``Nendoroids''! In addition to expression parts, optional parts such as a hat are included! #Buruaka

entries.title: The second edition of "Gundam Stamp Rally 2026" will be held with the completion of the installation of the life-sized Unicorn Gundam statue! Chance to win Gundam Base Limited Gunpla “Unicorn Gundam [Gold Coating]” and more!
entries.title_ja: 「ガンダムスタンプラリー2026」第2弾が実物大ユニコーンガンダム立像の設置終了に伴い開催！ガンダムベース限定ガンプラ「ユニコーンガンダム［ゴールドコーティング］」などが当たるチャンス！
entries.description: With the completion of the installation of the life-sized Unicorn Gundam statue, the second round of "Gundam Stamp Rally 2026" will start on June 8th! Once you have completed the overlapping stamps, you can participate in a lottery to win Unicorn Gundam Gunpla, Gundam Base exclusive products, and more! #Gundam

entries.title: Cosplayer [Shinoya Shino] | Cosplay of the caring tsundere fox-eared avatar beautiful girl "Aya Sakayori"
entries.title_ja: コスプレイヤー【しのや しの】｜面倒見の良いツンデレ狐耳アバターの美少女「酒寄彩葉」コスプレ
entries.description: We would like to introduce the cosplayer "Shinoya Shino" who cosplayed "Aya Sakayori" from "Super Kaguyahime!" on X (formerly Twitter). Shinoya Shino's cosplays are all of high quality with perfect wig sets. Ko

entries.title: Free-to-play "Town" open world "NTE", Steam and Epic Games version store pages suddenly appear. Will it be released in July?
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料「街」オープンワールド『NTE』、SteamとEpic Games版ストアページが突如出現。7月にもリリースか
entries.description: The Steam and Epic Games store store pages for Perfect World Games' NTE: Neverness to Everness were released on May 23rd.

entries.title: Opinions are rapidly emerging that the machine learning AI in the real Japanese race "Forza Horizon 6" is "unnaturally fast." Suspicions of “cheating” have been raised, leading to official investigation
entries.title_ja: リアル日本レース『Forza Horizon 6』の機械学習AIが「不自然に速すぎる」との意見が急浮上中。“ズル”疑惑も寄せられ、公式による調査へ
entries.description: ``Forza Horizon 6'' has become a hot topic after a developer message was released stating, ``We are currently investigating complaints that the opponent's AI is too fast, especially in high difficulty modes.''

entries.title: Open world forest ruins zombie survival game ``Never Be Alone'' will be available for early access on Steam on December 8th. Multiplayer compatible, survive with a firearm in an apocalyptic world
entries.title_ja: オープンワールド・森林廃墟巡りゾンビサバイバル『Never Be Alone』、Steamにて12月8日早期アクセス配信へ。マルチプレイ対応、終末世界で銃器を手に生き延びる
entries.description: Beast Studios announced on May 22nd that Never Be Alone will enter early access on December 8th, 2026. This work is an open world zombie survival game.

entries.title: Furyu, official response to "But it's Furyu". Reflecting on feedback and vowing to improve upon feedback that ``Even if the atmosphere is good, the feel of the game is uneasy''
entries.title_ja: フリュー、「でもフリューだしな」に公式反応。「雰囲気が良くてもゲームとしての手触りが不安」との声に反省＆改善誓う
entries.description: At the announcement of the new work, Frew himself said, ``But it's Frew,'' which attracted a lot of attention.

entries.title: A former director of the ``Dying Light'' series has expressed the opinion that ``game developers have an obligation to listen to the voices of players.'' Because the game also “belongs to the player”
entries.title_ja: 『ダイイングライト』シリーズ元ディレクター、「ゲーム開発者はプレイヤーの声に耳を傾ける“義務”がある」との意見を展開。ゲームは“プレイヤーのもの”でもあるから
entries.description: Tymon Smektała, former franchise director for the Dying Light series, shares his thoughts on listening to people who have played the game.

entries.title: Beautiful girl 3D roguelite "Endless Alice" has finally implemented the "last boss" with the latest update. “The biggest update in the history of this game” with new characters from “Chibikko Sniper”
entries.title_ja: 美少女3Dローグライト『エンドレスアリス』、最新アプデでついに“ラスボス”実装。「ちびっこスナイパー」の新キャラも登場の“本作史上最大アプデ”
entries.description: HowlingRain has released a major free update for Endless Alice. The final boss has finally been implemented, and new characters have also appeared.

entries.title: Open-world action game ``LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight'' is about to be released and receives ``overwhelmingly positive reviews''. You can play Batman properly in the light Lego world.
entries.title_ja: オープンワールドアクション『レゴ バットマン：レガシー・オブ・ザ・ダークナイト』リリース間もなく「圧倒的に好評」。ノリ軽めのレゴ世界でしっかりバットマンできる
entries.description: WB Games released Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight on May 22nd. This work is the latest work in the ``LEGO Batman'' series and has quickly received positive reviews.

entries.title: The HD remaster of ``Kiss'' RPG ``Extetra'' will be released on July 30th on Steam. Furyu's mysterious work has been powered up and brought to the present day, with Nintendo Switch and PS5 versions also in progress.
entries.title_ja: “キス”で戦うRPG『エクステトラ』HDリマスター、Steam版が7月30日に発売へ。フリューの怪作がパワーアップして現代に、Nintendo Switch版やPS5版も進行中
entries.description: Furyu announced on May 23rd that the HD remastered version of the fantasy RPG ``Extetra'' will be released on Steam on July 30th. It has also been announced that development has begun for the Nintendo Switch 2/Switch version and PS5 version.

entries.title: The Animate Fair for the RPG ``Fujyou Myoudou'' full of super beautiful ``sinners'' was absolutely mesmerizing with both the exhibits and the special voices. To celebrate the 3.5th anniversary, a full-scale mystery event is being held in the game.
entries.title_ja: 超美形“罪人”だらけRPG『無期迷途』のアニメイトフェアは、展示も特別ボイスもとにかくメロかった。3.5周年を祝し、ゲーム内では本格ミステリイベントも開催中
entries.description: Posters are displayed from the 1st floor to the 5th floor, and the sight of Convicts appearing one after another each time you go up the stairs is a spectacular sight.

entries.title: The grand prize of the “BitSummit PUNCH” award was decided to be “Artis Impact”. 4Gamer Award goes to BONJORY's "Handlime" [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 「BitSummit PUNCH」アワードの大賞は「アーティス インパクト」に決定。4Gamer賞はBONJORYの「Handlime」に［BitSummit］
entries.description: The award ceremony was held at "BitSummitPUNCH" currently being held at Miyako Messe in Kyoto. The winner of the VERMILIONGATE AWARD, the highest award, was Mas's ``Artis Impact.'' BONJORY's "Handlime" was selected for the 4Gamer Award.

entries.title: ``KILLA'' is a mystery adventure created by a group of four Korean friends. How has it changed since Toei Games decided to publish it? [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 韓国の仲良し4人組が作る推理アドベンチャー「KILLA」。東映ゲームズからのパブリッシングが決まり，どう変わった？［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the BitSummitPUNCH venue, we interviewed Kenkitsudan, a four-person Korean indie development team currently developing the mystery adventure game ``KILLA.'' We asked how Toei Games decided to publish the game and the differences in this demo version.

entries.title: A game based on a Spanish newspaper comic. 2D point & click ADV "Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail" drawn by the original author over 8 years [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: スペインの新聞漫画をゲーム化。原作者が8年かけて描き切る2Dポイント＆クリックADV「Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail」［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the CatalanArtsDigitalCulture booth at BitSummitPunch, a point-and-click ADV with hand-drawn art, "Jordi&Oslo:TheLostTail," was on display. This is a work of art in which the original author of the newspaper comic spent eight years drawing all the art.

entries.title: Check out 10 titles from the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), including supernatural mystery, steampunk action, and a journey to find the ultimate dish [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 超能力推理に，スチームパンクなアクション，究極の一皿を求める旅など，韓国コンテンツ振興院（KOCCA）の10タイトルを見る［BitSummit］
entries.description: The Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) is exhibiting a booth at the indie game event "BitSummitPUNCH" being held at Kyoto City Industrial Center Miyako Messe. Let's introduce Korean indie works. There are many ambitious works in various genres.

entries.title: New popular rhythm game "Muse Dash 2", horror ADV about the last two humans, slow life, etc. China Indie Game Alliance (CiGA) exhibits 9 titles [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 人気リズムゲーム新作「Muse Dash 2」，人類最後の2人を描くホラーADV，スローライフなど。中国インディーゲームアライアンス（CiGA）が9タイトル出展［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the CiGA booth of ``BitSummitPUNCH'' being held at the Kyoto City Kangyokan Miyako Messe, there are trial play tables of nine titles, mainly Chinese indie works. You can also play the popular game ``MuseDash2''.

entries.title: "Pro Jank Footy" is a sports x roguelite that makes you laugh. The game is chaotic, with points being stolen, players becoming huge, sudden blue screens, etc. [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: スポーツ×ローグライトで笑いを生む「Pro Jank Footy」。点数を盗む，選手巨大化，突如ブルースクリーンなど試合はカオス［BitSummit］
entries.description: I played the roguelite sports game "ProJankFooty" at BitSummitPUNCH. ``The next goal is scored, we win,'' ``The HDMI cable comes loose and the screen turns blue,'' and ``the players become gigantic.'' Unimaginable chaos is accelerating.

entries.title: "DREADMOOR" play report. A addictive horror fishing game where you catch strange fish in an eerie sea [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 「DREADMOOR（ドレッドムア）」プレイレポート。不気味な海で奇怪な魚を釣る，クセ強めのホラー系釣りゲーム［BitSummit］
entries.description: The dark fishing game ``DREADMOOR'' was exhibited at the indie game event ``BitSummitPUNCH'' being held at Miyako Messe in Kyoto Prefecture. It's a work with a strong quirk of traveling through a sea full of monsters and catching strange fish. I tried it out at the venue, so I'd like to share my impressions with you.

entries.title: Steam and Epic Games Store store pages for surreal city open world RPG "NTE: Neverness to Everness" released. Steam version scheduled for July 2026
entries.title_ja: 超現実都市オープンワールドRPG「NTE: Neverness to Everness」，SteamとEpic Games Storeのストアページ公開。Steam版は2026年7月予定
entries.description: PerfectWorldGames today (May 23, 2026) released the store page for the open world RPG "NTE: Neverness to Everness" on Steam and Epic Games Store. The Steam version is scheduled for release in July 2026.

entries.title: What will be their next move, which ranges from “mouthwash” to “raccoon dogs”? We asked the CEO of the distinctive CRITICAL REFLEX [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: “マウスウォッシュ”から“タヌキ”まで手掛ける彼らの次の一手とは。異彩を放つCRITICAL REFLEXのCEOに聞いてみた［BitSummit］
entries.description: Publisher CRITICALREFLEX is making a splash at BitSummit again this year. The company specializes in edgy titles that are not bound by genre boundaries, and has shown an explosive presence in the indie game scene in recent years. At the BitSummitPunch venue, Rita Lebedeva, the company's CEO, introduced the booth.

entries.title: That "train attack" too. In addition to 12 new titles, there will also be plenty of new information such as events and incubator programs at the Catalonia, Spain booth [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: あの「電車アタック」も。スペイン・カタルーニャ州ブースでは12本の新作タイトルに加えてイベントやインキュベータープログラムなど新情報も盛りだくさん［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the event ``BitSummitPunch'' being held at Miyako Messe in Kyoto, the booth of the government of Catalonia, Spain, which includes Barcelona, ​​is making its presence felt. In addition to releasing 12 new titles including ``Densha Attack,'' there is also plenty of information on game events and incubator programs.

entries.title: Which sense will you lose next? The popular fringe game “Saiken Shoujo” that has been viewed more than 270,000 times is now available with roguelike deck construction elements [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 次に失うのはどの感覚？ 閲覧数27万回以上を達成した人気フリゲ「代償少女」，ローグライクデッキ構築要素をプラスして登場［BitSummit］
entries.description: In recent years, works that were first distributed as free games on Unityroom have gained popularity, and a route to commercialization is being established. ``Saiken Girl'', which is on display at this year's BitSummitPUNCH, is one such work. Let's bring you a play report on how this popular title, which has been viewed more than 270,000 times, has evolved.

entries.title: A translator who gets lost in the game world has a great adventure. Introducing "Crazy Localization", a comical depiction of the chaos at the localization site [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: ゲーム世界に迷い込んだ翻訳者が大冒険。ローカライズ現場の修羅場をコミカルに描いた「Crazy Localization」を紹介［BitSummit］
entries.description: At the indie game event "BitSummitPUNCH", a new work "CrazyLocalization" by the team "Name Doesn't Describe" was exhibited. I would like to introduce it in this article as it is a comical depiction of the difficulties involved in localizing a game.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 154: “LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight” and “Forza Horizon 6” on sale
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第154号：「LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight」や「Forza Horizon 6」が発売に
entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, ``LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight,'' which depicts the growth of a young Bruce Wayne into Batman, and ``Forza Horizon 6,'' the latest work in the series set in Japan, were released.

entries.title: Is this an indie connection? “Schrödinger’s Call” and Odencat’s cat collaboration is being held at the BitSummit venue
entries.title_ja: これぞインディーなつながり？ 「シュレディンガーズ・コール」とOdencatのねこコラボがBitSummit会場で実施中
entries.description: A collaboration project between Shueisha Games and Odencat is currently underway at the BitSummitPUNCH venue. It's a wonderful project where you can get a sticker by connecting Hamlet from ``Schrödinger's Call'' with Odencat, Odencat's signature cat, over the phone. Let's make the cat's wish come true.

entries.title: Interview with Hiroyuki Ichinose, producer of "RPG Maker U2U". Focus on “P2D” that allows you to intuitively create maps with depth [BitSummit]
entries.title_ja: 「RPGツクールU2U」プロデューサーの一之瀬裕之氏にインタビュー。奥行きのあるマップを直感的に作れる“P2D”に注目［BitSummit］
entries.description: GotchaGotchaGames is exhibiting its latest game production software ``RPG Maker U2U'' at BitSummitPUNCH. We interviewed producer Hiroyuki Ichinose about this work, which features ``P2D'', a three-dimensional visual expression with depth.

entries.title: Traveling Yuri Suspense Horror “Hyper Euphoria” Steam version to be released on May 22nd

entries.description: Waku Waku Games has announced that the Steam version of the PC adventure game ``Hyper Euphoria'' developed by Cat Hui Corporation will be released on May 22, 2026. The price is 1,500 yen, and a Nintendo Switch version is scheduled to be released in 2026.
