entries.description: From Bushiroad Creative's capsule toy brand "Bushikapu!", creator efu's "Kami Eroku" has been made into a three-dimensional figure for the first time! Figures that condense a unique world view are scheduled to be released in late September 2026 #Capsule Toy #Shinkeiroku

entries.title: “Ellie”, “Joel” and “Bloater” from “The Last of Us Part I” appear as 1/4 scale statues Pre-orders start from May 22nd at Prime 1 Studio official online store
entries.title_ja: 「The Last of Us PartⅠ」より「エリー」「ジョエル」「ブローター」が1/4スケールスタチューで登場5月22日よりプライム1スタジオ公式オンラインストアにて予約開始
entries.description: Prime 1 Studio has made "Ellie", "Joel", and "Bloater" from the game "The Last of Us Part I" into three-dimensional 1/4 statues. We started accepting reservations from May 22nd on the EC site "Prime 1 Studio Official Online Store".

entries.title: Pre-orders for ``CSM Grongivert Gedrud'' from ``Kamen Rider Kuuga'' will be available for pre-order from 4:00 pm on May 22nd.A total of 11 people and approximately 160 types of recorded voices are available. Also includes lines in Grongi and Lint.
entries.title_ja: 「仮面ライダークウガ」より「CSMグロンギベルト ゲドルード」がプレバンにて5月22日16時より予約開始収録音声は総勢11名、約160種。グロンギ語、リント語の台詞も収録
entries.description: Bandai will begin accepting reservations for the adult role-playing toy ``CSM Grongibelt Gedrud'' on the mail order site ``Premium Bandai'' from 16:00 on May 22nd. Shipping is scheduled for November, and the price is 34,100 yen.

entries.title: Good news for hobby fans who are Amazon Prime members! The "Automatic Purchase Program" function has been implemented, making it possible to automatically purchase items without having to buy high-priced items, waiting for them to be restocked or at a reasonable price!
entries.title_ja: Amazonプライム会員のホビーファンに朗報！「自動購入プログラム」機能が実装され、プレ値の高額アイテムを買わずに再入荷や適正価格を待っての自動購入が可能に！
entries.description: Amazon has implemented an "auto-purchase" feature that allows you to wait for restock or price drop and automatically purchase! Confirmed that it has been introduced in some products such as Gunpla, plastic models, Tomica, Hot Wheels, and toys! #Amazon #Amazon Prime

entries.title: The sitting pose and smiling expression with side glances are attractive! Toru Takamatsu in his "Bandori" uniform is now a prize figure from Bushiroad Creative!
entries.title_ja: 座りポーズ＆流し目でほほ笑む表情が魅力的！『バンドリ』制服姿の高松燈がブシロードクリエイティブからプライズフィギュア化！
entries.description: The prize "BanG Dream! Premium Figure MyGO!!!!! Toru Takamatsu uniform ver." with a nice sitting pose will be available from May 2026! #Bandori #Prize

entries.title: Something is going to happen this summer! "Mecha Suma Impact 2026" will be held on the eve of June 2nd, new work will be announced on June 3rd
entries.title_ja: この夏、何かが起こる！ 「メカスマインパクト2026」が開催決定6月2日前夜祭、6月3日に新作発表を実施
entries.description: Good Smile Company will hold the distribution event "Mecha Suma Impact 2026" over two days on June 2nd and 3rd.

entries.title: Miscellaneous items that express the world view of the anime "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Phantom Blood/Battle Trend" and "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Stardust Crusaders" are now available!
entries.title_ja: アニメ『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 ファントムブラッド/戦闘潮流』『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スターダストクルセイダース』より、世界観を表現した雑貨アイテムが登場！
entries.description:
Article updated: May 22, 2026 - Offering a variety of items such as stone mask charm pouches and printed handkerchiefs with "fruit-shaped" motifs - Blooming Nakanishi Co., Ltd., founded in 1879 (Meiji 12) (Headquarters: Chuo-ku, Tokyo, President and CEO: Nakanishi […]
The post Miscellaneous items that express the world view of the anime "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Phantom Blood/Battle Trend" and "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Stardust Crusaders" are now available! first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: [Introducing wedding dresses for cosplay] Great for photo shoots! If you want to make your favorite character look like a bride, wear this one (2026 edition)
entries.title_ja: 【コスプレ向けウェディングドレス紹介】撮影映えバツグン！推しキャラの花嫁姿を叶えるならこの1着（2026年度版）
entries.description:
“Bride arrangements” and “wedding costumes” are among the most popular cosplay works. Authentic wedding dresses tend to be expensive, but cosplay dresses have many advantages: they are light and easy to move around in, are reasonably priced, and are easy to arrange. This time […]
The post [Introducing wedding dresses for cosplay] Great for photo shoots! If you want to make your favorite character look like a bride, wear this one (2026 edition) first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: Up to 4-player cooperation/planetary open world ``STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions'' will be released in early access on June 12th. A spin-off of "Astronia" that explores a mysterious planet.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力・惑星オープンワールド『STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions』6月12日に早期アクセス配信へ。不思議惑星を探検する、『アストロニーア』のスピンオフ作
entries.description: Devolver Digital announced on May 22nd that early access distribution of the planetary exploration adventure game ``STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions'' will begin on June 11th.

entries.title: It has been reported that a new cheat countermeasure for VALORANT has made the "direct memory access" cheat device unusable. Officials also strongly encourage “paperweightization”
entries.title_ja: 『VALORANT』の新チート対策で、“メモリ直アクセス”チートデバイスが使用不可になったとの報告。公式も「文鎮化」を強気に煽る
entries.description: The Riot Games official account made a bullish post, saying, ``Congratulations to the owners of expensive paperweights.''

entries.title: Announcement of ``BIOTONE.'' which requires a microphone and breaks pitch blocks. A “throat con” block crushing game where you control the bar with the pitch of your voice and have to be aware of your surroundings.
entries.title_ja: マイク必須・音程ブロック崩し『BIOTONE.』発表。声の高さでバーを操る、「周辺注意」の“喉コン”ブロック粉砕ゲーム
entries.description: Kayak released the Steam store page for ``BIOTONE.'' on May 21st. It is scheduled to be released in the second quarter of 2026.

entries.title: Famous game companies also participate! “Apply once and all at once” job change event “Experienced version Game Creators Draft (Engineer)” will be held [Applications will start accepting applications from June 1st]
entries.title_ja: 有名ゲーム会社も参加！“一度応募するだけで一斉選考”転職イベント「経験者版 ゲームクリエイターズドラフト（エンジニア）」開催決定【6月1日から応募受付開始】
entries.description: IMAGICA GEEQ announced on May 22 that it will hold a job event for new graduates and those with engineering experience. The entry period is scheduled to run from June 1st to July 10th at 6pm.

entries.title: ``Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6)'' sales boss once again emphasizes, ``We will not postpone it.'' Marketing will start in earnest “after late June”
entries.title_ja: 『グランド・セフト・オートVI（GTA6）』販売元ボス、「延期はしない」とまたまた強調。マーケティングは“6月下旬以降”に本格始動へ
entries.description: Trauss Zelnick, CEO of Take-Two Interactive, has confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI will be released on November 19th.

entries.title: In the beta update of "Slay the Spire 2", adjustments have been made to the new boss "Eternal Hourglass". Troublesome card “Decay” has been magically modified to be “unplayable”
entries.title_ja: 『Slay the Spire 2』ベータアプデで、新実装ボス「永劫の砂時計」にさっそく調整到来。厄介カード「衰微」は“プレイ不可”に魔改造
entries.description: In addition to immediate adjustments to "Eternal Hourglass," major adjustments have also been made to familiar Elites such as "Parasitized Prism" and "Writhing Swarm Organism."

entries.title: Dystopia Interviewer Sim ``Thank you for your application'' will be distributed on June 19th. A life of mass production of “prayer emails” where you are busy with reviewing resumes, judging acceptance, piles of documents, and paying rent.
entries.title_ja: ディストピア面接官シム『ご応募ありがとうございます』6月19日配信へ。履歴書さばいて合否をジャッジ、書類の山と家賃に追われる“お祈りメール”量産生活
entries.description: No More Robots announced on May 21st that the dystopian interviewer sim ``Thank you for your application'' will be released on June 19th.

entries.title: High-speed extreme 2D action "White Steel X 3" announced, scheduled for release in 2027. The latest work in the series wields a new "combined weapon", and also includes a mysterious reinforcement system
entries.title_ja: 高速極限2Dアクション『白き鋼鉄のX（イクス） 3』発表、2027年発売へ。新たな“合体型武装”を振るうシリーズ最新作、謎の強化システムも
entries.description: Inti Creates announced the action game ``White Steel X 3'' on May 22nd.

entries.title: Survival TPS ``ANOMALITH'' is a Tanaka Romeo scenario that depicts ``creepy'' SCP, Showa retro, and liminal space. Delivering a developer briefing session
entries.title_ja: サバイバルTPS『アノマリス／ANOMALITH』は、田中ロミオシナリオで「不気味な」SCPや昭和レトロとリミナルスペースを描く。開発者説明会をお届け
entries.description: ``ANOMALITH'' is a challenge to the TPS genre, which is different from Furyu's RPG-based genre. We will give you an explanation from the producer about the concept behind this work.

entries.title: Up to 8 players competitive slapstick race "Hashirehebereke EX" will be released on September 3rd. Sunsoft's masterpiece racing game has been remade in a modern style after 30 years
entries.title_ja: 最大8人対戦ドタバタレース『はしれへべれけEX』9月3日発売へ。サンソフトの傑作レースゲームが“約30年越し”に現代風リメイク
entries.description: Gravity Game Arise announced on May 22nd that the racing action game ``Hashirehebereke EX'' will be released on September 3rd.

entries.title: Square Enix deception multiplayer “KILLER INN” has an amazing “75% off” sale, now available for 300 yen. Transferable free trial version also available
entries.title_ja: スクエニ騙し合いマルチ『KILLER INN（キラーイン）』驚異の“75%オフ”セール開幕、いまなら300円。引き継ぎ可能な無料体験版も配信開始
entries.description: You can purchase it now for 75% off for 300 yen (tax included). A free trial version is also available.

entries.title: The second major update to the popular open world "Fuenden: Where Winds Meet" will be released on May 28th. Enjoy court life to the fullest with the opening of the ultra-vast “1 million square meter” “Imperial Palace Area”
entries.title_ja: 人気オープンワールド『風燕伝：Where Winds Meet』第2弾大型アプデ、5月28日配信へ。“100万平方メートル”の超広大「皇宮エリア」開放で、宮廷生活とことん謳歌
entries.description: NetEase Games announced on May 22nd that the second major update for ``Fuenden: Where Winds Meet'', ``Miyagaku no Asabake'', will be implemented on May 28th.

entries.title: In the free-to-play ``city'' open world ``NTE'', ``jailbreak research'' progresses rapidly. A “Taipa-focused” prison bullet tour that takes just 30 seconds from arrest to return home
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料「街」オープンワールド『NTE』にて、”脱獄研究”がやたら進む。逮捕から帰宅まで30秒ちょっと、“タイパ重視”刑務所弾丸ツアー
entries.description: There seems to be a growing movement among NTE users to "improve the efficiency of jailbreak" and perform time attacks.

entries.title: Impressions of advance play of Frew's new TPS "ANOMALITH". A disgusting and horror-like experience, but an intense SCP experience that encourages you to "attack hard"
entries.title_ja: フリュー新作TPS『アノマリス／ANOMALITH』先行プレイ感想。気持ち悪くてホラー風味だが、「ガンガン攻める」ことを促す、強烈SCP体験
entries.description: During the trial run of ``ANOMALITH,'' I felt that the game was full of ingenuity to entertain players, such as its eerie worldview and extremely aggressive combat. I will tell you the contents.

entries.title: E-sports club "INSOMNIA" launches a joint research project with the University of Tokyo and others. Efforts to tackle the “mystery of the brain” of e-sports players and scientifically lead to victory
entries.title_ja: eスポーツクラブ「INSOMNIA」、東大などと共同研究プロジェクト発足。eスポーツ選手の“脳の謎”に挑み、勝利を科学的に引き寄せる取り組み
entries.description: On May 22nd, the professional e-sports organization ``INSOMNIA'' announced the launch of ``INS×LAB.''

entries.title: The gameplay teaser for RPG "Hopetown" created by the staff involved in the development of "Disco Elysium" has been released. Change the fate of the town through reporting and publishing articles
entries.title_ja: 「ディスコ・エリジウム」開発に携わったスタッフが手がけるRPG「Hopetown」，ゲームプレイティザーを公開。取材と記事の発表で町の運命を変える
entries.description: LongdueGames has released a gameplay teaser for their new RPG "Hopetown." This work is a work in which the staff involved in the development of ``Disco Elysium'' participates, and the player plays the role of a journalist who visits the fictional mining town of New Greenwich, and follows the truth of the incidents that occur in the town.

entries.title: Security simulation ``Security 51'' that inspects entrances and exits at a mysterious facility begins playtest where anyone can participate
entries.title_ja: 謎の施設で出入りを検査する警備シミュレーション「Security 51」，誰でも参加できるプレイテストを開始
entries.description: On May 21, 2026, Alawar began playtesting a new title under development, ``Security51.'' This work is a security horror simulation game that was inspired by ``Papers, Please'' and ``ParanoiaSCP.''

entries.title: Collaboration cafe “Nijisanji Cafe ~Milky Ribbon Party~” will be held in Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka from June 15th to July 28th
entries.title_ja: コラボカフェ「にじさんじCafe 〜Milky Ribbon Party〜」が6月15日から7月28日まで東京，名古屋，大阪で開催
entries.description: On May 22, 2026, IT Entertainment announced that the collaboration cafe "Nijisanji Cafe~MilkyRibbonParty~" between the art space "andGALLERY" and "Nijisanji" will be held for a limited time from June 15th to July 28th. The participating stores are the Ikebukuro store, Nagoya 1st store, and Namba 1st store.

entries.title: SAO new work "Echoes of Aincrad" tutorial video for beta testers released. Introducing partner cooperation, weapon reinforcement system, base build elements, etc.
entries.title_ja: SAO新作「Echoes of Aincrad」βテスター向けチュートリアル映像を公開。パートナー連携や武器強化システム，拠点でのビルド要素などを紹介
entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment today released a tutorial video for the latest Sword Art Online home game, ``Echoes of Aincrad.'' In the video, you can see the game system of this work, from character creation to exploration, combat, and weapon enhancement.

entries.title: Songs from "The Legend of Zelda: Triforce of the Gods 2" are now available on Nintendo Music. Contains a total of 105 songs
entries.title_ja: 「ゼルダの伝説 神々のトライフォース2」の楽曲がNintendo Musicに登場。全105曲を収録
entries.description: Nintendo today (May 22, 2026) began distributing songs from ``The Legend of Zelda: Triforce of the Gods 2'' on ``NintendoMusic,'' a music distribution service for Nintendo Switch Online subscribers.

entries.title: Ellie, Joel, and Bloater from "The Last of Us Part I" appear as 1/4 scale statues. By arranging the three bodies, you can recreate the deadly battle scene from the movie.
entries.title_ja: 「The Last of Us Part I」からエリー，ジョエル，ブローターが1/4スケールスタチューで登場。3体を並べることで，劇中の死闘シーンを再現
entries.description: Prime 1 Studio today announced 1/4 scale statues of Ellie, Joel, and Bloater that appear in ``The Last of Us Part I'' in the Real Elite Master line of the high-end brand ``PRIME 1 STATUE'' and has started accepting reservations. By lining up the three figures, you can recreate the battle scene in the gymnasium in the movie.

entries.title: "STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions", early access version released on June 11th. Latest trailer and Q&A video also released
entries.title_ja: 「STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions」，6月11日に早期アクセス版をリリース。最新トレイラーやQ&A動画も公開
entries.description: DevolverDigital announced today (May 22, 2026) that it will release the early access version of the new title "STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions" developed by SystemEraSoftworks on June 11th. Along with the announcement, a roadmap containing future updates has also been released.

entries.title: Large-scale tactical shooter "WARDOGS", developer video released explaining the "three pillars" that form the game
entries.title_ja: 大規模タクティカルシューター「WARDOGS」，ゲームを形作る“3つの柱”を解説する開発者動画を公開
entries.description: BULKHEAD today (May 22, 2026) released a developer video ``Tactical Depth & Teamplay'' that introduces the game content of the new title ``WARDOGS'' currently under development. The video features development staff and introduces the three pillars that make up this work.

entries.title: You can enjoy songs such as ``Megami Ibunroku Persona'' and ``Persona 2 Sin'' for 30 hours. Unarchived distribution event starts on May 29th at 18:00
entries.title_ja: 「女神異聞録ペルソナ」や「ペルソナ2 罪」などの楽曲を30時間にわたって楽しめる。アーカイブなしの配信イベントが5月29日18：00にスタート
entries.description: Atlus announced on May 22, 2026 that "PersonaSoundStationVol.2" will be distributed on the official YouTube channel of the company's game sound label "ATLUSGAMEMUSIC" from 18:00 on May 29th to 0:00 on May 31st. In this project, songs such as ``Megami Ibunroku Persona,'' ``Persona 2 Sin,'' and ``Persona 2 Punishment'' will be distributed for 30 hours.

entries.title: The demo version of "AI Pixel Art Battle" where AI decides the winner and loser is now available on Steam. Battle by drawing a monster that can beat your opponent's monster.
entries.title_ja: 勝敗をAIが決める「AIドット絵バトル」，デモ版をSteamで配信開始。相手のモンスターに勝てそうなモンスターを描いてバトル
entries.description: MONOENTERTAINMENT today began distributing the demo version of the PC software ``AI Pixel Art Battle'' on Steam. This is a game where you draw and fight original monsters that are likely to defeat your opponent's monsters. The release date for the product version is within this year.

entries.title: "Pokémon Sleep", Latias/Latios pickup event will be held from June 8th. Dragon type seems to be useful
entries.title_ja: 「Pokémon Sleep」，ラティアス / ラティオスピックアップイベントが6月8日から開催。ドラゴンタイプが活躍できそう
entries.description: Pokemon announced today (May 22, 2026) that it will hold a "Latios and Heart Drop" event on the sleep app "Pokémon Sleep" starting June 8th. This event will feature Latias/Latios.

entries.title: [Play report] Now you can raise goats too! "Farming Simulator 26: Nintendo Switch Edition" lets you enjoy an even more advanced farming experience
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］今度はヤギも育てられる！ さらに進化した農業体験を堪能できる「Farming Simulator 26: Nintendo Switch Edition」
entries.description: Let's introduce "FarmingSimulator26:NintendoSwitchEdition" released by Sega on May 19, 2026. The "FarmingSimulator" series, developed by GIANTS Software, is highly popular mainly in Europe and the United States as a simulation game that allows you to experience authentic farming.

entries.title: "Forza Horizon 6" has over 6 million players within 3 days of its release. An event has also started where you can win various vehicles.
entries.title_ja: 「Forza Horizon 6」，リリースから3日でプレイヤー数が600万人を突破。さまざまな車両をもらえるイベントもスタート
entries.description: PlaygroundGames announced today (May 22, 2026) that the number of players for the latest game in the series, "Forza Horizon 6," has exceeded 6 million in just three days since its official release on May 19. Series 1 of the Festival Playlist will start from the 21st, and you can earn various vehicles by participating in the event.

entries.title: "Re-Story: Memories Repair Shop", a game about running an electronics repair shop in 2000s Tokyo, releases gameplay trailer
entries.title_ja: 2000年代の東京で電子機器修理店を営む「リ・ストーリー: 思い出修理屋」，ゲームプレイトレイラーを公開
entries.description: tinyBuild today released the gameplay trailer for ``Re-Story: Memories Repair Shop''. This work is set in Tokyo in the 2000s, and the player becomes the owner of a repair shop, and while repairing various gadgets brought in, the player comes into contact with the memories and lives of the clients. A trial exhibition is being held at BitSummitPUNCH.

entries.title: "Dorohedoro" Nikaido Demonization Progress Ver. 1/7 Complete Figure [Medicos Entertainment]
entries.title_ja: 『ドロヘドロ』 ニカイドウ 悪魔化進行Ver. 1/7 完成品フィギュア[メディコス・エンタテインメント]
entries.description:
From the manga "Dorohedoro", Nikaido appears! Based on the cover illustration of volume 16 of the comics, it has been made into a three-dimensional figure with advanced demonization. Not only from the front, but also diagonally, from the back, looking up, looking down... the silhouette is beautiful from any angle, and the original […]
The post "Dorohedoro" Nikaido Demonization Progress Ver. 1/7 Complete Figure [Medicos Entertainment] first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title: TV Anime "My Heart's Dangerous Guy" Anna Yamada Swimsuit Ver. 1/6 Complete Figure [Bell Fine]
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『僕の心のヤバイやつ』 山田杏奈 水着Ver. 1/6 完成品フィギュア[ベルファイン]
entries.description:
From the TV anime "Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu" comes a 1/6 scale figure of the heroine, Anna Yamada! The first thing that jumps out at you is her flowery smile!　Her carefree atmosphere will naturally make you relax as well. Lilacs […].
The post TV Anime "Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu" Anna Yamada Swimsuit Ver. 1/6 Complete Figure [BELFINE] appeared first on Amiami News.

entries.title: From the smartphone game "Blue Archive" comes a 1/7 scale figure of "Yuka" wearing pajamas!
entries.title_ja: スマホゲーム『ブルーアーカイブ -Blue Archive-』より、「ユウカ」がパジャマの姿で1/7スケールフィギュア化！
entries.description:
From the smartphone game ``Blue Archive'' comes ``Yuka'' wearing relaxed pajamas. Scheduled to be released in February 2027. Of course, it's perfectly fine to call me at such a time! Very popular smartphone game […]
The post From the smartphone game "Blue Archive" comes a 1/7 scale figure of "Yuka" wearing pajamas! first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title: An update has been carried out that adds "Grand Strategy SSB2", new weapon "Kongou-class destroyer Chokai", etc. Scenario maps will be added every month
entries.title_ja: 「大戦略SSB2」，新兵器“こんごう型護衛艦ちょうかい”などを追加するアップデートを実施。シナリオマップは毎月追加予定
entries.description: System Software Beta has released an update to ``Grand Strategy SSB2'' that adds new weapons such as the ``Kongou-class destroyer Chokai.'' Two scenario maps will be added every month until June 2026, and the final scenario will be distributed as paid DLC.

entries.title: Gugenka exhibits at VR event “Super Metafes 2026” Exhibition and sale of holomodel links and holomodel link bags
entries.title_ja: VRイベント「超メタフェス2026」にGugenka出展ホロモデリンクやホロモデリンクバッグの展示と販売
entries.description:
[Gugenka Co., Ltd.]
Gugenka Co., Ltd. (Representative Director and CEO Masashi Mikami) will be exhibiting at “Super Metafest 2026” to be held on Saturday, May 23, 2026. Holo... a device that allows you to carry your own avatar or digital figure on a daily basis.

entries.title: Yukihana Lamy x Choco Zap collaboration held, limited goods and support voice available
entries.title_ja: 雪花ラミィ×チョコザップコラボ開催、限定グッズ・応援ボイスを用意

Shipping is scheduled for September to October, and the price is 22,000 yen. There will also be a purple swimsuit version and a white swimsuit version.

entries.description: Gotcha Gotcha Games announced "RPG Maker U2U" on May 21st.

entries.title: The dwarf mining roguelite FPS "Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core" started to receive mixed reviews due to being "too difficult". Highly difficult cave exploration with upgraded equipment
entries.title_ja: ドワーフ採掘ローグライトFPS『Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core』、盛況も“難しすぎ”て賛否両論スタート。装備強化で挑む高難度洞窟探索
entries.description: Ghost Ship Publishing and Coffee Stain Publishing launched early access for Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core on May 21st. This work is a rogue-lite FPS that is a spin-off of ``Deep Rock Galactic'' and has been successful, but it has received mixed reviews due to its difficulty level and other factors.

entries.title: The government is aiming to introduce an "identity verification system using My Number Card" for purchases of Pokemon card games, etc., in August of this year. Is it a countermeasure against overheated resale?
entries.title_ja: ポケモンカードゲームの購入などに「マイナンバーカードで本人確認システム」導入へ、今年8月をめどに。過熱する転売に対策か
entries.description: The Pokémon Company announced on May 21 that it plans to introduce an identity verification system using My Number cards for the Pokémon Card Game. The system is expected to be used for some product sales and events.

entries.title: The "NieR: Automata" collaboration event will be held at the Square Enix deception multiplayer "KILLER INN" after the latest update released tomorrow. “Mystery x Violence” Battle as 2B or 9S

entries.description: Square Enix announced on May 21st that a collaboration event with ``NieR: Automata'' will be held in the murder mystery action game ``KILLER INN''.

entries.title: A downtown novel game that “does not reveal the plot” “How much is the corpse in the stocker?” ” To be distributed on May 28th. A “common story” that you want someone to like

entries.description: Renka, an independent game developer, posted on May 21st, ``How much is the corpse in the stocker? ' was announced to be released on May 28th. According to the story, it will be released on the night of May 28th.

entries.title: Rabbit girl's close-out action game "Rubinite" will be released on July 23rd. An exhilarating game specializing in boss rushes, where you can keep hitting fatal blows with “just evasion”
entries.title_ja: ウサギ少女見切りアクション『ルビナイト』7月23日に配信へ。“ジャスト回避”から致命の一撃を浴びせ続ける、ボスラッシュ特化爽快ゲーム
entries.description: Cup Dog Games announced on May 21st that the studio's 2D boss rush action game ``Rubinite'' will be released for PC (Steam) on July 23, 2026.

entries.title: It is reported that the Chinese government has banned the import of NVIDIA's GPU "RTX 5090 D v2" for China. Banned even though it is a model exclusively for China
entries.title_ja: NVIDIAの中国向けGPU「RTX 5090 D v2」、中国政府が“輸入禁止”にしたとの報道。中国専用モデルなのに、出禁に
entries.description: In China, it has emerged that the NVIDIA GPU "GeForce RTX 5090 D v2" may have been designated as a prohibited item by customs.

entries.title: Announcing the soothing animal snow removal game ``Winter Whiskers.'' Removing snow from an entire town buried in snow, chilling out with hard labor
entries.title_ja: 癒やしのどうぶつ除雪ゲーム『Winter Whiskers』発表。雪に埋もれた街丸ごとひたすら除雪、重労働チルアウト
entries.description: Mango Leaf Games announced the snow removal simulation game ``Winter Whiskers'' on May 21st.

entries.title: It is estimated that sales of ``Subnautica 2'' in the first week alone were ``approximately 16 billion yen.'' One of the fastest selling games released this year
entries.title_ja: 『サブノーティカ2』の初週だけで売上「約160億円」との推計。今年発売のゲームでも最速クラスの爆売れ
entries.description: Alinea Analytics, a game market data analysis company, reported that ``Subnautica 2'' is estimated to have sold 4.1 million copies in less than a week after its release, achieving revenue of 100 million dollars (approximately 16 billion yen).

entries.title: Behind the hit coin roguelike "RACCOIN" is the work of COREBLAZER, a "support team that is not a publisher." How did the mysterious group support the hit work?
entries.title_ja: ヒット中コインローグライク『RACCOIN』の後ろには、“パブリッシャーではない支援チーム” COREBLAZERの活躍あり。謎の集団はどのようにヒット作を後押ししたのか？
entries.description: One of the teams behind the success of "RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike" is the game development support team COREBLAZER. It will be interesting to see how they supported development from a position different from that of the publisher.

entries.title: ``Don't Touch Snail,'' a harsh tag game that can only be played once, will be released on May 29th. All you have to do is run away from the slow snail, but if you touch it you will die instantly and you will never be able to play with it again.
entries.title_ja: 「一回しか遊べない」過酷鬼ごっこゲーム『ドント・タッチ・スネイル』5月29日発売へ。のろのろカタツムリから逃げるだけ、ただし触れると即死して二度と遊べない
entries.description: PlasticBagHandMan and Both Good have announced that they will be releasing an "anti-healing" neglect game called "Don't Touch Snail" on May 29th.

entries.title: Steam “open world” language learning game “Language Learning in Noun Town” is finally officially released. A virtual world where you can “speak” and learn the names of things you encounter, and each time you learn, it becomes more colorful.
entries.title_ja: Steam“オープンワールド”言語学習ゲーム『Noun Townの言語学習』ついに正式リリース。出会ったモノの名前を“喋って”習得、学ぶたびに色づく仮想世界
entries.description: SUPER HYPER MEGA officially released “Language Learning in Noun Town” on May 20th.

entries.title: Announcement of "Starpath", a survival spaceship journey without combat. Multi-compatible, a spacecraft made from scratch can be used to navigate deep space, and if you take a wrong turn, you will be “drifting”
entries.title_ja: 戦闘なし宇宙船旅サバイバル『Starpath』発表。マルチ対応、一から手作りした宇宙船でひたすら深宇宙航行、進路を誤れば“漂流”
entries.description: On May 20th, independent game developer Jonathan Smårs announced the space open world survival craft game ``Starpath.''

entries.title: Cooperative slapstick railway construction game "Unrailed 2: Back on Track" will be officially released on June 11th, with PS5/Switch version also on sale. Busy rail-laying work to guide the unstoppable train to its goal
entries.title_ja: 協力ドタバタ鉄道建設ゲーム『Unrailed 2: バック・オン・トラック』6月11日正式リリース、PS5/Switch版も発売へ。止まらぬ列車をゴールまで導く、大忙しレール敷設作業
entries.description: Indoor Astronaut announced on May 21st that the official release date for Unrailed 2: Back on Track will be June 11th.

entries.title: “All hand-drawn” dark fantasy game “Tormentum II” will be released on July 24th. Highly rated nightmare world adventure sequel to be released 8 years after its announcement
entries.title_ja: “全部手描き”ダークファンタジーゲーム『Tormentum II』7月24日配信へ。高評価悪夢世界アドベンチャー続編、発表から8年越しに出る
entries.description: OhNoo Studio announced on May 21st that the point-and-click adventure game "Tormentum II" will be released on July 24th.

entries.title: "Tamagotchi Paradise - Orange Tropics / White Glacier", where Tamagotchis can be raised in "Nangoku" and "Kori" fields, will be released on July 11th

entries.description: Bandai announced today (May 21, 2026) that it will release ``TamagotchiParadise-OrangeTropics/WhiteGlacier'', which is equipped with new functions in ``TamagotchiParadise'', on July 11th. With this product, you can take care of your Tamagotchi in the new "Nangoku" and "Kori" fields.

entries.title: "Start!! Hero Base DX" is now available for Xbox. A strategy simulation game where you create a city of heroes.
entries.title_ja: 「発進!!ヒーロー基地DX」，Xbox向けに配信開始。ヒーローたちの街を作る戦略シミュレーションゲーム
entries.description: Kairosoft today began distributing the Xbox version of ``Take Off!! Hero Base DX.'' This work is a strategy simulation game set in a city that has been devastated by an evil organization, where you gather and train your fellow heroes, and enjoy city building and battles. There are also elements that allow you to change your vehicle and avatar and develop your own original hero.

entries.title: Washagana TV's latest video shows you how to play EXNOA's new game "Dot Abyss"
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，EXNOAの新作ゲーム「ドットアビス」をプレイする様子をお届け
entries.description: Today (May 21, 2026), the latest video of the web program "Washagana TV" by Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita was released. This time, we will show you how to play EXNOA's new game "Dot Abyss". Since many unique beautiful girls will appear, the team composition will be decided at a draft meeting.

entries.title: “Crystal of Atlan” x “NieR:Automata” collaboration starts today. In addition to costumes for 2B and 9S, a new profession "Oniblade" is now available.
entries.title_ja: 「クリスタル・オブ・アトラン」×「NieR:Automata」コラボが本日開始。2Bや9Sのコスチュームに加え，新職業「鬼刃」が登場
entries.description: Nuverse today launched a collaboration event with ``NieR: Automata'' for the action RPG ``Crystals of Atlan.'' In addition to implementing collaboration costumes for 2B and 9S and the new boss "Grun", various events are also being held to commemorate the 1st anniversary of the service.

entries.title: "Onegai Ipuri", 2nd edition will start sequentially from June 4th. A new “Oribia” bathrium coordination is now available

entries.description: Takara Tomy Arts today announced that two versions of the arcade game ``Onegai Ipuri'' will be released sequentially from June 4, 2026. In the 2nd edition, a new character, Oribia's bazurium coordination, ``Yuki's Flower Bazurium,'' will appear. Additionally, a collaboration with "Sanrio Characters" will be held.

entries.title: Classic SRPG "Tactics Wanderer" inspired by "FE" and "FFT" announced. Hand-drawn pixel art and scheduled for release in Q1 2027
entries.title_ja: 「FE」「FFT」にインスパイアされたクラシックSRPG「タクティクス・ワンダラー」発表。手描きのピクセルアートで描かれ，2027年第1四半期に発売予定
entries.description: CriticalDamageStudio, a private developer in Thailand, has announced a new title ``Tactics Wanderer'' and released an announcement trailer. It's a classic-style SRPG inspired by games like Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics. The game features over 40 classes and a branching growth tree, allowing you to develop 7 heroes.

entries.title: Steam, store tags have been significantly cleaned up. Added 17 items including ``Bangmaku Heaven'', ``Wuxia'', ``Samurai'', and ``Capybara''. Deleted 28 items including "Beware of workplace viewing," "Narration," and "Drama"

entries.description: A handmade piece of the popular character ``Usuchu'' from the new game ``Poko A Pokemon'' made of wool felt has been a big hit on SNS. entries.title_ja: 可動フィギュアと組みあわせて遊べる！ウェザリングやステッカーボムが目を引くエレキギターと中世ヨーロッパの剣が塗装いらずのプラモデル「プリプラ」に登場！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: Expand your play with movable figures! Vintage and sticker bomb design electric guitars and nameless warriors' swords are now available in the plastic model "Pripla" that does not require painting! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books! #Pripura

entries.title: The 11th series of Gashapon figures "Chijimase-tai" featuring characters who became smaller after drinking "Detective Conan" APTX4869 is now available! Contains all 6 types including Shinichi Kudo and Chihaya Hagiwara!
entries.title_ja: 『名探偵コナン』APTX4869を飲んで小さくなったキャラクターたちのガシャポンフィギュア「ちぢませ隊」第11弾が登場！工藤新一や萩原千速たち全6種を収録！
entries.description: From “Detective Conan”, the 11th Gashapon figure “Chijimase-tai” is now available! There are 6 types in the lineup: Shinichi Kudo, Chihaya Hagiwara, Jugo Yokomizo, Masumi Sera, Jinpei Matsuda, and Kenji Hagiwara! Scheduled to be released in the 4th week of May! #Detective Conan #Capsule Toy

entries.title: "SpongeBob" miniature package charm is now available in Gashapon! Includes SpongeBob, Squidward, Patrick, and Krabs minifigures!
entries.title_ja: 『スポンジ・ボブ』のミニチュアパッケージチャームがガシャポンに登場！スポンジ・ボブ、イカルド、パトリック、カーニのミニフィギュア入り！
entries.description: Gashapon “SpongeBob Miniature Package Charm” is now available! The blister package contains three-dimensional figures of SpongeBob! Scheduled to be released in the 4th week of May! #SpongeBob #Capsule Toy

entries.title: “Type 97 Medium Tank Chi-Ha” is now available as a special version of the cute “Chibimaru Military Series” with effect parts included! The Japan Ground Self-Defense Force's "3 1/2t truck" is also on sale!
entries.title_ja: まるっと可愛い“ちび丸ミリタリーシリーズ”にエフェクトパーツが付属する特別仕様で「九七式中戦車 チハ」が出撃！陸上自衛隊の「3 1/2tトラック」も発売！
entries.description: The ``Type 97 Medium Tank Chi-Ha'' is reprinted in Fujimi Model's ``Chibimaru Military Series'' with special specifications that include gun flame and dust effect parts! Furthermore, the JGSDF's general-purpose cab over truck "3 1/2t truck" is also on sale! #Chibimaru Military

entries.title: Cosplayer [Pochako] | Cosplay of the electronic diva “Hatsune Miku (Senbonzakura)” who descended into the world of cherry blossoms
entries.title_ja: コスプレイヤー【ぽちゃこ】｜桜の世界に舞い降りた電子の歌姫「初音ミク(千本桜)」コスプレ
entries.description: We would like to introduce the cosplayer "Pochako" who cosplayed "Hatsune Miku (Senbonzakura)" from "VOCALOID" on X (formerly Twitter). All of Pochako's cosplays are high quality, with rich expressions and movement.

entries.title: Announcement of "Pit Panic," a roguelike action game about climbing a temple. An archaeologist jumps and throws with a versatile hook, a great adventure in ruins full of traps
entries.title_ja: 神殿登りまくりローグライクアクション『Pit Panic』発表。考古学者が万能フックで跳んだり投げたり、罠だらけ遺跡大冒険
entries.description: Flying Rat Studio released "Pit Panic" on May 16th. This work is a roguelike action game in which you play an archaeologist and explore a temple.

entries.title: KRAFTON announced that the number of births within the company has doubled compared to the previous year. In addition to “support funds exceeding 10 million yen”, staff are also positive about “giving birth while working” due to the generous system
entries.title_ja: KRAFTON、「社内出生数」がなんと前年比2倍になったと発表。“1000万円超え支援金”のほか、たっぷり充実制度でスタッフも“働きつつの出産”に前向き傾向
entries.description: KRAFTON announced on May 14th that 46 children were born to employees between January and April 2026, approximately double the number of children born in the same period last year. The company's support for childbirth and childcare appears to be working.

entries.title: A pirated version of "Subnautica 2" user "regularly reported a bug on the official Discord", leaving both developers and the community stunned. The developer carefully lectures, ``Reconsider your life choices.''
entries.title_ja: 『サブノーティカ2』の海賊版ユーザーが「公式Discordで堂々バグ報告」して開発者/コミュニティともに唖然。開発元は「人生の選択を考え直して」と丁寧お説教
entries.description: A user who had obtained a pirated version of "Subnautica 2" and was playing it illegally appeared on the official Discord server. Pirated users are often criticized by the developer, but in the end they are gently admonished.

entries.title: The open world Japanese race "Forza Horizon 6" is a success with over 170,000 participants on Steam. Even before the official release, it is extremely popular as the “highest record in the history of the series”
entries.title_ja: オープンワールド日本レース『Forza Horizon 6』Steam同接「17万人超え」の盛況博す。正式リリース前なのに“シリーズ歴代最高記録”の特大人気
entries.description: "Forza Horizon 6" has started early access for premium edition purchasers. Although this work has not yet been officially released, it seems to be the most popular work in the series.

entries.title: Equipped with a feature that allows you to check the ``Top 10 Popular Games of the Week'' on the PS5 home screen, first released in beta. You can see the hottest games at a glance, such as “Titles whose play time is rapidly increasing”
entries.title_ja: PS5のホーム画面で「今週人気のゲームトップ10」を確認できる機能搭載、まずはベータ展開。“プレイ時間急増中タイトル”など、今ホットなゲームも一目でわかる
entries.description: A new feature has been rolled out in beta on the PS5's ``Welcome Hub'' that allows you to check things like ``Top 10 Popular Games of the Week''.

entries.title: Announcing the drawing hide-and-seek game ``Meccha Chameleon.'' Paint your own body to blend in with the wall, and play hide-and-seek with your “painting skills”
entries.title_ja: お絵描きかくれんぼゲーム『めっちゃカメレオン』発表。自分の体をペイントして壁と同化、“画力”で勝負する擬態かくれんぼ
entries.description: On May 15th, LEMORION announced ``Meccha Chameleon'', a hide-and-seek game with online multiplayer support.

entries.title: ``Elfie: A Sand Plan'', a three-dimensional sand castle building puzzle, continues to steadily increase in reputation with ``100% positive reviews''. Stacking blocks on a calm beach and sometimes relaxing and chatting with elephants
entries.title_ja: 砂のお城づくり立体パズル『Elfie: A Sand Plan』、“100％好評”のまま着実に評価を伸ばす。穏やかな浜辺でブロックを積み、たまにのんびりゾウさんとお喋り
entries.description: Pressed Elephant released Elfie: A Sand Plan on May 12th. This work has been steadily accumulating positive reviews, and has achieved a ``very positive'' status with a 100% positive rating.

entries.title: "Don't Kill the Game" movement grows in California. A bill stating that ``If you can no longer play after support ends, you must make a refund'' has been sent and will be discussed at the state legislature
entries.title_ja: 「ゲームを殺すな」運動がカリフォルニア州で進展。「サポート終了後に遊べなくなるなら返金義務付け」の法案が送付され、州議会で審議へ
entries.description: On May 14, California's Appropriations Committee voted to send bill AB 1921, "Protect Our Games Act," to the full floor.

entries.title: How can you use the Nintendo Switch 2's ``game chat'' to make games made by Capcom's RE ENGINE lighter? Verification report of fps improvement with "Pragmata" etc.
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch 2の「ゲームチャット」、なんと使うとカプコンのRE ENGINE製ゲームは軽くなる。『プラグマタ』などでfps向上との検証報告
entries.description: It appears that the frame rate of some Capcom titles for Nintendo Switch 2 increases when played while using the "game chat" function.

entries.title: A mysterious account called "Aoda Shokai" suddenly started on X (formerly Twitter). Unidentified, suspicious retro-style video
entries.title_ja: X（旧Twitter）にて突如として「アオダ商會」なる謎のアカウントが始動。正体不明、怪しさ満点のレトロ風動画
entries.description: An account calling itself ``Aoda Shokai'' that introduces daily necessities has appeared on X. Although it appears to be some kind of promotion, the product is introduced in a suspicious atmosphere, which only deepens the mystery.

entries.title: The adventure continues--A special video for "FFXI" celebrating its 24th anniversary, "FINAL FANTASY XI 24th Anniversary Movie" has been released. Commemorative campaign also started
entries.title_ja: 冒険は続いている――24周年を迎えた「FFXI」の特別映像「FINAL FANTASY XI 24th Anniversary Movie」が公開。記念キャンペーンも開始
entries.description: Square Enix today (May 15, 2026) released the 24th anniversary video ``FINAL FANTASYXI 24th Anniversary Movie'' of the MMORPG ``Final Fantasy XI.'' Additionally, multiple 24th anniversary campaigns are being held starting today.

entries.title: Yui's Hoe Hoe Game Speech: Episode 265 "I'll be the MC at the 'Touhou LostWord' live show! Let me talk about the Touhou arranged songs!"
entries.title_ja: 結のほえほえゲーム演説：第265回「『東方LostWord』のライブでMCするよ！　東方アレンジ楽曲を語らせてくれ！」
entries.description: Yui will be in charge of MC at the Touhou LostWord music event "LostWordLIVE2026". Yui, who loves not only the original work but also derivative works (especially arranged songs), has been immersed in the Touhou Project swamp for 20 years, and will talk about the songs related to "Touhou Lost Word" that she has fond memories of.

entries.title: ``Moss: The Forgotten Relic'', an adventure game in which the mouse Quill explores a destroyed kingdom, will be released this summer
entries.title_ja: ネズミのクイルが滅びた王国を探索するアドベンチャーゲーム「Moss: The Forgotten Relic」，今夏に発売決定
entries.description: Polyarc announced on May 16, 2026 that it will release the adventure game "Moss: The Forgotten Relic" this summer. This title combines "Moss: Volume 1" and "Moss: Volume 2" into one book. The player guides Quill, a small but brave mouse, as he explores a ruined kingdom that is being swallowed up by nature.

entries.title: Fighters from "The King of Fighters" play card games overseas. Combine various techniques and fight with combos and super special moves.
entries.title_ja: 「ザ・キング・オブ・ファイターズ」のファイターたちが海外でカードゲームに。さまざまな技を組み合わせ，コンボや超必殺技で戦おう
entries.description: Crowdfunding for the official card game "King of Fighters: The Orochi Saga" is underway on Kickstarter. Fighters gathered from across the boundaries of the work can be enjoyed in a variety of ways, including battles, solo play, and cooperative play.

entries.title: "One Move Away", a first-person packing puzzle game, released on May 28th. Let's fit the baggage that increases as life progresses so that it doesn't collapse.
entries.title_ja: 一人称視点の荷造りパズルゲーム「One Move Away」，5月28日にリリース。人生が進むほどに増える荷物を崩れないように収めきろう
entries.description: Playstack announced today (May 15, 2026) that it will release the new title "OneMoveAway", which is currently being developed by RamageGames, on May 28th. This is a first-person 3D puzzle game with the theme of packing, where you systematically load your belongings into a car or truck.

entries.title: Pay attention to the package art of Game Boy software. Crowdfunding is underway for a book that includes over 1000 different packages, including release areas and resale.
entries.title_ja: ゲームボーイソフトのパッケージアートに注目。発売地域や再販など，異なるパッケージ1000種類以上を収録した書籍のクラウドファンディング実施中
entries.description: Crowdfunding for the book ``GameBoyBoxArtCollectionVolume1'', which focuses on package art for Game Boy software, is being conducted on Kickstarter. It covers over 1,000 different versions of a single game, including versions in various languages ​​and re-released versions, spanning 220 pages.

entries.title: “Azur Lane” x “NieR: Automata” collaboration to be held
entries.title_ja: 「アズールレーン」×「NieR：Automata」コラボが開催決定
entries.description: Yostar today (May 15, 2026) announced a collaboration between the smartphone app ``Azur Lane'' and Square Enix's action RPG ``NieR: Automata.'' The details of the collaboration have not been disclosed at this time. If you are interested in the latest news, please follow the Azur Lane X account.

entries.title: "Slay the Spire - Downfall Board Game Japanese Version" has started on Clafan. The amount of support exceeded 40 million yen in just 2 hours.
entries.title_ja: 「Slay the Spire - Downfall ボードゲーム 日本語版」，クラファンをスタート。わずか2時間で支援額4000万円を突破
entries.description: Kenbiru today (May 15, 2026) started crowdfunding on ``CAMPFIRE'' for the release of the board game ``Slay the Spire-Downfall Board Game Japanese Version''. The goal has already been reached, and at the time of publication, more than 40 million yen in support has been collected.

entries.title: Experience your own story in Westeros. “Game of Thrones: King’s Road” developer email interview
entries.title_ja: ウェスタロスで自分だけの物語体験を。「ゲーム・オブ・スローンズ：キングスロード」開発者メールインタビュー
entries.description: We bring you an email interview with the developer of "Game of Thrones: King's Road," which Netmarble will officially launch on May 21, 2026. The people who answered were Jang Hyun-il, executive producer of NetmarbleNeo, which is developing this work, and Moon Joong-gi, the company's general manager.

entries.title: A mysterious X-account ``Awoda Shokai'' that introduces crazy products has appeared. Maybe some sort of content related promotion?
entries.title_ja: 狂気じみた商品を紹介する謎のXアカウント「アヲダ商會」が出現。なんらかのコンテンツに関するプロモーションかも？
entries.description: There are many "weird accounts" on X (formerly Twitter). Some accounts take advantage of the 140-character limit to create unique experiences, while others push simple madness. Among them, an account named ``Awoda Shokai'' has recently started posting.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 153: “Subnautica 2” that can be played in cooperative play and “Hotel Architect”, a hotel management sim, are now on sale
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第153号：協力プレイで遊べる「Subnautica 2」や，ホテル経営シム「Hotel Architect」が発売に
entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, ``Subnautica 2'', an underwater survival adventure set in an alien ocean, and ``HotelArchitect'', a construction and management simulation where you travel around the world to design and operate luxury hotels, were released.

entries.title: In "NTE: Neverness to Everness", which has 90 consecutive ceilings/no slipping through, how many gachas do you actually have to spin to get a limited character? I did a simple calculation
entries.title_ja: 天井90連/すり抜けなしの「NTE: Neverness to Everness」で，限定キャラをお迎えするには，実際どのくらいガチャを回せばいいのか。シンプルに計算してみた
entries.description: The gacha of "NTE: Neverness to Everness" is like a board game, with a shallow ceiling and no slipping through. However, it seems that it is rare to actually turn it all the way to the ceiling.

entries.title: New 3D puzzle “Touhou Yukkuri Mountain” to be released on May 28th for PC/Mac/Switch
entries.title_ja: 新作3Dパズル「東方ゆっくりマウンテン」，PC/Mac/Switch向けに5月28日発売決定
entries.description: Becide has announced that the new title ``Touhou Yukkuri Mountain'' (PC/Mac/Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch) will be released on May 28, 2026. This work is a 3D puzzle game where you throw "slowly" into a container and make it bigger.It is also scheduled to be exhibited at the indie game event "BitSummit PUNCH" to be held in Kyoto from May 22nd to 24th.
entries.location: 京都府京都市／オンライン

entries.title: “Sound! Euphonium” “Second Part Special Video” that plays after the end credits is released on YouTube
entries.title_ja: 「響け！ユーフォニアム」エンドロール後に流れる「後編特別映像」をYouTubeで公開
entries.description: The special video for the second part of the first part of the theatrical anime "Final Movement Sound! Euphonium" that plays after the end credits has been released on YouTube's KyoAni channel.

entries.title: A new series of “food education” youth romantic comedy about picky eaters and overeating girls, “Yakpeda” Highly durable poster
entries.title_ja: 偏食男子と食べ盛り女子の“食育系”青春ラブコメ新連載、「弱ペダ」高耐久ポスターも
entries.description: Isatsu Sato's new series, ``Katayama-kun, enjoy!'', known for ``She is extremely easy to melt'', has started in the June issue of Bessatsu Shonen Champion (Akita Shoten), released today, May 15th. This is a ``nutrition education'' youth romantic comedy about a girl who eats her fill and a boy who is a picky eater.

entries.title: "The Summer When Light Died" 1st Anniversary Thanksgiving Key Visual Revealed, Guests Include Chiaki Kobayashi, Shuichiro Umeda and Others
entries.title_ja: 「光が死んだ夏」1周年感謝祭のキービジュアル公開、ゲストに小林千晃、梅田修一朗ら
entries.description: New key visuals and guest performers have been announced for the first music event for the TV anime "The Summer Where Light Died" based on the original work by Mokumokuren.

entries.title: "The return of the first princess Lucia and her splendid advance" The older sister who was harassed by her sisters shows the qualities of a king
entries.title_ja: 「第一王女ルシアの帰還と華麗なる快進撃」妹たちに嫌がらせされた姉、王の資質を発揮
entries.description: Volume 1 of Nobutaro's ``The Return of the First Princess Lucia and the Splendid Advancement'' was released today, May 15th.

entries.title: Anime “BLEACH” retrospective project “Shinigami Substitute Disappearance” visual released
entries.title_ja: アニメ「BLEACH」振り返り企画の「死神代行消失篇」ビジュアル公開
entries.description: The project "TV ANIMATION 'BLEACH' THE STORIES", which looks back on the trajectory of the TV anime "BLEACH" based on the original work by Tite Kubo, has entered its fourth installment, "Shinigami Substitute Disappearance Edition", and the visuals have been released.

entries.title: "Gundam" 50th anniversary project starts! “SEED FREEDOM ZERO” theatrical release and remaster project
entries.title_ja: 「ガンダム」50周年プロジェクト始動！「SEED FREEDOM ZERO」劇場公開やリマスター企画
entries.description: The "Gundam 50th Anniversary Project" has been launched to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the start of anime broadcasting of the "Gundam" series. The plan was announced at "Gundam Conference SPRING 2026" held today, May 15th.

entries.title: The new series “Holobeat”, based on the original work by Shigenobu Matsumoto and depicting a tag battle between a boy and a monster, is now available on CoroCoro
entries.title_ja: 松本しげのぶ原作、少年と妖怪のタッグバトルを描く新連載「ホロビート」がコロコロで
entries.description: The new series ``Holobeat'', with original story and name composition by Shigenobu Matsumoto, scenario cooperation by Tsutomu Sajima, original character design by Akira Amano, and illustration by Akira Tsuruta, started today in the June issue of Monthly CoroCoro Comic (Shogakukan), released on May 15th.

entries.title: A revenge story about a main character who wakes up after an accident 7 years later and doesn't give up on his dreams even though he has lost everything.
entries.title_ja: 事故から目覚めたら7年後、すべて失っても夢を諦めない主人公のリベンジストーリー
entries.description: Kyoko Ogata's new series ``Is it going to end here!? ~When I wake up 7 years later!? Total revenge on my career and life'' will be released today, May 15th, on the forcs label Comic Genma! It started as a work. Distribution has started at each e-book store.

entries.title: The second part of the third episode of the official comic version of "Dolls Nest: ORPHANS" will be published in the online magazine "Young Ace UP" today, 5/15 (Friday)!
entries.title_ja: 公式コミカライズ「Dolls Nest:ORPHANS」第3話後編、オンラインマガジン「ヤングエースUP」に本日5/15(金)掲載！
entries.description: ``Dolls Nest'' is a customized 3D action game for PC that is currently on sale on Steam and was originally planned by NitroArts, a CG team belonging to Nitroplus. The second part of the official comic version of "Dolls Nest: ORPHANS" Episode 3 "Chuo Cave II/Lost Children" will be released today on 20th...

entries.title: “Machi★Asobi vol.30” will finally be held from May 16th (Sat) to 17th (Sun)!
entries.title_ja: 「マチ★アソビ vol.30」5/16(土)～17(日)いよいよ開催！
entries.description: The anime/game themed entertainment event "Machi★Asobi vol.30" will finally be held in Tokushima City, Tokushima Prefecture from tomorrow, May 16th (Sat) to May 17th (Sun), 2026! We will once again be holding a photo session for “Touken Ranbu ONLINE” promotion leader “Okkii Konnosuke”. Distribution of "Okkii Konnosuke business card"...

entries.title: “Bocchi Za Rock!” is created by Majiaki, who will be working on Shimokitazawa SHELTER’s 35th anniversary visual.
entries.title_ja: 「ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！」はまじあきが下北沢SHELTERの35周年記念ビジュアル手がける
entries.description: Hamajiaki from "Bocchi Za Rock!" created the key visual to commemorate the 35th anniversary of the live house Shimokitazawa SHELTER.

entries.title: ``It's not the decline of the Metaverse itself'' Mr. Tanigo talks about the true meaning of the end of Holo-Earth and the path to ``qualitative expansion'' through technological integration.
entries.title_ja: 「メタバース自体の衰退ではない」カバー谷郷氏が語るホロアース終了の真意と、技術統合による「質的拡大」への道
entries.description:
On May 14, 2026, Cover Co., Ltd. held a financial results briefing for the fiscal year ending March 2026 for the media. On this day, the company's movements attracted a lot of attention, with the termination of the service of the Metaverse platform "Holo Earth" trending on SNS […]
The post ``It's not the decline of the Metaverse itself'' Mr. Tanigo talks about the true meaning of the end of Holo-Earth and the path to ``qualitative expansion'' through technology integration appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: THE IDOLM@STER Miki Hoshii's first US performance will be broadcast live for free
entries.title_ja: アイドルマスター・星井美希、米国初公演の全編無料生中継が決定
entries.description:
It has been decided that the entire solo showcase "THE FUTURE SPOTLIGHT" by Miki Hoshii, an idol belonging to 765 Production of the Idolmaster series, will be broadcast live for free. Distribution will be on YouTube's Idolmaster channel […]
The post The Idolmaster Miki Hoshii's first US performance will be broadcast live for free in its entirety! Appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: [Nijisanji] Three types of new VTuber auditions will be held at the same time Applications are accepted until June 5th
entries.title_ja: 【にじさんじ】新規VTuberオーディション3種を同時開催 応募は6月5日まで
entries.description:
On May 15, 2026, ANYCOLOR Co., Ltd. announced the holding of three new types of auditions at the talent development project “VTA (Virtual Talent Academy)” for those who aim to become VTubers/virtual livers. Apply […]
The post [Nijisanji] Three types of new VTuber auditions will be held simultaneously. Applications are accepted until June 5th. First appeared on Mogura VR.

entries.title: VTuber agency “Specialite” 5th generation debuts
entries.title_ja: VTuber事務所「すぺしゃりて」5期生デビュー
entries.description:
Three 5th generation talents have made their debut from the VTuber agency "Specialite" operated by REALITY Studios Co., Ltd. "Specialite" is a group of talents who are good at games, and VTubers whose main activity is game distribution […]
The post VTuber agency "Specialite" 5th generation debut appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: Metasekai will hold 2026 virtual artist audition, applications are open until June 30th
entries.title_ja: メタセカイ、2026年度バーチャルアーティストオーディション開催、応募は6月30日まで
entries.description:
Next-generation VTuber production "Metasekai" is holding the 2026 Virtual Artist Audition. The application period is until June 30, 2026 (Tuesday). "Metasekai" is a music-based distribution that utilizes 3D models […]
The post Metasekai will hold virtual artist auditions in 2026, applications accepted until June 30th appeared first on Mogura VR.

entries.title: Katsuhiro Harada's new SNK studio ``guarantees independence'' - clarifies that inquiries regarding job openings should be made to the company rather than the parent company

entries.title: Sales of "Power Wash Simulator" by Square Enix will end on May 19th. "Tomb Raider Special Request" etc. will also be discontinued

entries.title: The key to victory is “drawing ability”! ? “Meccha Chameleon,” a hide-and-seek game where you disguise yourself by painting your body, scheduled to be released in June 2026

entries.description: Individual game developer LEMORION has released the Steam store page for the PC game ``Meccha Chameleon.'' It is scheduled to be released in June 2026. This game is a game where you paint a pure white character and play hide and seek while mimicking it like a chameleon.

entries.title: "Gundam 50th Anniversary Project" has started. There are many noteworthy projects such as the “Mobile Suit Gundam” remaster project and the “Yoshiyuki Tomino Exhibition (tentative)”
entries.title_ja: 「ガンダム50周年プロジェクト」が始動。「機動戦士ガンダム」のリマスタープロジェクトや「富野由悠季展（仮）」など注目企画が目白押し
entries.description: Bandai Namco Group Gundam Project announced on May 15, 2026 the start of the "Gundam 50th Anniversary Project". In this project, a lot of information was released, including the remastering project of ``Mobile Suit Gundam'', which is the origin of the series, and the ``Yoshiyuki Tomino Exhibition (tentative title)'' to be held at the Tokyo National Museum in 2029.

entries.title: The movie “Return to Silent Hill” based on “Silent Hill 2” is now available on Amazon Prime Video

entries.title: "Narushio" and the figure "Nendoroid Shorekeeper" will be released in October. ``Concerto of stars'' and ``butterfly'' are included as optional parts.

entries.title: The early access version of the Touhou fan-created game "Imperial Gensokyo ~ TOHOTOPIA", which can be played by up to 4 people, has been released. Turn-based strategy for casual fun

entries.title: [Play Report] ``Navigatore in the Collapsed World'' has a difficult transition between heartwarming scenes and serious scenes. Is this VR? Or reality?

entries.description: The romance ADV “Navigatore of the Collapsed World” began distribution on Steam on April 30, 2026. Although this work belongs to the otome game genre, there is only one character to be conquered. We bring you a play report of this work, which is set in the collapsed world "Navigatore".

entries.title: Underwater adventure "Subnautica 2" has sold over 2 million copies worldwide within 12 hours of its release. The number of people who can connect simultaneously is up to 9 times larger than the previous work.

entries.description: KRAFTON JAPAN announced today (May 15, 2026) that cumulative sales of the underwater adventure ``Subnautica 2'' have exceeded 2 million units worldwide within 12 hours from the start of early access.

entries.title: “Trickal” pop-up shop will be held from May 16th. Lots of cool goods such as sparkling cushions and acrylic goods featuring popular characters.

A variety of items will be on sale, including Spiky die-cut cushions and various acrylic goods.

entries.title: The third PV of the dungeon RPG "Demon Kill Demon ~Yomi 1984~" has been released. A trial version that allows you to play the introduction to the story will be released on May 21st.

entries.description: Experience today released the third PV for the Dungeon RPG ``Demon Kill Demon ~Yomi 1984~'' for Switch. The video highlights the worldview of the work and the characters you meet in Yomi, the setting of the story. It has also been revealed that a trial version that allows you to play the introduction to the story will be distributed from May 21, 2026.

entries.title: Blockchain game "EGGRYPTO X" to be released for smartphones this fall. A monster breeding RPG with the theme of “The one and only monster in the world that you bond with”
entries.title_ja: ブロックチェーンゲーム「EGGRYPTO X」，スマホ向けに今秋リリース。「君が絆ぐ、世界に1体だけのモンスター」がテーマのモンスター育成RPG
entries.description: GameWithNFT today announced that it will release the blockchain game "EGGRYPTOX" for smartphones this fall. This work is a monster breeding RPG with the theme of ``a one-of-a-kind monster in the world that you bond with.'' We are planning a highly flexible training system in which "inheritance skills" are the key, allowing you to raise your own monsters.

entries.title: ANYCOLOR starts recruiting new auditions for VTuber training project “VTA”. Three types of performances: talented vocalist, idol, and one-trick vocalist

entries.description: Remake HD games are doing well. Sales of older titles also exceeded sales.

entries.description:
Article updated: May 14, 2026 BANDAI NAMCO Experience Co., Ltd. will be selling original goods using original illustrations of “Gakuen Idolmaster x Atre Akihabara” from Friday, May 15, 2026 at the “Atre Akihabara Event […]
The post "Gakuen Idolmaster x Atre Akihabara" Goods using the newly drawn illustration "Early Summer" are now available! Sales will start at “Atre Akihabara” from Friday, May 15, 2026! first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: The retro locomotive adventure sim ``A Bumpy Ride'' continues to gain popularity with 97% positive reviews. A leisurely train journey through an unknown world with animal guests on board
entries.title_ja: レトロ機関車で冒険シム『A Bumpy Ride』、“97％好評”のまま好評積み上げ猛進中。動物のお客さんたちを乗せ、未知の世界をのんびり巡る汽車の旅
entries.description: Cosmoporium Games began distributing the train driving exploration game ``A Bumpy Ride'' on May 2nd. It has gotten off to a good start with a high popularity rate of 97%.

entries.title: Announcement of deep sea dive action game ``Indark Recall''. A mysterious cleaning job on the ocean floor that involves dragging your body along in Seoul
entries.title_ja: 深海ダイブアクション『インダーク リコール』発表。ソウルで身体を引っ張って進む、海底での不思議な清掃業務
entries.description: room6's indie game label ``Yokaze'' announced ``Indark Recall'' on May 14th.

entries.title: In Washagana TV's latest video, we show you how to play "G'AIM'E Time Crisis" where you can enjoy nostalgic gun shooting.
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，懐かしのガンシューティングを楽しめる「G'AIM'E タイムクライシス」をプレイする様子をお届け
entries.description: Today (May 14, 2026), the latest video of the web program ``Washagana TV'' by Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita was released. This time, we will show you how to play "G'AIM'E Time Crisis", where you can enjoy nostalgic gun shooting. Both of them are very excited about the game they used to play at the game center.

entries.title: Noto Satoyama Pokémon With You Airport, the world's first airport named after a Pokémon, opens on July 7th
entries.title_ja: 世界で初めてポケモンの名を冠した空港「のと里山ポケモン・ウィズ・ユー空港」，7月7日にオープン
entries.description: The Pokémon With You Foundation and Ishikawa Prefecture have announced that the current ``Noto Satoyama Airport'' will be re-opened for a limited period from July 7, 2026 to September 30, 2029, as the world's first airport named after a Pokémon, ``Noto Satoyama Pokémon With You Airport.''

entries.title: Nexon announces consolidated results for the first quarter of 2026. “ARC Raiders” and “MapleStory” drive growth, achieving record revenue and operating income
entries.title_ja: ネクソン，2026年度第1四半期の連結業績を発表。「ARC Raiders」と「メイプルストーリー」が成長を牽引し，過去最高の売上収益と営業利益を達成
entries.description: Nexon today announced its consolidated financial results for the first quarter of 2026. Revenue was 152.2 billion yen and operating profit was 58.2 billion yen, both of which were record highs. The company's growth is driven by the ``ARCRaiders'' and ``MapleStory'' franchises.

entries.title: A “virtual photographer” who takes beautiful pictures of the “city” open world “NTE” is very popular. Beautiful surreal art photos created one after another
entries.title_ja: 「街」オープンワールド『NTE』をひたすら綺麗に撮る“バーチャル写真家”が熱い人気。次々と生み出される超現実美麗アート写真
entries.description: Mr. Sorahako, a domestic virtual photographer, has been uploading photos of ``NTE'' on SNS. The high quality is attracting attention.

entries.title: Announcement of cosmic horror ``Sleepover'' about the last girl in humanity. Two girls left in the apocalypse, their hearts being cornered as they search for memories
entries.title_ja: 人類最後の少女コズミックホラー『Sleepover』発表。終末世界に残ったふたりの少女、記憶をたどり追い詰められる心
entries.description: Developer ChimpWampus has announced the cosmic horror visual novel Sleepover. Scheduled release date is Q3 2027.

entries.title: DRECOM's indie game studio "DRECOM CREATORS STUDIO" established. Comprehensive support for individual and small-scale development games and spreading them around the world
entries.title_ja: ドリコムのインディーゲームスタジオ「DRECOM CREATORS STUDIO」設立。個人・小規模開発ゲームを包括サポート、世界に広げる
entries.description: DRECOM announced on May 14th that it has established "DRECOM CREATORS STUDIO".

entries.title: The developer of ``ARC Raiders'' has announced that it will stop issuing small updates and instead have ``large updates twice a year.'' The next update will be the “largest in history” in October.
entries.title_ja: 『ARC Raiders』開発元、小出しアプデをやめて「大型アプデ年2回」にすると発表。次は10月に“史上最大規模”のアプデを出す
entries.description: Embark Studios announced on May 14th that it will change its update policy for this game.

entries.title: Announcement of "Shark Mart", a multi-cooperative underwater shop management sim. A shark disguised as a dolphin conducts business with fish, taking advantage of the opportunity to "eat customers" in an underground business.
entries.title_ja: 協力マルチ対応・海中ショップ経営シム『Shark Mart』発表。イルカに扮したサメが魚たち相手に商売、隙を狙って“客を喰う”闇ビジネス
entries.description: On May 14th, Polden Publishing announced ``Shark Mart'', an underwater shop management simulation game created by stre1itzia.

entries.title: Details of the "Granblue Fantasy" x anime "Fullmetal Alchemist" collaboration have been revealed. Participate in the event and recruit Edward Elric and Greedo and Lin Yao.
entries.title_ja: 「グラブル」×アニメ「鋼の錬金術師」コラボの詳細を解禁。イベントに参加してエドワード・エルリックとグリード＆リン・ヤオを仲間にしよう
entries.description: A collaboration event with the TV anime "Fullmetal Alchemist" in the social game "Granblue Fantasy" developed by Cygames will start at 17:00 on May 15, 2026. This time, in addition to the synopsis of the story, the characters that can be recruited during the event, and the summon stones and weapons that can be obtained, etc., have been revealed.

entries.title: After 60 seconds, you die. Steam store page for “The 60-Second Syndrome”, a horror game that aims to escape from a time loop, released
entries.title_ja: 60秒後，あなたは死ぬ。タイムループからの脱出を目指すホラーゲーム「60病 The 60-Second Syndrome」，Steamストアページを公開
entries.description: Matrix Creators today released the Steam store page for the PC software ``The 60-Second Syndrome''. This is a horror game where the goal is to escape from a time loop where you die and time is reset after 60 seconds.

entries.title: Approximately 530 titles have been added to the Nintendo Switch 2/Switch sale. “The Cannibal Cage – KLETKA” is on sale for the first time, and “Kamitsubaki City is under construction.” ” and the time manipulation puzzle “Timelie”, all at low prices.
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch 2/ Switch向けセールにどどんと約530本追加。『人喰ノ檻 – KLETKA』が初セール、『神椿市建設中。』や時間操作系パズル『Timelie』などいろいろお安い
entries.description: On May 14th, a new sale for Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch titles began on the Nintendo eShop. Approximately 530 titles are eligible.

entries.title: The finding that ``game developers should take the initiative to respond to unfavorable reviews from Steam users'' is attracting attention. There are some reviews that say it's better not to reply.
entries.title_ja: 「ゲーム開発者はSteamユーザーからの不評レビューに、あえて返信すべき」との知見が注目集める。“返信しない方がいい”レビューもあるけど
entries.description: Joe Henson, a game designer and marketing consultant, expressed his belief in Steam reviews that ``you should respond even to negative reviews'' based on several reasons.

entries.title: The sequel to the highly rated and terrifying novel game about ghosts, “Ghostpia Season 2” has finally been released. A mysterious city and bloody Sayoko appear
entries.title_ja: 高評価・幽霊たちの物騒なノベルゲーム続編『ghostpia シーズンツー』ついに映像公開。謎の都市や、血塗れの小夜子などが登場
entries.description: room6's indie game label ``Yokaze'' released the video for ``Ghostpia Season 2'' on May 14th.

entries.title: “New game studios are rapidly increasing” CANARY ISLANDS GAMES from Spain's Canary Islands will have a booth at “BitSummit PUNCH” in Kyoto. You can play various new works
entries.title_ja: “新ゲームスタジオ急増中”スペイン・カナリア諸島発CANARY ISLANDS GAMES、京都「BitSummit PUNCH」にブース出展へ。新鋭作品をいろいろ遊べる
entries.description: The Canary Islands State Government announced on May 14th that it will be exhibiting a ``CANARY ISLANDS GAMES'' booth at the indie game event ``BitSummit PUNCH.''

entries.title: Fixed screen action game “Tsukuru Series Magical Shot the Attack Bump☆” where you defeat enemies by pushing them into walls, the Switch version has resumed distribution
entries.title_ja: 敵を壁に押し込んで倒す固定画面アクション「ツクールシリーズ マジカルショット・ザ・アタックバンプ☆」，Switch版の配信を再開
entries.description: GotchaGotchaGames today resumed distribution of the Nintendo Switch software ``Tsukuru Series Magical Shot the Attack Bump☆''. It is a fixed-screen 2D action game that features unique actions in which you defeat enemies by blowing them into walls and gimmicks.

entries.title: "FFXIV" Complete Pack and "Golden Legacy" are on sale for half price. A campaign to win the mount “First Fat Chocobo” has also started
entries.title_ja: 「FFXIV」，コンプリートパックと「黄金のレガシー」の半額セールを開催。マウント「初代でぶチョコボ」が当たるキャンペーンもスタート
entries.description: Square Enix today (May 14, 2026) started a sale where you can purchase ``Final Fantasy XIV Complete Pack'' and ``Final Fantasy XIV: Golden Legacy'' at half price. On the official X account, a campaign has started where 140 people will win the ``first generation fat chocobo'' mount.

entries.title: MUTAN/Brownies, a game company, is a medium-sized company, but they are recruiting people with the following strengths: ``easy to work on popular titles,'' ``able to create original work,'' and ``double hiring opportunity.'' We ask both presidents about the strengths of their special positions.
entries.title_ja: ゲーム会社MUTAN・ブラウニーズは中規模だけれど「人気タイトルに関わりやすい」「オリジナル作れる」「ダブル採用チャンス」を武器に人材募集中。特殊な立ち位置の強みを両社長に訊く
entries.description: MUTAN and Brownies are currently hiring for a wide range of positions. What kind of human resources are these two companies, each with their own distinct personalities, currently looking for? We asked him to speak openly about things that were sometimes too honest.

entries.title: A new feature "Blazing Pass" has been released in "GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-". You can get rewards by playing games and increasing your BP level.
entries.title_ja: 「GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-」で新機能「ブレイジングパス」が公開に。ゲームをプレイして「BPレベル」を上げるとリワードを得られる
entries.description: Arc System Works today (May 14, 2026) released a new feature ``Blazing Pass'' in the fighting game ``GUILTYGEAR-STRIVE-''. This is a feature that allows you to earn rewards that can be used in some modes by playing the game and increasing your BP level. In addition to being available for free, a paid ``GGST Blazing Pass Plus'' is also available.

entries.title: Aiming for the end of the collapsed world, he embarks on a journey where various encounters await. 2.5D puzzle ADV “Beyond The Plastic Wall”, teaser trailer released
entries.title_ja: 崩壊した世界の果てを目指し，さまざまな出会いが待ち受ける旅に出る。2.5DパズルADV「Beyond The Plastic Wall」，ティザートレイラーを公開
entries.description: On May 13, 2026, MotvindStudios and ARTEFrance announced the new title "BeyondThePlasticWall" and released a teaser trailer. This is a puzzle adventure game in which the main character, Haru, who lives as a scavenger in a collapsing world, aims to reach the last city at the end of the world.

entries.title: See through the human disguise and remove them from the animal bar. “Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY!” Demo version now available
entries.title_ja: 人間の変装を見破り，動物専用のバーから排除せよ。「Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY!」，デモ版を配信開始
entries.description: Domnaier today (May 14, 2026) started distributing the demo version of the new title "AnimalyBar:NOHUMANITY!" which is currently under development. This is a horror simulation game where you play as a gorilla bartender serving customers at a bar exclusively for animals in a world where animals have won the war against humans.

entries.title: “Game world” interference adventure “Crushed In Time” will be released on June 11th. The lost duo of Holmes and Watson pursue the case, pinch it, stretch it, and peel it away.
entries.title_ja: “ゲーム世界”干渉アドベンチャー『Crushed In Time』6月11日配信へ。ホームズ＆ワトソンの迷コンビが事件を追い、つまんで伸ばしてひっぺがす
entries.description: Draw Me A Pixel announced on May 13th that Crushed In Time will be released on June 11th.

entries.title: "Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core" releases new trailer introducing 5 classes and various content
entries.title_ja: 「Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core」，5種類のクラスやさまざまなコンテンツを紹介する最新トレイラーを公開
entries.description: On May 13, 2026, GhostShipGames released the latest trailer introducing the game contents of the new title ``DeepRock Galactic: Rogue Core'', which is scheduled to be released in early access on May 21, Japan time. Various content in the game is introduced, including the five playable classes.

entries.title: Just before the release of the ocean planet open world "Subnautica 2", "past works" are rapidly increasing in popularity. You can buy it now at 75% off
entries.title_ja: 海洋惑星オープンワールド『サブノーティカ2』の発売直前にして、今“過去作”が人気ぐんぐん上昇中。今なら75％オフで買える
entries.description: Prior to the release of ``Subnautica 2'', the popularity of previous games in the series seems to be increasing.

entries.title: The official website of ``Party Animals'', whose popularity is declining, suddenly announces that it will hold a ``generated AI video contest'', causing confusion. A fierce backlash erupted, including “review bombing”
entries.title_ja: 人気低迷中の『Party Animals』公式、突如「生成AI動画コンテスト」を開催すると発表し困惑広がる。“レビュー爆撃”など猛反発に発展

entries.title: Steal valuables without being noticed by scary monsters. Official version of 6-player cooperative horror burglary game “Burgle Supply Company” released
entries.title_ja: 恐ろしいモンスターに気付かれないように金目のものを盗み出せ。6人協力ホラー空き巣ゲーム「Burgle Supply Company」，正式版をリリース
entries.description: On May 12, 2026, TerriblePostureGames officially released "BurgleSupplyCompany", which had been in early access on Steam. This work is a cooperative horror-comedy game in which up to six people work together to commit thieves as members of ``Kashisu Bussan Co., Ltd.,'' a mutual aid association for burglars.

entries.title: “Ichiban Kuji Goddess of Victory: NIKKE CHAPTER 8” will be released sequentially from August 8th. Dorothy and Lapi in swimsuits: Red Hood as a figure
entries.title_ja: 「一番くじ 勝利の女神：NIKKE CHAPTER8」，8月8日から順次発売。水着姿のドロシーやラピ：レッドフードがフィギュアに
entries.description: BANDAISPIRITS today announced that "Ichiban Kuji Goddess of Victory: NIKKECHAPTER8" will be released sequentially from August 8, 2026. The price is 850 yen (tax included) once. This product is the 8th installment of the Gun Girl RPG "Goddess of Victory: NIKKE".

entries.title: "Garden of Yog-Sothoth", store benefit information for the packaged version for Switch has been released. Also decided to exhibit at “BitSummit PUNCH”
entries.title_ja: 「ヨグ＝ソトースの庭」，Switch向けパッケージ版の店舗特典情報を解禁。「BitSummit PUNCH」への試遊出展も決定
entries.description: On May 13, 2026, Shochiku Games released the in-store bonus information for the Switch package version of ``The Garden of Yog-Sothoth''. A total of 11 stores are targeted, including Akiba☆Sofmap, Amazon.co.jp, and Rakuten Books. Details are published on the special website. It has also been decided that a trial exhibition will be held at "BitSummitPUNCH".

entries.title: “Console Archives Master of Monsters ~Sages of the Dawn~” starts distribution on May 14th
entries.title_ja: 「コンソールアーカイブス マスター・オブ・モンスターズ 〜暁の賢者達〜」，5月14日に配信開始
entries.description: Hamster has announced that distribution of ``Console Archives Master of Monsters ~Sages of the Dawn~'' will begin on May 14, 2026. ``Master of Monsters ~Sages of the Dawn~'' is a simulation war game released for 32-bit home game consoles in 1997. Monsters are summoned from another world and battled and trained.

entries.title: The "Gakupuri" and "Dokisaba" campaigns will begin on May 19th at Lawson stores nationwide. If you purchase 3 eligible sweets, you will receive an original clear sheet.
entries.title_ja: 「学プリ」「ドキサバ」のキャンペーン，全国のローソンで5月19日に開始。対象のお菓子を3点購入すると，オリジナルクリアシートがもらえる
entries.description: The "Prince of Tennis Gyuutto! The Prince of School Festival'-40andmore..." and "The Prince of Tennis Gyuutto! Thrilling Survival Tiebreak'game" campaigns are scheduled to be held at Lawson stores nationwide from May 19, 2026. In the campaign, if you purchase three eligible sweets, you will receive an original clear sheet.

entries.title: Optical 10 keyless keyboard "Huntsman V3 Tenkeyless 8KHz" is now available from Razer. Lapitri & 8000Hz compatible for 26,980 yen
entries.title_ja: 光学式10キーレスキーボード「Huntsman V3 Tenkeyless 8KHz」がRazerから登場。ラピトリ＆8000Hz対応で2万6980円
entries.description: On May 13, 2026, Razer released the ``HuntsmanV3Tenkeyless8KHz'' 10-keyless gaming keyboard equipped with optical analog key switches. Although it is a high-end specification that supports rapid triggers and a polling rate of 8000Hz, the highlight is that it is relatively inexpensive at a direct sales price of 26,980 yen including tax.

entries.title: Sunny Side Up Group and Akatsuki agree on business integration. Akatsuki conducts a tender offer and changes the company name to "Sunny's Holdings (tentative name)"
entries.title_ja: サニーサイドアップグループとアカツキが経営統合に合意。アカツキによる株式公開買付けを実施し，新社名「サニーズホールディングス（仮称）」へ
entries.description: Sunny Side Up Group and Akatsuki announced today (May 13, 2026) that they have agreed to integrate their businesses. As part of this, Akatsuki will implement a takeover offer (TOB) for Sunny Side Up Group.

entries.title: Metroidvania ``Clockwork Ambrosia'', where you can enjoy over 100 types of weapon customization, is now available on Steam. A trial version where you can play the beginning is also available
entries.title_ja: 100種類以上の武器カスタマイズを楽しめるメトロイドヴァニア「Clockwork Ambrosia」，Steamで発売。序盤をプレイできる体験版も配信中
entries.description: OIGames today began distributing the PC action RPG "ClockworkAmbrosia" on Steam. This work is a 2D action platformer that adopts a steampunk and retro-future worldview. It combines exploratory gameplay with weapon customization elements.

entries.title: 3-player cooperative roguelite FPS sequel "Deadzone Rogue 2" announced. The battle against the machine army moves to the fallen Earth.
entries.title_ja: 3人協力ローグライトFPS続編「Deadzone Rogue 2」が発表に。機械の軍勢との戦いは陥落した地球へと舞台を移す
entries.description: ProphecyGames today (May 13, 2026) announced the new title "Deadzone Rogue 2" and released the announcement trailer. This work is a sequel to the roguelite FPS "Deadzone: Rogue" that supports cooperative play with up to three people. The setting moves to Earth, and the battle against the mechanical army ``Monarch'' continues from the previous work.

entries.title: Black Jacket, a deck-building roguelite blackjack game that twists the rules, is now available for PC/consumers
entries.title_ja: ルールをねじ曲げるデッキ構築型ローグライトブラックジャック「Black Jacket」，PC / コンシューマ向けに配信開始
entries.description: SkystoneGames today (May 13, 2026) released a new title "BlackJacket" developed by Mi'pu'miGames. This is a deck-building rogue-lite blackjack game in which players compete against ghosts wandering the underworld of hell for coins used to buy a ferryman.

entries.title: Rhythm fighting action game "Dead as Disco" early access version released on Steam. Official release scheduled for 2027
entries.title_ja: リズム格闘アクション「Dead as Disco」早期アクセス版をSteamでリリース。2027年正式リリース予定
entries.description: Brain Jar Games released the early access version of their new game "Dead as Disco" on Steam on May 6th. It features a battle system that synchronizes with music, and a 20% off sale is being held until May 20th to commemorate its release. Scheduled to be updated for official release in 2027.

entries.description: New characters and cast members have been announced for the TV anime ``The Strongest Dried Prince's Secret Battle for the Throne'', which will begin broadcasting from July 2026, and it has been revealed that Atsushi Tamaru and Ryota Takeuchi will be playing the characters. The first PV has also been released.

_url_verified.page_title: TVアニメ『最強出涸らし皇子の暗躍帝位争い』新たなキャラクター＆キャスト情報が公開！　アルノルトがレオナルトを次期皇帝にするために暗躍する第1弾PVも解禁 - eeo Media（イーオメディア）

entries.title: A new mode centered around the “Fifth Personality” story, “Note Additions,” will be implemented in June! You can experience the world view from a different perspective than before.
entries.title_ja: 『第五人格』ストーリーを軸にした新モード「手記の加筆」6月実装！これまでと別視点で世界観に触れられる
entries.description: “Identity V Fifth Personality” new mode “Note addition” is scheduled to be implemented in June 2026!
