entries.title_ja: 『ブルアカ』元スタッフの新作『アストラエ・オラティオ』登場キャラ初公開―魔法使いではない普通の公務員「主任」とその上司「平和岸灯愛」
entries.description: A new magical RPG from Dynamis One, a company founded by former staff of ``Blue Archive.'' The characters are finally revealed for the first time.

entries.title: “NieR Game Series 15th Anniversary Lottery” is on sale again online! The ``Kine'' and ``2B'' figures are beautiful, with outstanding thighs and dual-wielding skills.
entries.title_ja: 「NieRゲームシリーズ15周年記念くじ」がオンライン再販！抜群の太ももや二刀流も決まる「カイネ」「2B」フィギュアが美しい
entries.description: “NieR Game Series 15th Anniversary Lottery” is on sale again online! Sales will start on "e-STORE lottery" from 12:00 on May 15th.

entries.title: Nintendo's lineup for Switch 2 in the second half of this fiscal year includes ``new titles in addition to those already announced'' - mentioned at financial results briefing, adding that ``we will provide details at the appropriate time''
entries.title_ja: 任天堂、今期後半のスイッチ2向けラインナップには「発表済み以外にも新作タイトル」ー決算説明会で言及、「適切なタイミングで詳細をお伝え」とも
entries.description: Nintendo mentioned future new titles during the Q&A session at the "Financial Results Briefing for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2026 (Online)."

entries.title: Kirby and Waddle Dee on your smartphone! Newly designed mobile accessories released by iFace
entries.title_ja: カービィ、ワドルディをスマホに！iFaceより新デザインのモバイルアクセサリーが登場
entries.description: Mobile accessory brand "iFace" has announced new goods featuring Kirby and Waddle Dee. Available in four types: smartphone case, AirPods case, grip holder, and shoulder strap. Pre-orders are scheduled to begin on May 13th, and sales are scheduled to begin in mid-May 2026.

entries.title: The popular program “On the Run” makes its first foray into VR! An experiential event to “escape from the hunters” staged in “Liminal Space” will be held.
entries.title_ja: 人気番組「逃走中」がVRに初進出！「リミナルスペース」舞台の“ハンターから逃げ切る”体験型イベントが開催
entries.description: “Runaway Liminal World Escape in VR Space” is scheduled to be held from June 27th to September 27th, 2026!

entries.title: ``Kamen Rider Agito'' with the ultimate sake cup ``Awaken your soul.'' To commemorate the 25th anniversary of the broadcast, Arita baked bean plates, place mats, etc. are on sale.
entries.title_ja: 「仮面ライダーアギト」至高のぐい呑みで「目覚めろ、その魂。」放送開始25周年記念として有田焼豆皿、ランチョンマットなどが受注販売
entries.description: "Kamen Rider Agito" 25th anniversary goods are available for order! The ultimate sake cup made of 100% tin.

entries.title: Details of the special edition of "Culdcept Begins", a completely new work for the first time in 10 years, announced! There are plenty of luxury benefits such as the original reprint package and card book that can be obtained before the standalone release.
entries.title_ja: 10年ぶり完全新作『カルドセプト ビギンズ』特装版の詳細発表！単体発売に先駆けて入手できる初代復刻版のパケやカードブックなど豪華特典が盛りだくさん
entries.description: Details of the special edition, which includes a reprint of the first work in the series, have been announced.

entries.title: Convenient for making Gunpla and accessories! ``Aron Alpha Hikari'', which instantly adheres when exposed to a special light, will be on display at the 64th Shizuoka Hobby Show
entries.title_ja: ガンプラやアクセサリー作りにも便利！専用ライトをあてると瞬間接着「アロンアルフア 光」が第64回静岡ホビーショーに体験展示
entries.description: Toagosei will exhibit at the 64th Shizuoka Hobby Show to be held from May 13th to 17th, 2026, and will experience and sell “Aron Alpha Hikari”!

entries.title: Soft vinyl-style figures of Kikaider and Inazuman! “Toei Special Effects Ball Chain Mascot Ishinomori Heroes” will be released in late May
entries.title_ja: キカイダーやイナズマンのソフビ風フィギュア！「東映特撮ボールチェーンマスコット 石ノ森ヒーローズ」が5月下旬発売
entries.description: Soft vinyl-style figures are now available in regular and clear colors!

entries.title: "Gundam Witch of Mercury" Tanuki Sletta and Kitsune Miorine are back! Collaboration products of “Red Tanuki/Green Fox” newly drawn in yukata will be released on May 20th.
entries.title_ja: 「ガンダム 水星の魔女」たぬきスレッタ、きつねミオリネ再び！新たに浴衣姿で描き下ろされた「赤いたぬき/緑のきつね」コラボ商品が5月20日発売
entries.description: Maru-chan's "Red Tanuki/Green Fox" in collaboration with "Mobile Suit Gundam: Witch of Mercury" will be released sequentially from May 20th!

entries.title: “Alice in Wonderland” 75th anniversary online lottery is now on sale! There are also maniac items such as mirrors with three-dimensional “creatures of the Tarzi forest”.
entries.title_ja: 「ふしぎの国のアリス」75周年記念オンラインくじが発売！”タルジーの森の生き物”を立体化したミラーなど、マニアックなアイテムも
entries.description: "SEGA Lucky Lottery Online "75th Anniversary of the Movie 'Alice in Wonderland'" is now on sale! The sale period is until July 21st.

entries.title: “Sanrio Character Grand Prize” lottery will be released in October! A special project featuring characters ranked high, who will be in first place this year?
entries.title_ja: 「サンリオキャラクター大賞」当りくじが10月発売決定！上位にランクインしたキャラクターが登場するスペシャル企画、今年の1位はいったい誰に
entries.description: “2026 Sanrio Character Grand Prize Lottery” will be released in October!

entries.title: Capsule toy specialty store "Gachagacha no Mori Apita Kuwana Store" opened on May 15th in Kuwana City, Mie Prefecture. First store opened at UNY commercial facility with 778 capsule toy machines
entries.title_ja: 三重県桑名市にカプセルトイ専門店「ガチャガチャの森　アピタ桑名店」が5月15日オープン。ユニー商業施設に初出店778台のカプセルトイマシンを展開
entries.description: Luluark will open a capsule toy specialty store, ``Gachagacha no Mori Apita Kuwana Store,'' on the second floor of the commercial facility ``Apita Kuwana'' in Kuwana City, Mie Prefecture, on May 15th. Business hours are from 9:00 to 21:00.

entries.title: The transformation item “Kokoro Perfume” from “PreCure, Open My Heart!” and “Heart Catch PreCure” is now available as a role-playing toy!
entries.title_ja: 「プリキュア、オープン・マイ・ハート！」、「ハートキャッチプリキュア」の変身アイテム「ココロパフューム」がなりきり玩具で登場！
entries.description: Bandai will release the role-playing toy ``Pretty Memories Heartcatch PreCure! Transformation Perfume Kokoro Perfume'' at Premium Bandai in October. The price is 6,930 yen.

entries.title: Shota Oni's mysterious BL "My Dear Yona-san" is now in full color book
entries.title_ja: ショタおに怪異BL「僕の愛しいよなさん」、フルカラーで単行本化
entries.description: Yoruichi's book ``My Dear Yona-san'' was released today, May 12th, by KADOKAWA's Beam Comics.

entries.title_ja: 「しゅごキャラ！」×浅草花やしき、PEACH-PITが和装のあむたち描き下ろす
entries.description: A collaboration event between PEACH-PIT's Shugo Chara! and Asakusa Hanayashiki, an amusement park in Tokyo, will be held from tomorrow, May 13th to June 29th.

entries.title: Volume 1 of ``Room 999'', the story of a delivery man who delivers letters to the strange creatures living in a strange apartment complex, is now available
entries.title_ja: 奇々怪々な集合住宅、そこに暮らす異形に手紙を届ける配達員の物語「999号室」1巻発売
entries.description: Volume 1 of Nangana's ``Room 999'' was released today, May 12th.

entries.title: "Bobobo" exhibition event will be held in Tokyo and Osaka, and a special site will be called "Titani! Titani!"
entries.title_ja: 「ボーボボ」展示イベントを東京＆大阪で開催、特設サイトで「チターニ！チターニ！」
entries.description: The "Bobobobo Bobobo" exhibition event "Bobobobo Bobobo Exhibition DIVE INTO THE BO-BOBO WORLD" will be held in Tokyo and Osaka. A teaser visual was also released.

entries.title: "Haikyu!!" Karasuno and Aoba Johsai gather at Cocos and receive clear files and stickers

entries.description: The collaboration between the anime ``Haikyu!!'' based on the original work by Haruichi Furudate and the family restaurant Coco's, ``Let's gather at Coco's today too! Campaign'' will be held from May 19th to June 29th.

entries.title: In a world where talent is visualized, the story of an “unemployed S” girl aiming to become a top idol.

entries.description: Yuko Setsuna's ``Under Idol'' volume 1 was released by Square Enix today, May 12th. In a world where talent is visible, this is the story of an "unemployed S" girl who aims to become a top idol.

entries.description: Volume 1 of Tetsuichi's ``MAMBA Special Outsourcing Agency Magical Step 19th Branch'' was released today, May 12th, by KADOKAWA's Beam Comics.

entries.title: When he returns, he becomes the true mastermind. A dark fantasy of revenge of a boy who works behind the scenes for his benefactor.
entries.title_ja: 回帰した暁には真の黒幕に　恩人のために暗躍する少年の復讐ダークファンタジー
entries.description: Volume 1 of Tagane Kajiken's ``The Optimal Solution That Will Lead You to the Mastermind'', originally written by Washiro Fujiki, was released by Square Enix today, May 12th.

entries.title: "1st Movie Theater Award" Hiro Shimono & Saori Hayami thank the staff and repeat customers; Conan is also happy
entries.title_ja: 「第1回 映画館大賞」下野紘＆早見沙織がスタッフとリピーターに感謝　コナンも喜ぶ
entries.description: The ``1st Movie Theater Award'' award ceremony, sponsored by the ``Let's Go to the Movie Theater!'' Executive Committee, was held today, May 12th, at 109 Cinemas Premium Shinjuku in Tokyo. entries.description: Developer Odd Dreams Digital announced on May 11th that ``Everything is Crab: Biological Evolution Roguelite'' has sold over 200,000 copies. It is said that it reached the milestone in less than three days after its release.

entries.title: Relax in the footbath with Pokemon. "Wakura Pokemon Footbath" has opened at Wakura Onsen in Ishikawa Prefecture. Free footbath overlooking Nanao Bay

entries.title: Fill dents with putty or dilute gasoline with water. The free prologue version of the anything-goes car repair sim “Cheap Car Repair” is now available

entries.description: On May 11, 2026, SimplicityGames and PlayWay released a demo version of ``CheapCarRepair: Welcome to Nowhere'' on Steam, a demo version of ``CheapCarRepair'', a new title currently under development by LittleDogGames. This work is a simulation game set in rural Poland in the 1990s, where you work as a mechanic who runs an automobile repair shop.

entries.title: The official version of NITRO GEN OMEGA, a turn-based tactical RPG featuring anime-style production, has started distribution.

entries.title: The early access version of ``Super Night Riders S1'', a racing game inspired by the 80's classic, has been released on Steam. 10% off sale underway
entries.title_ja: 80年代の名作にインスパイアされたレースゲーム「Super Night Riders S1」，早期アクセス版をSteamでリリース。10％オフセールを開催中
entries.description: miyu.works today released the early access version of the PC game ``SuperNightRidersS1'' on Steam. This work is a racing game series that is inspired by classics from the 1980s, but uses a modern checkpoint system. This is a reboot version of "SuperNightRiders" released in 2016.

entries.title: ``Kioku: That Summer Day'' is an ADV where you spend your summer vacation on an island that is a combination of Scandinavian and Japanese countryside, and the demo version is now available in Japanese.
entries.title_ja: 北欧と日本の田舎が溶け合ったような島で夏休みを過ごすADV「キオク:あの夏の日」，デモ版が日本語に対応
entries.description: The demo version of the PC game ``Kioku: That Summer Day'' developed by LugnGames and published by Assemble Entertainment is now available in Japanese. This is a 3D adventure game set on Kioku Island, an idyllic island that is a fusion of Scandinavian and Japanese countryside, where you play the role of a young girl, Asti, and spend your summer vacation.

entries.title: Today, May 12th, is the anniversary of the start of the ARGONAVIS project! Introducing past articles such as reports and interviews
entries.title_ja: 本日5月12日はARGONAVISプロジェクト始動の記念日！　レポートやインタビューなど，過去記事をまるっとご紹介
entries.description: On May 12, 2018, Bushiroad's boy band project "fromARGONAVIS" celebrated its 8th anniversary, and this year marks its 9th year (the name was different at the time). Although the project is currently on indefinite hiatus, we will introduce excerpts from numerous reports and interviews published on 4Gamer from 2018 to 2023.

entries.title: “Draw & Guess,” an online drawing message game that can be played by up to 16 people, now available for smartphones
entries.title_ja: 最大16人で遊べるオンラインお絵かき伝言ゲーム「Draw & Guess」，スマホ向けに配信開始
entries.description: Shochiku Games today (May 12, 2026) released the smartphone version of ``Draw&Guess.'' The price is free, and in-app purchases are available. This work is an online drawing message game created by German company Acureus that can be played by up to 16 people. The Steam version was released before the smartphone version, and worldwide sales have exceeded 4 million copies.

entries.title: "Life Below" developer video released. Talk about how he got involved in the production and the characters.
entries.title_ja: 「Life Below」の開発者動画が公開に。制作に関わったきっかけやキャラクターについて語る
entries.description: A developer video for the new game "Life Below" scheduled to be released by KasedoGames on May 26, 2026 has been released on Calypso Media's official Japanese YouTube channel. This time, Rhianna Pratchett, a scenario writer who handles the story, appears. He talks about how he got involved in writing the script for this work, and the anecdotes that led to the creation of one of the characters, ``Pontos.''

entries.title: A collaboration event with the popular character "Pingu" is currently being held. Idle RPG “Pyu Pyu Slime” released for smartphones
entries.title_ja: 人気キャラクター「ピングー」とのコラボイベントを開催中。放置系RPG「ピューピュースライム」，スマホ向けにリリース
entries.description: X-LEGEND Entertainment today released the smartphone app "Pyu Pyu Slime". This work is an idle RPG where you grow slime. It has elements of a bullet hell shooting game, and you can enjoy exhilarating battles with intuitive controls. To commemorate the release, a collaboration event with the popular character "Pingu" is also being held.

entries.title: Armed with a gun, the girl takes revenge on her kidnappers. Body cam FPS “Better Than Dead”, early access version released

entries.description: MicroProse today (May 12, 2026) released the early access version of its new title "Better Than Dead." This work is an FPS shot from the perspective of a body camera, in which a girl whose life was destroyed by kidnappers takes revenge on the kidnappers. Armed with a gun, a body camera, and a revenge list, the girl ventures into the dark side of Hong Kong.

entries.title: KRAFTON announces financial results for the first quarter of 2026. Sales increased 56.9% year-on-year to 1,371.4 billion won, marking a record high on a quarterly basis

entries.description: On April 30, 2026, KRAFTON announced its business results for the first quarter of 2026. Based on consolidated financial statements applying the Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS), sales were 1,371.4 billion won (up 56.9% year-on-year) and operating income was 561.6 billion won (up 22.8% year-on-year), both of which were record highs on a quarterly basis.

That challenge.

entries.title: "Heroaka" new short animation to be released this summer, a one-shot featuring high school student Eri will be visualized
entries.title_ja: 「ヒロアカ」新作短編アニメを今夏公開、高校生のエリが登場する読切を映像化
entries.description: A short story drawn by Kohei Horikoshi for the fan book ``My Hero Academia Ultra Age'' of ``My Hero Academia'' has been adapted into a short animation. It will be released this summer as "I am a hero too."

entries.title: A castle with a barrier, a fiancée magician who came to take out a girl who had been trapped for many years.
entries.title_ja: 結界が張られた城、長年閉じ込められていた少女を連れ出しに来た婚約者の魔術師
entries.description: Volume 1 of Maro Shino's ``A couple of magicians who were imprisoned for about 100 years travel the world'' was released by Takeshobo today, May 2nd. This is a comic adaptation of Mari Yoshino's novel.

entries.title: The much-talked-about city open world “NTE” sold over 2 billion yen on the first day of global release – significantly exceeding the level of “Phantom Tower” in core metrics
entries.title_ja: 話題の都市オープンワールド『NTE』グローバルリリース初日で20億円超の売上―コア指標で『幻塔』の水準を大幅に上回る
entries.description: It has also been revealed that in the global version, PC and PS5 account for approximately 75% of sales contribution.

entries.title: "Pragmata" Diana, a father who lost his 8-year-old daughter, posted that it was "healing for the soul" - Director and Diana "herself" also responded
entries.title_ja: 8歳の娘を亡くした父親、『プラグマタ』ディアナは「魂の癒し」と投稿―ディレクターやディアナ“本人”も反応
entries.description: A 55-year-old overseas gamer reported this on the bulletin board.

entries.title: “Very popular” Metaverse adventure game sequel “Broken Reality 2000” to be released in July!
entries.title_ja: “非常に好評”メタバース舞台のアドベンチャーゲーム続編『Broken Reality 2000』7月配信決定！
entries.description: A new trailer exploring the colorful world has also been released.

entries.title: [5,390 yen → 1,347 yen] 75% off sale for the popular space 4X "Stellaris" celebrating its 10th anniversary until May 11th! After that, the price will be increased by $10 by including "DLC that you should buy first" etc.
entries.title_ja: 【5,390円→1,347円】10周年迎える人気宇宙4X『Stellaris』本体75％オフセールは5月11日まで！その後「最初に買うべきDLC」などを同梱し10ドル値上げ予定
entries.description: The price increase due to the addition of content was announced in March.

entries.title: “70s-style robot anime Get P-X” Taro-kun’s mystery remains unchanged even on that nostalgic day in 1999 and now in Reiwa [Play Report]
entries.title_ja: 『70年代風ロボットアニメ ゲッP-X』懐かしき99年のあの日も、令和の今も変わらぬタロウくんの謎【プレイレポ】
entries.description: The nostalgia foreign robot game fans feel before the first English version of the PS cult STG is released after 27 years.

entries.title: Open playtest of Wreck Runners, a slapstick co-op escape horror where you collect valuables in the Bermuda Triangle!
entries.title_ja: バミューダトライアングルで貴重品を回収するドタバタCo-op脱出ホラー『Wreck Runners』オープンプレイテスト開催！
entries.description: Even if you fail to escape, the fantastic slapstick drama will remain in your memory long after the mission.

entries.title: Current number of players is not enough to support long-term development - team shooter "Last Flag" released half a month ago reports difficulties
entries.title_ja: 現在のプレイヤー数は長期の開発を支えていくのに十分でない―半月前リリースのチームシューター『Last Flag』が苦境を報告
entries.description: The planned console version also seems to be in a difficult situation.

entries.title: “Dragon Quest” Get excited about Japanese-style “slime” goods! A lineup of items that are easy to use on a daily basis, including soy sauce plates and chopsticks.
entries.title_ja: 『ドラクエ』和風な「スライム」グッズにワクワク！醤油皿やお箸など日常で使いやすいラインナップ
entries.description: “Dragon Quest” slime Japanese-style goods are on sale again. 10 types of products that are easy to use on a daily basis, such as soy sauce plates and chopsticks.

entries.title: There is also a Mochi Piko stuffed animal with a cherry blossom pattern on the Noust drawn by PiPi! From “Hatsune Miku”, Sakura Miku items will be available as Furyu prizes!
entries.title_ja: PiPi氏描き下ろしのぬーストに桜柄のもちぴこぬいぐるみも！『初音ミク』より、桜ミクのアイテムがフリューのプライズで展開！
entries.description: From "Hatsune Miku" comes a new Sakura Miku prize! A Nudor stopper figure and a Mochipiko plushie in a lineup of three types will bring spring into full bloom! #Hatsune Miku #Sakura Miku

entries.title: Contains popular characters from "Stone Ocean" such as Jorin Kujo and E. Costello! The 8th sticker wafer from "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure" is now available!
entries.title_ja: 空条徐倫やE・コステロたち『ストーンオーシャン』の人気キャラクターを収録！『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険』のシールウエハース第8弾が登場！
entries.description: From "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure", the 8th edition of the sticker wafer "Niformation" is now available! This time, popular characters from "Stone Ocean" are included! The lineup includes a total of 31 types, including 1 secret type! #jojo #candy toy

entries.title: Chino from "Is the Order a Rabbit? BLOOM" appears in the shop's uniform in PM Office A's movable plastic kit "Plafia"! Now accepting pre-orders at Rakuten Books along with the minifigure bundled version!
entries.title_ja: 「ご注文はうさぎですか？ BLOOM」からチノがお店の制服姿でピーエムオフィスエーの可動式プラキット「プラフィア」に登場！ミニフィギュア同梱版と共に楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: Chino from ``Is the Order a Rabbit? BLOOM'' appears in the PM Office A ``Plafia'' series wearing a shop uniform♪ 25 positions are active and you can enjoy a variety of poses, and a ``sitting skirt'' is included, allowing you to sit on the edge of a chair or desk! #gochiusa

entries.title: "Vintage Assortment", "Team Transport", Formula 1 Assortment, etc. are now available for pre-order on Amazon!
entries.title_ja: 「ヴィンテージアソート」や「チームトランスポート」、フォーミュラ1のアソートなどがAmazonで予約受付中！
entries.description: Hot Wheels "Vintage Assortment - Vintage Grand Prix", "Formula 1(R) Sprint Race Circuit", "Team Transport Assortment", "Premium Race Assortment" and more are now available! #hot wheels #minicar

entries.title: ``Medalist'' Inori Tsujie & Hikaru Ouzaki, ``Mahou Tsukai PreCure! ” Cure Miracle, “Touken Ranbu” Kagemitsu Koryu, “Nijisanji” Kaisei and Akagi Wen appear! “Hobby Round 34” Dealer Photo Report
entries.title_ja: 『メダリスト』結束いのり＆狼嵜光、『魔法つかいプリキュア！』キュアミラクル、『刀剣乱舞』小竜景光、「にじさんじ」魁星や赤城ウェンなど登場！「ホビーラウンド34」ディーラーフォトレポート
entries.description: “Touken Ranbu” Kagemitsu Koryu, “Ultraman Arc” Ultraman Arc, “Medabots” Black Mail, “Medalist” Tsugei Inori & Hikaru Ouzaki, “Mahou Tsukai PreCure! “Hobby Round 34” dealer photo report featuring Cure Miracle and more! #Hobby Round #Hobby Run 34

entries.title: The atmosphere is different from usual! “Funeral Freelen” Freelen Braid Ver. is now available from the POP UP PARADE series! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books!!
entries.title_ja: 普段と違う雰囲気にドキリ！POP UP PARADEシリーズから『葬送のフリーレン』フリーレン 三つ編みVer.が登場！楽天ブックスで予約受付中!!
entries.description: From POP UP PARADE, a popular and affordable figure series that you can't help but pick up, Freelen in her braids from the anime ``Funeral Freelen'' has been made into a figure! Now accepting reservations at Rakuten Books! #Funeral Freelen #Poppare

entries.title: "Evangelion New Theatrical Version" Makinami Mari Illustrious is commercialized from Volks' top beauty modeling brand "Absolute zone"! The commercialization of “Chara Gumin” featuring Shiho Nishizumi and Chiyo Shimada from “Garupan” in resort swimsuits is also announced for the first time! “Hobby Round 34” Photo Report
entries.title_ja: ボークス美女造形の最高峰ブランド「絶対領域（Absolute zone）」から『ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版』真希波・マリ・イラストリアスが商品化！『ガルパン』西住しほ＆島田千代がリゾート水着姿になった「キャラグミン」商品化も初発表！「ホビーラウンド34」フォトレポート
entries.description: The commercialization of "Chara Gumin" featuring Shiho Nishizumi and Chiyo Shimada in resort swimsuits from "Garupan" and "Chara Gumin" featuring Kana in the race queen costume from "Bunny Garden" has been announced for the first time! “Hobby Round 34” Photo Report #Hobby Round #Hobby Run 34

entries.title: Includes newly drawn illustration cards by Conan Edogawa, Chihaya Hagiwara, and Jugo Yokomizo! The 6th edition of "Itajaga Detective Conan" candy toy with card is now available!
entries.title_ja: 江戸川コナン、萩原千速、横溝重悟の描き下ろしイラストカードを収録！カード付き食玩「イタジャガ 名探偵コナン」第6弾が登場！
entries.description: The 6th edition of “Itajaga Detective Conan” candy toy with collection card is now available! Contains a total of 30 types, including special cards designed with original illustrations by Conan Edogawa, Chihaya Hagiwara, and Jugo Yokomizo! #Detective Conan #Candy Toy

entries.title: “Detective Conan” New items for Sega Prize in May! “Petite World Memories” figures with trunk box include “Heiji Hattori,” “Kazuha Toyama,” and “Shuichi Akai”!!
entries.title_ja: 『名探偵コナン』セガプライズ5月の新作アイテム！トランクBOX付きフィギュア“Petite World Memories”には「服部平次」「遠山和葉」「赤井秀一」が登場!!
entries.description: Sega, which is currently offering prize items for the "Detective Conan" anime series, introduces a series of new items, including a figure with trunk box to be released in May 2026! #Detective Conan #SEGA PRIZES

entries.title: The dignified sword-drawing pose and light steps with cat ears are attractive! Crusch and Ferris from “Re:ZERO − Starting Life in Another World” are now available as prize figures!
entries.title_ja: 凛々しい抜刀ポーズ＆猫耳の軽やかなステップが魅力的！『Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活』のクルシュとフェリスをプライズフィギュア化！
entries.description: From ``Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World'', Crusch and Ferris are made into prize figures! Two members of Crusch's camp are now three-dimensional! #rezero #rezero

entries.title: Cosplayer [Ria Tsukishiro] | Cosplay of the purple commander of the secret society “Laplace Darkness”
entries.title_ja: コスプレイヤー【月城りあ】｜秘密結社の紫色の総帥「 ラプラス・ダークネス」コスプレ
entries.description: We would like to introduce the cosplayer "Ria Tsukishiro" who cosplayed "Laplace Darkness" from "Hololive" on X (formerly Twitter). All of Ria Tsukishiro's cosplays are of high quality, projecting the character's inner self into photos.

entries.title: Overwhelmingly popular Touhou Project derivative work roguelite ACT “Touhou Kashinden” finally supports Japanese display. Kokoro Hata skillfully uses emotions to defeat bosses.
entries.title_ja: 圧倒的に好評・ 東方Project二次創作ローグライトACT『東方華心伝』ついに日本語表示に対応。秦こころが感情を巧みに使いわけ、ボスたちをしばく
entries.description: On May 1st, Nishiki Yuushicho released a major update for ``Touhou Kashinden - Touhou Blooming Soul'' that includes Japanese support. This work is a fan-created rogue-lite action game featuring Kokoro Hata, who appears in the Touhou Project works.

entries.title: High-freedom space RPG "The Outer Worlds" "regular version" will be discontinued, only the full version will be available on PC/PS5/Xbox Series X|S. Owners can get the full version for free
entries.title_ja: 高自由度宇宙RPG『アウター・ワールド』“通常版”が販売終了へ、PC/PS5/Xbox Series X|Sでは完全版のみに。所有者は無料で完全版を入手可能
entries.description: Obsidian Entertainment announced on May 1st that the regular edition of ``The Outer Worlds'' for PC/PS5/Xbox Series X'S will end on May 27th, and only ``The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition'' will be sold.

entries.title: Approximately 40% of US gamers say they play games on consoles "because of the exclusive titles." Although the ratio is decreasing, the existence of exclusive titles still remains strong.
entries.title_ja: 米国ゲーマーの約4割が、「独占タイトルがあるから」コンソールでゲームを遊ぶと回答。割合は減少傾向も、未だ根強い独占タイトルの存在
entries.description: 41% of US console gamers say they play their consoles because of exclusive titles.

entries.title: ``Helldiver 2'' received ``over 3,000 unfavorable reviews'' after the new update, and the official team immediately announced balance adjustments. “Balance adjustment criticism” resurfaces in the third year of service
entries.title_ja: 『ヘルダイバー2』新アプデ後に不評レビュー「3000件超え」、公式はすぐさまバランス再調整を発表。サービス3年目にして再燃する“バランス調整批判”
entries.description: Users disagreed over the adjustment policy for ``Helldiver 2'', leading to the developer announcing that some changes would be reverted.

entries.title: Details of the upcoming cosmetic update for the popular cooperative horror film "R.E.P.O." have been unveiled. If you bring home a "cosmetic box", you have a chance to get decorations, but if you handle it roughly, it will break.
entries.title_ja: 人気協力ホラー『R.E.P.O.』来たるコスメアプデの詳細がお披露目。「コスメボックス」を持ち帰れば装飾ゲットのチャンス、でも乱暴に扱うとやっぱり壊れる
entries.description: semiwork has released the details of the cosmetic system that will be implemented in the next major update of "R.E.P.O.", "Cosmetics Update".

entries.title: "New toys" will be introduced in the next update of "Terraria". A glimpse of new elements such as “flowerpot-style minions with limbs” and “shooting with Daybloom flowers”
entries.title_ja: 『テラリア』次回アプデでは「新しいおもちゃ」が登場予定。“手足の生えた植木鉢風ミニオン”や“デイブルームの花で射撃”など、新要素いろいろチラ見せ
entries.description: Version 1.4.5.7, which is currently under development, will introduce several new elements.

entries.title: VHS-style first-person psychological horror “Overcome Your Fears – Caretaker” is now available for free on Steam for a limited time
entries.title_ja: VHS風一人称視点サイコホラー『Overcome Your Fears – Caretaker』、Steamにて期間限定で無料配布中
entries.description: On May 1st, markuwaaaaa started distributing the horror game ``Overcome Your Fears - Caretaker'' for free on Steam. The period ends at midnight on May 8th, Japan time.

entries.title: "MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA", a new work by "MELBURA", announced. Equipped with a new character system, a new work is finally here!
entries.title_ja: 『メルブラ』新作『MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA』発表。新キャラ・システムを搭載し、ついに新作が登場へ
entries.description: TYPE-MOON, French Bread, and Aniplex announced "MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA" on May 2nd. It is scheduled to be released in early 2027, along with new characters and an evolution system.

entries.title: The turn-based strategy game ``Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era'' recovered its development costs on the first day of release. Developers rejoice at the huge success of series reboot
entries.title_ja: ターン制ストラテジー『Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era』、なんとリリース初日で開発費を回収していた。開発元はシリーズ再始動作の大ヒットに歓喜
entries.description: Unfrozen announced on May 1 that Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era sold 250,000 copies in the first 24 hours after its release. According to the developer, they have already recovered the production costs.

entries.title: In the free-to-play ``city'' open world ``NTE'', searches for ``criminal acts'' and ``acrobatic jailbreaks'' are becoming extremely popular. The birth of a naughty play with too much freedom
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料“街”オープンワールド『NTE』にて“犯罪すれすれ行為”や“アクロバティック脱獄”探しがやけに流行る。自由過ぎなやんちゃプレイ爆誕
entries.description: Attempts to perform acrobatic jailbreaks and cause nuisance without being charged with a crime seem to be popular in ``NTE: Neverness to Everness''.

entries.title: Train colony city building sim ``Steel Artery: Train City Builder'' will be released on May 16th. A super-huge train city where orcs and elves coexist, and skillfully manage carefree citizens.
entries.title_ja: 列車コロニー街づくりシム『Steel Artery: Train City Builder』、5月16日リリースへ。オークやエルフらが共生する超巨大列車都市、気まま市民を上手に管理
entries.description: Crytivo announced on May 2nd that Steel Artery: Train City Builder will be released on May 15th. This is a colony simulation game where you build a city inside a train.

entries.title: The 4-player cooperative western PvE shooter "Far Far West" is so popular that it was mistakenly identified as a DDoS attack, causing a server failure. Currently restored
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力西部劇PvEシューター『Far Far West』大人気すぎてDDoS攻撃と誤認され、サーバー障害発生の珍事。現在は復旧済み
entries.description: Evil Raptor reported a server outage for its FPS "Far Far West" on May 1. The problem has now already been resolved.

entries.title: [EVO Japan] What are the future goals of Shoma Uno and Tokido, who have joined VARREL? Report on the press conference where the rebranding of VARREL was also discussed.
entries.title_ja: ［EVO Japan］VARRELに加入した宇野昌磨選手とときど選手の今後の目標とは。VARRELのリブランディングも語られた記者会見をレポート
entries.description: On the first day of "EVO Japan 2026", the e-sports team "VARREL" announced the addition of professional figure skater Shoma Uno and professional gamer Tokido. Uno will continue to work as a professional figure skater and as a member of an e-sports team.

entries.title: "Die in the Dungeon" ends early access and transitions to retail version. A unique turn-based roguelite where you build your deck using dice.
entries.title_ja: 「Die in the Dungeon」，アーリーアクセスを終了して製品版に移行。ダイスでデッキを組むユニークなターン制ローグライト
entries.description: Publisher HypeTrainDigital announced that it has released the production version of ``DieintheDungeon'' developed by indie developer ATICO. The product version now also supports Japanese. It's a unique turn-based roguelite that replaces all deck builder cards with dice.

entries.title: [EVO Japan] Update patch “Ver.2.01” that adjusts some battle balance and issues of “GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-” will be released on May 14th
entries.title_ja: ［EVO Japan］「GUILTY GEAR ‐STRIVE‐」の一部バトルバランスや不具合の調整を行うアップデートパッチ「Ver.2.01」が5月14日に配信
entries.description: Arc System Works today (May 2, 2026) announced that the update patch ``Ver.2.01'' for ``GUILTYGEAR-STRIVE-'' will be distributed on May 14th. In addition to some battle balance and bug adjustments, Blazing Pass will also be launched.

entries.title: "Infinity Niki" Ver.2.5 "Spirits returning home". In order to find the truth, Nikki and her friends go to the place where the gods of reincarnation, Icorus, and the saints were buried.
entries.title_ja: 「インフィニティニキ」Ver.2.5「帰路につく諸霊」。ニキたちは真実を探すため，輪廻の神イコルスや聖女たちが生まれた埋骨の地へ
entries.description: InfoldGames has released a major update to Infinity Nikki Ver. 2.5, ``Spirits Returning Home''. Set in the land of burial, the main story approaches the truth about Icorus, the god of reincarnation, and the saints, keel skills, new stages, and more have been added.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 151: “Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era” and “Far Far West” on sale
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第151号：「Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era」や「Far Far West」が発売に
entries.description: This week's Weekly Steam Plaza brings you the latest Steam titles and sale information. This week, "OldenEra," the latest title in the "HeroesofMightandMagic" series after a 10-year absence, and "FarFarWest," a 1-4 player co-op FPS in which players take on the role of a robotic cowboy bounty hunter, were released.

entries.title: Yui's Hoe Hoe Game Speech: No. 264 "Perhaps the world's first? I'll talk about how to beat the surname shiritori game ``Last Name Connection''"
entries.title_ja: 結のほえほえゲーム演説：第264回「おそらく世界初？　名字しりとりゲーム『名字繋ぎ』攻略方法を話します」
entries.description: Yamada, Tamura, Muraoka, Okajima, Shimazaki... Yui is addicted to the free game ``Last Name Tsunagi'', where you connect two kanji last names using shiritori. It seems that while playing the game, he came up with some strategies, and in this series, he will "teach" them.

entries.title: [EVO Japan] Mr. Karate participates in “Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves”. Scheduled to be implemented in May 2026
entries.title_ja: ［EVO Japan］「餓狼伝説 City of the Wolves」にMr.カラテが参戦。2026年5月に実装予定
entries.description: SNK today (May 2, 2026) announced the new character "Mr. Karate" who will be participating in "Fatal Fury City of the Wolves". Implementation is scheduled for May 2026. The person inside is believed to be Robert Garcia, based on the image of a tiger and the line, "Who's here?"

entries.title: “Okekatsu! ” A new horizon was felt through the rehearsal. “Aikatsu! Series” fans can experience it at the venue!
entries.title_ja: 『オケカツ！』リハーサルを通じて感じた，新たな地平。「アイカツ！シリーズ」ファンは会場で体感しよう
entries.description: On May 4th (Monday/holiday), "'Aikatsu! Series' Orchestra Concert 'Okekatsu!' 2026-Anniversary Baton-" will be held at Sumida Triphony Hall. In this article, we will provide a report on that rehearsal.

entries.title: “EVO Japan 2026” venue report. Manufacturer booths, photo spots, cosplay photography, playable exhibits of new fighting games, and plenty of other highlights!
entries.title_ja: 「EVO Japan 2026」会場レポート。メーカーブースにフォトスポット，コスプレ撮影，新作格ゲーのプレイアブル出展と見どころ満載！
entries.description: The venue for "EVOJapan2026", which has been held at Tokyo Big Sight since May 1st, was lined with unique booths. I'll report on what was particularly impressive. There were photo spots, cosplay photo shoots, playable exhibits of new fighting games, and nostalgic Akekon exhibits.

entries.title: [EVO Japan] “THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV” Balance adjustments for all characters will be implemented in July 2026
entries.title_ja: ［EVO Japan］「THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV」，全キャラクターを対象にしたバランス調整を2026年7月に実施
entries.description: SNK today (May 2, 2026) announced that balance adjustments to the fighting game "THE KINGOFFIGHTERS XV" will be carried out in July 2026. It is said that all characters will be eligible for distribution after the conclusion of EVO in Las Vegas.

entries.title: [EVO Japan] “MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA” announced. The latest work in the Melbra series with new systems and characters added.
entries.title_ja: ［EVO Japan］「MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA」発表。新システムとキャラクターが追加されたメルブラシリーズの最新作
entries.description: TYPE-MOON and French Bread today (May 2, 2026) announced the latest work in the MELTYBLOOD series, “MELTYBLOOD:TWI-LUMINA.” Release is scheduled for early 2027. It is said that new systems and characters will be added to the renewed version of TYPELUMINA.

entries.title: "Magical Blush" production announcement. A 2D action-adventure that combines a spell combo system with Metroidvania-style exploration.

entries.title: Turn-based x real-time fusion bullet hell roguelike "Enter the Chronosphere" will be released in early access on May 15th. If you stop, your enemy will stop too, a highly anticipated work that will get a lot of attention from Japan.

entries.title: Announcement of "Re:Re:Re:Respawn", an action game where "your own corpse" is used as a platform. A corpse utilization game that repeats death and respawn.

entries.title: According to the developer of ``Hitman,'' who is working on ``007 First Light,'' the in-house game engine has evolved to its limits. We asked him about his determination to make “the first 007 game in 14 years” now.
entries.title_ja: 『007 First Light』を手がける『ヒットマン』開発者いわく、内製ゲームエンジンは限界まで進化。“14年ぶりの「007」ゲーム”をあえて今作る覚悟を訊いた
entries.description: We asked him some interesting questions about why IO Interactive, known for the ``Hitman'' series, is working on a ``007'' game and the appeal of this work.

entries.title: The basic free-to-play "town" open world "NTE" got off to a good start with "sales of over 2 billion yen" on the first day alone. The global version has the top sales in Japan and the US.
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料“街”オープンワールド『NTE』、初日だけで「売上20億円超」の好発進。グローバル版は日本と米国が売上ツートップ
entries.description: ``NTE: Neverness to Everness'' (hereinafter referred to as NTE), which was released globally on April 29th, had sales of over 2 billion yen on the first day.

entries.title: ZERO Sievert 2, a sequel to the popular PvE escape shooter, announced. Tense survival game influenced by "Tarkov" is powered up with long-awaited "up to 4-player cooperative multiplayer support"

entries.title: ``007 First Light'' has plenty of ``Hitman'' DNA in its disguises and infiltration routes, but its ``007'' character elevates it to something else. Impressions of trial play after playing various strategy routes
entries.title_ja: 『007 First Light』は変装や潜入経路に『ヒットマン』のDNAたっぷり、しかし「007」らしさで別モノに昇華。攻略ルートいろいろ遊んでみた試遊プレイ感想
entries.description: ``007 First Light'' is a luxurious work that incorporates the high-quality stealth action that was backed by the ``Hitman'' series and the flashy action that is familiar from movies.

entries.title: Announcement of "Steam to Electric", a voxel railway network construction sim. Run historical experimental trains such as a “jet engine train” and a “gyro monorail”

entries.title: Get into a vehicle and aim for victory in one-on-one battles with enemy aircraft. Arcade Archives version “Cyber ​​Command”, released on April 30th

entries.title: What kind of game is the new release ``CRYMELIGHT'' and the related work ``CRYSTAR'' currently on sale? A “crying” action RPG that starts with a strong introduction.
entries.title_ja: 新作発表『クライムライト／CRYMELIGHT』、格安セール中の関連作『CRYSTAR -クライスタ-』ってどんなゲーム？強烈な導入から始まる“泣き”アクションRPG
entries.description: In conjunction with the announcement of the new work ``CRYMELIGHT'', I would like to take a look back at what kind of title the action RPG ``CRYMELIGHT'' is.

entries.title: Capcom formulates ``Community Tournament Guidelines'' for ``Street Fighter 6,'' etc. Clarification such as “participation fee is up to 2000 yen”, is it NG to give Amagifi as a prize?
entries.title_ja: カプコン、『ストリートファイター6』など向け「コミュニティ大会開催ガイドライン」を策定。“参加費は2000円まで”など明確化、賞品アマギフはNGか
entries.description: On April 28th, Capcom announced the ``Capcom Community Tournament Guidelines.''

entries.title: The distributor of the Chinese soul-like ``End of the Ming: Utsuronohane'' purchased the rights from the developer for ``approximately 750 million yen.'' Amid rumors that the “development team has been disbanded”
entries.title_ja: 中華ソウルライク『明末：ウツロノハネ』販売元が「約7億5000万円」で開発元から権利を買収。“開発チームは解散済み”との噂が立つなかで
entries.description: Digital Bros. announced on April 27th that the two companies have agreed to acquire the intellectual property rights for ``End of Ming: Utsuronohane'' from the developer, Chengdu Lingze Technology.

entries.title: The Steam version of the high school girl ghost ``explaining the cause of death'' horror mystery ``Kugayama Shiori's Death Notebook'' will be suddenly released on April 30th. Chasing the presumed ghost of a high school girl, the truth about memory and death
entries.title_ja: 女子高生幽霊「死因解明」ホラーミステリー『久我山栞の死様手帖』Steam版、4月30日に突如発売へ。推定女子高生幽霊と追う、記憶と死の真相
entries.description: Visual novel maker Laplacian announced on April 28th that the Steam version of ``Kugayama Shiori's Death Notebook'' will begin distribution on April 30th at midnight.

entries.title: The free trial version of ``Final Fantasy VII Rebirth'' Switch 2/Xbox version is now available. Saves can be carried over to the final version, so you can enjoy plenty of fun and receive bonuses.
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーVII リバース』Switch 2/Xbox版の無料体験版が配信開始。製品版にセーブ引き継ぎ可能、たっぷり遊べて特典までもらえる
entries.description: On April 28th, Square Enix began distributing a free trial version of ``Final Fantasy VII Rebirth'' for Nintendo Switch 2/Xbox Series X'S/Windows.

entries.title: Game developers are also paying attention to the voices saying, ``Stop announcing new games too early.'' I'll keep you waiting, but there are complicated circumstances that I would like to announce as soon as possible.
entries.title_ja: 「“新作ゲームの早すぎる発表”をやめて」との声に、ゲーム開発者も注目。待たせちゃうけど、早めに発表したい複雑な事情
entries.description: Users are questioning the industry's practice of announcing games when they're still in the early stages of development, then not hearing anything about them for years.

entries.title: Nintendo Switch 2/ Approximately 200 books added to the sale for Switch. Nintendo titles are also eligible, and popular multiplayer titles such as ``Core Keeper'' and 2-player horror ``Re-Animal'' are also available at low prices.
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch 2/ Switch向けセールに約200本追加。任天堂タイトルも対象、『コア・キーパー』や2人プレイ対応ホラー『リアニマル』など人気マルチプレイ作品もお安く
entries.description: On April 28th, a new sale for Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch titles began on the Nintendo eShop. Approximately 200 titles are eligible.

entries.title: Steam's featured deck building auto battler "Lunchbreak Tactics" now available in Japanese. Addictive asynchronous PvP with heated battles in the spare time and “just one more time”
entries.title_ja: Steam注目デッキ構築オートバトラー『Lunchbreak Tactics』配信開始、日本語対応済み。すき間時間で白熱バトル、“あと1回だけ”が続く病みつき非同期PvP
entries.description: Vsoo Games released the asynchronous PvP roguelite card game ``Lunchbreak Tactics'' on April 28th.

entries.title: Emergency service management sim ``Global Rescue'' quickly became very popular on Steam. A 3D map of the “local town” is created from sanitary map data, and emergency vehicles are used to maintain public order from morning to night.

entries.description: On April 28, Aerosoft GmbH began distributing early access to PeDePe's emergency service simulation ``Global Rescue''.

entries.title: There is a heated debate among game developers over the question of how far they must go in creating their own games in order to be able to claim the title of "individual developer." The wavering line of “OK to outsource”
entries.title_ja: ゲームの「個人開発者」は、“どこまでひとりで作れば名乗れるのか”巡り開発者間で議論白熱。揺らぐ“外注OK”のライン
entries.description: There is a debate surrounding the term ``individual developer'' in games, mainly in the English-speaking world.

entries.title: Steam free roguelike "Elin" official newsletter April issue released. Secretly obtained mini illustrations and musical scores are also released.

entries.description: PLAYISM announced on April 28th that the online event "PLAYISM GAME SHOW 2026.5.10" will be held on May 10th.

entries.description: I'd like to introduce you to the traditional metroidvania and deadly game characteristics that I experienced through a trial play of ``Karma Exorcist'', which is currently being developed by Cyclos.

entries.title: "STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions", open beta test will be held from May 1st Japan time. Cooperative action set in the world of "Astronia"
entries.title_ja: 「STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions」，オープンβテストを日本時間の5月1日から開催。「アストロニーア」の世界を舞台とした協力アクション
entries.description: DevolverDigital announced today (April 28, 2026) that it will begin open beta testing for its new title "STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions" on May 1, Japan time. This work is an action-adventure game set in the world of ``Astronia'' where you can enjoy various discoveries and explorations through cooperative play.

entries.title: "Algorithm Prescription" is a "swamp love visual novel" that aims to achieve the optimal "1/100 likeability" for each other. Trial version is also available
entries.title_ja: 「Algorithm Prescription」はお互いにとって最適な「100分の1の好感度」を目指す「沼系恋愛ビジュアルノベル」。体験版も配信中
entries.description: Shochiku today (April 28, 2026) released the trial version of its new PC title ``Algorithm Prescription'' on Steam. In this trial version, you can see the relationship between the main character, Kokoro, and the characters you want to conquer from the perspective of Kou, one of the characters that appears in the game. In addition, in the product version, the aim is to achieve a mutually optimal ``1/100 favorability''.

entries.title: "Kioku: That Summer Day" will be released on Steam on May 28th. An adventure set on Kioku Island, which is a fusion of Scandinavian and Japanese countryside.
entries.title_ja: 「キオク:あの夏の日」，5月28日にSteamでリリース決定。北欧と日本の田舎が溶け合ったような「キオク島」を舞台にしたアドベンチャー
entries.description: Assemble Entertainment announced today (April 28, 2026) that it will release the PC adventure "Kioku: That Summer Day" on Steam on May 28th. The player takes on the role of ``Asti,'' a girl who moves to ``Kioku Island,'' which is a combination of Scandinavian and Japanese countryside, and spends her summer vacation exploring the island and enjoying interacting with the people.

entries.title: Official version of "MEMOLITH: Forsaken by Light" released. A turn-based RPG featuring battles where the timing of actions and positioning determines victory or defeat.
entries.title_ja: 「MEMOLITH: Forsaken by Light」正式版をリリース。行動のタイミングやポジショニングが勝敗を左右するバトルが魅力のターン制RPG

entries.title_ja: 「常世ノ塔」開発者の新作タイトル「MELTMARE -メルトメア」，ファーストトレイラーを公開。東京ゲームダンジョン12への出展も

This is an action-adventure game in which you guide Lua, a strange girl on the other side of the screen, to escape from a mysterious facility infested with monsters.

entries.title: The main cast of the live-action group drama ADV project "Shibuya Scramble Stories" has been announced. Mr. Yosuke Kubozuka, Mr. Hironari Amano, Mr. Fumio Kitakami, Mr. Yuto Nakamura, and Mr. Yu Matsuda.

entries.description: Sonic Powered today announced that the railway driving sims ``Railway Japan! RealPro Tokyo-Kanagawa! Tokyu Corporation Edition'' and ``Railway Japan! RealPro Long Distance Driving! Limited Express Hitori Kinki Nippon Railway Edition'' will be released for PS5 on August 6, 2026. In the PS5 version, the view from the driver's seat is composed mainly of 4K quality live-action footage, showing every detail of the scenery vividly.

entries.title: [Play Report] The classic “Heroes of Might and Magic” is back. How “Olden Era” feels and feels as early access approaches
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］クラシカルな「Heroes of Might and Magic」が返ってきた。早期アクセスが間近に迫る「Olden Era」の手触りやいかに
entries.description: ``Olden Era'', the first new game in the ``Heroes of Might and Magic'' series in 10 years, is scheduled to start early access on April 30th. Under the banner of returning to classic HoMM, how did they inherit the framework of the series and how did they modernize it? I actually played the early access version and got a feel for the game.

entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンター』ナルガクルガとフルフルが迫力のある造形が魅力のデフォルメソフビフィギュア「鎮座獣」シリーズに襲来！フルフルは原種に加えて真っ赤な体の亜種もラインナップ！
entries.description: From the "Monster Hunter" series, Nargacuga and Furufuru appear in Banpresto's soft vinyl figures "Chinzajuu"! Scheduled to be released sequentially from April 28th (Tuesday)! #Monster Hunter #Figure

entries.title: From "Haikyuu!!", Yu Nishitani, Ryunosuke Tanaka, and Tadashi Yamaguchi will appear as deformed mascots at the Furyu Prize!
entries.title_ja: 『ハイキュー!!』より、西谷夕、田中龍之介、山口忠がデフォルメマスコットになってフリューのプライズに登場！
entries.description: Yu Nishitani, Ryunosuke Tanaka, and Tadashi Yamaguchi from "Haikyu!!" are joining the lineup for the third installment of Furyu's "Chopinui Petit"! Deformed mascot in uniform! #Haikyuu #hq_anime

entries.title: "Marriage Toxin" Design of Gero Hikaru, Kinosaki Mei and others! Acrylic stands, glittering hologram tin badges, and SNS-style acrylic key chains are now available for pre-order at Kadost!
entries.title_ja: 『マリッジトキシン』下呂ヒカルや城崎メイたちをデザイン！アクリルスタンドやホログラム仕様のキラキラ缶バッジ、SNS風アクリルキーホルダーがカドストで予約受付中！
entries.description: Acrylic stands, sparkly tin badges, and SNS-style acrylic key chains designed with illustrations of characters from "Marriage Toxin" are now available! Now accepting reservations at Kadost! #marriagetoxin

entries.title: Precise reproduction of nostalgic cassette tapes! Capsule toy “ATC maxell miniature collection” scheduled to be released on April 27th (Monday)
entries.title_ja: 懐かしのカセットテープを精密再現！カプセルトイ「ATC maxell ミニチュアコレクション」が4月27日（月）発売予定
entries.description: A precise miniature figure of the nostalgic Maxell cassette tape! Capsule toy "Maxell Miniature Collection" from Ikimon will be released on April 27th (Monday)!! #Capsule Toy #Ikimon #Maxell

entries.title: New prize figures of "Kisekoi", "Gakumasu", "Hololive", and "Re:Zero" scheduled to be released in late April 2026 will be exhibited in Akihabara!
entries.title_ja: 2026年4月下旬登場予定の『着せ恋』『学マス』『ホロライブ』『リゼロ』新作プライズフィギュアが秋葉原で展示！
entries.description: Prize figures such as Umi Kitagawa from "Kise Koi", Hajime Todoroki from "Hololive", Saki Hanami from "Gakuen Idolmaster", Yume Hanami from "Re:Zero", Nargacuga from "Monster Hunter", Furufuru, and more will be on display in Akihabara! #dressed love #school mass

entries.title: Reservation deadline for “Soul of Chogokin GX-38R Iron Gear” from “Battle Mecha Xabungle” is today!
entries.title_ja: 「戦闘メカ ザブングル」より「超合金魂 GX-38R アイアンギアー」本日予約締切！
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS is accepting reservations for the figure ``Soul of Chogokin GX-38R Iron Gear'' on Premium Bandai until 11:00 pm today, April 26th. The price is 37,400 yen. Shipping is scheduled for August.

entries.title: Banpresto is releasing the 7th series of candy-themed "Kirby's Dream Land" prize figures! There are 3 types of cute figures, including Kirby who pokes his head out of a popcorn can!
entries.title_ja: お菓子をテーマにした『星のカービィ』プライズフィギュアの第7弾がバンプレストから登場！ポップコーン缶の中から顔を出すカービィなど可愛いフィギュアは全3種類！
entries.description: Banpresto has released the 7th installment of the "Paldolce Collection" prize figure based on "Kirby's Dream Land" with the theme of delicious sweets! Scheduled to be released sequentially from April 28th (Tuesday)! #Kirby of the Stars #Prize

entries.title: Capsule toy “NTC Shiny Fukura Frog” will be released on April 27th (Monday)! Approximately 58mm in actual size, even the jiggling feeling after bathing is reproduced!!
entries.title_ja: カプセルトイ 「NTC ツヤツヤのフクラガエル」が4月27日（月）発売予定！約58ミリのほぼ実寸サイズで水浴び後のプルプル感まで再現!!
entries.description: Fukura frog, popular for its round shape, is now available as a capsule toy! Ikimon's "NTC Glossy Fukura Frog" is scheduled to be released on April 27th (Monday)!! It reproduces the plump body and grumpy expression, and the surface has a glossy finish that makes it so cute that you can stroke it♪ #Capsule Toy #Ikimon

entries.title: "Persona 5 The Royal" is 80% off at 1,535 yen. "Shapez" is 90% off and only 120 yen. This week's high discount PC games
entries.title_ja: 『ペルソナ５ ザ・ロイヤル』が80％オフの1535円。『shapez』は90％オフでわずか120円。今週の高割引率PCゲーム
entries.description: In this article, we will focus on titles that have been on sale on Steam in the past week, with a focus on games with particularly high discount rates.

entries.title: Alice in Wonder Underland, a disturbing fairy tale exploration adventure, evokes the ``internet experience of yesteryear.'' Chaotic exploration full of anxiety and excitement, not knowing what will happen
entries.title_ja: 不穏メルヘン探索アドベンチャー『アリスインワンダーアンダーランド』は、“かつてのインターネット体験”を呼び覚ます。何が起きるかわからない不安とワクワクに満ちたカオス探索
entries.description: "Alice in Wonder Underland -AIWU-" is an exploration adventure game set in a dream world. The player takes on the role of Alice and adventures into an unknown world that spreads outside her room.

entries.title: “Saka Tsuku 2026” The English league is so strong that it will break your heart even after 200 hours of play. Despair for the first time after 3 months of serious play serialization
entries.title_ja: 『サカつく2026』イングランドリーグはプレイ200時間でも心が折れそうになる“地獄”級の強さ。3か月間ガチプレイ連載で、初めての絶望
entries.description: "Saka Tsuku 2026" is the 8th edition of the serious play diary, and the English league edition is the one that experienced the greatest despair.

entries.title: "Shadowverse Worlds Beyond" New spell "Graton Spell" from the new card pack "God Slayer Anathema" has been exclusively released. “Minimum 0 cost”, a new style of removal spell for arcane witches
entries.title_ja: 『シャドウバース ワールズビヨンド』新カードパック「神殺し・アナテマ」から、新スペル「グラトンスペル」独占公開。“最低0コスト”、秘術ウィッチ向け除去スペルに新風か
entries.description: In this article, we will provide information on ``Graton Spell'' from the 7th card pack ``Anathema's Gambit'' of ``Shadowverse Worlds Beyond''.

entries.title: Furyu's ``CRYMELIGHT'' announced, scheduled for release in November. “The more you repent, the stronger you become”, a roguelike action in the vein of “Crystas”
entries.title_ja: フリュー『クライムライト／CRYMELIGHT』発表、11月発売へ。“懺悔するだけ強くなる”、『クライスタ』の流れを汲むローグライクアクション
entries.description: On April 25th, Furyu announced the new roguelike action game ``CRYMELIGHT''.

entries.title: Announcing ``Luna Pulse'', a rogue-lite card game with tense short-term battles. The ritual of the witches on a never-ending moonlit night reconstructed into a “death game” battle
entries.title_ja: 緊迫短期決戦ローグライトカードゲーム『ルナパルス』発表。「死にゲー」の戦闘に再構築した、明けない月夜の魔女たちの儀式
entries.description: Fahrenheit 213 (213℉) announced "Luna Pulse" on April 25th.

entries.title: Fantasy “work-intensive” adventure “Memory of Memorie: A Chill Story” announced. Another world work call where you work hard with a girl who is an apprentice wizard
entries.title_ja: ファンタジー“作業集中”アドベンチャー『Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story』発表。魔法使い見習いの少女と一緒にがんばる異世界作業通話
entries.description: BeXide announced "Memory of Memorie: A Chill Story" on April 25th, scheduled for release in summer 2026. This work is an adventure game where you work together with Memory, a witch's apprentice.

entries.title: “Pain Pain Go Away!”, a psychotherapeutic typing game for a sick girl, will be released on May 20th. New work by Hitoshi Fujisawa, who is also known for the Dragon Quest series, The Fourth Boundary, etc.
entries.title_ja: 病み少女心療タイピングゲーム『Pain Pain Go Away!』5月20日配信へ。『ドラクエ』シリーズ・「第四境界」などの藤澤仁氏手がける新作
entries.description: Story note brand Lorebard announced on April 25th that it will release ``Pain Pain Go Away!'' on May 20th. This is a typing adventure game where you play as a counselor and delve into the darkness of girls' hearts.

entries.title: A live-action romance sim from a hamster's perspective, ``Hamukoi - The sweet days of me and my three sisters who were reincarnated as hamsters'' will be released in July this year. A game that the weekly magazine “FRIDAY” is also involved in, overcomes “Steam store page deletion”
entries.title_ja: ハムスター視点の実写恋愛シム『ハムコイ-ハムスターに転生した僕と三姉妹の甘々な日々』今年7月発売へ。週刊誌「FRIDAY」も携わるゲーム、“Steamストアページ削除”を乗り越えて
entries.description: Kodansha announced on April 25th that ``Hamukoi - The sweet days of me and my three sisters who were reincarnated as hamsters'' will be released in July 2026. This work is a love sim in which the main character is reincarnated as a hamster and lives together with his three childhood friends as pets.

entries.title: A new stage is unveiled in the latest trailer for the large-scale domestic metroidvania ``Chronoscript''. The ocean world depicted in beautiful hand-drawn art
entries.title_ja: 大型国産メトロイドヴァニア『Chronoscript（クロノスクリプト）』最新トレイラーで新ステージお披露目。手書き風美麗アートで描かれる海洋世界
entries.description: On April 25th, Shueisha Games announced a new video for ``Chronoscript: The Endless End''. This work is a 2D action-adventure game in which you explore "inside the manuscript."

entries.title: The Spring and Autumn Sengoku sim ``Mandate Order'', which is currently available as a trial version on Steam, has benefits even in disasters, such as ``infecting enemies with plagues''. We asked the developer what his aim was to achieve both a sense of history and ease of play.
entries.title_ja: Steam体験版配信中の春秋戦国シム『Mandate Order』は“疫病を敵に感染させる”など、災害にもメリットあり。歴史感と遊びやすさの両立を目指す開発者に狙いを訊いた
entries.description: The trial version of the Spring and Autumn Sengoku sim ``Mandate Order'' is now available. I heard some interesting information from the development team, so I would like to introduce it to you.

entries.title: Announcement of "PUKEY GODDES SHOT TRICK", a hellish drinking Russian roulette game. A destructive “drinking survival” where you drink until you vomit your soul with a beautiful devil girl
entries.title_ja: 地獄のお酒ロシアンルーレットゲーム『PUKEY GODDES SHOT TRICK』発表。美少女悪魔と魂を吐くまで飲む、破滅的“酒飲みサバイバル”
entries.description: Alliance Arts announced ``PUKEY GODDES SHOT TRICK'' on April 25th. This is a Russian roulette-only survival game where you challenge a beautiful devil to a Russian roulette-style drinking match.

entries.title: Enjoy the “life of a popular protagonist” in “Arknights: Endfield”. I like the lively, slow-life feel of Key's new album ``anemoi.'' Everything about MOUSE is of high quality. This week's gaming
entries.title_ja: 『アークナイツ：エンドフィールド』で“鬼モテ主人公ライフ”を楽しむ。Key新作『anemoi』の賑やかスローライフ感がいい。『MOUSE』はすべてが高品質。今週のゲーミング
entries.description: Now Gaming is a corner where every Sunday, each writer loosely writes about the games they played that week. This is the 541st time.

entries.title: Basic free-to-play ``City'' The city of open world ``NTE'' has a lot of ``mysterious creations.'' almost reality
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料「街」オープンワールド『NTE』の街には「謎の作り込み」がめちゃくちゃある。ほぼ現実
entries.description: Based on the preliminary play of "NTE: Neverness to Everness", we will introduce how to walk through Heterocity, a city full of endearing waste.

entries.title: Sanrio has established its own game brand "Sanrio Games". MMORPG "AION 2" will be distributed domestically within the year. 7 must-see gaming articles this week
entries.title_ja: サンリオがなんと自社ゲームブランド「Sanrio Games」を設立。MMORPG『AION 2』は年内国内配信へ。今週の見逃せないゲーム記事7選
entries.description: We have picked up 7 articles, focusing on game introduction articles that received a great response from this week's AUTOMATON. This is the 79th time.

entries.title: ``In Us'', a four-person cooperative horror game in which you identify a devil hidden in a village, will be released in the winter of 2026. Human or devil? Shout out, reveal it, and laugh together.
entries.title_ja: 村に紛れた悪魔を見極める4人協力型ホラー「In Us」，2026年冬に発売。人間か悪魔か，叫んで暴いて笑い合え
entries.description: Yaneura Games announced the new PC game "InUs" today (April 25, 2026) at INDIELiveExpo2026. Up to four exorcists work together to identify demons disguised as humans and exorcise them. The aim is to create an experience that includes both shouts and laughter.

entries.title: Frew's completely new work "CRYMELIGHT" will be released on November 5th. A roguelike action game where you fight in the afterlife using your own sins as weapons.
entries.title_ja: フリュー完全新作「クライムライト／CRYMELIGHT」が11月5日に発売へ。死後の世界で，自らの“罪”を武器に戦うローグライクアクション
entries.description: Furyu announced today (April 25, 2026) at the indie game live broadcast event "INDIELiveExpo2026.4.25" that it will release a completely new title "CRYMELIGHT" on November 5, 2026. This work is a roguelike action game in which girls who carry sins fight in the afterlife.

entries.title: [Play Report] Mandate Order is a nation-building sim RTS set in the Spring and Autumn Warring States period. There are too many things to do, from mining and production to building defense lines, developing logistics networks, and deciding on foreign policy!
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］春秋戦国時代を舞台にした建国シムRTS「マンデートオーダー」。採掘や生産から防衛線の構築，物流網の整備，外交政策の決定まで，やることが多すぎる！
entries.description: At the trial event ``Yusenkan'' sponsored by BilibiliGames, I experienced the new game ``Mandate Order,'' which is set in China during the Spring, Autumn, and Warring States periods. This work is an RTS centered around a nation-building simulation, and features a profound game design in which players are responsible for all elements of nation management, from resource gathering and production management to designing logistics networks and determining diplomatic policy.

entries.title: A sweet life with three beautiful sisters from a hamster's perspective? Is sushi a race? New information on 4 Kodansha Game Lab titles released at INDIE Live Expo
entries.title_ja: ハムスター視点で美人三姉妹と甘々な生活？ お寿司がレース？　INDIE Live Expoにて講談社ゲームラボ4タイトルの新情報が公開に
entries.description: Kodansha Game Lab released new information on four publishing titles at the indie game live event "INDIELiveExpo2026.4.25". The release dates for ``Hamukoi,'' where you can live a sweet life with three beautiful sisters from the perspective of a hamster, and ``Wabi Sabi Sushi Derby,'' where you raise sushi and challenge them to a race, have been revealed.

entries.title: Providing young people with opportunities to learn and take on challenges through esports. NASEF JAPAN begins full-scale nationwide expansion of human resource development activities by introducing regular membership system and establishing local branches
entries.title_ja: eスポーツを通じて学びや挑戦の機会を若者に。NASEF JAPANが正会員制度導入と地方支部設立により，人材育成活動の本格的な全国展開を始動
entries.description: NASEFJAPAN (International Educational Esports Federation Network Japan Headquarters) held a press conference in Tokyo on April 24, 2026. At this presentation, the organization, which is celebrating its 5th anniversary, announced the full-scale introduction of a regular membership system with the aim of becoming a national organization, as well as future plans regarding the establishment of local branches.

entries.title: The new werewolf action game ``OCTOPinbs'' will be released on Steam on May 12th. Hunt down the arsonist by observing his behavior without using words.
entries.title_ja: 人狼系アクションゲームの新作「OCTOPinbs」が5月12日にSteamでリリース。言葉を使わず挙動を見て放火犯を追い詰めろ
entries.description: Aniplex announced today (April 25th) that the new game ``OCTOPinbs'' will be released on Steam on May 12th. This work is a werewolf-type action game in which the player disguises himself as a firefighter to catch an arsonist who sets fire by looking at his surroundings and identifying him. Up to 10 people can participate, and the feature is that the true identity is uncovered by observing behavior on the spot rather than through conversations.

entries.title: Open beta test begins for high-speed mechanical shooting “OMEGA PHENEX COMMENCED PROJECT SIX”
entries.title_ja: ハイスピードメカシューティング「OMEGA PHENEX COMMENCED PROJECT SIX」のオープンβテスト開始
entries.description: Surume Kobo today (April 25, 2026) announced the start of open beta testing for the high-speed mechanical shooting game "OMEGAPHENEXCOMMENCED PROJECTSIX." During the test, you can experience high-speed battles and mecha customization through early missions.

entries.title: Sukeban Games' latest work ".45 Parabellum Bloodhound", which worked on "VA-11 HALL-A", will be released around summer 2026
entries.title_ja: 「VA-11 HALL-A」を手がけたSukeban Gamesの最新作「.45 パラベラム ブラッドハウンド」，2026年夏ごろに発売決定
entries.description: SukebanGames today announced on the indie game information program "INDIELiveExpo2026.4.25" that ".45 Parabellum Bloodhound" will be released around summer 2026. The latest work from the studio that created "VA-11HALL-A" will finally be released this summer.

entries.title: ``Luna Pulse'', a ``death geeky light card game'' where 13 witches fight, has been announced. Release date is 2027
entries.title_ja: 13人の魔女が戦う“死にゲーローグライトカードゲーム”「ルナパルス」が発表に。発売時期は2027年
entries.description: 213℉ today announced on the indie game information program "INDIELiveExpo2026.4.25" that it will release a new work "Luna Pulse" in 2027. This work is a single-player card game. The game is characterized by reading each other's cards and predicting the opponent's choices, and a ``death game''-like gameplay in which one blow's damage leads to defeat.

entries.title: A digital reinterpretation of the gamebook. The RPG “Verita Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle”, which is also attracting attention for its “touch reproduction” of pencils and dice, will be released on PC in 2026
entries.title_ja: ゲームブックをデジタルで再解釈。鉛筆＆サイコロの“手触り再現”にも注目なRPG「ヴェリタステイルズ：暗黒城の魔女」は2026年にPCで発売へ
entries.description: Digitalis Publishing has announced that it will release the PC RPG ``Verita Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle'' in 2026. This is a game that digitally revives the feel of the game books ``Grail Quest'' and ``Sorcery'' that were popular in the 1980s, recreating the effect of writing numbers with a pencil and deciding your fate with dice. A scenario of approximately 300,000 characters has been prepared in which the player aims from the plague capital to the witch's castle.

entries.title: “PUKEY GODDESS SHOT TRICK,” a game of drinking and survival with demons in a bar in hell, will be released on Steam in 2026
entries.title_ja: 地獄のバーで悪魔と飲みサバイバルを繰り広げる「PUKEY GODDESS SHOT TRICK」は，2026年Steamで発売へ
entries.description: AllianceArts has announced that the new game ``PUKEYGODDESSSHOTTRICK'' will be released on Steam in 2026. The setting is Pandemonium, a bar in hell. This is a unique drinking survival game where you play Russian roulette with the demon Femme Soeur who loves you so much that you want to kill him, and you make toasts with shot glasses of different alcohol content.

entries.title: The official version of "Dungeon Crawler: Lucky Rabbit and the Magic Claw" will be released on May 1, 2026. There will also be a major update on the same day.
entries.title_ja: 「ダンジョンクロウラー：幸運ウサギと魔法の爪」，正式版が2026年5月1日にリリース決定。同日には大型アップデートも
entries.description: StrayFawnStudio has announced that the official version (v1.0) of ``Dungeon Crawler: Lucky Rabbit and the Magic Claw'', which combines crane games and deck building, will be released on May 1, 2026. On the same day, the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation5, and Xbox Series

entries.title: The release date of the typing ADV "Pain Pain Go Away!" has been decided on May 20th. Cast information and latest trailer also released
entries.title_ja: タイピングADV「Pain Pain Go Away!」の発売日が5月20日に決定。キャスト情報や最新トレイラーも公開に
entries.description: Story Note, which handles the ADV game brand Lorebard, has announced that the release date of the PC adventure game ``PainPainGoAway!'', which the company is currently developing, has been set for May 20, 2026. At the same time, cast information on the main characters and the latest trailer have been released.

entries.title: Another world work adventure “Memory of Memorie” will be released in summer 2026. Let's work at a desk with a wizard apprentice girl
entries.title_ja: 異世界作業用アドベンチャー「Memory of Memorie」，2026年夏に発売決定。魔法使い見習いの少女と一緒にデスクワークしよう
entries.description: Becide announced at the "INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25" broadcast today that the new work "Memory of Memorie: AChillStory" will be released in the summer of 2026. This work is an ADV for working at a desk with a girl who is an apprentice wizard who lives in another world.

entries.title: "INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25" Check out all the noteworthy announcement information. In addition to the nine world premiere titles, the release dates of several works have been revealed.
entries.title_ja: 「INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25」，注目発表情報をまとめてチェック。世界初公開の9タイトルに加え，複数作品の発売日などが明らかにされた
entries.description: The INDIELiveExpo secretariat streamed the indie game event "INDIELiveExpo2026.4.25" today (April 25, 2026), introducing more than 200 indie games, including 9 titles released for the first time in the world. Furthermore, it was announced that a ``BitSummit x INDIELiveExpo special program broadcast'' will be held in conjunction with the indie event ``BitSummit.''

entries.title: The trial version of the PC visual novel game "Algorithm Prescription" will be released on April 28th at 18:00. Enjoy the story from the perspective of the main character's colleagues
entries.title_ja: PC向けビジュアルノベルゲーム「Algorithm Prescription」，体験版を4月28日18：00に配信。主人公の同僚の視点で物語を楽しめる
entries.description: Shochiku Co., Ltd. will start distributing the free trial version of its new product "Algorithm Prescription" for PC from 18:00 on April 28, 2026 Japan time. It is a visual novel based on the concept of romance and suspense, and the Steam store page has also been released.

entries.title: “Cabetsu Soft Cafe Gokaime ~Cabetsu Soft Tea Party~” held in Stella Map Cafe Akihabara
entries.title_ja: 『きゃべつそふとCafeごかいめ ～きゃべつそふとティーパーティー～』開催 in ステラマップカフェ秋葉原
entries.description: The 5th Cabetsu Soft Cafe will be held at Stella Map Cafe Akihabara from April 24th to May 10th, 2026, by reservation only. There are various benefits such as new goods, food, drinks, and random tin badges as a pre-order bonus.

_url_verified.page_title: 『きゃべつそふとCafeごかいめ ～きゃべつそふとティーパーティー～』開催 in ステラマップカフェ秋葉原4月24日より開催! – コラボカフェ

entries.title: Overwhelming presence! "B-style Azur Lane Shinano Genmu no Twilight" [Newly photographed at AmiAmi exhibition] Reproduced in a bunny suit on 1/4 scale!

entries.description: Freeing will be releasing a 1/4 scale figure "B-style Azur Lane Shinano Genmu no Twilight" in November 2026. This is a three-dimensional version of the aircraft carrier "Shinano" belonging to Jusakura, which appears in the smartphone game "Azur Lane" operated by Yostar.

entries.description: Good Smile Company's 1/7 scale figure "Anna Yanami Swimsuit Ver." scheduled to be released in December 2026. This is a three-dimensional version of Anna Yanami, one of the defeated heroines who appears in the TV anime ``Too Many Losing Heroines!''.

entries.description: Mitsubishi Electric vacuum cleaners are on sale at Amazon. The period ends at 23:59 on May 4th.

entries.title: A bug that has existed in Minecraft for "about 13 and a half years" has finally been fixed. why now

entries.description: ``Minecraft'' Snapshot 26.2 is attracting attention for the fact that ``Wildcats now spawn even in Peaceful.''

entries.title: Dirty room cleaning/renovation game "House Flipper Remastered Collection" will be released on June 5th. “House Flipper” power-up remaster with “all DLC included”
