entries.description: Frozen Way announced on April 25th that ``House Flipper Remastered Collection'' will be released on June 4th. It is said to be a remastered version of ``House Flipper'' that includes all the DLC from the same work, and has an improved UI and power-ups.

entries.title: ``Pragmata'' overseas official X account suffers from ``hijacking'' by ``Diana.'' Hacking just like the main story, a girl android's "prank"
entries.title_ja: 『プラグマタ』海外公式Xアカウント、「ディアナ」による“乗っ取り被害”に遭う。本編さながらのハッキング、少女アンドロイドの“いたずら”
entries.description: The overseas official account of ``Pragmata'' suddenly became a hot topic after posting a post claiming that ``Diana'', who appears in the work, had been hacked.

entries.title: "Final Fantasy XIV" new expansion pack "Silver Wanderer" announced, scheduled for release in January 2027. Continuous innovations such as “escape from daily life” and “new operation mode” make it easier to play.
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーXIV』新拡張パック「白銀のワンダラー」発表、2027年1月発売へ。“デイリーからの脱却”、“新操作モード”など続々刷新で、より遊びやすく
entries.description: On April 25th, Square Enix announced a new expansion pack for Final Fantasy XIV called Silver Wanderer.

entries.title: Officially announced unsolved crime horror film “SOS Recordings”. Pursuing the mystery of the missing climber based on the "real-life accident" of Mt. Asahidake in Hokkaido
entries.title_ja: 未解決事件ホラー『SOS Recordings』正式発表。北海道・旭岳の“現実の遭難事件”を題材に、消えた登山者の謎を追う
entries.description: CRITICAL REFLEX announced on April 25th that it will be in charge of publishing "SOS Recordings" produced by PackDev. Along with the release of the new trailer, it was also revealed that the game will be released in 2026 and that it will be localized into Japanese.

entries.title: The next major update for the popular cooperative horror game “R.E.P.O.” will be released on May 7th. Details of new items such as “enemy blowing cane” and “anti-gravity cane” are also shown.
entries.title_ja: 人気協力ホラー『R.E.P.O.』次期大型アプデは5月7日に配信へ。“敵ぶっ飛ばし杖”や“反重力杖”など、新アイテムの詳細もチラ見せ
entries.description: semiwork has announced that the next major update for "R.E.P.O." will be released on May 7th local time. In the update, a new "cane" will be added as an item.

entries.title: A former developer of the new RPG ``Divinity'' draws laughter by revealing his ``ambition'': ``I want to destroy Steam's servers when the new game is released.'' I was disappointed in Baldur's Gate 3.
entries.title_ja: 新作RPG『Divinity』開発元幹部、「新作リリース時にはSteamのサーバーを破壊したい」と“野望”を明かして笑いを誘う。『バルダーズ・ゲート3』のときは惜しかった
entries.description: Michael Douse of Larian Studios said on April 24th that his ambition is to "completely take down Steam's servers" when the next game is released.

entries.title: Online werewolf game server "Ruru Saba" will be closed in May 2026. The long-established Werewolf store has closed after a 17-year history.
entries.title_ja: オンライン人狼ゲームサーバー「るる鯖」2026年5月中に閉鎖へ。長きに渡り親しまれた人狼の老舗、約17年の歴史に幕
entries.description: Ruru, the operator of the online werewolf game server "Ruru Saba," announced on April 25 that the site will be shut down in May 2026.

entries.title: Nintendo Switch 2nd version “Final Fantasy XIV” will be released in August 2026
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch 2版「ファイナルファンタジーXIV」が2026年8月に発売決定
entries.description: Square Enix announced today (April 25th) that the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the MMORPG "Final Fantasy XIV" will be released in August 2026. You can play the game even if you are not a Nintendo Switch Online member, and there is also about a month of advance play available.

entries.title: A beautiful girl is having a live performance next to me who has been reincarnated. Village building action RPG “Awesome, the demon castle next to my house www” will be released in winter 2026
entries.title_ja: 転生した俺んちの横で美少女が魔狂宴（ライブ）してるんだが。村づくりアクションRPG「ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www」2026年冬に発売
entries.description: One or Eight announced Team EARTHWARS' village-building action RPG ``Awesome, The Devil's Castle Next to My House www'' on the indie game information program ``INDIE Live Expo''. The Steam version is scheduled to be released in winter 2026, and the Switch 2/PS5 version is scheduled to be released in 2027.

entries.title: [Interview] “Okekatsu! ” Hiroyuki Mito, conductor of all performances, talks about the charm of the “Aikatsu! Series” songs and memories of the coronavirus pandemic
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］『オケカツ！』全公演の指揮者・水戸博之氏が語る，「アイカツ！シリーズ」楽曲の魅力とコロナ禍の記憶
entries.description: "'Aikatsu! Series' Orchestra Concert 'Okekatsu!' 2026-AnniversaryBaton-" will be held on May 4, 2026. “Okekatsu! We asked conductor Hiroyuki Mito, who has conducted all performances of the series, about the appeal of the songs in the Aikatsu! Series, his memories of the coronavirus pandemic that forced them to record without an audience, and his expectations for the latest performance.

entries.title: A booth of "NTE: Neverness to Everness" will be exhibited at "Nico Nico Chokaigi 2026". On stage, there will also be a race competition using the features in the work and a photo session with official cosplayers.
entries.title_ja: 「ニコニコ超会議2026」に「NTE: Neverness to Everness」のブースが出展。ステージでは作中の機能を使ったレース大会や公式コスプレイヤーの撮影会も
entries.description: A booth for the urban open world RPG "NTE: Neverness to Everness" is being exhibited at "Nico Nico Super Conference 2026", which is being held from today until April 26th. On stage, one-on-one car races using the in-game racing function and photo sessions with official cosplayers were held.

entries.title: What do Ace Combat pilots eat? Thinking about "flight meals" for those who rule the skies. My collaboration cafe: Menu 087
entries.title_ja: 「エースコンバット」のパイロットは何を食べているのか？　空を支配する者たちの“機中食”を考える。俺のコラボカフェ：Menu 087
entries.description: The series ``My Collaboration Cafe'', published on the fourth Saturday of every month, is a corner where current chef Tetsuya Onishi collaborates with various games and introduces recipes he imagined. This time, I thought about what Ace Combat pilots ate and made a dish based on documents from World War II.

entries.title: The dungeon exploration ADV "The Hero Party is Zenmetsu Shita." will be released on July 22, 2026. New trailer released
entries.title_ja: ダンジョン探索ADV「勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。」は，2026年7月22日に発売決定。新トレーラー公開
entries.description: Death Guild and Flashlight Games have announced that the release date of the dungeon exploration adventure ``The Hero Party is Completed'' has been set for July 22, 2026. In addition, a new trailer will be released at INDIELiveExpo on April 25th. This is a roguelite-style card battle game where you choose just one person from a stuck hero party and aim to escape together.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 150: Deck-building roguelite “Vampire Crawlers” and two-player puzzle-solving ADV “Together: Moon Escape” on sale
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第150号：デッキ構築型ローグライト「Vampire Crawlers」や，2人用謎解きADV「Together: Moon Escape」が発売に
entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, ``Vampire Crawlers'', a deck-building card game based on ``Vampire Survivors'', and ``Together: Moon Escape'', a co-op ADV set on the moon, were released.

entries.title: "EVERCADE" announces support for NEOGEO titles. EVARCADE for its cost performance or NEOGEO AES+ for its reproduction of the actual machine? Reiwa NEOGEO war begins
entries.title_ja: 「EVERCADE」がNEOGEOタイトルのサポートを表明。コストパフォーマンスのEVERCADEか，実機再現の「NEOGEO AES+」か。令和のNEOGEO戦争勃発
entries.description: Blaze Entertainment, which operates the ``EVERCADE'' label, has officially announced that it will continue to support NEOGEO titles, and once again emphasized its good cost performance. It seems that this announcement was made with the recent announcement of "NEOGEO AES+" in mind, and it may be called the outbreak of the Reiwa NEOGEO war.

entries.title: "FFXIV" exhibition "Trajectory of the Warrior of Light Exhibition -Adventurer's Chronicle-" preview report. Currently being held at Sunshine City, Tokyo
entries.title_ja: 「FFXIV」の展覧会「光の戦士の軌跡展 -Adventurer's Chronicle-」内覧会レポート。東京・サンシャインシティで開催中
entries.description: ``Adventurer's Chronicle'', an exhibition of the MMORPG ``Final Fantasy XIV'' currently being serviced by Square Enix, has opened. The event is scheduled to be held at the Tokyo venue from April 25th to May 10th, and the Osaka venue from May 30th to June 14th.

entries.title: The latest expansion package "Final Fantasy XIV: Silver Wanderer" has been announced. January 2027 release
entries.title_ja: 最新拡張パッケージ「ファイナルファンタジーXIV：白銀のワンダラー（探求者）」が発表に。2027年1月のリリース
entries.description: Square Enix announced today (April 25th) at the keynote speech at the MMORPG "Final Fantasy XIV" event "FINAL FANTASY *April 25th 15:20, official images added

entries.title: The PC version of "Makai Toshi CHI-BA" is now available on BOOTH. A fantasy RPG with a strong local flavor created based on Chiba folklore.
entries.title_ja: 「魔界都市CHI-BA」のPC版がBOOTHに登場。千葉の伝承をもとに制作されたローカル色の強いファンタジーRPG
entries.description: The PC version of ``Makai Toshi CHI-BA,'' a work by independent game developer Koyurugi Koubou, is on sale at Creators Market BOOTH. This is a fantasy RPG with motifs of place names, history, and legends in Chiba Prefecture, in which four high school students stand up to save Chiba, which is thrown into chaos by a monster that suddenly appears.

entries.title: Wanderburg, a roguelike where the moving castle gets bigger and bigger, will start early access in summer 2026
entries.title_ja: 動く城をどんどん大きくしていくローグライク「Wanderburg」，早期アクセスを2026年夏にスタート
entries.description: Randwerk today announced on the indie game information program "INDIELiveExpo2026.4.25" that early access for "Wanderburg" will start in the summer of 2026. This work is an action game in which you control a "moving castle." Explore the automatically generated map, destroy enemy castles, and make your castle bigger and bigger.

entries.title: Game events at the library lead to community interaction and reading experiences. How to create a new public space using games
entries.title_ja: 図書館でのゲームイベントが地域交流と読書体験につながる。ゲームを活用した新しい公共空間の作り方
entries.description: We would like to bring you a report from the crosstalk session ``Examples of Game Utilization in Libraries'' from the session ``Tokyo Serious Game Summit'' sponsored by IGDA Japan. Game events at libraries are a new way to utilize public facilities, and they also connect games to reading experiences. This was explained through examples.

entries.title: Two official Star Trek analog games are currently being crowdfunded. Immerse yourself in the world of Star Trek with murder mystery and escape games
entries.title_ja: 「スタートレック」の公式アナログゲーム2本がクラウドファンディング実施中。マーダーミステリーと脱出ゲームでスタートレックの世界に浸ろう
entries.description: Crowdfunding for two official Star Trek analog games is underway on Kickstarter. In the game set on ``Star Trek: Deep Space Nine,'' you will investigate a murder, and in the game set on ``Star Trek: Lower Decks,'' you will rescue the crew.

entries.title: "moorestech", an automation sim x anime-style RPG that runs a factory with gears, has started recruiting CBT participants. Test scheduled to be conducted in June 2026
entries.title_ja: 歯車で工場を動かす自動化シム×アニメ調RPG「moorestech」，CBT参加者の募集を開始。テストは2026年6月実施予定
entries.description: sakastudio has announced that it will conduct a closed beta test of ``moorestech'', which combines automated factory simulation with anime-like RPG elements, in June 2026. This work features a unique system that operates the factory using "gears" and "rotational energy" rather than electric wires. Recruitment of participants has begun via the official Discord.

The post Universal Studios Japan's 25th anniversary "This summer's only festival begins!" "One Piece Premier Summer 2026" to be held first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: SEGA launches "SEGA UNIVERSE", which is responsible for new development of old IP. Suggesting new developments such as “Outrun”, “Bare Knuckle”, “NiGHTS into dreams…” and “Sakura Wars”
entries.title_ja: セガ、往年のIPの新展開を担う「SEGA UNIVERSE」を始動。『アウトラン』『ベア・ナックル』『NiGHTS into dreams…』『サクラ大戦』などの新展開を示唆
entries.description: On April 24th, SEGA announced ``SEGA UNIVERSE'', a project that will be responsible for the new development of old IP. A concept movie and official website have also been released.

entries.title: Japan External Trade Organization JETRO is planning to hold a sale event for "Japanese games" on Steam and is looking for developers, creators, and manufacturers who wish to participate. Participation is free
entries.title_ja: 日本貿易振興機構ジェトロ、Steamで「日本のゲーム」のセールイベントを開催予定で参加希望の開発者やクリエイター、メーカーを募集中。参加は無料
entries.description: Japan External Trade Organization JETRO plans to hold a sale/promotion event "MADE IN JAPAN COLLECTION" featuring Japanese games on Steam in 2026 as well. At the same time, we have started recruiting Japanese game developers and manufacturers.

entries.title: A large DLC has suddenly started to be distributed for the roguelike horror ACT "Hotel Barcelona", whose ratings are steadily improving. Implement new stages and bosses that will take you deeper into the abyss.
entries.title_ja: 評価ぐんぐん持ち直し中ローグライクホラーACT『ホテル・バルセロナ』に大型DLCいきなり配信開始。さらなる深淵へ誘う、新規ステージやボスなど実装
entries.description: On April 24th, White Owls released the DLC ``Late Check-Out DLC: From Dusk Valley to Grandall Estate.'' for ``HOTEL BARCELONA'' for the PC (Steam) version.

entries.title: Steam ``Very well received'' roguelike village building puzzle ``Neon Village'' officially released today. A large update has arrived, and the volume is about twice that of the original.
entries.title_ja: Steam「非常に好評」ローグライク村づくりパズル『Neon Village』本日正式リリース。大型アプデも到来、当初の約2倍の大ボリュームに
entries.description: On April 24th, Encraft officially released ``Neon Village,'' a game that combines 3-match puzzle and deck-building roguelike.

entries.title: The game, which was suspended due to the developer going to prison for 3 years, will resume development due to ``Parole''. Now that I'm using a computer, I'll start by reporting on my current situation.
entries.title_ja: 開発者が“刑務所に3年入る”のでアプデ停止中だったゲーム、「仮釈放」により開発再開へ。パソコンに触れるようになり、まずは近況報告
entries.description: Team Fortune has announced that they will resume development of the FPS “Fortune’s Run”. This is a work whose updates had been stopped because the developer was incarcerated.

entries.title: Toei's new game business ``Toei Games'' immediately announced three titles. Horror ADV, dark mystery game, debug battle game, and other intense games released by a popular ballpoint pen artist.
entries.title_ja: 東映の新ゲーム事業「東映ゲームズ」、さっそく3タイトルを発表。人気ボールペン絵師が放つホラーADV、ダーク推理ゲーム、デバッグバトルゲームと濃いゲーム揃う
entries.description: Toei Games, a game business brand, announced on April 24th the first publishing title under the brand.

entries.title: The HD remastered version of the mysterious RPG "Extetora", which fights with "kiss", has been announced after 13 years. The deadly energy is “passed from mouth to mouth from the main character” and has become beautiful and modern
entries.title_ja: “キス”で戦う怪作RPG『エクステトラ』、13年越しのHDリマスター版発表。必殺エネルギーは「主人公から口移し」、美しくなって現代に
entries.description: On April 24th, Furyu announced the HD remastered version of ``Extetra''. The compatible platform is PC (Steam), and it is scheduled to be released in the summer of 2026.

entries.title: The official release of the blockbuster automated factory construction game ``Shapez 2'' is heating up excitement. “The biggest ever in this game” update is packed with features such as a new “factory building” mode
entries.title_ja: 大ヒット自動化工場建設ゲーム『shapez 2』正式リリースで熱い盛り上がり見せる。「本作史上最大」アプデで“工場作りまくり”新モードなど要素満載
entries.description: Gamirror Games and tobspr Games officially released Shapez 2 on April 23rd. With additional features such as new modes, this game has been a success since its release.

entries.title: ``Fingertip Farm'', which supports up to 15 people and allows you to manage your farm ``on the keyboard'', immediately started with ``very positive reviews''. A unique farm game where the more you work, the more crops you grow, where your keyboard becomes a field.
entries.title_ja: 最大15人マルチ対応・“キーボード上”農場経営『指先農園』さっそく「非常に好評」スタート。作業するほど作物が育つ、「キーボードが畑になる」異色農園ゲーム
entries.description: Milkway Studio distributed ``Fingertip Farm'' on April 20th. This work has gained popularity as a desktop game that doubles as a work tool.

entries.title: A Valve employee asserts, ``Steam doesn't have a 'secret button' for promoting games.'' Various advice for developers, including how algorithms work and steady efforts
entries.title_ja: Valve社員が「Steamにはゲーム宣伝用の“秘密のボタン”なんてない」と断言。開発者向けに、アルゴリズムの仕組みや地道な努力などいろいろアドバイス
entries.description: Valve staff answers user questions and gives advice on how to get noticed on Steam.

entries.title: IndieUp, a matching service for game developers and live streamers, has started completely free of charge. Is there a system that makes it easier for “reliable distributors” to receive games, making it a win-win service?
entries.title_ja: ゲーム開発者×実況配信者のマッチングサービス「IndieUp」完全無料で始動。“信頼できる配信者”がゲームをもらいやすい仕組みあり、Win-Winサービスなるか
entries.description: On April 23, 0UP GAMES, the gaming brand of RAY UP LLC, released the beta version of ``IndieUp,'' a matching service for indie game developers and game play distributors.

entries.title: A new issue of unpaid money has been discovered on the fan site Ubugoe, and the developer of the game ``Purgatory Blue'' has announced that ``the 10.93 million yen collected has not been paid at all.'' Representative Ubugoe faces criminal charges
entries.title_ja: クラファンサイトうぶごえに新たな未送金問題発覚、ゲーム『パーガトリー・ブルー』開発者が「集まった1093万円が一切支払われてない」と発表。うぶごえ代表を刑事告訴へ
entries.description: The developer of the game ``Purgatory Blue'', which raised 10.93 million yen through the crowdfunding ``Ubugoe'', has reported that none of the funds raised have been transferred.

entries.title: The reason why the battles in ``Love and Deep Sky'' are so authentic is because ``battle is romance.'' An approach to widely distributing love games where we fight together and grow love.
entries.title_ja: 『恋と深空』のバトルが本格的なのは、“戦闘こそがロマンス”だから。ともに戦い愛を育む、恋愛ゲームを広く届けるためのアプローチ
entries.description: I would like to quote from the speech given by Lizi, the producer of ``Koi to Shinzora'' at the Game Developers Conference held in San Francisco.

entries.title: Announcement of relaxing drawing sandbox "Charming Hill". A truly “easy” painting game where anyone can become a painter, even if you don’t have a talent for painting.
entries.title_ja: くつろぎお絵描きサンドボックス『Charming Hill』発表。絵心なくても誰でも画伯、本当に“簡単”な絵画ゲーム
entries.description: On April 24th, SOPA Games announced Charming Hill, a sandbox painting game created by PlanC games.

entries.title: Up to 16 people, microphone required Horror "Cursed Companions" Japanese version update available. Conquer the dungeon by “speaking” spells, causing screaming chaos with “NG words” hidden in the conversation
entries.title_ja: 最大16人・マイク必須ホラー『Cursed Companions』日本語対応アプデ配信へ。呪文を“喋って”ダンジョン攻略、会話に潜む「NGワード」で絶叫カオス
entries.description: Crimson Forge Studios has announced that a Japanese update for the cooperative horror game ``Cursed Companions'' will be released on April 30th.

entries.title: “Ichiban Kuji Collapse: Star Rail Vol.3” will be released sequentially from September 12th. The top prize will be a 38cm POTEPOTTE stuffed animal.
entries.title_ja: 「一番くじ 崩壊：スターレイル Vol.3」，9月12日から順次発売。上位賞には約38cmの「POTEPOTTEぬいぐるみ」がラインナップ
entries.description: BANDAISPIRITS announced today that it will release "Ichiban Kuji Kotsu: Star Rail Vol. 3" sequentially from September 12, 2026. The price is 1,450 yen (tax included) once. This product is the third installment of the space fantasy RPG "Collapse: Star Rail".

entries.title: 4v4 pottery battle action "Kiln" now available. Wear your own ceramic armor and destroy the enemy team's cauldron.
entries.title_ja: 4対4の陶芸バトルアクション「Kiln」，配信開始。自身で作り上げた陶器のアーマーをまとって敵チームの釜を消化しよう
entries.description: Xbox Game Studios today (April 24, 2026) released a new title "Kiln" developed by DoubleFine Productions. This is a 4v4 online multiplayer ``pottery'' battle game where players wear ceramic armor created on a potter's wheel to extinguish the enemy team's cauldron.

entries.title: NEXON Korea announces new dark fantasy MMORPG “Embers of the Uncrowned”. Demo scheduled to be released at Steam Next festival in June
entries.title_ja: NEXON Korea，新作ダークファンタジーMMORPG「Embers of the Uncrowned」を発表。6月のSteam Nextフェスでデモを公開予定
entries.description: NEXONKorea announced on April 23rd a new dark fantasy MMORPG for PC, ``EmbersoftheUncrowned''. The company released a cinematic trailer through its official YouTube channel, showing off the atmosphere and tone of the film. In addition, a developer note summarizing the development team's philosophy and main characteristics is also shared.

entries.title: "Forza Horizon 6" release commemorative event "Tokyo Lights, Horizon Nights" will be held. Numerous famous cars, media and influencers from around the world gather in Tokyo
entries.title_ja: 「Forza Horizon 6」発売記念イベント「Tokyo Lights, Horizon Nights」開催。数々の名車，世界中のメディアやインフルエンサーが東京に集結
entries.description: On April 23, 2026, Microsoft held the "Tokyo Lights, Horizon Nights" event to commemorate the release of "Forza Horizon 6." As this is the first film in the series to be set in Japan, media, influencers, and people from all over the world gathered in Tokyo.

entries.title: REJECT original Akecon supervised by Mr. Haitani is now available. Start accepting reservations on May 1st
entries.title_ja: ハイタニ氏監修のREJECTオリジナルアケコンが登場。5月1日に予約の受付を開始
entries.description: On April 24, 2026, REJECT announced that it will begin accepting reservations for the arcade controller "REJECTArcadeController" and the leverless controller "REJECTArcadeControllerLeverless" on May 1, 2026.

entries.title: SEGA has launched a new project, ``SEGA UNIVERSE,'' that shines a light on past works. Official website and concept movie released
entries.title_ja: セガ，往年の作品に光を当てる新プロジェクト「SEGA UNIVERSE」を始動。公式サイトとコンセプトムービーを公開
entries.description: SEGA today announced the start of its new project ``SEGA UNIVERSE'' and released the official website and concept movie. This project is based on the concept of "NOOLD, STAYGOLD" and will shine a light on the works of yesteryear that are still loved by fans. Jumping out of the world of games, images, music, fashion, etc. are developed.

entries.title: [Play report] Enjoy expanded action! Play "GRANBLUE FANTASY: Relink - Endless Ragnarok" open beta test
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］拡張されたアクションが楽しめる！ 「GRANBLUE FANTASY: Relink - Endless Ragnarok」オープンβテストをプレイ
entries.description: Cygames' new action RPG "GRANBLUEFANTSY: Relink-Endless Ragnarok" is undergoing an open beta test. In this test, the new systems ``Summon'' and ``Ascend Chain'' have been added, allowing you to enjoy an expanded and exhilarating action experience.

entries.title: Pre-registration for the hand-drawn monster capture RPG “Ruumi Master” starts today. Global release scheduled for summer 2026
entries.title_ja: 手描き風モンスター捕獲RPG「るぅみマスター」，本日より事前登録スタート。2026年夏グローバルリリース予定
entries.description: bilibili will start pre-registration for the new smartphone RPG "Ruumi Master" on April 24, 2026. It features hand-drawn graphics that look like a moving picture book, and in addition to capturing and raising hundreds of monsters called ``Ruumi'', it also includes home management and mini-games where you can freely create your own space. Global release is scheduled for summer 2026.

entries.title: TV anime "Pokémon", new character "Navi" appearing in the new chapter "Wonder Voyage" and song information released
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ「ポケットモンスター」，新章「ワンダーボヤージュ」に登場する新キャラ「ナヴィ」や楽曲情報を解禁

entries.description: Volume 1 of Fukatsu's ``Sasa Fallin' Jail'', based on the original work by Vocaloid P Niru Kajitsu, was released today, April 23rd.

entries.title: In order to learn the truth about death, we act out what happened 8 years ago... ``Performing a dead Kimura'' comic version
entries.title_ja: 死の真相を知るため、8年前の出来事を演じる…「死んだ木村を上演」コミカライズ
entries.description: Volume 1 of the comic adaptation of Reisuke Kaneko's youth novel ``Dead Kimura wo Performance'' was released today, April 23rd. The manga is written by Tamane Taka.

entries.title: Why did the strongest man in the empire become an adventurer with a lowly job? A genius knight with a natural temperament is unrivaled without realizing it.
entries.title_ja: 帝国最強の男が、なぜ底辺職の冒険者に？天然気質の天才騎士が無自覚に無双
entries.description: Volume 1 of Mujii Imai's ``The Empire's Strongest Genius Knight, Admires an Adventurer'' was released today, April 23rd. This is a comic adaptation based on Misa Aoi's novel.

entries.title: There's no need to show mercy to dangerous people - "Yabaihito R" is a Western service dog that depicts a girl with a predisposition to disaster and her hidden side.

entries.description: Naoto Tsushima's ``Transformers All Spark Complete Edition'' was released by Takeshobo today, April 23rd.

entries.description: The first volume of Kotonoha Tsumugi's ``Love and Synchronicity'' was released today, April 23rd.

entries.title: Yoko Kamio, Satoru Makimura and others depict the worldview of the five Hoshino Resorts brands as a “story”
entries.title_ja: 神尾葉子、槇村さとるらが星野リゾート5ブランドの世界観を“物語”にして描き出す
entries.description: A major collaboration project between Hoshino Resorts and Shueisha's fashion magazine, "Hoshino Resorts x Shueisha 100th Anniversary - Traveling Manga," has begun. Yoko Kamio, Satoru Makimura, Aki Mochida, Ami Uzumi, and Nana Haruta depict the worldview of each brand developed by Hoshino Resorts and the real thrill of travel as a "story."

entries.title: Anime "Macross 7" will be released for free on YouTube, 52 episodes including 3 episodes not aired on TV

entries.title: The second season of the anime "Assassination Kizoku" will start broadcasting in 2027, teaser visual released, retrospective PV also
entries.title_ja: アニメ「暗殺貴族」第2期は2027年放送開始　ティザービジュアル公開、振り返りPVも

entries.title: “ONE PIECE CHOPPER’s” Volume 1, delivering the life of Chopper living in the real world
entries.title_ja: 「ONE PIECE CHOPPER’s」1巻、現実世界に生きるチョッパーの暮らしをお届け
entries.description: Volume 1 of the book ``ONE PIECE CHOPPER's'', which was born from the project ``CHOPPER's'' featuring Chopper from Eiichiro Oda's ``ONE PIECE'', was released today, April 23rd.

Additionally, although the official version will only be in English, support for Japanese and Chinese (simplified and traditional characters) has been decided with support from Shochiku Games. Implementation is scheduled for sometime in 2026.

entries.title: Yasuhide Ishigami, who obtained curatorial qualifications in order to create the museum, talks about this. What is necessary to raise the overall level of serious games with the theme of solving problems such as education, medicine, and social problems

entries.description: Collect and preserve serious games and create a ``museum'' that anyone can use for research or reference. We will report on the seminar and crosstalk held on the first day of the Tokyo Serious Game Summit, where board game editor Yasuhide Ishigami took the stage.

entries.title: Why did the latest Super Mario movie go to space? Interview with Shigeru Miyamoto about creating the story of “The Super Mario Galaxy Movie”

entries.description: How was the sequel to the popular animated film ``The Super Mario Galaxy Movie'' made? We spoke to Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto, Mario's creator and co-producer this time around, about the process of producing the script, how the characters were drawn, and the expressions unique to the movie.

entries.title: ``Artifact - 3D puzzle'', a 3D puzzle game for restoring artifacts, released on Steam. Contains 64 artifacts from 8 different cultures, including ancient Egypt

entries.description: ArtFireGames today released the PC game "Artifact-3Dpuzzle" on Steam. This is a 3D puzzle game where you restore artifacts from eight different cultures. Inspired by the traditional Japanese restoration technique ``kintsugi,'' players assemble statues and ceramics from fragments.

entries.title: What does the woman's apology mean? Furyu is releasing a mysterious video on the official X account of a new title for home game consoles

A disturbing video has now been released that shows the date and time "2026.4.2520:30" and the voice of a woman apologizing. It is expected that some information will be released at 20:30 on April 25, 2026. Let's look forward to that day.

The Sangora Valley is a fictional region located in the Carpathian Mountains, and its design was said to be inspired by the nature and culture of Central and Eastern Europe.

entries.title: Release of the product version of ``Sol Cesto'', a roguelite that explores the underground world in search of the sun. Expanding characters and biomes through early access

entries.description: The retail version of the roguelite ``SolCesto'', whose early access version attracted a lot of attention, has been released. In the product version, the number of characters has increased to 10 and the number of biomes has been expanded to 5. Current Steam user reviews are "very positive," and a 33% off sale is currently underway to commemorate the release.

entries.title: "Collapse: Star Rail", Ver. 4.2 "And the people's laughter echoes" will be distributed on April 22nd. “Ginro LV.999” and “Hiei” appear, and 3rd anniversary event is held

entries.description: Today (April 10, 2026), HoYoverse released a preview program for Ver. 4.2 of ``Collapse: Star Rail'', ``And the People's Laughter Reverberates,'' and set the distribution date for April 22nd. In the new version, a series of special events will be held for the upcoming 3rd anniversary on April 26th, and "Ginro LV.999" and "Hiei" will appear as new characters.

The second pre-sale of tickets has started, and we have also received comments from the 26 cast members who will appear in this work, so we will post them here.

entries.title: [Interview] "Japanese content is like oil" - Interview with the CEO of Manga Productions about the characteristics of the Middle East market and the purpose of exhibiting at AnimeJapan
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］「日本コンテンツは石油のようなもの」――マンガプロダクションズCEOに聞く，中東市場の特色とAnimeJapan出展の狙い
entries.description: Manga Productions, a company based in Saudi Arabia that sends Japanese anime, manga, and games to the Middle East, was exhibiting at AnimeJapan this year as well. I visited the booth again this time, so I would like to tell you about the situation along with an interview with CEO Bukari Isamu.

entries.title: [Interview] What is the reason behind the “explosion” of indie game events in this historic town?　“Wandering Kawagoe GAME DIGG” aims to be community-based rather than revitalizing the town
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］歴史ある町にインディーゲームイベントが“爆誕”した理由とは？　「ぶらり川越 GAME DIGG」が目指す，町おこしではない地域密着
entries.description: The game event "Wandering Kawagoe GAMEDIGG2" will be held in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture on April 25, 2026. How did this open town event, which you can enjoy while strolling through Kawagoe's traditional townscape, come about, and what is its goal? We spoke to four members of the executive committee.

entries.title: Learn the world of "Crusader Kings III" through manga. Approaching the charm of the addictive time thief with a murky human drama [PR]
entries.title_ja: マンガで知る「Crusader Kings III」の世界。ドロドロ人間ドラマがクセになる時間泥棒の魅力に迫る【PR】
entries.description: “CrusaderKings III” has been extremely popular since its release in 2020. Some people may have heard the name, but don't really know what kind of game it is. In this article, we will provide a digest manga for those people that will give you a quick understanding of the atmosphere and charm of "CK3".

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza No. 148: Musical RPG “People of Note” and SF action “Super Alloy Crush” to be released
entries.title_ja: 週刊Steam広場 第148号：ミュージカルRPG「People of Note」や，SFアクション「Super Alloy Crush」が発売に
entries.description: "Weekly Steam Square" delivers information on Steam titles and sales that were released this week. This week, ``People of Note'', a turn-based RPG that explores a world where different cultures live for each music genre, and ``SuperAlloy Crush'', an action rogue-lite depicting the adventures of space hunters, were released.

entries.title: An indie game experience for parents and children to enjoy together. Fun games and the charm of “encounters” found at “TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2026”
entries.title_ja: 親子で楽しむインディーゲーム体験。「TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2026」で見つけた，楽しかったゲームと“出会い”の魅力
entries.description: An indie game that has become familiar to children. Game events held all over Japan are valuable places where you can enjoy encountering new works and also get to know the thoughts of the creators. We will introduce the discoveries and experiences that can only be made when parents and children participate together through ``TOKYO INDIEGA MESSUMMIT 2026,'' which we visited as a family.

entries.title: Concentrate, run, shoot. TAMASHIKA, a new arcade-like FPS featuring psychedelic production and an overwhelming sense of exhilaration, is released today.

entries.description: EDGLRD released the new title "TAMASHIKA" today (April 11, 2026). This work is a first-person shooting action game featuring psychedelic hand-drawn animation. entries.title: The smartphone version of "Battlefield Fuga" will be released this summer. Optimized for smartphone operation, making it easier to play anywhere. Trial play session held at Kansai Kemoket 11

entries.description: CyberConnect2 has announced that it will release a smartphone version of the dramatic simulation RPG ``Battlefield Fuga'' in the summer of 2026. The game is optimized for smartphone operation, making it easier to play anywhere. Furthermore, in addition to the in-game benefits of the DX version for other models, the first to third DLC will be included. A trial play session is scheduled to be held at "Kansai Kemoket 11".

entries.description: Agni Flare released a new title ``SHIKA-Q'' today. This work is a competitive puzzle game using a 10x10 board. It supports offline and online two-player matches, and also features a single-player challenge mode. As a side event of "EVOJapan2026", an official tournament will be held at Tokyo Big Sight on May 3rd.

This mode is a mountain climbing game with up to four players. Climb the ice wall with an ice ax, pull up your friends with a fishing rod, and aim for the top of the mountain. Also, the new season of FaaastPenguin has started.

entries.title: “Twilight Town Prisoners” A supernatural survival story featuring unique characters whose talent for “strategy” awakens in a lawless area where death row inmates kill each other.

entries.description: The story is set in Japan, where the death penalty has been abolished and serious criminals are now imprisoned in a town called Twilight Town. Murder and robbery were not considered crimes in Twilight Town, and death row inmates were forced to kill each other. The main character, Sendo Yuuma, is imprisoned in such a lawless area, despite being falsely accused of arson. While meeting people imprisoned in Twilight Town for various reasons, Yuma begins to discover his hidden abilities. "Twilight Town Prisoners" is currently being serialized in Magazine Pocket.

I would like to examine how EASportsFC's brand transformation maintained its economic success, the criticism of accelerating monetization behind that success, and the ``multi-licensing strategy'' that FIFA is pursuing after abandoning its monopoly.

entries.title: Pre-orders have started for the portable game console “EVERCADE NEXUS” where you can enjoy retro and indie games with official licenses.

It also has features such as vertical screen mode and ``EVERSYNC'', which allows multiplayer with just one software.

As if to tell you to ride this big wave, "MonsterTrain2" was introduced on "After School Reviews!". This game, which incorporates elements of tower defense, seems like it's easy to overdo it when the deck is spinning...?

The world tour that will be held in each country will be carried out in accordance with the characteristics of the local Xbox community and region.

entries.title: Metroidvania “Solateria” for parry lovers (Hobonichi Indie Pick Up!)

entries.description: Today's "Hobonichi Indie PickUp!" introduces the Metroidvania "Solateria" where you can enjoy exhilarating parry-centered battles. If you deflect an enemy's attack at the right time, a slow motion will occur, and by inputting additional input, you can unleash a powerful counterattack. In a world ravaged by a shadow plague, a small fire warrior embarks on a journey to find the missing king.

entries.title: [Interview] Interview with “WWE Superstar” ASUKA about the appeal of “WWE 2K26.” Looking back on his 10 years in WWE

entries.description: ``WWE2K26'' is a professional wrestling action game released by 2K. We present an interview with ASUKA, who appears in this work and has been a leader in WWE's women's division as a Japanese superstar. We asked the player, who is also a hardcore gamer, to talk about the amazing reproducibility and appeal of this work, as well as his 10-year journey with WWE.

entries.title: "Darwin's Paradox!", an action ADV starring an octopus, released today. Use the unique abilities of an octopus to overcome the gimmicks of each stage.

entries.description: KONAMI today released "Darwin's Paradox!" developed by ZDTStudio. This is an action-adventure game where you control an octopus named Darwin who was kidnapped by a UFO and fights against an alien conspiracy. Utilize the unique abilities of an octopus, such as mimicry, blindness, and movement using suction cups, to overcome the gimmicks of each stage.

entries.title: New Metroidvania ``Annalog'' for NES, now available for fans. Recommended for fans of ``Metroid,'' ``The Legend of Zelda,'' and programming logic puzzles.
entries.title_ja: NES用新作メトロイドヴァニア「Annalog」，クラファンを実施中。「メトロイド」「ゼルダの伝説」やプログラミング系論理パズル好きにオススメ
entries.description: The new Metroidvania ``Annalog'' for the NES (Overseas Famicom) is currently undergoing crowdfunding on Kickstarter. The player takes on the role of a young girl who explores a post-apocalyptic monochrome world while creating a path by actually programming machines such as bulkheads and lifts that can be found in various places by combining commands and parameters.

entries.description: Kairosoft has announced that distribution of the Switch 2/Switch version of ``Maoujo Monogatari'' will begin on April 9, 2026. The player becomes the lord of an abandoned castle in the frontier, welcomes unique monsters, and fights off invading adventurers. In addition to expanding the display range and improving graphics, the Switch 2 version supports 4K resolution and mouse operation.

entries.title: [Play Report] An exhilarating combo battle created by stylish movements and a variety of builds. What we learned from the playtest of the new side-scrolling action game “SlashZero”
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］スタイリッシュな動きと多彩なビルドが生む爽快コンボバトル。新作横スクロールアクション「SlashZero」プレイテストで見えてきたこと
entries.description: Playtesting for Streetlamp Studio's new title ``SlashZero'' began on March 27, 2026. Featuring a cyberpunk worldview and anime-style graphics, this is an ambitious work that combines fast-paced combat and roguelike elements. In this article, we will introduce its appeal based on about 5 hours of play.

entries.title: "Atomic Heart: Ultimate Edition" containing all DLC, PS5 package version will be released on June 25th. An action RPG set in the fictional Soviet Union.

This is a complete version that includes all DLC in the main game.

entries.description: Daishi Kyoukai announced today that the exhibition event ``Human One Room'' will be held at Toranomon Hills in Tokyo from April 18th to May 17th. This work is the latest work in the ``Human'' series of daily life erosion games developed by The Fourth Boundary. He will be in charge of one of the 40 rooms in the exhibition "TOKYOROOMS Exhibition - 40 Rooms, 40 Ways of Living" which will be held during the same period.

entries.title: Which button is the correct answer? Horror puzzle game that aims to escape from a mysterious room, ``Push it and if it doesn't work, try it'', Switch version released today

It's a puzzle adventure game where you aim to escape from a mysterious room with countless buttons. The game combines horror elements, where if you press too many buttons, your ``sanity'' decreases.

entries.description: PLAYISM today released the downloadable version of the record puzzle action game "MotionRec" for PlayStation5/NintendoSwitch. entries.description: PoldenPublishing today announced the PC game "Salty Dog" developed by CrossbridgeGameStudios. This is a cooperative 2D action game in which dog divers explore the deep sea. Using physical calculations, the game uses a harpoon to retrieve treasures and creatures on the ocean floor. The items you bring back can be exchanged for cash and used to upgrade your submarine.

entries.title: Commemorating the first prize in the international works category of the "Vertical Reading Manga Award 2025" "I will be the head of the family in this life" Mon e-mail interview
entries.title_ja: 「タテ読みマンガアワード 2025」海外作品部門1位受賞記念 「今世は当主になります」Monメールインタビュー
entries.description: The "Vertical Reading Manga Award," a manga award for vertically scrolling manga organized by Comic Natalie, was held for the second time, and "Konzei wa toushu ni naru naru" won first place in the overseas works category at the "Vertical Reading Manga Award 2025. In this reincarnation fantasy, the main character, Florentia, wakes up as a seven-year-old girl and struggles to protect her beloved father and her family, which is doomed to destruction. At the award ceremony for the "Tate-omi Manga Award 2025," guest judge Pate-chan and other panelists commented on the work as "exhilarating in its revenge and at the same time heartwarming (to see a child trying her best). To commemorate the first place award in the foreign works category, we conducted an e-mail interview with Mon, the artist in charge of drawing, about such "Konzei ha Toushi ni naru Naru" (This World Will Be Our Lord). We asked him about the story behind the creation of the beloved protagonist, saying, "I sometimes feel as if I am lovingly raising the child together with the readers.

entries.title: Commemorating the first prize in the domestic works category of the "Vertical Reading Manga Award 2025" "It's the tyrant's bad girl you asked for" interview with Tenichi Mail
entries.title_ja: 「タテ読みマンガアワード 2025」国内作品部門1位受賞記念 「お求めいただいた暴君陛下の悪女です」天壱メールインタビュー
entries.description: The "Vertical Reading Manga Award," a manga award for vertically scrolling manga organized by Comic Natalie, was held for the second time, and "It's the Tyrant's Bad Girl You Asked For" won first place in the domestic works category. The work is a story of romance and revenge that begins when Lars, despised as an evil woman by her homeland, gets a chance to return to the past and start her life over a second time. Yudai Sano of INI, who participated in the "Vertical Reading Manga Award 2025" as a guest judge, said, "Every time there is revenge, the exhilaration is amazing. To commemorate winning first place in the domestic works category for "It's the Tyrant His Majesty's Bad Girl You Asked For," we conducted an e-mail interview with Tenichi, who is in charge of the original story and scenario. We asked him about his thoughts on the award and the source of the idea for the revenge scene.

entries.title: Management simulation "Sintopia," which aims to punish sinful souls and prosper in hell, will be released on Steam on April 17, Japan time.
entries.title_ja: 罪深い魂を罰して地獄の繁栄を目指す経営シミュレーション「Sintopia」，日本時間の4月17日にSteamでリリース
entries.description: Team17 announced today (March 25, 2026) that its new title "Sintopia" will be released on April 17, 2026 Japan time. In this dark comedy-style strategy and management simulation game, players take on the role of an administrator who controls the bureaucratic system of Hell, and leads a group of minions called "Employees" under his command to make Hell prosper.

entries.title: Remake of "OFF", now available for PC & Switch with Japanese language support. New battle system and elements to improve comfort are added.
entries.title_ja: リメイク版「OFF」，日本語対応でPC＆Switch向けに配信。バトルシステムの刷新や快適性の向上を図る要素を追加して登場
entries.description: FangamerJapan released a remake of OFF on March 26, 2026. OFF is a free-to-play game by creator MortisGhost that has influenced many other games. The remake version includes an updated battle system, new areas and bosses, and other additional elements.

entries.title: Pokémon Champions" pre-release trial report. Brushed-up system for "easy-to-play" matches shines through!
entries.title_ja: 「Pokémon Champions」配信前先行体験会レポート。“対戦のしやすさ”を追求したシステム面のブラッシュアップが光る
entries.description: Pokémon will release a NintendoSwitch version of its new title "PokémonChampions" on April 8, 2026. Although some information, such as the battle format, has been disclosed, there are still many aspects of this title that are shrouded in mystery. A preliminary trial event was held for the media prior to the release of the game, and we will report on the event.

entries.title: Ruiki, the creator of the "X68000 Z," has released photos of a mysterious piece of hardware. The appearance does not give an idea of what is inside, so what is the "next challenge"?
entries.title_ja: 「X68000 Z」の瑞起が謎のハードウェアの写真を公開。外見から中身は想像できず，“次なる挑戦”とは何なのか
entries.description: Ruiki, known for its various reissued hardware products, has released a photo of a mysterious hardware on its official X account. It is said to be the company's "next challenge," and there are high expectations for what it will be. The photo seems to be some kind of hardware, but only the company logo "ZUIKI" can be seen, and no details have been revealed.

entries.title: Zombie Survival "NAKWON: LAST PARADISE", Closed Alpha Test Play Data Released. Approximately 280,000 people participated, and more than 32 million infected were defeated.
entries.title_ja: ゾンビサバイバル「NAKWON: LAST PARADISE」，クローズドαテストのプレイデータを公開。参加者約28万人，討伐された感染者は3200万体以上
entries.description: Nexon today released play data from the closed alpha test of NAKWON:LASTPARADISE, a PvPvE zombie survival game in development. The total number of participants is 279,484, and the maximum number of simultaneous connections on Steam is 37,000. An "infographic video" summarizing statistics during the test period is also available.

entries.title: ［Etranger Overlord" is an ACT adventure game that is full of entertainment elements, including a villainess, hell, food, and a musical.
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポート］「エトランジュ オーヴァーロード」は悪役令嬢×地獄×グルメ×ミュージカルと娯楽要素が満載なACTアドベンチャー
entries.description: Etrange Overlord," which will be released today (March 26, 2026), is an ACT adventure based on a web novel by Sohei Shinkawa (PN. Kitayama Roman), producer of "Ningyo hime of the Kingdom of Mar" and "Makai Senki Disgaea" series, among others. It was developed by Gem Drop and marketed by Broccoli.

entries.title: Mystery ADV "Snoopy and the Exciting Secret Club", gameplay trailer released. It contains about 13 minutes of the first part of the game.
entries.title_ja: ミステリーADV「スヌーピーとワクワクひみつクラブ」，ゲームプレイトレイラーを公開。ゲーム序盤の約13分を収録
entries.description: 3goo today released a gameplay trailer for "Snoopy and the Exciting Secret Club," which the company plans to release on May 14. In this mystery adventure game, Snoopy and his Peanuts friends form a detective club and investigate mysterious cases. Various events are depicted with a bit of dry humor.

entries.title: The Fun Pimps, developer of "7 Days to Die," joins Behaviour Interactive, known for "Dead by Daylight" and other titles.
entries.title_ja: 「7 Days to Die」開発のThe Fun Pimps，「Dead by Daylight」などで知られるBehaviour Interactiveの傘下に加入
entries.description: TheFunPimps, developer of "7DaystoDie," announced today (March 25, 2026) that it has joined the BehaviourInteractive umbrella, known for "DeadbyDaylight" and other titles. To accompany the announcement, a video featuring comments from RichardHuenink, co-founder of TheFunPimps, is available.

entries.title: Retro Rewind, a management sim that brings up a 1990s video rental store from scratch (Almost a Day Indie Pick Up!)
entries.title_ja: 1990年代のレンタルビデオ店をイチから育てる経営シム「Retro Rewind」（ほぼ日 インディーPick Up！）
entries.description: Today's "Almost a Day Indie PickUp!" introduces "RetroRewind-VideoStoreSimulator. This title is a management simulation in which the player becomes the owner of a video rental store in the 1990s and aims to become the best video store in town while performing videotape stocking and rental operations.

entries.title: ［Interview] "DAMON and BABY" is a touchstone for a new development environment. We will create games with unprecedented approaches to ensure a good life as a developer.
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］「DAMON and BABY」は新たな開発環境の試金石。よき開発者人生を送ってもらうために，これまでにない取り組みでゲームを作る
entries.description: We spoke with Taisuke Ishiwata and Yuji Ota of Arc System Works about "Damon and Baby," which was released today (March 26, 2026). The new action game, which represents a new frontier for the company, was also an effort to ensure the company's survival in the age of indie games.

entries.title: First anniversary of the broadcast of the anime "The Summer the Light Died" is being commemorated with the first music event of the work to be held in July.

entries.title: Idolatry": Win the Saba competition to debut your beloved idol! A brain-driven idol manga depicting the ultimate "guessing game"!
entries.title_ja: 「アイドラトリィ」サバ番を勝ち抜いて最愛の推しをデビューさせる！究極の“推し活”を描く頭脳型アイドルマンガ
entries.description: Cyanna Yomi is an idol geek whose life's purpose is to promote her beloved guess, Fuwari Tsukishiro. One day, the idol group that she belongs to suddenly breaks up. In her disappointment, she learns that Fuwari is going to try out for an idol audition program, and decides to enter the audition herself in order to lead her to the top. Idolatry" is serialized in Magazine Pocket.

entries.title: A story of the strongest sword saint reincarnated as a beautiful girl maid who protects a young lady by replacing her sword with a broom, volume 1.

entries.description:
3D Animated Film "KPOP Girls! Interview with the production team about the use of UE in "Demon Hunters," published by Epic Games.

entries.title: Weekly JOI Bulletin Vol.26 | 【Weekly JOI Dispatch】Hololive Summer Goods Re-release Bonanza! Chiikawa Movie Café Launch & Anime Announcements Galore This Week
entries.title_ja: 週間JOI通信 Vol.26｜ホロライブ夏グッズ再販祭り！映画ちいかわカフェも開幕、アニメ新作発表ラッシュで今週は目白押し
entries.description:
The otaku scene from June 15-21, 2026 exploded with summer re-releases, new merch drops, and anime announcements! Highlights include the joyful return of Hololive Ichiban Kuji pre-orders, detailed reveals for the Chiikawa movie collab café, and the 3rd PV for 『Unconscious Saint』. Wallets and schedules are working overtime. VTuber streaming tech upgrades and cosplay event fever also demand attention. Next week: watch for Gunpla new releases and TOKYO ANIME NEXT updates.

## 🎉 ホロライブ夏祭り再び！一番くじ受注再販でちょこのっこフィギュア大集合

ファンが待ち望んだニュースが飛び込んできました。**ホロライブの新作一番くじが受注再販**を開始！ときのそら、宝鐘マリンをはじめとする人気メンバーの「ちょこのっこ」フィギュアが勢揃いする豪華ラインナップです。前回即完売だった方も、これでリベンジのチャンス到来。さらに同じくホロライブからは、**『ホロライブOCG』エクストラブースター『サマー・ホログラム』**の収録カードが続々公開中。水着姿の白銀ノエルや宝鐘マリンなど、夏らしい眩しいビジュアルが話題を呼んでいます。カードゲームファンもコレクターも、夏に向けて準備万端の一週間でした。

## 🍰 映画『ちいかわ』コラボカフェが開催決定！「島二郎のカツカレー」など名場面再現メニューが盛り沢山

ちいかわファン必見のニュースです。**映画『ちいかわ』の世界観を再現したコラボカフェ**が開催決定！「島二郎のカツカレーと貝汁」や「セイレーンのたいへんよく漬けましたプレート」など、作中の名シーンを彷彿とさせるフードメニューが盛り沢山とのこと。SNSではすでに「絶対行く！」「予約戦争になりそう」との声が続出しています。また、7月10日からは**映画ちいかわTシャツ全4種**（人魚の島のひみつ、WARNING、WELCOME ISLAND、セイレーン）も順次発売予定。カフェ巡りとグッズ収集、どちらも楽しめる夏になりそうです。

## 📺 アニメ新作ラッシュ＆PV公開！『無自覚聖女』『身代わり令嬢』『恋する乙女の作り方』に注目

今週はアニメファンにとって情報過多な一週間でした。まず**『無自覚聖女』の第3弾PV**が公開され、OP主題歌を花耶、EDをウタヒメドリーム オールスターズが担当することが判明。さらに**ライトノベル原作『身代わり令嬢』**には市ノ瀬加那、千葉翔也、日笠陽子、青木瑠璃子という豪華声優陣が参加決定。そして大きなサプライズが、万丈梓『**恋する乙女の作り方**』のTVアニメ化発表！コスメ男子×男の娘というユニークなラブコメが映像化されるとあって、早くも話題沸騰中です。また、10月からは池袋で新アニメイベント**『TOKYO ANIME NEXT』**が開催予定。日本アニメの魅力を国内外に発信する大型企画として期待が高まっています。

## 🎮 ガンプラ＆フィギュア新商品、7月発売スケジュール続々公開

モデラー＆コレクターの皆さん、財布の準備はできていますか？BANDAI SPIRITSから**2026年7月発売スケジュール**が公開され、7月11日には**HGCEグフイグナイテッド（ハイネ専用機）**がリニューアル登場。赤と黒のカラーリングが眩しい機体が、最新の技術で蘇ります。また、**『ヤマトよ永遠に REBEL3199』より1/1000宇宙戦艦アリゾナ**の新商品画像も一挙お披露目。さらに『ヒロアカ』からは**トガヒミコの"艶感"にこだわったプライズフィギュア**が順次展開予定。迫力のサイズと再現度で、ファンの注目を集めています。ベイブレードファンには、タカラトミーモールで7月より**『BEYBLADE X』の抽選販売**が実施される重要なお知らせも。入手困難な人気商品を狙うチャンスです。

## 🎤 VTuber界隈も進化中！カバー新配信システム試験導入＆コスプレイベント熱気高まる

技術革新の波はVTuber業界にも。**カバー株式会社が新配信システムをmekParkとholoANに試験導入**するとのニュースが発表されました。より高品質で安定した配信環境の実現に向けた大きな一歩です。また、今週も**VTuberおすすめ動画特集（～6月19日）**が公開され、見逃せない名場面が続々紹介されています。

一方、リアルイベントも盛り上がりを見せており、サンリオフェス2026では**Gugenkaがポチャッコと遊べるMRゲーム＆ハローキティとふれ合えるMRグリーティング**を提供予定。さらに『ケロロ軍曹』の公開記念キャンペーンがSHIBUYA109で実施され、デジタルスタンプラリーなどが楽しめます。コスプレ界隈では、台湾や香港の美女レイヤーによる『NIKKE』『ゼンゼロ』『崩スタ』など人気ゲームキャラの高クオリティコスプレ写真が多数公開され、SNSで大きな反響を呼んでいます。

## 🔮 来週の注目ポイント

1. **7月ガンプラ新商品の予約開始**：HGCEグフイグナイテッド（ハイネ専用機）をはじめ、夏の新作ラインナップが出揃います。
2. **『TOKYO ANIME NEXT』続報**：10月開催予定の新アニメイベント、出展作品やゲストの続報に期待。
3. **『恋する乙女の作り方』アニメ化詳細**：制作スタジオやキャスト発表が待たれる注目作。続報をお見逃しなく。

今週もヲタク界隈は盛りだくさんでしたね。次回の週刊JOI通信もお楽しみに！
entries.summary_ja: 2026年6月15日～21日のヲタク界隈は、夏に向けた再販・新商品ラッシュとアニメ新作発表が目白押し！ホロライブ一番くじの嬉しい受注再販、映画『ちいかわ』コラボカフェの詳細公開、『無自覚聖女』第3弾PVなど、財布とスケジュール帳が忙しくなる一週間でした。VTuber配信システムの進化や、コスプレイベントの熱気も見逃せません。来週はガンプラ新商品発売とTOKYO ANIME NEXTの続報に注目です。

## 🎉 Hololive Summer Festival Redux! Ichiban Kuji Pre-Orders Return with ChoconoKKo Figure Lineup

Fans got the news they'd been waiting for: **Hololive's new Ichiban Kuji is back for pre-orders!** The lineup features adorable ChoconoKKo figures of beloved members like Tokino Sora and Houshou Marine. Those who missed out on the instant sellout last time now have their revenge arc. Additionally, **Hololive OCG Extra Booster 『Summer Hologram』** card reveals continue to drop—showcasing summery visuals like swimsuit-clad Shirogane Noel and Marine that have fans buzzing. Card game enthusiasts and collectors alike are gearing up for a scorching summer.

## 🍰 Chiikawa Movie Collab Café Announced! Iconic Menu Items Like 「Island Jiro's Katsu Curry」 Recreate Film Scenes

Chiikawa fans, mark your calendars! A **collaboration café themed around the Chiikawa movie** has been confirmed, featuring food items that bring iconic scenes to life—like 「Island Jiro's Katsu Curry & Shellfish Soup」 and 「Siren's Perfectly Marinated Plate.」 Social media is already ablaze with 「I'm definitely going!」 and 「Reservation wars incoming.」 Starting July 10, **four types of Chiikawa movie T-shirts** (Mermaid Island Secret, WARNING, WELCOME ISLAND, Siren) will also launch sequentially. It's shaping up to be a summer of café pilgrimages and merch hunts.

## 📺 Anime Announcement Avalanche! 『Unconscious Saint』, 『Substitute Lady』, 『Making of a Maiden in Love』 Lead the Charge

This week delivered information overload for anime fans. First, the **3rd PV for 『Unconscious Saint』** dropped, revealing that Hanaya will perform the OP and Utahime Dream All Stars the ED. Then, **light novel adaptation 『Substitute Lady』** locked in a star-studded voice cast including Ichinose Kana, Chiba Shouya, Hiyashi Yoko, and Aoki Ruriko. The biggest surprise? Manjo Azusa's **『Making of a Maiden in Love』 announced for TV anime**—a unique rom-com about a cosmetics-loving boy and a male-presenting-as-female character that's already trending. Plus, October will see the launch of **『TOKYO ANIME NEXT』**, a new large-scale anime event in Ikebukuro aimed at promoting Japanese animation domestically and internationally.

## 🎮 Gunpla & Figure New Products—July Release Schedule Rolls Out

Modelers and collectors, is your wallet ready? BANDAI SPIRITS unveiled its **July 2026 release schedule**, with the **HGCE Gouf Ignited (Heine Custom)** landing on July 11—a renewed kit flaunting striking red-and-black colors. New product images for the **1/1000 Space Battleship Arizona from 『Yamato Forever REBEL3199』** were also showcased. Meanwhile, 『My Hero Academia』 fans can look forward to a **Toga Himiko prize figure emphasizing her 「glossy allure,」** rolling out in impressive scale and detail. Beyblade enthusiasts should note that Takara Tomy Mall will hold **lottery sales for 『BEYBLADE X』** starting in July—a rare chance to snag hard-to-get items.

## 🎤 VTuber Scene Evolves! Cover's New Streaming System Trials & Cosplay Event Fever Rises

Technological innovation is hitting the VTuber sphere. **Cover Corporation announced trial deployment of a new streaming system on mekPark and holoAN**, marking a major step toward higher-quality, more stable broadcasts. This week also featured the **weekly VTuber video highlights (through June 19)**, showcasing must-see moments.

On the IRL event front, Sanrio Fes 2026 will offer **Gugenka-powered MR games with Pochacco and MR greetings with Hello Kitty**. Meanwhile, 『Keroro Gunso』 is running a commemorative campaign at SHIBUYA109 with digital stamp rallies and more. In the cosplay world, high-quality shoots of popular game characters like 『NIKKE』, 『Zenless Zone Zero』, and 『Honkai: Star Rail』 by stunning cosplayers from Taiwan and Hong Kong flooded social media, drawing massive reactions.

## 🔮 Next Week's Watchlist

1. **July Gunpla Pre-Orders Open**: HGCE Gouf Ignited (Heine Custom) and other summer kits line up.
2. **『TOKYO ANIME NEXT』 Updates**: Stay tuned for exhibitor and guest announcements for the October event.
3. **『Making of a Maiden in Love』 Anime Details**: Fans eagerly await studio and cast reveals for this buzzworthy title.

Another jam-packed week in the otaku world! See you in the next Weekly JOI Dispatch!

entries.description:
This week brought a scorching lineup of fall anime sequels and summer-season PV drops. Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 lands in October, while Rumiko Takahashi's MAO gears up for a two-cour run from April 2026—thrilling both nostalgic fans and newcomers. On the merch front, Dragon Ball Z duel figures, Chiikawa Park's first anniversary specials, and fresh Kirby goods flooded the market. Meanwhile, cosplay spotlights shone on a stunning Hong Kong cosplayer's Azur Lane Shinano and eye-catching NIKKE outfits. Next week: final intel before summer anime kicks off in earnest!

## 🎬 アニメ情報 ─ 秋＆2026年春の続編ラッシュが加速

今週は**続編アニメの公式発表**が相次ぎました。まず『**佐々木とピーちゃん**』Season2が**2026年10月放送決定**、新PVと新ビジュアルが一挙解禁され、異世界転生×中年サラリーマンの組み合わせに再び注目が集まっています。さらに高橋留美子先生の『**MAO**』が**2026年4月から連続2クール**で放送開始と発表され、キービジュアルも公開。るーみっくファンには見逃せない情報です。

夏クール直前では『**二十世紀電氣目録-ユーレカ・エヴリカ-**』がキービジュアル第3弾と放送直前PVを公開、レトロ×SF感が高まる演出に期待が高まります。また『**とんがり帽子のアトリエ**』最終話の先行映像も配信され、リチェの険しい表情を捉えたビジュアルがファンの心を鷲掴みにしています。

**体験版＆ゲーム動向**では『Staffer Retro: 超能力推理クエスト』体験版Act 2が6月16日から期間限定配信開始。アドベンチャーゲーム好きは要チェックです。

---

## 🎁 フィギュア＆グッズ ─ ドラゴンボール、ちいかわ、カービィが大暴れ

### 📦 話題のフィギュア

- **『ドラゴンボールZ』孫悟空VSベジータ**  
  伝説の初対決シーンが迫力の造形で甦るプライズフィギュアが順次展開中。並べて飾れば名バトルが自宅に再現できます。

- **『カードキャプターさくら クリアカード編』木之本桜**  
  一番くじ『Blessed collection』が11月上旬発売予定。白とゴールドのカラーリングが美しいオープニングコスチューム姿で立体化されます。

- **『機動警察パトレイバー』MG イングラム2号機/3号機**  
  Amazonで販売再開中！ 往年のロボアニメファンは今がチャンス。

### 🧸 キャラクターグッズ

- **ちいかわパーク1周年記念**  
  入場者特典として数量限定＆ランダムで『まめまめフィギュア チャーム マーカー』がプレゼント。現地イベントの盛り上がりが続きます。

- **ちいかわ『ボンボンドロップシール』**  
  6月16日から先着販売開始。モモンガや古本屋など全4種のラインナップがファンの収集欲を刺激中。

- **『星のカービィ』6月の新作グッズ**  
  絵本シリーズ『いつでもカービィ』フレークシールや、飛んでいるように見える『とびマス』フィギュアなど、コレクター心をくすぐるアイテムが続々。

### 🎮 コラボ＆アパレル

- **グラニフ×『キングダム ハーツ』**  
  ソラたちのTシャツやXIII機関パーカーなど全19種が6月16日発売。オシャレとオタクの両立が叶います。

- **GU×『パペットスンスン』**  
  アイスクリームテーマのTシャツ、パジャマなど全15種が追加予約販売中。普段使いできるキャラものとして人気沸騰。

- **アベイル×『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険』第4部**  
  東方仗助、吉良吉影ら4人をイメージしたバッグ・ポーチ類が6月20日発売。ジョジョ立ちしながらお出かけできそうです。

---

## 🎉 イベント＆コラボカフェ ─ 米津玄師×カラオケパセラで歌唱キャンペーン

今週の現地系トピックでは、**カラオケパセラ×米津玄師『烏』歌唱キャンペーン**が展開中。音楽ファン必見のコラボ企画で、カラオケ好きヲタクにはたまらない内容です。

また、ちいかわパークのオープン1周年イベントが引き続き盛況で、来場者特典のフィギュアチャーム目当てに足を運ぶファンが後を絶ちません。

---

## 📸 コスプレ＆VTuber ─ 香港美女レイヤーとバーチャルシーンの新展開

### 🌟 今週の注目コスプレ

- **『アズールレーン』信濃（香港美女レイヤー）**  
  妖精のようなシースルー衣装が艷やか。しなやかなS字ラインで視線を独占し、写真9枚が各所で話題に。

- **『NIKKE』ミハラ＆ドロシー**  
  艶っぽいボンデージ衣装や、ちらりと見える太もも×レースのタイツがセクシーすぎると評判。美スタイルとポージングの作り込みが見事。

- **『ゼンゼロ』0号・アンビー**  
  等身大フィギュアのような完璧なスタイルに見惚れる人が続出。ゲームキャラの再現度が高すぎると話題沸騰。

### 🎤 VTuberニュース

- **バーチャルシンガーYuNi、独立＆会社設立**  
  所属事務所を退所し、自身の会社を設立して音楽活動に注力すると発表。今後の動向に注目が集まります。

- **GEMS COMPANY、再始動を発表**  
  バーチャルアイドルグループが新体制でリスタート。ファンからは期待の声が続々。

- **『ゆうぎり高校』デビュー**  
  『あおぎり高校』の姉妹校として新人5名がデビュー。VTuberシーンの勢力図がさらに拡大中。

---

## 🔮 来週の注目ポイント

1. **夏アニメ本格スタート前の最終PVラッシュ**  
   7月開始作品の最終告知が相次ぐ見込み。見逃し厳禁。

2. **ガンプラ『HG ガンダムサンドロック改 EW』抽選締切**  
   プレバン抽選販売の応募期限が6月17日15時まで。欲しい人は急げ！

3. **コラボカフェ＆イベント情報の追加発表**  
   夏に向けた新企画が続々解禁される時期。公式SNSのチェックをお忘れなく。

---

**編集後記**  
今週は続編アニメとグッズ展開が充実した一週間でした。特に『佐々木とピーちゃん』Season2と『MAO』の連続2クール発表は、2026年秋〜2027年春のアニメスケジュールを一気に華やかにしてくれそうです。コスプレ界隈も香港レイヤーのクオリティ高すぎ問題が話題で、国内外のファンが刺激を受けています。来週も熱いニュースをお届けしますので、お楽しみに！
entries.summary_ja: 今週は秋アニメの続編告知と夏クール直前PVラッシュが熱い一週間でした。『佐々木とピーちゃん』Season2が10月放送決定、高橋留美子先生の『MAO』も2026年4月に連続2クール放送が発表され、往年のファンも新規層も大注目。フィギュア＆グッズ方面ではドラゴンボール対決フィギュア、ちいかわパーク1周年記念、カービィ新作グッズが続々展開中。さらにコスプレ記事では『アズールレーン』信濃の香港美女レイヤーや『NIKKE』コスが話題沸騰。来週は夏アニメ本格スタート前の最終情報チェックが必須です！

entries.article_markdown_en:
## 🎬 Anime Updates — Fall & Spring 2026 Sequel Rush Accelerates

This week saw a **flurry of official sequel announcements**. First up, **Sasaki and Peeps Season 2** drops in **October 2026**, complete with a fresh PV and key visual—rekindling buzz around the isekai-meets-salaryman premise. Meanwhile, Rumiko Takahashi's **MAO** kicks off a **two-cour run from April 2026**, with its key visual already unveiled. Rumiko fans, mark your calendars.

Ahead of summer, **20th Century Electric Catalogue (Eureka Eureka)** released its third key visual and a pre-broadcast PV, ramping up the retro-SF hype. **Witch Hat Atelier**'s final episode preview also landed, spotlighting Riche's intense expression and gripping fans worldwide.

On the **game front**, *Staffer Retro: Paranormal Investigation Quest* launches its Act 2 demo on June 16 for a limited run—adventure game aficionados, take note.

---

## 🎁 Figures & Merch — Dragon Ball, Chiikawa, Kirby Dominate

### 📦 Spotlight Figures

- **Dragon Ball Z: Goku vs. Vegeta**  
  The legendary first clash returns as a powerhouse prize figure series. Display them side by side to recreate the epic showdown at home.

- **Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card — Sakura Kinomoto**  
  The *Ichiban Kuji: Blessed collection* arrives in early November, featuring Sakura's white-and-gold opening costume in stunning detail.

- **Patlabor MG Ingram Units 2 & 3**  
  Back in stock on Amazon—classic mecha fans, now's your chance.

### 🧸 Character Goods

- **Chiikawa Park 1st Anniversary**  
  Limited-edition *Mamemame Figure Charm Markers* distributed to visitors. The on-site buzz continues unabated.

- **Chiikawa Bonbon Drop Seals**  
  Sold first-come, first-served from June 16. Four designs (Momonga, secondhand bookstore, etc.) fuel collector fervor.

- **Kirby's June Lineup**  
  *Itsudemo Kirby* picture-book flake stickers and the gravity-defying *Tobi-Masu* figures tickle fans' hoarding instincts.

### 🎮 Collabs & Apparel

- **Graniph × Kingdom Hearts**  
  Nineteen items—including Sora tees and Organization XIII hoodies—launch June 16. Fashion meets fandom flawlessly.

- **GU × Puppet Sun-Sun**  
  Ice-cream-themed tees and pajamas (15 varieties) up for additional pre-orders. Everyday wearables with character charm.

- **Avail × JoJo Part 4**  
  Bags and pouches inspired by Josuke Higashikata, Yoshikage Kira, and crew drop June 20. Perfect for striking a pose on the go.

---

## 🎉 Events & Collab Cafés — Yonezu Kenshi × Karaoke Pasela Campaign

This week's on-the-ground highlight: **Karaoke Pasela × Yonezu Kenshi *Karasu* Singing Campaign**. Music-loving otaku, don't miss this collab.

Meanwhile, Chiikawa Park's first-anniversary festivities continue to draw crowds eager for those charm-marker freebies.

---

## 📸 Cosplay & VTubers — Hong Kong Beauties & Virtual Scene Shakeups

### 🌟 Cosplay Highlights

- **Azur Lane's Shinano (Hong Kong Cosplayer)**  
  Sheer fairy-like attire and a sinuous S-curve silhouette commanded attention across nine viral photos.

- **NIKKE's Mihara & Dorothy**  
  Sultry bondage gear and lace-thigh peeks turned heads. Impeccable styling and posing prowess on full display.

- **ZenZero's Anby (Unit 0)**  
  Life-size-figure-level perfection. Fans couldn't help but gawk at the game-accurate reproduction.

### 🎤 VTuber News

- **Virtual Singer YuNi Goes Independent**  
  Exited her agency and founded her own company to focus on music. Eyes on her next moves.

- **GEMS COMPANY Reboots**  
  The virtual idol group relaunches under a new setup. Fan anticipation runs high.

- **Yugiri High School Debuts**  
  Aogiri High's sister school welcomes five new talents. The VTuber landscape keeps expanding.

---

## 🔮 Next Week's Watch List

1. **Final Summer-Anime PV Blitz**  
   Expect last-minute trailers for July premieres. Don't blink.

2. **Gunpla HG Sandrock Kai EW Lottery Deadline**  
   Premium Bandai entries close June 17 at 15:00. Act fast if you want in.

3. **New Collab Café & Event Reveals**  
   Summer-bound projects will drop soon. Keep official socials on speed dial.

---

**Editor's Note**  
This week delivered a rich mix of sequel announcements and merch madness. *Sasaki and Peeps* Season 2 and *MAO*'s two-cour commitment brighten the fall-to-spring anime calendar considerably. Meanwhile, Hong Kong cosplayers' sky-high quality sparked global admiration. Stay tuned for more scorching updates next week!

entries.title: Weekly JOI Bulletin Vol.24 | Persona 6 & New Crash Bandicoot Revealed! Gaming Showcases Heat Up Before Nintendo Direct + Taiwan Cosplay Scene Takes Center Stage

entries.description:
Xbox Games Showcase 2026 dropped bombshells with Persona 6 and a new Crash Bandicoot title, while anticipation peaks for tomorrow's 50-minute Nintendo Direct (June 9, 23:00 JST). Meanwhile, Taiwanese cosplayers dominated this week's photo reports with jaw-dropping recreations of Wuthering Waves and Zenless Zone Zero characters, backed by official event coverage. Other highlights: Sakatsuku 2026 Ver2.0 details, STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT first-press bonuses, and Nijisanji unit Nornis announcing their disbandment. A whirlwind week across anime, games, and VTuber scenes!

## 🎮 ゲーム界の電撃発表ラッシュ――Xbox＆ニンダイ前夜祭

今週最大の話題は**Xbox Games Showcase 2026**で飛び出した『ペルソナ6』と新作『クレッシュ・バンディクー』の公式発表。特に『ペルソナ6』はシリーズファン待望の続編とあって、SNSでは「#P6」トレンド入りが続出。一方、『クレタク』新作はノスタルジックなアクション復活への期待が高まり、往年のファンが歓喜の声を上げています[^1]。

さらに翌**6月9日23時には「Nintendo Direct 2026.6.9」が約50分の大ボリュームで配信決定**。任天堂ファンの間では「何が来るか」予想合戦が過熱中。前回のニンダイから間が空いていたこともあり、新作タイトルや続報の嵐が予想されています[^2]。この勢いのまま来週へ突入しそうです！

一方、国内では**『サカつく2026』のVer2.0大型アップデート詳細が6月5日に発表**され、既存プレイヤーの期待も上昇。また『STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT』のパッケージ版初回特典にスピンオフADVが同梱されることも判明し、シュタゲファンには見逃せない情報となっています[^3][^4]。

## 🎬 アニメ＆マンガ動向――実写化・応援上映・大阪初上陸

アニメ・マンガ界では**実写ドラマ化の波**が止まりません。蜜柑子『35歳、今さら恋とかありえない』が石黒英雄＆入来茉里のW主演で映像化決定。また『トーキョーカモフラージュアワー』は連載約6年半の歴史に幕を下ろし、実写ドラマ化も実現した作品としてファンに惜しまれています[^12][^13]。

## 🎁 グッズ＆くじ情報――GU×エヴァ、マンダロリアン、サッカー日本代表

物販・くじ系では**GU×『新世紀エヴァンゲリオン』コラボ**が「激アツ」と話題。綾波レイや初号機をヴィンテージ風Tシャツにデザインし、ファッション×アニメの融合が好評を博しています[^19]。

映画『マンダロリアン・アンド・グローグー』は**興行収入20億円突破記念**として第4弾特典に「グローグー」のメモリアルフォトが追加。スター・ウォーズファンの心をつかんで離しません[^20]。

スポーツ×オタク融合では**「一番くじ サッカー日本代表」**が登場。ラストワン賞は『最高の景色を2026』の台座付きサインボールで、サッカーファンとくじファンの両方からテンション爆上がりの声が上がっています[^21]。

## 🎮 Gaming's Bombshell Week: Xbox Showcase & Nintendo Direct Eve

This week's biggest splash came from **Xbox Games Showcase 2026**, which officially unveiled *Persona 6* and a brand-new *Crash Bandicoot* title. The *Persona 6* reveal sent series fans into a frenzy, with "#P6" trending worldwide. Meanwhile, nostalgic *Crash* fans rejoiced at the prospect of the classic platformer's return[^1].

Hot on Xbox's heels, **Nintendo Direct 2026.6.9** drops tomorrow (June 9, 23:00 JST) with a whopping **50-minute runtime**. Speculation is running wild across social media as Nintendo fans brace for a potential deluge of new announcements and long-awaited updates[^2].

On the domestic front, **Sakatsuku 2026's Ver2.0 major update details** were announced on June 5, raising excitement among existing players. Also noteworthy: *STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT*'s physical first-press edition will bundle a spin-off ADV, a must-grab for Steins;Gate devotees[^3][^4].

[^1]: Persona 6 & New Crash Bandicoot Too! Xbox Games Showcase 2026 Announcements Roundup (Game Spark)  
[^2]: The Long-Awaited "Nindai" Is Here! Nintendo Direct 2026.6.9 Airs June 9, 23:00 JST — 50 Minutes of Hype (Game Spark)  
[^3]: Sakatsuku 2026 Ver2.0 Major Update Details to Be Announced June 5 (4Gamer)  
[^4]: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT Physical Edition Bundles Spin-off ADV as First-Press Bonus (4Gamer)

## 📸 Taiwan Cosplay Scene Dominates: Wuthering Waves & Zenless Zone Zero Official Events

This week's cosplay coverage was **utterly dominated by Taiwanese cosplayers** delivering jaw-dropping accuracy. The highlight: *Wuthering Waves* **2nd Anniversary Fes.** official photo report featuring **52 images** of elite cosplayers embodying Rover, Mortefi, and Yinlin with "live-action movie" levels of detail[^5][^6][^7].

*Zenless Zone Zero* also shone, with **Hong Kong beauties nailing Qingyi and Anby's slender silhouettes**. The combo of blonde gyaru vibes + thigh-high boots earned universal praise as "perfect beauty incarnate"[^8][^9].

Elsewhere, meticulously crafted builds of *FGO*'s Jeanne d'Arc Alter, *Expelled from Paradise*'s Angela, and *Evangelion*'s Asuka in rock-band attire flooded timelines. Nostalgic picks like *Ranma ½*'s Shampoo and *Madoka Magica*'s Madoka also made triumphant returns in modern-day shoots[^10][^11].

## 🎬 Anime & Manga Updates: Live-Action Adaptations, Cheer Screenings & Osaka Debut

The **live-action adaptation wave** shows no signs of slowing. Mikanko's *Can't Fall in Love Now at 35* scored a drama adaptation starring Hideaki Kuroshio & Mari Iriki, while *Tokyo Camouflage Hour* wrapped its ~6.5-year serialization after successfully transitioning to live-action[^12][^13].

In theaters, the **simultaneous cheer screening of *Semper Paratus! Kintsua × Sharknado 6*** became a viral "miracle synergy" event, with B-movie fans flooding social media with "chaotic brilliance" reactions[^14].

Osaka welcomed **Chiikawa Bakery's first-ever store**, complete with Osaka-exclusive "Takosen Burger" and limited tees—a must-visit for Kansai-based fans of the adorable franchise[^15].

## 🎤 VTuber & Collab Frontlines: Unit Disbandment, Indie Game Launch, Merch Drops

Nijisanji's unit **Nornis (Inui Toko & Machita Chima) announced their disbandment**, with both talents shifting focus to solo activities. Fans expressed bittersweet farewells while anticipating their next chapters[^16].

On a brighter note, **VTuber Marie Android's self-developed game *Marie Android* hits Steam**, earning massive kudos for her indie dev hustle. Supportive comments like "I'll buy it Day 1!" flooded her channels[^17].

Merch-wise, **Hololive's miComet (Sakura Miko & Hoshimachi Suisei) × JOYSOUND collab** was announced, featuring life-size acrylic stands and other original goods—a karaoke + VTuber fan's dream combo[^18].

**GU×Neon Genesis Evangelion collab** ignited hype with vintage-style tees featuring Rei Ayanami and EVA Unit-01—a fusion of fashion and anime that fans called "fire"[^19].

*The Mandalorian & Grogu* film **crossed ¥2 billion at the box office**, celebrating with a 4th bonus gift: Grogu memorial photo. Star Wars fans couldn't get enough[^20].

Sports×otaku crossover peaked with **Ichiban Kuji: Japan National Soccer Team**, whose Last One Prize—a signed ball on a pedestal reading "The Best View in 2026"—sent both soccer and lottery fans into overdrive[^21].

Also notable: **Haikyu!! new FuRyu lottery** spotlights Nekoma High (Kenma, Kuroo, Coach Nekomata) with intricately detailed figures[^22], while **Dragon Ball Z's Mr. Satan prize figure** captures his iconic World Tournament glory pose[^23].

entries.title: Weekly JOI Bulletin Vol.23 | Kizuna AI Digital Figure, Pokémon Card 30th Anniversary Pack, and Nijisanji Fes 2026 On-Site Report Heat Up the Otaku Scene!
entries.title_ja: 週間JOI通信 Vol.23｜キズナアイ新衣装デジタルフィギュア登場、『ポケカ』30周年記念パック発表、にじフェス2026現地レポートが話題に！
entries.description:
This week's otaku scene is packed with new merchandise announcements! Kizuna AI's new song outfit gets digitalized as a figure, Pokémon Card Game reveals its 30th anniversary pack with a new rarity tier, and Pie no Mi's first-ever anime collaboration café is set to open. Plus, a hilarious incident at Wuthering Waves' 2nd anniversary offline event, HUNTER×HUNTER x Graniph collab launch, VTuber event on-site reports, and more unmissable news from the past week!

## 🎮 ゲーム＆アニメの今週ホット話題

### 『ポケカ』30周年記念パックに新レアリティ【FUR】登場

今週最大の話題は『ポケモンカードゲーム』30周年記念拡張パック『30th CELEBRATION』の発表！新レアリティ【FUR】でミュウex・ミュウツーexが収録されるほか、30種類ものピカチュウバリエーションが登場。コレクター魂を揺さぶる豪華ラインナップに、SNSでは早くも予約合戦の気配が漂っています。

### 『HUNTER×HUNTER』グラニフコラボがついに発売

ファン待望のグラニフ×アニメ『HUNTER×HUNTER』コラボが満を持して発売開始。ゴン、キルア、ヒソカのドッジボール共闘シーンをプリントしたパーカーなど全20種類がラインナップ。あの名シーンを纏えるとあって、即完売必至のアイテムです。

### 『鳴潮』2周年オフイベで着ぐるみツバキが珍事件

『鳴潮』2周年オフラインイベントで、着ぐるみツバキがファンのぬいぐるみをハンマーで吹き飛ばして紛失させるハプニングが発生。幸い無事発見されたものの、公式の【やりすぎ】演出にファンからは笑いと驚きの声が上がりました。こういうハチャメチャ感も含めて愛されるコンテンツですね！

## 🎭 VTuber＆イベント系トピック

### にじさんじフェス2026現地体験レポートが感動を呼ぶ

初参加者による『にじさんじフェス2026』現地レポートが大きな反響を呼んでいます。大型VTuberイベントならではの臨場感、ファン同士の一体感、そしてステージパフォーマンスのクオリティに【初めてでここまで感動するとは】との声が続出。来年の参戦を決意した人も多いのでは？

### 家長むぎの勉強配信企画がスポンサー獲得

にじさんじVTuber家長むぎさんの人気企画『Study with me』に、株式会社ネストピがスポンサー参加。Lo-Fiゲーム『Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story』のPRとして展開され、勉強配信とゲームプロモーションの新しいコラボ形態として注目を集めています。

### おすすめVTuber動画週間まとめ（～5月29日）

Mogura VRによる今週のおすすめVTuber動画まとめでは、切り抜き職人たちが厳選した珠玉の配信アーカイブが紹介されました。見逃した配信もこれでチェック完璧！

## 🗿 フィギュア＆グッズの発売・予約注目情報

### キズナアイ新曲衣装がデジタルフィギュアに

キズナアイの新曲『KAMACHO』で披露された『KAMATTE AI』衣装が、3Dビューワーアプリ『ホロモデル』にデジタルフィギュアとして登場。VTuber文化とデジタルコレクションの融合が加速しています。

### 『モンハン』アイコンモチーフのラバーマスコット全10種ガシャポン展開

entries.article_markdown_en:
## 🎮 Hot Topics in Games & Anime This Week

### Pokémon Card Game 30th Anniversary Pack Introduces New Rarity [FUR]

The biggest news this week is the announcement of the Pokémon Card Game's 30th anniversary expansion pack, '30th CELEBRATION'! Featuring a new rarity tier [FUR] with Mew ex and Mewtwo ex, plus 30 different Pikachu variations, this collector's dream lineup is already sparking reservation wars on social media.

### HUNTER×HUNTER x Graniph Collab Finally Launches

The long-awaited Graniph x HUNTER×HUNTER anime collaboration has officially launched, featuring hoodies printed with the iconic dodgeball teamwork scene of Gon, Killua, and Hisoka among 20 total items. Fans can now wear that legendary moment—expect these to sell out fast!

### Wuthering Waves 2nd Anniversary Event Features Mascot Tsubaki Incident

At the Wuthering Waves 2nd anniversary offline event, the mascot Tsubaki accidentally launched a fan's plushie with a hammer, temporarily losing it. Fortunately, it was found safe and sound, but the [over-the-top] official performance sparked both laughter and surprise from fans. This chaotic energy is part of what makes the franchise beloved!

## 🎭 VTuber & Event Highlights

### Nijisanji Fes 2026 On-Site Experience Report Moves Hearts

A first-timer's on-site report from Nijisanji Fes 2026 has generated massive buzz. The live atmosphere unique to large-scale VTuber events, fan unity, and high-quality stage performances left many saying [I never expected to be this moved on my first time]. Many are already planning to attend next year!

### Ienaga Mugi's Study Stream Secures Sponsor

Nijisanji VTuber Ienaga Mugi's popular 'Study with me' stream has attracted sponsorship from Nestopi Inc., promoting the Lo-Fi game 'Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story.' This marks a new form of collaboration between study streams and game promotions, drawing attention across the industry.

### Weekly Recommended VTuber Videos (Up to May 29)

Mogura VR's curated weekly VTuber video roundup introduced carefully selected archived streams by clip creators. Perfect for catching up on any streams you missed!

## 🗿 Figure & Merchandise Release Highlights

### Kizuna AI's New Song Outfit Becomes Digital Figure

The 'KAMATTE AI' outfit showcased in Kizuna AI's new song 'KAMACHO' is now available as a digital figure on the 3D viewer app 'HoloModel.' The fusion of VTuber culture and digital collectibles continues to accelerate.

### Monster Hunter Icon Rubber Mascots: All 10 Types in Gashapon

From Rathalos to Arshveldo, a stellar Monster Hunter lineup is coming to Gashapon in the 4th week of June. Hunters won't want to miss completing this entire collection.

### Touken Ranbu Mejirushi Accessories Released

The popular 'Mejirushi Accessory #Hashtag Ver.' series welcomes Touken Ranbu, featuring all 10 types including Mikazuki Munechika and Heshikiri Hasebe. Already a hot topic among Saniwa (players) as must-have merch for their favorites.

### Sanrio Magic Wand Collection Looks Too Good

New Sanrio character merchandise including 'My Melody & Kuromi Magic Wand Collection' and three other new items have been announced. These figures blend magical girl elements with Sanrio cuteness—perfect for display!

### Other Notable Merch

- **JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 'JOJO Ball' Gashapon Series 3**: Star Platinum, Crazy Diamond, and more across 4 types
- **Goddess of Victory: NIKKE Wafer 5**: Featuring adorable Rapi & Red Hood lineup, releasing June 15
- **Kirby Picture Book Latest Volume Commemorative Goods**: Ball chain mascots and book tote bags rolling out from June 19
- **UNIQLO x Snoopy New Collection**: College life-themed UV-cut caps, jackets, and more across 9 types

## ☕ Collab Cafés & On-Site Cosplay Events

### Pie no Mi's First Anime Adaptation x Pasela Collab Announced

Lotte's popular snack Pie no Mi is getting its first-ever anime adaptation, with an experiential collaboration at Pasela starting in June. Themed around [watch and eat to enjoy], it features limited menus suitable for families. A fresh take on snack animation!

### Cosplay Features Heat Up

This week saw numerous stunning cosplay photo features, including Zenless Zone Zero's Agent Anby's slender silhouette recreation, Hololive's Sakamata Chloe in cat-ear maid outfit, and Wuthering Waves 2nd anniversary cosplays, primarily on Inside Games. On-site event report photos clearly show the thriving cosplay culture.

### Acosta Ikebukuro Report

A feature spotlighted 8 notable cosplayers at Acosta Ikebukuro, including popular VTuber cosplays like Shiranui Flare and Kazakiri Rurii, across 37 photos. The short-pants looks were especially praised as adorable.

## 📅 What to Watch Next Week

1. **3rd Week of June Gashapon New Release Rush**: Kingdom's Ouki Assort Gashapon, Monster Hunter rubber mascots—gachapon fans, prepare your wallets!
2. **Witch Hat Atelier New Cast Announcement**: Sasaran voiced by Takao Nakao and Yuinii voiced by Hisaya Ishibashi confirmed. More info on the anime's second cour coming soon!
3. **Sound! Euphonium 7th Week Theater Bonus**: Distribution begins for bonuses featuring Kumiko's handwritten message. This might be your last chance to visit the theater!

---

This week's otaku scene was packed with fresh info! Be sure to check out the detailed articles for any news that caught your eye. See you next week in the Weekly JOI Report!
